Explosivo / Sticky Bombs
No longer sticks to monsters.
Eye of the Occult: Isaac can control the mid-flight direction of the head, however its air-time is not increased.
Flat Stone: Will cause Bob's Rotten Head to bounce once, exploding twice and leaving two gas clouds.
Fire Mind: Creates fire when the head lands.
Godhead: Creates a Godhead aura around the head and applies homing effect when thrown.
Haemolacria: When the head lands, tears are fired.
Holy Light: Has a chance to throw a Holy Light head that spawns a damaging beam of light dealing (4x) 3x the explosion damage when it hits an enemy.
Homing tears: Homing is applied to the thrown head as well.
The head will slightly bounce off of walls with spectral tears. It still passes through obstacles.

Lachryphagy: The head act as a tear, dividing itself if enough time has passed and interacting with other tears. The five heads coming from the main head deal half damage. Feeding a head with another increases damage by the amount of damage Isaac has. If a tear is fed with a head, the tear will gain the head's damage.
The Parasite: Causes two smaller tears to appear that explodes for half the damage of the head. Tears do not look like the normal head.
Rubber Cement: Causes the head to bounce off of rocks and walls.
Tiny Planet: When used, Bob's Rotten Head will orbit the player similar to a tear.
Trisagion

Shoots a white blast of light instead of the head that pierces through monsters, and causing explosions when it contacts an enemy (if not killing it at the first tick), an obstacle, or when it runs out of range. One tick of the beam deals 33% of Bob's Rotten Head's damage to monsters, but the resulting explosion every tick deals full damage.
Uranus: Monsters are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.
Worm trinkets: Bob's Rotten Head is affected by trinkets like Hook Worm and Wiggle Worm the same way tears are.

needsReview: The explosion deals a flat 185 + Isaac's tear damage and leaves behind a gas cloud that poisons affected monsters. The poison cloud deals 5 damage.
The poison deals 3 times Isaac's tear damage over time.

effects: Restores one full Red Heart.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Doubles the amount Yum Heart heals.
Jacob and Esau: Heals the character who uses it for a full red heart and the other for half a red heart.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Heals one Coin Hearts; no blue fly is generated.

interactions.text: Maggy's Bow: No effect; will still only replenish one full Red Heart.

name: Lucky Foot
description: +1 luck. Improves Isaac's chances at various random events (independent from the luck stat). Converts all bad pills into good pills, without identifying them.
effects: +1 luck.
Increases chances of winning at Shell Game, , Slot Machine, Fortune Telling Machine, and Confessional.
Increases chances of getting a room-clearing drop (independent from the luck stat).
Increases the chance of a reward from a Beggars or Devil Beggar after each of their first payouts.
On Hard mode, reduces the minimum number of donations for each reward to 2 (from 3).
Does not apply to Key Master, Bomb Bum, Battery Bum, or Rotten Beggar.
Converts all "bad" pills into their "good" counterparts but doesn't affect neutral ones, like PHD. Pills remain unidentified.

interactions.text: False PHD: Pills can both be good or bad again. Taking a bad pill still applies the benefits from False PHD.
Lucky Toe: The extra luck-independent chance of room clearing drops from Lucky Toe applies only in a diminished form, unless at zero or negative luck. This bonus from Lucky Foot is still retained.

name: Doctor's Remote
description: Creates a crosshair on the ground that can be aimed with tear controls. A missile strikes the spot after 2 seconds, creating a heavy damage explosion.
effects: Upon activation, a large red crosshair will appear on the ground. The crosshair can be moved using tear controls.
After approximately 2 seconds, a large missile will land on the red marker. The missile acts like a large bomb explosion, dealing 20 times Isaac's damage (the same as Epic Fetus).

synergies.text: This item shares many of the synergies and interactions with Epic Fetus.
Car Battery: Drops an additional missile after the first one.

interactions.text: Tainted Azazel: Shoots thin Brimstone beams when rocket explodes. This behavior is not shared with Epic Fetus, which produces no brimstone lasers.

needsReview: After approximately 2 seconds, a large missile will land on the red marker. The missile acts like a large bomb explosion, dealing 20 times Isaac's damage (the same as Epic Fetus).

name: Cupid's Arrow
description: Grants Isaac triangular piercing tears that travel through enemies (but not obstacles) instead of breaking on impact with them.
effects: Grants piercing tears that travel through enemies (but not obstacles) instead of breaking on impact with them.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus: Bombs travel through enemies. When combined with Ipecac, bombs do not explode upon hitting enemies.
Bombs also deal 2.5x Isaac's damage to enemies when passing through them.
Fire Mind: Tears will continue to pierce enemies while retaining the explosion chance.
Doesn't pierce through Poop, Fire Places, or enemies.

name: Shoop da Whoop!
description: Fires a laser from Isaac's mouth that deals twice Isaac's tear damage.
effects: When used, the next shot will fire a large, Brimstone-like laser in the direction Isaac shoots that deals double Isaac's tear damage. If Isaac is already shooting, the item immediately activates in that direction.
The laser hits up to 12 times.
Status effects can be applied by the laser.

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt: Allows the item to be charged and used multiple times in a room, which can help with dealing extra damage in enduring fights like most endgame bosses.
9 Volt: Can be used once every room, and more frequently in Challenge Rooms.
Broken Remote: Since item charges aren't expended until Isaac chooses a direction to shoot, the player can teleport across the floor indefinitely.

Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the power of the laser by 2x and +3 flat damage, on top of the 2x base damage already applied by Shoop da Whoop. Enemies who die to the laser under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

Ipecac: Increases the damage of the beam greatly, as Ipecac's +40 flat damage boost is added straight to Shoop Da Whoop whithout any damage decrease unlike Brimstone. This basically allows Isaac to kill most normal bosses in 1 shot.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

name: Steven
description: +1 damage.
effects: +1 damage.

name: Pentagram
description: +1 damage, increases Devil Room / Angel Room chance by 10%.
effects: +1 damage.
Increases chance for a Devil Room / Angel Room door to open by 10%.
This chance is increased to 15% with two or more Pentagrams.

name: Dr. Fetus
description: Tears are replaced by Bombs that benefit from bomb-enhancing effects and slide for a fixed time after being fired.
effects: Tears are replaced with Bombs that explode approximately one second after being fired.

Dr. Fetus has two formulas for calculating the damage it does. At first, each bomb deals 10 times the character's normal tear damage. If the previous formula would lead to the bombs doing more than 60 damage, the bombs instead deal 5 times the character's normal tear damage plus a 30 flat damage. The flat 30 is not affected by damage multipliers.
Tears down: Tear Delay x 2.5 / Fire Rate / 2.5.

Bomb velocity formula has not been updated to account for the new range stat so it uses tear height for calculation (and not the actual range stat), resulting in the range stat effectively not working for Dr. Fetus with exceptions being Number One, Kidney Stone, Pluto, and Inner Child's revive, which make velocity absurdly low. Shot speed still increases bomb velocity.
Bombs grow larger or smaller with tear size modifiers and deal no knockback to each other.

synergies.text: Apple! / Euthanasia / Tough Love: Damage multiplier may be applied to the non-flat damage without a visual difference.
Euthanasia bombs retain the instant kill ability.
Bob's Bladder: Bombs from Dr. Fetus leave creep, allowing for extra damage.
Bobby-Bomb / Homing Tears: Bombs home in on enemies.
Bomber Boy: Bombs explode in a large cross-shaped pattern.
Bomber Boy + Cricket's Body / The Parasite / Polyphemus / Scatter Bombs: The subsequent bomb or bombs explode in a cross-shaped pattern.
Blood Bombs: Bombs leave behind a pool of red creep.

Brimstone Bombs: The activation rate of the Brimstone lasers is random and dependent on Luck. The chance is 11% at 0 Luck, increasing by 3% per luck. This maximizes at 100% at 29.67 luck and minimizes at 0% at -3.67 luck. The beams of Brimstone Bombs can push fired bombs, making this item powerful but hazardous.
Butt Bombs: Bombs inherit the Butt Bomb effects.
The activation rate is random and dependent on luck. The chance is 20% at 0 Luck, increasing by 3% per luck. This maximizes at 100% at 26.67 luck and minimizes at 0% at -6.67 luck.
Unlike normal Butt Bombs, this synergy cannot heal Brownie, Clog, Colostomia, Dangle, or Dingle. Both the explosion and the cloud effect deal full damage.
Poisonous Tears : Fires Bob's Curse bombs.
Cricket's Body: The bombs split outwards into 4 tiny bombs, which detonate almost immediately.
The split bombs deal a flat 21 damage / 35 damage.
Increases range instead of decreasing it.
Cricket's Body + The Parasite: Bombs split outwards into 4 Cricket bombs and 2 Parasite bombs, which detonate and split a second time into the other type, for a total of 23 explosions.

C Section: C Section has priority. Does not apply Dr. Fetus' tears down. The fetuses drop small bombs when they touch an enemy. The bomb's damage follows Dr. Fetus' damage calculation, based on half of the fetuses damage. A fetus can drop only one bomb.

The fetuses' bombs do not benefit from Isaac's bomb effects such as Hot Bombs or Bobby-Bomb. However, they do benefit from Isaac's tear effects and have appearance of the corresponding bombs. For example, Hot Bombs from Fire Mind, Bobby-Bomb from Homing Tears. As such, Cricket's Body, The Parasite and Polyphemus leave a subsequent bomb or bombs, and Mysterious Liquid leaves a creep.
C Section + Ipecac: The fetuses explode before dropping any bomb.

Dr. Fetus: Each additional copy of this item, such as from Diplopia / Crooked Penny, causes Isaac to fire one additional bomb in a side by side spread up to a maximum of 16 bombs. This maximum can’t be surpassed by other multi-shot effects such as 20/20.
Eye of Belial: Bombs get piercing. No more further effect.
Bombs deal 2.5x piercing damage.
Fire Mind / Hot Bombs: The bombs leave behind a fire that damages enemies on contact after exploding, and bombs themselves deal 1 / points of 16 damage on contact.
For Hot Bombs, the activation rate of the fire is dependent on luck. The chance is 26% at 0 Luck, increasing by 6% per luck. This maximizes at 100% at 12.34 luck and minimizes at 0% at -4.34 luck.

Ghost Bombs: Bombs gain spectral and create ghosts when they explode. The activation rate of the ghosts is dependent on luck. The chance is 34% at 0 Luck, increasing by 8% per luck. This maximizes at 100% at 8.25 luck and minimizes at 0% at -4.25 luck.

Ghost Bombs + Almond Milk / Haemolacria / Monstro's Lung / Scatter Bombs / Soy Milk: While the bombs are mini, any created ghosts are smaller too and instantly launch themselves at enemies and explode, destroying nearby enemy tears, similar to Purgatory. They each deal 2x Isaac's damage, up to 4 times.
Godhead: Does not give bombs the damaging aura, but does give them the homing effect.
/The Mulligan: Explosions can spawn flies.

Haemolacria: Haemolacria has priority. Applies +10 Tear Delay after Haemolacria tears down, instead of Dr. Fetus tears down. The main tear is reminiscent of a bomb and scatters into 3-5 bombs that explode simultaneously. The split bombs deal half of Dr. Fetus' damage calculation based on the main tear's damage.
Haemolacria + Sad Bombs: Sad bombs from Haemolacria tears shoot 10 Haemolacria tears, which then scatters into bombs without Sad Bombs' property.

Ipecac: The bombs become Bob's Curse bombs. Isaac is immune to his bomb shots (not explosives or placed bombs). Shots will also explode immediately on impact with enemies, rocks, Poops, angel statues, devil statues, or walls. Does not apply Ipecac's tears down.
The effect on damage becomes a flat +2 bonus instead of +40. Bombs leave behind a cloud of poison gas that will poison enemies in contact with it.
Isaac is immune to the shrapnel bombs left by Cricket's Body, The Parasite, Polyphemus, and Scatter Bombs. Isaac is not immune to Ipecac shots from Sad Bombs.
Ipecac + Monstro's Lung: Isaac is no longer immune to his own bombs, and since they explode as soon as they make contact, it makes self-damage very likely. The flat damage bonus is increased to +40.
Ipecac + Tech X: Isaac is immune to the main bomb shot, but not the explosions created by the laser ring.
Little Horn: Black-tinted bombs can summon Big Horn's hand to instantly kill non-boss enemies or to deal damage against bosses.
Monstro's Lung: Monstro's Lung has priority. Does not apply Dr. Fetus' tears down. Fires 6 bombs which detonate simultaneously / at different times.
Multi-shot effects add 1 bomb to the barrage, up to 21 bombs.
Mr. Mega: Adds 25 flat damage to bomb explosions.
The bonus damage is only applied if the bombs are visually Mr. Mega bombs, which means items like Soy Milk won't get the bonus damage.
Mysterious Liquid: Exploding bombs leave behind a large pool of creep.
The Parasite: Upon exploding, bombs split into two other bombs, which explode almost immediately.
The split bombs deal a flat 24 damage/ 40 damage.
Piercing tears: Bombs deal 2.5x Isaac's damage to enemies when passing through them.
Poison tears: This is guaranteed by Bob's Curse, Ipecac, and Scorpio, and also has a chance to trigger from The Common Cold, Black Tooth, Pinky Eye or Serpent's Kiss.
Poison bombs leave behind a cloud of toxic gas that will poison enemies in contact with it aside from the main target.
Polyphemus: The bombs increase in size and do increased damage.
The bombs become Mr. Mega bombs. After they detonate, they leave behind a regular-sized bomb that deals a flat 60 damage/ 100 damage, much like a standard bomb.
Proptosis: Distance penalty does not apply.
The non-flat damage for Dr. Fetus' damage calculation is doubled / tripled.
Pyromaniac: Explosions heal Isaac, essentially making him invincible as long as he has at least one red heart container.
Remote Detonator: The bombs can be detonated on command, making it easier to hit moving enemies. Unlike placed bombs, they will eventually detonate on their own.
Rocket in a Jar: Shoots rockets.
Piercing tears: Rockets do not pierce through enemies. However, they deal both piercing damage and explosion damage on impact with an enemy.
Rocket in a Jar + Polyphemus: Rockets will “bounce” off of enemies, rocks, and walls, detonating twice. This is easily observable by firing parallel to a wall while moving towards it.
Sad Bombs: Fires tears as normally placed Sad Bombs would.
The activation rate is random and dependent on luck. The chance is 11% at 0 Luck, increasing by 3% per luck. This maximizes at 100% at 29.67 luck and minimizes at 0% at -3.67 luck.
Scatter Bombs: The bombs split into 2-4/ 4-5 tiny bombs. The bombs deal half damage of the bomb it came from.
The activation rate is random and dependent on luck. The chance is 34% at 0 Luck, increasing by 8% per luck. This maximizes at 100% at 8.25 luck and minimizes at 0% at -4.25 luck.
Stye: The bombs have a 50% chance of gaining Stye's damage boost but not its range upgrade/shot speed downgrade. Affected bombs and their explosions are tinted a pale blue.
The damage boost is applied to Isaac's base tear damage and does not affect any other aspect of Dr. Fetus's damage calculation.
Tech X: Dr. Fetus has priority. The bombs have a laser ring around them.
Tech X + Cricket's Body / The Parasite / Polyphemus / Scatter Bombs: The subsequent bomb or bombs do not have the laser ring.
Uranus: The bombs freeze enemies upon killing them.

interactions.text: Compound Fracture
Blasting Cap: Shot bombs cannot drop additional bombs.
Epic Fetus: Overrides Dr. Fetus.
Explosivo: The bombs have a chance of sticking to an enemy. These bombs have the same appearance as Sticky Bombs, but do not spawn spiders or slowing white creep.
Eye Sore: When Isaac shoots, he has a chance to fire 1-3 additional bombs in random directions.

The Forgotten/Tainted Forgotten: A live bomb will spawn on top of The Forgotten when he starts charging his attack. The Forgotten will toss bombs after releasing the charge; airborne bombs deal 1.5x his damage if they collide with an enemy with enough speed. Max distance is obtained with minimal charge. If the bomb explodes while charging, a normal ranged bone attack happens after releasing it. The melee attack is unaffected.
Isaac's Tears: Fires normal tears.
Immaculate Heart: Orbital tears are unaffected by Dr. Fetus and act normally.

Kidney Stone / Number One / Pluto / Inner Child's revive: The bombs lose almost all of their range, and cannot be improved by range ups. Shot speed and tear height ups can be used to mitigate this downside.
Lead Pencil: Every fifteenth shot will cause a barrage of short-ranged tears, which blocks the path of the bomb and can harm Isaac as the result.
The Ludovico Technique: The bomb can be controlled before exploding, similar to Epic Fetus. Isaac does not shoot bombs while controlling it.
The Ludovico Technique + Almond Milk / Soy Milk: Since Isaac can't shoot bombs before they explode, this results in a damage down with no effective fire rate increase.
Marked: Isaac continuously fires bombs at the crosshair.
Mom's Eye: Grants a chance to shoot an extra bomb from the back of Isaac's head.
Mom's Eye + Eye of the Occult: Bombs that spawn from Mom's Eye will try to move to where you're shooting making it very difficult to not get hit by your own explosions.
Mom's Knife: Overrides Dr. Fetus.
My Reflection: The bombs lose momentum and slide back towards Isaac, making self-damage very likely.
Ouroboros Worm: Does not affect the trajectory of the bombs. Turns some bombs into homing bombs, similar to Bobby-Bomb.
Parasitoid: Bomb explosions have a chance of leaving the slowing creep in a larger pool than egg sack tears, however the egg sack bombs can't spawn Blue Flies/Blue Spiders.
Rapidly shoots low damage mini-bombs. Bombs don't knock each other back.
Spectral tears: The bombs can pierce through the obstacles. If a bomb is fired inside an obstacle, the bomb collides against it, but not against others.
Spirit Sword: Overrides Dr. Fetus.
Spirit Sword + Haemolacria: The split bombs can appear from Spirit Sword's projectiles.
Sticky Bombs: The bombs stick to enemies ( unless Isaac has piercing), but enemies killed by the bomb will not spawn Blue Spiders.
The bombs always spawn slowing white creep after exploding.
Tear Detonator: No effect on bombs.
Tear height ups such as Tape Worm, Jupiter, Telepathy For Dummies, I - The Magician, and Huge Growth: Improves the effective range of the bombs.
Technology 2: The bombs are pushed forward by the laser.
Technology Zero: Dr. Fetus bombs do not generate electricity. Tears from other sources such as Sad Bombs can still generate electricity.
The Wiz: Causes Isaac to fire two bombs instead of one in diagonal directions.
Tiny Planet: The bombs fly uncontrollably around the player, making self-damage very likely.

Tractor Beam: After firing a bomb and moving, the bomb will have a homing-style effect towards the beam, but will not stay directly on the beam. Not recommended, as changing directions while firing will cause the bomb to reel back to Isaac at high speed, making self-damage very likely.

dpsNote: bomb damage uses its own formula, not tear damage

name: Magneto
description: Pulls pickups towards Isaac.
effects: Pickups (e.g. hearts, coins, keys, bombs, etc.) are attracted to Isaac.
The attraction enables the item to pass/fly over pits or rocks, but not through Key Blocks.
Red Heart are only attracted if Isaac could pick them up with his existing Red Heart containers.
Lil' Battery act similarly to hearts in that they will only be attracted to Isaac if his active item isn't fully charged.

Chests roughly 2 or fewer tiles away from Isaac open automatically. Spiked Chests are opened without damaging Isaac. Locked Chests and Bomb Chests are not opened and still require a key/bomb, though Locked chests will be opened from a distance if Isaac possesses the Paper Clip.

interactions.text: Hypercoagulation: Magneto cuts the momentum of the hearts, allowing for easy pickup and, in turn, making Isaac very tough to kill.

Options?: If a chest is presented as a choice and opened by Magneto, the other reward won't disappear unless the empty chest is then touched. Chests with items disappear or make the other reward disappear, though.

Options? + Broken Modem: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a TMTRAINER item if the chest contained an item.
Tainted Magdalene/Tainted Keeper: Attracts hearts and coins dropped by enemies, allowing for easier survival and/or coin-gathering, respectively.
Tainted ???: Poop pickups are not attracted.
Paper Clip: Allows locked chests to be opened from a short distance.
Broken Magnet: Does not increase the pull speed of coins.

name: Treasure Map
description: Reveals the map of each floor. It does not identify special rooms and does not reveal the locations of Secret Rooms / Super Secret Rooms.
effects: Reveals the map of each floor. It does not identify special rooms and does not reveal the locations of Secret Rooms / Super Secret Rooms.

synergies.text: Book of Secrets: Can make it easier to gain X-Ray Vision as Book of Secrets cannot give a mapping effect Isaac already has.

name: Mom's Eye
quote: Eye in the back of your head
description: Gives Isaac a chance to fire tears from the back of his head.
effects: Gives Isaac a chance to shoot a tear out of an eye on the back of his head.

synergies.text: Continuum: Tears shot out of the back reappear on the opposite side of the screen.
Eye of the Occult: Mom's Eye tears follow the direction in which Isaac is shooting.
Loki's Horns: Any time Mom's Eye would activate, Loki's Horns activates instead.
Rubber Cement: Tears bounce around, making the backward tear more likely to hit enemies.
Mom's Knife: Another knife is permanently behind Isaac, able to deal contact damage. The fire chance is still affected by luck as usual.

interactions.text: 20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: No effect on the tears fired out of the back of Isaac's head. The chance to activate is checked per shot, not for each tear fired.
Dr. Fetus: Occasionally shoots a bomb backward. Not recommended, as self-damage is likely.
Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: Chance for two airstrikes on opposite sides of Isaac.
Ipecac: Occasionally shoots an explosive shot backward. Not recommended, as self-damage is likely.
Kidney Stone: Adds a chance for each tear from the barrage to fire from the front and back of Isaac. The kidney stone will only fire from the front of Isaac.
The Ludovico Technique: Adds a chance for piercing + spectral tears to be fired in random directions from the main tear. This chance scales with luck and goes up to 100% at 10 Luck.
Monstro's Lung: Occasionally fires one red tear out the back of Isaac's head.
Tractor Beam: The backward tear is not affected by Tractor Beam.
The Wiz: The backward tear is not affected by The Wiz.

name: Lemon Mishap
description: Creates a small pool of yellow creep, damaging enemies that cross it. The pool lasts for the entire room.
effects: Creates a tiny / small pool of yellow creep, damaging enemies that cross it.
The pool lasts for the entire room, only disappearing when it is exited.
The puddle deals 8 damage per tick or 24 damage per second.

synergies.text: Lost Cork: Doubles puddle size.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

needsReview: The puddle deals 8 damage per tick or 24 damage per second.

name: Distant Admiration
description: Spawns an attack fly that circles further out than Halo of Flies, but closer than Forever alone, dealing 75 damage per second.
effects: Spawns a red attack fly that circles around Isaac, and deals 5 damage per tick or 75 damage per second on contact.
The fly circles farther out than regular orbitals, but closer than Forever alone.
needsReview: Spawns a red attack fly that circles around Isaac, and deals 5 damage per tick or 75 damage per second on contact.

name: Book of Shadows
description: Creates a protective shield, nullifying all types of damage in the current room for 10 seconds.
effects: Upon use, creates a protective shield, nullifying all types of damage in the current room for 10 seconds.

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt: With sufficient damage, the Book of Shadows can be kept active indefinitely.
Car Battery: Doubles the duration of invulnerability.
Cube of Meat and most other orbitals: Highly effective with Book of Shadows, as Isaac can run into enemies with an active shield to deal massive amounts of damage.

interactions.text: Blood Oath: If the book is used just before the knife stabs Isaac, he will not lose any health, nor gain any stat upgrades associated with the item.
Blood Rights/IV Bag/Razor Blade: Does not prevent damage from these items.

name: The Ladder
description: Allows Isaac to walk across gaps one square across by automatically placing a ladder between the two walkable sections.
effects: Allows Isaac to walk across gaps one square across by automatically placing a ladder between the two walkable sections. Enemies can not walk over the ladder.
Jacob and Esau: both characters can walk over the ladder, but only the character with the item can place it.

name: Charm of the Vampire
description: Heals Isaac for a Half Red Heart for every 13 enemies killed. +0.3 damage.
effects: Restores a Half Red Heart for every 13 enemies killed.
+0.3 damage.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn't count towards the healing counter.
E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't count towards the healing counter.
Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen don't count towards the healing counter.
Frozen enemies do count for the healing effect.
Maggy's Bow: No effect.
My Reflection: Despite vampires having no reflection, Charm of the Vampire does not remove the effect of My Reflection.
Tainted Magdalene: Restores a full Red Heart instead.

name: The Battery
description: Activated items can be overcharged, allowing them to store up to one extra use.
effects: Activated items can be overcharged, allowing them to store up to one extra use.
Extra charges appear in yellow over the normal charge meter.

synergies.text: 48 Hour Energy pill: A fully discharged item will be doubly charged, along with spawning 1 or 2 Lil' Battery.
AAA Battery: If Isaac's active item would have at least one full charge upon clearing a room, it gains two charges.

Friendly Ball: Walking over a captured enemy will double charge the ball, allowing the enemy to be released, and allowing to catch a new one in the same room, and the process repeats. Trying to catch a new enemy while the old one hasn't spawned yet will have no effect.
Jacob's Ladder / 120 Volt: Increases the amount of arcs a spark can generate.
Notched Axe: Causes remaining charge from the previous floor to carry over to the next one.

name: Steam Sale
description: Reduces all Shop prices by 50%, rounded down to 7 coins for an item, rounded up to 2-3 coins for a pickup.
effects: Halves the price of all purchasable items and pickups.
Items on sale for an odd amount will have their price rounded down (ie; 15 cost items will cost 7).
Most Pickups have their price reduced to 3. This includes Grab Bags, which are normally sold for 7.
Red Hearts have their price reduced to 2.
Prevents shops from having natural discounts.

synergies.text: Adoption Papers: Both of the discounts stack, selling familiars for 5 cents.
Diplopia: Can be used to create two Steam Sales, reducing the price of all items in the shop to 0.

Diplopia + Restock or Greed mode: Restock will allow shop items to replenish indefinitely, so by having multiple Steam Sales by the methods above, infinite items may be purchased. Be careful not to pick up Missing No., which will remove the Steam Sales and will likely replace many items with Breakfast.
Each additional Steam Sale will further reduce the price of all items in the shop, down to a minimum of 1 cent.

interactions.text: A Pound of Flesh: Devil Deals and Black Markets will have their price reduced. Shop items will cost the same amount of health.

name: Anarchist Cookbook
description: Spawns six Troll Bombs around the room.
effects: Spawns 6 Troll Bombs, generally near the center of the room.

synergies.text: Blasting Cap: Spawned Troll Bombs can drop extra bomb pickups.
Car Battery : Spawns 13 troll bombs.
Remote Detonator: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until Remote Detonator is activated, unlike regular Troll Bombs.

interactions.text: Bomber Boy: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.
Mr. Mega: No effect.
Pyromaniac: Spawned bombs can be used for mass healing.
Safety Scissors: Spawned troll bombs become bomb pickups.
Scatter Bombs: Not recommended. Each Troll Bomb will spawn several smaller bombs upon exploding, making it very hard to avoid taking damage.
No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.

effects: All enemies in the room are slowed for 8 seconds.

effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears 1.36 times per second that each do 6 damage.
These tears appear red, but have no special effects.

synergies.text: Mongo Baby: Will copy Sister Maggy’s tears.

needsReview: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears 1.36 times per second that each do 6 damage.

name: Technology
description: Replaces tears with a piercing laser with unlimited range.
effects: Replaces tears with a laser beam with unlimited range and piercing. The laser is fired from Isaac's left eye.

synergies.text: Haemolacria: Fires arcing Haemolacria tears that release Technology lasers in all directions upon impact.
The Technology laser coils around the Brimstone beam, granting a 1.5x damage multiplier, which can stack with other multipliers such as Magic Mushroom's 1.5x damage multiplier.
Technology's damage multiplier will be overridden if Isaac has the powered up version (from picking up Brimstone twice or using Sulfur with Brimstone).
Epic Fetus: Fires lasers in all directions upon impact of a missile.

Eye of the Occult: The laser becomes dark purple and automatically fires at a controllable crosshair. The crosshair behaves nearly identically to the one created by Marked (including in its synergies and interactions with other items) with the exception that lasers often arch towards the crosshair rather than traveling towards it directly and any other projectiles affected by Eye of the Occult that are not lasers (such as from Eye of Greed or Fate's Reward) will chase the crosshair and hover above it for the remainder of their range.
Technology + Tech.5/Technology 2: Tech.5 and Technology 2 lasers are also affected by the crosshair but cannot create the crosshair on their own.
Fire Mind: Laser lights enemies on fire but loses the ability to explode enemies.
The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Isaac shoots multiple lasers with a decreased rate of fire.
Lachryphagy: Isaac shoots a short-range laser that will form a Lachryphagy tear, which has piercing.

The Ludovico Technique: The laser becomes a large ring that is controllable and looks like a Tech X shot. Enemies inside the ring without touching it are not hurt. The tears stat is ignored and the damage is dealt very rapidly at a rate equivalent to a 1 tear delay. Shot speed is ignored.
When Spoon Bender is added to this synergy, the laser ring will morph to target enemies, along with the standard homing effect.
Marked: Isaac can fire lasers at the crosshair.
Mom's Eye: Fires a laser from the back of Isaac's head as well as the front.
Fires a barrage of small lasers.
Pop!: Laser loses its unlimited range, but spawns eyeball tears at the end of the laser.
The beams do 6x damage at point blank range but decreases to 0.1 damage at about 8 tiles away.
Spirit Sword: Sword becomes a lightsaber. Surrounds Isaac with a laser on every swing. Enemy projectiles are deflected by both normal and charged attacks.
Fires a Brimstone ring coiled by a laser. Hitbox is bigger with no damage increase.
Technology: Adds an additional laser for every extra copy of the item up to a maximum of 16, with no downgrade to damage or tears.
Technology is affected by the fire rate multiplier. Holding Stapler, Lead Pencil or playing as Cain will allow Isaac to angle shots with momentum again.
Tiny Planet: Laser circles around Isaac and then continues its path forward in a straight line. The laser is also spectral.
Tiny Planet + A Lump of Coal: The extra distance covered by the laser more than doubles damage right in front of Isaac, and it increases as normal further away.
Tough Love / Apple!: The lasers can gain the damage multiplier from each of the items, although there is no visual difference.

interactions.text: Shoot 2 lasers.
Create laser balls that fire technology lasers when released.
Technology laser wraps around the Brimstone beam, dealing extra damage, but not increasing Brimstone range.
Blood Clot / Chemical Peel / The Peeper: 50% chance to apply the flat damage up/damage increase with each shot.
The laser can be charged, increasing its size and damage.
Technology lasers wrap around the screen with the Continuum effect with momentum retained.
Charges a barrage of 5 lasers.
Releases a 4-way spread of tears whenever the laser hits a wall or an enemy.

Dead Eye: Prior to picking up Technology, the damage multiplier is preserved to where its at, and missing shots will not remove it. Saving and quitting the game will remove the multiplier. Picking Dead Eye after Technology has no effect.
Death's Touch: Overridden by Technology, but still grants damage.
Dr. Fetus: Overrides Technology.
Euthanasia: The lasers can gain the damage multiplier from Euthanasia although there is no visual difference. Euthanasia loses its instant kill ability, however.
Eye of Belial: Overridden by Technology.
Flat Stone: Overridden by Technology.
Flat Worm / Pulse Worm: No effect.
Godhead: Homing laser, but the halo is lost.
The laser is recolored to a bright yellow-orange and keeps the chance to drop coins when hitting enemies.
Holy Light shots have a chance to activate on hit as expected.
Hook Worm: Laser follows a square wave, which increases its hitbox.
Ipecac: Laser doesn't gain Ipecac's flat damage bonus or fire rate decrease, poisons targets.
Gives a flat +4 damage instead of +40, poisons targets. Fire rate is not decreased.
Gives a flat +2 damage instead of +40, laser poisons and explodes on contact, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's damage. Fire rate decrease applies.
Mom's Knife: Not reccomended. Isaac will blow himself up consistently whenever he shoots the knife.
Isaac's Tears: Fires normal tears.
Fires electricity normally.
Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance. This allows for a huge damage increase from longer distances.
When playing as Lilith, Mom's Knife overrides Technology.
The tip of Mom's Knife connects to isaac's body with a laser when launched. This effect is similar to that of Technology Zero
The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.
Pop!: The laser ends halfway through the loop. Spawns Eyeball tears like normal.
The laser spawns pools of liquid always when it hits obstacles and occasionally on enemies.
Neptunus: Overridden by Technology.
Number One: Expected tears up and the laser's color turns yellow.
Works as intended.
Pupula Duplex: Laser becomes spectral.
Laser beams are thicker in terms of width.
Soy Milk: Expected high damage down and very high tears up. Because Technology has no knockback like standard tears, this will generally be a good DPS increase.
Technology Zero: No effect.
Laser splits into two perpendicular beams upon hitting an obstacle.
Also spawn small split tears.
Laser wraps around itself multiple times, effectively increasing hitbox.
Lasers bounce off of walls.
Lasers are no longer affected by Isaac's momentum.
Trisagion: Overridden by Technology.
Wiggle Worm: Laser follows a sine wave, which increases its hitbox.
Compound Fracture: Overriden by Technology.

dpsNote: continuous piercing laser, not discrete shots

name: Chocolate Milk
description: Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.
effects: Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.
Tear damage scales from approximately 10% damage at a minimum charge to 400% damage at full charge.
The minimum charge damage increases as Isaac's fire rate increases.

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Fires multiple charged shots.
Cricket's Body / The Parasite / Compound Fracture: Since split tears tend to hit the same target the main tear hits, this can allow for much higher damage.
The Forgotten: When charging the club, instead of being thrown, the club grows bigger in size and damage.

Tainted Azazel: The beam takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point during its charge. Sneezing on enemies fills half the charge meter and can be immediately released for high damage.
Explosivo: Firing quickly generates a lot of explosive tears, which leads to a much higher damage than firing tears alone.
Charging the shots increases the size of the aura, but not its damage.
Firing quickly generates lots of Blue Flies, which can lead to much higher damage than firing tears alone.

Haemolacria: Increased tear delay. Completely charged shots and their burst tears are larger and deal higher damage than normal. Chocolate Milk also allows low-damage Haemolacria shots to be fired rapidly.
Haemolacria + Tech X: rings are created where the Haemolacria shot splashes. The Tech X rings do full damage even on minimum charge shots that were fired rapidly.
Haemolacria + Brimstone: Haemolacria bursts into 4-7 brimstone beams that do full damage even on minimum charge shots that were fired rapidly.
Immaculate Heart: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.
Ghost Pepper / Bird's Eye: Fires' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to fire full damage flames frequently.
Parasitoid / The Mulligan: Flies and spiders generated deal full damage regardless of charge, allowing Isaac to shoot low damage tears to generate flies and spiders rapidly which do full damage.
Charge level does not affect generated tears. Isaac's Tears recharge only when a shot is fired.

Ipecac: Increased tear delay. Charged shots deal massively increased damage, as the +40 damage from Ipecac is run through the damage multiplier of Chocolate Milk. It also allows low-damage Ipecac shots to be fired rapidly.
Charged and uncharged fed tears deal similar damage.
Spiders spawn only when a shot is fired.
Tear damage, along with the number of tears fired is dependent on charge time.
Polyphemus: Increased tear delay. Massively increases the damage of each shot, and charged tears decay in damage much slower as they pierce as a result.
Sinus Infection: Booger damage is influenced by the damage of the individual tear, so fully-charged Chocolate Milk shots can result in very potent damage over time.
The laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage regardless of charge, tears are affected by Chocolate Milk as normal.
Trisagion: Fully charged beams deal four times normal damage. Trisagion's shots are colored brown.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: No effect, but retains the reduced tear delay.
Azazel / Brimstone: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.

The beam takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point during its charge. Width and damage of the beam increases at higher charges; width scales from 50% at minimum charge to 160% at maximum charge, while damage scales from 25% at minimum charge to 250% at maximum charge.
C Section: Overrides Chocolate Milk.
Cursed Eye takes longer to charge, but low damage shots can be fired rapidly. If fully charged, Isaac fires five Chocolate Milk shots.
Overrides Chocolate Milk.
Marked: Isaac will automatically charge his shots. Fire rate increases when the crosshair is closer to Isaac, and damage increases when the crosshair is farther from Isaac.
Mega Blast: Firing the Mega Blast beam while Chocolate Milk charges preserve the charge, but does not increase the beam's damage.
Neptunus: Overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.
Neptunus + Kidney Stone: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.
Shoots moderately charged shots at a quick pace with no increase in damage.
No effect on Sprinkler.
Lasers can be charged, dealing up to 4x damage when fully charged. Low-damage lasers can also be fired rapidly.
At 30.00 fire rate or above, charging is no longer needed and lasers deal 4x damage.

name: Cube of Meat
description: Creates an orbital familiar. Collecting additional copies gives it the ability to shoot tears, then chase enemies to deal contact damage, then deal even more contact damage.
effects: Spawns an orbital familiar around Isaac which blocks shots and deals 52.5 contact damage per second.
Each subsequent Cube of Meat obtained is combined with the first one (increasing its 'level'), changing its characteristics
Level 2: Gives the orbital the ability to shoot tears that deal 3.5 damage once every 0.73 seconds.
Level 3: Changes it from an orbital to a Meat Boy that chases nearby enemies dealing 12.5 contact damage per second.
Level 4: Increases the size of the Meat Boy and increases its damage to 25 contact damage per second.
The fifth Cube of Meat will create a new Level 1 cube, and start the cycle again.

synergies.text: Invulnerability and shields are very useful with orbitals like Cube of Meat.
This is even more useful with invulnerability items which doesn't allow to do contact damages, like Unicorn Stump.
Book of Revelations: Ensures that Harbingers that haven't already been defeated will replace their respective floor's boss, making it drastically easier to collect multiple Cubes of Meat.
Box of Friends / Monster Manual: Additional copies of Cube of Meat combine with the first, increasing its level as normal.
Potato Peeler: Consumes 1 Red Heart container in return for creating 1 Cube of Meat and increasing damage a little.

interactions.text: Duct Tape: Familiar will stay in place relative to Isaac at levels 1 and 2. No effect at levels 3 and 4.
Pretty Fly: Cube of Meat will replace one if Isaac already has 3 Pretty Flies. If the Cube of Meat reaches level 3 or 4, the Pretty Fly will come back until another Cube of Meat orbital is obtained.

If the Book of Revelations is used at least once on a floor, a Harbinger will replace the current floor's boss if possible.
This will always happen as long as the floor's respective Harbinger has not been encountered, the boss has not been fought yet, and a Harbinger can appear on the floor normally.

interactions.text: Genesis: Effects on the Boss Room and boss item still apply to the floor even after using Genesis.

description: Creates a trapdoor to go to the next floor. Once per floor, using it on tiles with special graphics will instead create a Crawl Space.
effects: Spawns a trapdoor that leads to the next floor upon activation.

Some floor tiles will appear with a special decorative graphic (for example, grass or paper in Basement). Using this item on these tiles will guarantee a Crawl Space. Only one Crawl Space can be made per floor, as all subsequent uses will only spawn trapdoors.
A list of all decoration tiles may be found here

name: 9 Volt
description: Reduces the charge of any activated item by 1. Any 1 charge items instead have timed recharges.
effects: Fully charges the currently held active item upon 9 Volt's first pickup.
If the current active item has a recharge time of more than 1 bar, then it will grant 1 bar of charge whenever the item is activated.

If the current active item has a recharge time of 1 bar, then it will change the item to have a timed recharge of 15 seconds. The recharging of the item only triggers so long as there are enemies present in the room in any fashion. Empty rooms do not cause recharging to start.
If the current activated item already has a timed recharge, 9 Volt makes it start at half charge when used, effectively halving the time to recharge and allowing quicker reuse.

3-bar items: Quadruple rooms and L-shaped rooms give 2 bars after clearing them, allowing one free use of the item in those rooms if the gauge is full upon entering them. It can also be used at the beginning of a Boss Challenge Room to get the full charges back after beating both bosses.
AAA Battery + 3-bar items: Same as the 2-bar item synergy without AAA Battery.
4-bar items: In a Challenge Room, if the item is used during the first wave, it will get all its charges back at the end.
AAA Battery + 4-bar items: Same as the 3-bar item synergy without AAA Battery.
Jacob's Ladder: Increases arcing distance of sparks.
Keeper: The Wooden Nickel and the 9 Volt allow him to gain health (and money) forever, as long as there is an enemy in the room.

interactions.text: Birthright + Eve: Dead Bird will be active at all times.

Box of Friends: Does not double Dead Bird, even if Isaac has taken damage before use.

name: Brimstone
description: Tears are replaced with a blood laser beam that pierces through all enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period.
effects: Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is piercing and spectral, dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.
The laser deals damage equal to Isaac's damage and deals damage each tick.

These ticks occur every 1/15th of a second (once every 4 frames). However, after the first damage tick, there is an additional pause for ~0.12 seconds (7 frames). Damage ticks work normally after that.
Brimstone ticks 9 times over the course of ~0.63 seconds (38 frames).
Charge Time (s) = (1)/(30)(Roundup(Tear Delay)) approx (1)/(Fire Rate)
Starting from 15.00 fire rate, the beam can last indefinitely as long as the fire key is held, and higher fire rate results in higher damage and larger scale.
Damage per Tick = (6 * Damage)/(Tear Delay + 1) = (Damage * Fire Rate)/(5)
Tears down: Tear Delay x 3 / Fire Rate / 3.

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Fires a spread of 2/3/4 Brimstone beams.

Despite the fire rate penalty caused by The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider, the overall DPS increase is more significant compared to 20/20. However, if combined, 20/20 negates the fire rate penalty of the aforementioned items, which results in enormous damage output.

Almond Milk: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam lasts indefinitely as long as the fire key is held. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls. The beam will also gain random worm trinket effects.
Increasing the tears stat will increase the damage and width of Brimstone as well.
Damage per Tick = (Damage x Fire Rate) / 5
Azazel / Tainted Azazel: Picking up Brimstone with him will give him the regular version.
The bonus applies randomly on every tick of the beam, including the insta-kill ability from Euthanasia.

Anti-Gravity: An orb of energy expands, then shrinks while firing the beam after a delay. The orb still hurts enemies if they touch it. Isaac can start charging a new shot immediately after releasing the fire key without canceling the first shot, effectively allowing for a faster firing rate. It makes it harder to hit enemies with Azazel as the beam does not increase in range. Size and damage of the beams no longer scales with fire rate, nor is it possible to sustain a perpetual beam at above 15 fire rate.
Anti-Gravity + Soy Milk / Almond Milk: Allows auto-firing upon full charge, but without permanent beam uptime.
Both Isaac and Incubus fire Brimstone orbs.
Brain Worm: The beam will curve 90 degrees in order to attack opponents, effectively acting as a stronger form of homing. Very strong against multi-segment bosses such as Pin or Mother.
Brimstone
The first additional copy of this item grants a 1.2x damage multiplier and +1 damage and doubles the beam's width. Further copies will only grant +1 damage.
If combined with Azazel's Birthright effect, the laser beam will be 4x wider.

Blue Flies are spawned at a rate of approximately one blue fly per tick (every other tick) of damage for each enemy it hits, up to 13 flies. The spawned blue flies will also move to attack the targeted enemy immediately.
