Options?: Chests may be accompanied by normal room drops or other chests of a type that's easier to open, mitigating the downsides.

Paper Clip: The Key scarcity problem is completely prevented, since Paper Clip causes Locked Chests to be openable without Keys, making Guppy's Tail's only downside the chance to replace room clears with nothing at all.
If Cain starts with the Trinket, entering Curse Rooms and opening Red Chests in hopes of finding Guppy's Tail early is a very effective strategy.

name: IV Bag
description: Damages Isaac and spawns a random amount of coins, similar to a Blood Donation Machine.
effects: Upon use, causes Isaac to lose half a heart of health (or a full heart in Chapter 4 onward) while spawning coins.
Each use pays out with 1-2 coins on Normal mode or 1 coin on Hard mode.
IV Bag takes Red Hearts before other heart types.

synergies.text: Isaac's Heart: Can be used without taking damage, resulting in an infinite amount of coins.
Isaac still takes damage from this during .
PHD
Increases each payout to 2-3 coins on Normal mode and 2 on Hard mode.
Portable Slot: Can be alternated between to gain ridiculous amounts of pickups from only a few initial coins or hearts.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Spawns 0-1 coins instead.

interactions.text: Invulnerability and shields can't be used to prevent damage from IV Bag, even if it normally prevents damage from a Blood Donation Machine.
Car Battery: No effect.
Cracked Dice: Rerolls the coins generated by IV bag, and can be used to generate unlimited pickups and items.
Holy Mantle and similar items: IV Bag ignores the shield's protection, resulting in Isaac taking damage regardless.

name: Best Friend
description: Spawns a decoy Isaac that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies will always target the decoy and ignore Isaac.
effects: Spawns a decoy vaguely resembling Isaac in his crying animation, which explodes after 5 seconds with the blast radius of a Mega Troll Bomb.
The explosion deals 185 damage.
The decoy bomb distracts enemies, as they will target the decoy instead of Isaac regardless of distance.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Spawns two decoys on top of each other.
Remote Detonator + Schoolbag: The decoy bomb is affected by remote detonator.

needsReview: The explosion deals 185 damage.

name: Remote Detonator
description: Bombs placed by Isaac only explode when Remote Detonator is used. Gives 5 bombs.
effects: Activating the Remote Detonator will cause all Bombs placed by Isaac to explode.
Bombs will no longer explode without the usage of the detonator.
Gives 5 bombs when picked up. If the same instance of the item is picked up a second time in the same run, this effect will not be applied.

synergies.text: Anarchist Cookbook/Best Friend/Mr. Boom + Schoolbag: The active item bombs are affected by remote detonator.
Broken Remote: Allows unlimited teleportation.

Bob's Bladder: Bombs will continue to leave creep until they are manually detonated. Allows for maximization of creep damage, potentially dealing more damage over time to a boss than just a singular bomb.
Bobby-Bomb: Bombs placed will chase after the enemy, making it easier to do massive amounts of damage to enemies.
Curse of the Tower / XVI - The Tower: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until the Remote Detonator is used, unlike normal Troll Bombs.
Dr. Fetus: Remote Detonator can be used to detonate the fired bombs early, which can be useful against moving enemies.
No. 2: The bombs automatically dropped by No. 2 will not detonate on their own, greatly reducing the risk of accidental explosive self-damage.
Rocket in a Jar: Rockets do not explode on impact with surfaces, requiring manual detonation.
Rocket in a Jar + Dr. Fetus: Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will still explode on impact, but can be manually detonated.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Scatter Bombs: Remote Detonator can be used on the original bomb, but not on the small bombs that are spawned.

name: Stigmata
description: +0.3 damage, grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
+0.3 damage.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

name: Mom's Purse
description: Allows Isaac to hold one additional trinket. Drops a random trinket.
effects: Allows two different trinkets to be carried at once.
Spawns one random trinket.

synergies.text: Tick: Lets you gain the benefits of the item without losing your only trinket slot.
You cannot replace the Tick with The Match Stick once it is picked up, as it will only occupy the second trinket slot.

interactions.text: Belly Button: No effect; Isaac can still only hold two trinkets.

name: Bob's Curse
description: +5 Bombs. Grants Isaac's bombs a poison effect. They also leave a lingering poison cloud, and Isaac becomes immune to poison.
effects: Grants 5 Bombs.
Grants all of Isaac's bombs a poison effect.
The bombs leave a lingering green poison cloud after exploding.
Gives Isaac immunity to poison effects such as those from destroying Mushrooms and Sick Boom Fly.

name: Pageant Boy
description: Spawns seven random coins around Isaac and a random penny trinket.
effects: Spawns seven coins around Isaac.
These coins may be any normal type with their respective usual chances: Penny, Nickels, Dimes, Lucky Penny, Sticky Nickels or Golden Penny.
Denomination of coins that spawn is not affected by luck.
Spawns one of the following trinkets: Blessed Penny, Bloody Penny, Burnt Penny, Butt Penny, Charged Penny, Counterfeit Penny, Cursed Penny, Flat Penny and Rotten Penny.

synergies.text: Nuh Uh!: On the low chance this item spawns in Womb or Corpse, coins dropped will instead be replaced by drops from Nuh Uh!'s drop table.

name: Scapular
description: Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart, he is granted one Soul Heart.
effects: Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart (either red, soul, or black), the aura around his head temporarily vanishes and he is granted one Soul Heart.
After re-entering a room, the ability can be triggered again.
With Bone Hearts, the effect triggers on both half-filled and empty ones.

synergies.text: Kamikaze!: Damage from Kamikaze's explosions will activate Scapular, allowing Isaac to trigger on-damage effects infinitely between rooms.

interactions.text: Cursed Skull: Provided Scapular can always trigger, grants effective immortality, as the soul heart is always given before the teleport takes place.
+The Wafer: Grants true immortality, plus one hit on the soul heart, allowing the player to get hit once before teleporting.

name: Speed Ball
description: +0.3 speed, +0.2 shot speed.
effects: +0.3 speed.
+0.2 shot speed.

name: Bum Friend
description: Spawns a familiar that picks up Penny for himself, giving random pickups in return. Can spawn items from the Beggar item pool.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac and picks up coins on the ground.
After picking up 6 coins, Bum Friend will return to Isaac and drop a pickup.
After that, Bum Friend has a 67% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 3 coins and a 33% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 4 coins.

synergies.text: BFFS!: All future drops will happen every 3 coins. If the next scheduled drop at the moment of acquiring BFFS! requires more than 3 coins, the amount will not be lowered.
Mitre: Red Hearts that Bum drops can be converted into Soul Hearts.
King Baby / RC Remote: No effect.
Chaos: Bum Friend's item pedestals will be affected by Chaos, spawning an item from a random pool.

name: Guppy's Head
description: Spawns 2-4 friendly Blue Flies that damage enemies.
effects: Spawns 2-4 friendly Blue Flies.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Increases range of flies spawned to 4-8.
Fish Tail: Doubles flies spawned.
9 Volt: Guppy's Head slowly gains charge while in a hostile room.

name: Prayer Card
description: Gives Isaac an Eternal Heart.
effects: Gives an Eternal Heart upon activation.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Grants one full Heart Container upon use.
Tainted Eden: Health ups granted by eternal hearts are not rerolled when Tainted Eden takes damage.

interactions.text: Tainted Magdalene: Doesn't benefit from her passive ability, giving only 1 Eternal Heart as usual.

name: Notched Axe
description: Isaac destroys obstacles and opens Secret Rooms by walking into them, but cannot shoot or pick up items until it's cancelled. Toggles between tears and the pickaxe, which can be swung to attack and break obstacles. Using it depletes the charge, and it can't be used until next floor once the charge runs out.
effects: Isaac stops shooting tears and holds the Notched Axe like The Forgotten's club, and can break obstacles, blow open doors, and hit enemies for 3x damage by swinging it. The Notched Axe has 64 charges. Hitting rocks or opening doors depletes 1 charge for each obstacle destroyed. Hitting enemies depletes 2 charges. Isaac can toggle back and forth between tears and using the Notched Axe by pressing the Active Item button. Once the Notched Axe runs out of charges, it cannot be used for the rest of the floor.
The charges on Notched Axe cannot be refilled by means other than going to a new floor or picking up Iron Bar. This includes Lil' Battery, Battery Bums, 4.5 Volt, Jumper Cables, etc.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: Melee attacks will generate a hovering tear in the shape of the swing of the pickaxe.
The Battery: Causes remaining charge from the previous floor to carry over to the next one.
Bethany: Breaking Notched Axe and using a Soul Charge to activate it again will allow for a single use before immediately breaking.
Increased durability: Each use of the axe has a very high chance not to use a charge.
Faster usage: The axe can be swung up to four times per second, regardless of Judas' tears stat.
Higher knockback: Enemies are knocked back when hit, receiving 8 + 0.2 x floor damage if they collide with a wall, obstacle, or other enemies.
Fire effect: The axe will set enemies on fire. The burn deals damage equal to Judas' damage, and ticks up to 5 times.
Increased luck: destroying obstacles with the axe has an increased chance to spawn pickups.
Destroying Poops will spawn pickups much more frequently. When combined with Petrified Poop, the chance becomes 100% and will often result in multiple pickups from a single poop.
Destroying Tinted Rocks will drop more consumables than usual, similarly to Super Special Rocks.
Destroying Props (such as Urns, Mushrooms, Skulls, and Polyps) gives the prop an extra chance to drop its rewards. This can result in a single prop giving multiple drops.
Destroying Fool's Gold rocks will drop significantly more coins.}}
Dip wisp (can only be obtained from poop): Fires brown tears that deal 1.5 damage and has extremely low health.
Black wisp: Fires black tears that have the effect of A Lump of Coal and deal 2.5 damage.
Silver wisp: Fires metallic tears that have the effect of Iron Bar and deal 4 damage.
Gold wisp: Fires penny tears that can turn enemies gold similar to Midas' Touch and deal 3.5 damage.
Red wisp: Fires laser tears similar to the ones fired by Technology and deal 3.5 damage.
Blue wisp: Fires diamond tears similar to the ones fired by Crown Of Light that deal 7 damage.}}
Broken Padlock: Allows the Notched Axe to open locked chests and doors. The opening of chests does not use durability, however it will consume a key if Isaac has any.
Ipecac: Melee attacks will trigger an explosion when they makes contact with an enemy; unlike with the Forgotten's bone club, Isaac will take damage from these Ipecac explosions.
Iron Bar: Fully recharges the axe when picked up.
Technology: Melee attacks will cause a technology laser ring to appear around Isaac, damaging enemies.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Found Soul: Found Soul gets a Notched Axe that breaks after a single use. If Notched Axe is dropped and picked up again, Found Soul will be able to use it again.

conditionalEffects: Isaac stops shooting tears and holds the Notched Axe like The Forgotten's club, and can break obstacles, blow open doors, and hit enemies for 3x damage by swinging it. The Notched Axe has 64 charges. Hitting rocks or opening doors depletes 1 charge for each obstacle destroyed. Hitting enemies depletes 2 charges. Isaac can toggle back and forth between tears and using the Notched Axe by pressing the Active Item button. Once the Notched Axe runs out of charges, it cannot be used for the rest of the floor.

name: Infestation
description: 1-3 Blue Flies randomly spawn every time Isaac gets hit. 2-6 Blue Flies randomly spawn every time Isaac gets hit.
effects: 2-6 Blue Flies spawn whenever Isaac takes damage.

interactions.text: Fish Tail: Doubles number of flies spawned.
Hive Mind: Flies are bigger and deal double damage.

name: Ipecac
description: Replaces tears with explosive and poisoning projectiles fired in an arc from the mouth.
effects: Replaces tears with explosive and poisoning projectiles fired in an arc.
1/3 Fire Rate
0.8x range multiplier.
0.8x shot speed multiplier.
+40 flat damage (See Effective Damage)
Tear size multiplier: 0.4x

synergies.text: Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Ipecac it turns into a larger slow moving green locust that deals x1.5 Isaac’s damage per tick and poisons enemies.

Brain Worm: The Ipecac tears will snap 90 degrees and rain down at nearby enemy should the shot miss, completely eliminating the shortcoming of having too much range and causing Ipecac tears to fly over enemy's head, missing them.

Blood beam now does poison damage and will explode on connection with an enemy which can damage the character if close enough. The character doesn't gain the Damage Up or Tears Down effects. The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2, but Isaac's tear rate stat is not modified. The beam explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The explosions do not occur when the beam narrows, meaning that they occur only twice per shot without Soy Milk / Almond Milk. The beam and its explosions poison enemies.
Cricket's Body: The main tear splits into four explosive splash tears. The splash tears can still damage Isaac.
Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Cricket's Body's own x0.8 range multiplier.
C Section: The fetuses explode once they touch an enemy, poisoning and dealing damage equal to Isaac's Damage.
Dr. Fetus: Bombs explode on contact, do no damage to Isaac and become Bob's Curse bombs.
The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. Bombs leave a poison cloud that damages enemies. With Jacob and Esau only the character with the items is immune to the explosions.
Dr. Fetus + Monstro's Lung: Renders Isaac no longer immune to his shots. The flat damage bonus is increased back to +40.
Dr. Fetus + Sad Bombs: Isaac is not immune to the explosive shots created by the Sad Bombs' effect.
Epic Fetus: Missiles turn green and are poisonous. Damage greatly increases as the flat damage bonus stacks with Epic Fetus' explosive multiplier.
Flat Stone: The Ipecac shots cause full-damage explosions instead of lesser splash damage when they bounce off the floor, though they can also harm Isaac.
Each bounce creates an explosion that deals half Isaac's damage as well as dealing the regular splash damage. The bounce explosion radius is slightly larger than the splash radius.

The Forgotten: The flat damage bonus is reduced to +4. Melee attacks become poisonous and explosive; he cannot be hurt by the blasts but is pushed back by them. The explosions deal 1.5x damage. The charged throwing attack is only poisonous. The Soul uses Ipecac as normal.

The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. The thrown bone club can explode once on enemy contact while being sent out, but not while returning. These explosions deal from 10 + 2.8x to 10 + 6x Damage based on how much the attack is charged, and do no self-damage.
When the skeleton form has Technology, the thrown bone club constantly explodes and deals damage to The Forgotten.
Haemolacria: Tear delay is increased by 1/3 compared to either of the items on their own, but Isaac now fires Ipecac shots that release poisonous, high-damage but non-explosive split tears on impact.
Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Haemolacria's own x0.8 range multiplier.
The Ludovico Technique: Tear damage is increased by 4, explodes when killing an enemy, and comes back to Isaac.
+2 flat damage bonus, no explosion.

Maw Of The Void: The ring becomes poisonous and explodes on the first enemy or obstacle contact it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The explosions do not occur for the first four ticks.
Mom's Knife: Knife turns green, may poison enemies, and removes Ipecac's damage increase.

Also adds +2 flat damage bonus. The thrown knife can explode once on enemy contact while being sent out, but not while returning. These explosions deal from 10 + 2.1x to 10 + 6x Damage based on how much the attack is charged.
Monstro's Lung: Isaac fires a barrage of Ipecac shots, with no increase in charge time compared to Monstro's Lung alone.
Charge time increases by 3x.

Montezuma's Revenge: The poop beam gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The beam explodes 10 times, either on the first enemy or obstacle it hits or at the very end otherwise, dealing 10 + twice of the beam's damage.
Mysterious Liquid: Leaves a massive pool of creep on the floor on impact.

The Parasite: The Ipecac tear will spawn two smaller explosive tears when it collides with a solid object, but not with an enemy. These tears can spawn tears on their own as well, potentially leading to huge chain reactions.

Revelation: The laser gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The laser explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick. The explosions occur 8 times and deal 10 + twice of the laser's damage.
Tech X: The flat damage bonus is reduced to +4. The laser ring becomes poisonous.

The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. The laser ring becomes poisonous and explodes every other tick on contact, deal 10 + twice of the ring's damage. Knockback from the blasts will push enemies along the path of the ring, prolonging damage. The ring will not open Secret Rooms if the entrance is on the bottom wall since the ring will never explode against the bottom wall.
Technology: Removes the flat damage bonus, poisonous laser.
+2 flat damage bonus, poisonous laser that explodes on enemy or obstacle contact, deal 10 + twice of Isaac's damage. Keeps Ipecac's stats other than damage.

Note: This combination is not advised if the player has the Multidimensional Baby familiar. When the ipecac technology laser passes through the Multidimensional Baby, it instantly explodes, damaging the player and likely being fatal for the run.
Trisagion: Trisagion blasts do not explode on hit. The explosion happen once the blast runs out of range or hits a wall and deals damage equal to Isaac's Damage.

Trisagion blasts are poisonous and explode upon impact with an enemy or obstacle, dealing 10 + twice of the blast's damage. When the base of the blast reaches an enemy or obstacle, it explodes and deals damage equal to Isaac's Damage.

interactions.text: 120 Volt: The zaps get only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The 0.75x-1.5x damage multiplier applies afterwards.

Crown Of Light / Polyphemus / Proptosis / Sacred Heart / Bloody Lust: The damage multipliers from these items do not apply to Ipecac's +40 bonus, resulting in much lower damage increase than expected.
Chocolate Milk: Charged up Ipecac deals expectedly high damage. Rapid-fire can be used against weaker enemies or to clear obstacles when necessary.
Cricket's Head / Eve's Mascara / Magic Mushroom: The damage multipliers from these items apply to Ipecac's +40 bonus, unlike others.

Fire Mind: Due to the nature of the Ipecac, all shots will have a 100% chance of leaving a fire at the center of the explosion. It will also no longer leave behind green creep and the explosion will be of normal color instead of green.
Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, instead of the expected +20.
Glass Cannon: As the Glass Cannon tears are so large, even a modest damage increase or a single tear size increasing item is likely to render the tear unable to damage enemies.
Holy Light: A beam of light will spawn on top of any enemy within the explosion's radius.
Jacob's Ladder: The sparks spawn only when they hit a wall.
Lost Contact: Ipecac shots will explode on contact with enemy shots.
Mom's Eye / Loki's Horns: Occasionally shoots backwards or in all 4 directions, with high risk of self-damage.
Number One: Not recommended. Unlike other similar items, Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does stack with Number One's own x0.8 range multiplier, making self-damage more likely.
Piercing tears: Tears will still explode on enemy contact, nullifying piercing.
Rubber Cement: Tears will bounce off walls and rocks and won't explode until they hit the ground. Not recommended, as self-damage is likely.
Spectral tears: Ipecac shots no longer explode on contact with obstacles or walls, making accidental self-damage less likely but more difficult to open doors.
Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten's melee attacks will explode. Tainted Soul is immune only to those explosions, so any further explosions caused by synergies will damage it.
Technology Zero: High fire rate needed for explosive shots to be connected.
Tiny Planet: Ipecac tears orbit around Isaac for a very long time. They land far enough to not cause self-damage, but that can be relied on only if Isaac is not moving and do not hit enemies.

Tractor Beam: The Ipecac tear will travel in an arc along the beam, even if Isaac is moving forward as well. When Isaac changes direction, the tear will snap to the beam, making it very easy to accidentally hit close objects blocking its new path.

Brimstone + Monstro's Lung: The erratically fired lasers can easily hit rocks or enemies near Isaac, damaging him. This affect is worsened by Azazel's need to be close to enemies to damage them. Be wary of this synergy without explosion immunity.

dpsNote: explosion damage, not tear contact damage

name: Tough Love
description: Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals x3.2 Isaac's damage.
effects: Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals x3.2 Isaac's damage.

interactions.text: Apple!: With 14 Luck, overrides Tough Love. With 13 Luck, Apple and Tough Love each have about an equal chance to trigger.
Occasionally fires Brimstone beam with damage multiplier of Tough Love.
Cricket's Body / Compound Fracture: Teeth will split into smaller teeth.
Adds a chance for the bombs to deal increased damage. See the page for the specific damage formula.
Fire Mind: Adds a flaming effect to the teeth, but without the chance of exploding.
Ipecac: Teeth explode with the increased blast damage of Mr. Mega.
Both damage multipliers apply, combined damage multiplier is x6.4.
Haemolacria: Tears will not appear as teeth but may still gain the damage multiplier.

Jawbreaker: Activation rates are individually applied to each tear, effectively allowing for higher amounts of teeth. At 9 Luck, the trinket is no longer needed, as Tough Love will already guarantee that every shot is a tooth.

The Ludovico Technique: Tear occasionally flicks to being a tooth, which deals 3.2x Isaac's tear damage, before immediately returning to being a normal tear. The frequency at which the tear very briefly transforms into a tooth increases with Luck, permanently becoming a tooth at 9 Luck.
The Parasite: Split tears will not turn into teeth.
Papa Fly/Pointy Rib/Linger Bean: Can benefit the damage multiplier.
Spirit Sword: Both the sword and projectiles can deal increased damage.
Technology: Damage multiplier applies occasionally.

name: The Mulligan
description: Tears have a 16.67% chance of spawning allied Blue Flies when they hit an enemy.
effects: Tears have a 16.67% chance of spawning allied Blue Flies when they hit an enemy.

synergies.text: Azazel/Brimstone: Rapid damage ticks can cause large amounts of blue flies to spawn.
Chocolate Milk: The Mulligan's ability isn't affected by the charge time, meaning rapidly firing uncharged shots will generate a ton of blue flies.
Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Has a 16.67% chance to spawn a fly on every hit by a split shot, which boosts the spawning of flies immensely.
Dr. Fetus: Bombs have a chance to spawn blue flies when damaging enemies.
Finger!: Rapidly spawns blue flies when pointed at an enemy.
Urn of Souls: Fires have a chance to spawn blue flies.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: Overrides The Mulligan.

name: Technology 2
description: Replaces the tears fired from Isaac's right eye with a rapid-firing low damage piercing laser. Damage down.
effects: Replaces Isaac's right eye tears with an unlimited range piercing laser which fires continuously, dealing damage 15 times per second.
This compounds with the damage down for a total of 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
Only the laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
Tears fired per second * (2/3).
Laser is able to knock back enemies.

synergies.text: 8 Inch Nails / Blister / Pisces: The laser will consistently push back enemies.
Blood Clot / Chemical Peel: Since Isaac's right eye is replaced by Technology 2, he can only fire tears from his left eye, which gives all his tears higher damage and range.
Brimstone: Laser fires continuously while Brimstone charges at normal rate.
Chocolate Milk: The laser fires while Chocolate Milk charges at normal rate.
Cricket's Body : The laser will rapidly split into small low damage tears upon impact with an enemy or obstacle.
Cursed Eye: The laser fires while Cursed Eye charges at normal rate, retaining the teleporting effect.
Tears are replaced with lasers, fired from the same eye of Technology 2.
Epic Fetus: The laser fires while the missiles are being aimed.
Euthanasia / Explosivo / Holy Light / Little Horn / Nose Goblin / Sinus Infection: Every damage tick from the laser can also apply these tear effects and does so rapidly.
Explosivo’s 60 point explosion damage bonus is unaffected by the laser’s reduced damage making the combination incredibly effective.
Incubus / Lil Clot / Sumptorium / Twisted Pair: The familiars fire a continuous laser.
Ipecac: Laser damage increases dramatically while also gaining the poison effect.

Lachryphagy: Significantly shortens the range of the laser. A piercing Lachryphagy tear spawns at the end of the laser every tick, rapidly feeding off of each other and bursting when standing still. This is an extremely powerful combo that alone can provide enough damage output to challenge any boss in the game.
A fire rate reduction such as from The Inner Eye or a few Tears Down pills makes the combo even stronger, as tears will grow even larger before bursting.
Lead Pencil: Replaces tears with lasers similar to Technology. These are shot from the eye that shoots Technology 2, doing damage alongside the Technology 2 beam.
Loki's Horns: Additional tears are affected by Technology 2 but are replaced by Technology's lasers, dealing 100% of Isaac's damage and with 16 luck gives you Technology 2's fire rate.
Lost Contact: The laser destroys all hostile projectiles that come into contact with it.
The Ludovico Technique: Isaac simultaneously controls a tear and fires the laser; however, Isaac will only fire the Technology 2 laser in the direction that the tear is currently facing.
The Ludovico Technique also makes the laser spectral.
A Lump of Coal: Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.
Marked: Isaac simultaneously controls a big red target on the ground and fires the laser in the cardinal directions.
The laser now continuously fires towards the crosshair along with tears.
Mom's Knife: The laser fires while the Knife charges at normal rate.
Monstro's Lung: The laser fires while Monstro's Lung charges at normal rate. No reduction in tear burst size.
The Parasite: Laser splits into two perpendicular beams upon hitting an obstacle.
Also spawn small split tears.
Rubber Cement: Laser bounces off of walls.
Technology is affected by the fire rate multiplier. Holding Stapler, Lead Pencil or playing as Cain will allow Isaac to angle shots with momentum again.
Tiny Planet: The laser spirals around Isaac once and then goes straight again.
The Wiz: Tears are fired diagonally while the laser is fired straight forward.
Urn of Souls: Isaac can still fire the laser as normal while using the urn.

interactions.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider / Sprinkler / any multishot item: No effect.
Azazel: The Technology 2 continuously fires its lesser damage laser as Azazel charges his Brimstone.
Eye of Belial / Parasitoid: The laser is unaffected.
Parasitoid: The laser can now rapidly spawn slowing creep and spawns flies or spiders.
Eye of the Occult: Only affects the laser's color.
Eye of the Occult + Brimstone / Technology: The Tech 2 laser also automatically fires at the crosshair.
Fire Mind: Tears still ignite enemies, but no longer have a chance to explode.
Isaac's Tears: Fires normal tears.
Mom's Eye: Occasionally shoots a laser behind Isaac. With 15+ Luck, fires a new laser on every tick, dealing extremely high damage.
The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.
Pop!: The laser has drastically reduced range, and eyeball tears are rapidly created at the end of the laser.
Technology 2: Multiple copies of the item provide no benefit.

dpsNote: continuous low-damage laser on one eye
conditionalEffects: This compounds with the damage down for a total of 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
needsReview: This compounds with the damage down for a total of 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
Only the laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.

name: Mutant Spider
description: Isaac shoots four tears at once with lower fire rate.
effects: Isaac fires 4 tears at the same time.
Tears fired per second * 0.42.

synergies.text: Removes the fire rate penalty while reducing damage to 80%. Additional copies will add one additional tear with no further change to damage/fire rate.
Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Mutant Spider it creates four locusts instead of one.
Brimstone: Shoots 4 beams at once.
Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: Replaces the single missile strike with a barrage of four consecutive missiles.
Shoots 5 tears with no further decrease in fire rate.
Libra: Negates the firing rate reduction effect.
Monstro's Lung: Adds 7 tears to the barrage with a significant decrease in fire rate.
Each copy of the item adds +2 tears, up to the maximum of 16.
Polyphemus: Tear rate is not lowered further. Damage is increased by a flat +5 instead of normal Polyphemus boost.
Tractor Beam: All tears are fired along the beam.
Three shots are fired in each direction.

interactions.text: Keeper: Fires 7 / 5 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.
Tainted Keeper: Fires 6 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.
The Ludovico Technique: The tear gains 3 orbiting tears.
Loki's Horns: Only occasionally fires one tear in the other three directions.
Fires three shots out of each eye.
Pupula Duplex + Lachryphagy: The four shots instantly fuse and burst.
Sad Bombs / Varicose Veins / It Hurts: No effect.

needsReview: Isaac fires 4 tears at the same time.

name: Chemical Peel
description: Tears fired from the left eye have +2 flat damage.
effects: +2 flat damage to tears fired from Isaac's left eye.

name: Gnawed Leaf
description: After standing still and not shooting for a short time, Isaac turns invincible until he moves or shoots.
effects: After standing still and not pressing the move or attack buttons for one second, Isaac will turn into an invulnerable statue.
Using bombs and active items will remove the invincibility state.

synergies.text: 7 Seals: One of the more versatile familiars that works with Gnawed Leaf. The varied forms and attacks of this familiar make it capable of clearing pretty much any room given time. The locusts it produces often fly to Isaac which takes care of chasing enemies, but its damaging creep and chasing attacks can reach even the farthest enemies.
120 Volt: With enough damage, 120 Volt's zaps becomes far more efficient at killing than orbitals.
At 15 damage minimum, it surpasses most orbitals.
At 30 damage or more, it surpasses Sacrificial Dagger.

Angry Fly: Aggressively attacks enemies even if they're far away, but can end up harmlessly orbiting slow or stationary enemies indefinitely, or trying to attack invulnerable enemies. It does better with slow or stationary bosses than regular enemies, diving in to attack periodically instead of harmlessly orbiting.

Daddy Longlegs: Allows Isaac to easily clear most rooms or bosses while in statue form. Daddy Longlegs cannot damage bosses like The Shell and won't target enemies that are a long distance from Isaac. In a pinch, Mom's Toenail works the same, albeit much slower.
Damocles: If Isaac is in statue form when the sword falls, he will survive.
Dark Arts: While Isaac is surrounded by enemies, he will not take damage and will safely go into the shadow state. (Even if enemies are in pointblank range.)
Decap Attack: The head can be used on stationary bosses to wither them down.
E. Coli /Midas' Touch /Serpent's Kiss / The Virus: Monsters touching the statue will be affected without Isaac taking collision damage.
Empty Vessel: if Empty Vessel's requirement is fulfilled, Isaac can safely wait for the shield to activate, allowing to deal damage without leaving invulnerability.
IBS: Orbitals and other things (such as 120 Volt) can trigger IBS while in statue form, however, Isaac will still be invincible. This can be really good if a Stinky Poop is held above his head.
Kamikaze!: Statue form will break, but the initial explosion will not damage Isaac, therefore granting Isaac quasi-unlimited bombs.
The Ludovico Technique: The hovering tear will still deal damage and the statue form won't break as long as the attack buttons aren't being pressed.
The Ludovico Technique + Strange Attractor: Can pull enemies in while remaining a statue, clearing out rooms easily.
Mom's Knife: The knife can damage enemies while Isaac is a statue.
Mom's Heels: While invincible, Isaac can still deal contact damage.
Monstrance: The aura makes quick work of chasing enemies.
The Pinking Shears: Isaac's body will attack enemies while his head is invincible.
Placenta: Isaac can safely regenerate Red Hearts in any room, making it easy to have enough health from any mistake at the cost of time.
Robo-Baby 2.0: Since it fires automatically, this familiar is one of the more effective synergies, since it will even shoot off screen as it’s knocked around.

Salvation: The aura can trigger from nearby enemies while Isaac is safely a statue, and the damaging beams when this happens can reach farther enemies. This powerful attack can make quick work of bosses that chase Isaac.
Spin to Win: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac.

Sprinkler: Can be placed upon entering a room, and will continue to fire when Isaac is invincible, meaning any room can be cleared without the risk of Isaac taking damage. This theoretically allows end-game bosses to be beaten without having to move.
Super Magnet: Pulls enemies into Isaac, can be extremely powerful if combined with orbitals that allow contact damage.
Tainted Magdalene: Tainted Magdalene's "Hug" attack still triggers when in the statue state without taking damage, making short work of aggressive enemies as well as providing lots of healing.

Tainted Forgotten: The Soul is invincible as long as the bone club is not used and The Forgotten is not thrown, even if The Soul is holding The Forgotten and moving around. Combined with orbitals that deal contact damage like Cube of Meat or items that can trigger damage only by movement such as Purgatory, can make for a trivial method to beat any boss.
When worst comes to worst and Isaac has no orbitals or familiars, the knife can be used to deal damage, due to how common the transformation is.

Tooth and Nail: Allows one second to act and/or reposition without taking damage. Useful in situations such as ranged combat when enemies bombard from a distance, or to attack and move to a safe distance where Isaac can safely regain statue form.

interactions.text: 2Spooky: Counterintuitive and should be avoided, as most enemies will never approach orbital range.

synergies.text: Blood Oath: For each half heart damaged by Blood Oath, Old Bandage has a chance to drop a heart. Synergy further improves with luck.

Humbleing Bundle only has a 50% chance to double the hearts dropped, but Old Bandage may still drop 1 heart.

name: Sad Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Upon exploding, bombs shoot 10 tears around them, affected by tear modifiers.
effects: Upon exploding, Bombs shoot 10 tears off in every direction, similar to Tammy's Head. The tears deal a flat 25 damage plus Isaac's damage and are affected by any tear modifiers Isaac has on his tears.
Grants five bombs.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: Tears will hover in place for a few seconds before dispersing.
BBF/Best Friend/Bob's Brain/Bob's Rotten Head/Mr. Boom: Gains the Sad Bombs effect.

Brimstone: Bombs explode into Brimstone beams in all directions.

The bomb’s tears can also generate flies.
Haemolacria: Bombs explode into Haemolacria tears which burst into tears.
Kamikaze!: Tears will explode after activating the item.

Tears from extra explosions deal 65% of their normal damage.
Technology: Bombs explode into Technology beams in all directions.
Tech X: Bombs explode into Technology beams in all directions.

interactions.text: 20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: Does not affect the amount of tears when bombs explode.
Bomber Boy: Only the center most explosion creates 10 tears.
Explosivo: Tear explosions are not affected by Sad Bombs.
Ipecac: Normal Ipecac shots won't explode into tears, but placed bombs will shoot Ipecac shots in every direction.
The Ludovico Technique/Marked: Tears that burst from bombs cannot be controlled.
My Reflection: Tears will return to the place where the bomb exploded, not Isaac.
Tiny Planet: Tears orbit around where the bomb exploded, not Isaac.
Tech.5: No effect.
The damage reduction is removed.

name: Rubber Cement
description: Tears bounce off walls, enemies, and environmental objects.
effects: Makes tears bounce off walls, enemies and environmental objects.
Tears that bounce off of enemies bounce in random directions, whereas tears that bounce off of walls and other objects bounce directly back.
When tears bounce from enemies, they become able to hit the same enemy again should they bounce off of another enemy or obstacle.
Tears bounce off bombs and are unable to push them, making Troll Bombs more difficult to deal with.

synergies.text: Brimstone: The blood laser bounces off of walls, creating a second beam that deals half damage.
Azazel's Brimstone laser becomes a full length laser after bouncing, but will deal half of the damage.
Azazel's Brimstone no longer becomes a full length laser after bouncing, and instead bounce as a regular mini-Brimstone.
A Lump of Coal: Both effects stack, with tears that bounce off of enemies being able to hit others for more damage.
The Parasite: Tears will bounce off of walls without splitting, but split and bounce when hitting enemies. The split tears and the original one will bounce off everything.

Pop!: Significantly increases the uptime of tears, since they are not limited by range and each tear will bounce off of each other. Continuously firing tears will eventually create a positive feedback loop, as the tears will keep bouncing faster and faster while not dropping to the floor.

Pop! + A Lump of Coal: Extremely powerful combination; Lump of Coal's tear size increase will make it much easier for tears to bounce off of each other, while they increase in damage very rapidly. Given some time and enough tears, this can kill even final bosses such as Hush and Delirium quickly.
Technology / Technology 2 / Tech.5: Laser bounces off walls, creating a second beam that does half damage.
Tech X: The laser rings bounce off walls.

interactions.text: Bob's Rotten Head: The bomb bounces back upon hitting an obstacle, and will not explode until it runs out of air time. Not recommended, as it can make self-damage more likely in small rooms.
Continuum: Overridden by Rubber Cement; tears will still bounce off of walls and obstacles.
Dr. Fetus: Overrides Rubber Cement.
Epic Fetus: Overrides Rubber Cement.
The Forgotten: No effect on the skeleton form's attacks.
Homing tears: Tears will bounce off enemies and home back in, but to deal damage to that enemy again they must bounce off a different object.
Ipecac: Tears will bounce off of obstacles, but not enemies.
Jacob's Ladder: Tears don't generate arcs when hitting obstacles.
Lost Contact: Tears will bounce off of enemy tears. Not recommended unless the player's fire rate is high, as it can prove detrimental when trying to hit a shooting enemy.
The Ludovico Technique: Overrides Rubber Cement.
Mom's Knife: Overrides Rubber Cement.

Piercing tears: Tears that don't destroy enemies will bounce off of them instead of going straight through them. Tears can still damage enemies such as Knights that are normally invulnerable from the front.
Tears regain the ability to push bombs.
Sinus Infection: Boogers stick to enemies, but otherwise they bounce normally.
Spectral tears: Overridden by Rubber Cement.
Tears pass through obstacles but bounce off walls.
Sulfuric Acid: Overridden by Rubber Cement.
Tiny Planet: Tears no longer fly over obstacles but instead bounce very quickly along with them, appearing to "vibrate".
Tears pass through obstacles but coast along walls, trying to maintain the circular trajectory.
Trisagion: Tears no longer bounce off of enemies but will still bounce off of walls and obstacles.

name: Anti-Gravity
description: Tears float in position until firing ceases, after which they will fly off in the direction they were shot in. -2 Tear Delay. +1 Fire Rate.
effects: Holding the fire buttons causes tears to hover in midair. When released, the tears will all shoot in the direction they were originally fired.
If the fire buttons are not released, the tears will fire on their own after 3 seconds.
+1.0 fire rate.

synergies.text: C Section: Fetuses stand in place while the fire button is held. They will still home on enemies in this state. Fetuses attacking this way deal more damage.
The Forgotten: Each swing of his club creates an additional hitbox in front of him that lasts for about a second before proceeding forward and disappearing. The club throw is unaffected.
Lachryphagy: Tears will float in midair, making them easier to feed. Burst tears will also float in midair before moving.
Proptosis: The tears will not decrease in size or damage until they start moving, making this excellent against enemies that chase Isaac.
Tainted Magdalene: Hug swipes float, allowing for extra hits as the swipes remain mid-air.
Tech.5: Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.
Technology Zero: All of the tears fired are connected by electricity, creating a series of electric fences.
Tears orbit close to Isaac when held, then snap to the edge of the orbit when released.

interactions.text: Azazel / Brimstone: A red mist expands and then contracts, doing contact damage to any enemy that touches it. It then fires the original Brimstone shot before disappearing. It allows a new shot to be charged up immediately after firing without interrupting the first shot. It does not increase the range of Azazel's Brimstone beam.
Brimstone + Soy Milk: Brimstone continues firing from the position it was fired.
Bob's Rotten Head: Continues to hover in the air while the fire button is pressed after launching it.
Chocolate Milk: Overrides Anti-Gravity.
Chocolate Milk + Soy Milk: Tears are released immediately, despite not charging.
Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / Haemolacria / The Parasite: Burst tears will not hover even if a fire button is held.
Cursed Eye / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Eye of the Occult / The Ludovico Technique / Marked / Mom's Knife / Monstro's Lung / Tech X: Only tear delay down applies.
Diplopia: No effect; -2 tears delay does not stack.
Euthanasia: If a needle tear destroys an enemy and the fire button is held, the burst needles will hover until the button is released.
Kidney Stone: When the Kidney Stone effect is activated, the tear barrage will hover until released. The stone will not hover and will travel regardless.

(Not recommended) The anti-gravity effect stays in place for the whole duration of the tear barrage even if the fire button isn't held resulting in a complete loss of control of fire for as long as the barrage is active.
A Lump of Coal: Despite the visual increase in size, damage still only increases based on the distance traveled.
Tears no longer increase in size while hovering.

Multidimensional Baby: Multidimensional Baby will travel the same path as the Anti-Gravity tears, easily doubling any stationary shots. Any moving tears that hit it will produce a normal moving copy, however stationary tears will spawn a copy that will eventually fall to the ground even after the direction is released.
Stationary duplicated tears will release normally.

My Reflection: Combines both effects. Tears no longer hover in place; instead, they will weakly home in on Isaac like he is a pivot point, following as he moves. Releasing the attack buttons will launch the tears from their position as usual.
Notched Axe: Melee attacks will generate a hovering tear in the shape of the swing of the pickaxe.
Spirit Sword: Sword beams are affected normally by Anti-Gravity. Regular sword swipes are unaffected, but spin attacks freeze for a short time before firing.
Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.

name: Pyromaniac
description: +5 bombs. Grants immunity to explosion damage and causes explosions to heal Isaac. Also grants immunity to fire.
effects: +5 Bombs.
All explosions heal Isaac instead of damaging him. If Isaac has no Red Heart containers or full health, no damage is taken.
Explosions heal one half Red Heart.
Grants immunity to damage from Fire Places or enemy fires, but does not heal Isaac.
It does not protect the player from taking damage from fire projectiles or the White Fire Place in Downpour II.

synergies.text: Anarchist Cookbook: Spawned bombs can be used for mass healing.

Blood Bombs: If the player has run out of bombs, they can spend half a heart to drop a bomb and recover it by getting caught in the explosion (it won't work on characters that can't obtain red health).
This allows Isaac to infinitely damage himself for items such as Fanny Pack.
Bomber Boy: Heals Isaac multiple times per bomb depending on the number of explosions that hit him.
Curse of the Tower: Whenever Isaac gets hit, numerous healing troll bombs fill the room, nullifying nearly any red heart damage taken.
Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Ipecac: Explosions heal Isaac, essentially making him invincible as long as he has more than one red heart container and a decent rate of fire.
Kamikaze!: Provides an unlimited source of explosions which will heal.
Tainted Magdalene: Explosions heal a full Red Heart again.
Walnut: Walnut will only require 1-5 explosions to open. As Isaac is immune to explosions, he can safely open Walnut without taking any damage.

name: Cricket's Body
description: When tears hit an object or deplete their range, they spawn 4 smaller tears, whose range and damage scale with Isaac's. Grants -1 tear delay and reduces range. Grants +0.5 fire rate and reduces range.
effects: When Isaac's normal tears disappear (either from hitting the ground or hitting something else), they spawn 4 smaller tears.
Each smaller tear deals half of Isaac's normal damage.
Split tears are scaled down by 0.6x from the main ones, ignoring damage-based size reduction.
+0.1 tear size.
+0.5 fire rate.
0.8x range multiplier.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: All tears split by the prism will burst into split tears.
Bob's Rotten Head: Bob's Rotten Head splits into four smaller heads on detonation.
Compound Fracture: When bone tears split into bone shards after hitting an obstacle or enemy, the bone shards will split into 4 smaller bone shards after hitting the ground.

Explosivo: The explosion results in split Explosivo shots being generated. If the target survives, they're likely to immediately stick again. The split tears explode when they hit an enemy or the ground.
Haemolacria: Main tears can split as they burst upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy. The split tears can burst, but burst tears from main tears do not split.
Cricket's Body's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Haemolacria's own x0.8 range multiplier.
Ipecac: Main tear splits into four explosive splash tears. The split tears can still damage Isaac. Having Host Hat or Pyromaniac is strongly recommended.
Cricket's Body's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Ipecac's own x0.8 range multiplier.
Lachryphagy: Fed tears split into 12 tears.
Lead Pencil/Monstro's Lung: All tears fired will splash after landing. Increased damage potential only noticed when firing into groups, due to the random pattern of each tear when it splashes.
The Parasite: Eight split tears instead of four.
Tiny Planet: The split tears orbit Isaac instead of spreading.
Tough Love: Teeth tears will split into 4 smaller teeth.
Tractor Beam: Main tears and split tears will travel along the beam.

interactions.text: Small red brimstone tears will fire out upon the beam hitting a wall or enemy.
Brimstone + Soy Milk: Brimstone tears always fire out at the end of the beam.
Dead Onion: Significantly decreases effective range, potentially preventing the split tears from causing damage.
Diplopia: No effect.
Increases range, the bombs fired by Dr. Fetus will split into smaller bombs, much like Scatter Bombs.
Epic Fetus: Only tear stat change applies.
Euthanasia: Needle tears will split into 4 small needle tears upon hitting the ground or an enemy. Split tears produced have a chance to deal triple damage but will not cause tear bursts.
Fire Mind: Main tear splits into four explosive splash tears. Having Host Hat or Pyromaniac is strongly recommended.
Flat Stone: Tears will usually only bounce twice, unless Isaac has high range, and spawn burst tears when they bounce.
Hook Worm: Split tears gain a significant range increase, allowing them to potentially hit farther targets
Kidney Stone: Drastically decreases range, potentially preventing the split tears from causing damage. The stone will not split.
The Ludovico Technique: Overrides Cricket's Body except for stat effects which apply.
Mom's Knife: Range of the knife is significantly decreased.
Number One: Tears disappear very quickly after being fired, and split tears barely travel at all.
Not recommended. Unlike other similar items, Cricket's Body's x0.8 range multiplier does stack with Number One's own x0.8 range multiplier, thus drastically reducing range.
Piercing tears: Tears will only split after landing on the ground.
Spectral tears: Tears will only split after landing on the ground.
Cricket's Body tear splitting effect applies when lasers hit something.

needsReview: Split tears are scaled down by 0.6x from the main ones, ignoring damage-based size reduction.

name: Gimpy
description: Gives chance of spawning a Soul Heart when taking damage. Enemies have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart after being killed.
effects: When Isaac takes damage, there is a chance that a Soul Heart may spawn.
Monsters have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart after being killed. Chance depends on killed monster's base health.

synergies.text: Blood Oath: For each half heart damaged by Blood Oath, Gimpy has a chance to drop a soul heart. Synergy further improves with luck.

Dark Bum: Dark Bum can collect the Half Red Hearts that enemies drop, which when combined with the chance to drop Soul Hearts when damaged, is a good way to generate Soul and Black Hearts as well as other pickups.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can't drop hearts.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can't drop hearts.

name: Black Lotus
description: Grants one Red Heart Container, one Soul Heart, and one Black Heart.
effects: Grants a full Red Heart Container, one Soul Heart, and one Black Heart.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

name: Piggy Bank
description: Gives 3 Penny on pick-up. Every time Isaac is damaged, he will drop one or two additional pennies.
effects: Adds 3 Penny on pickup.
When Isaac takes damage, spawns 1 or 2 Pennies near him.

interactions.text: Dull Razor: Activates Piggy Bank's effect without actually taking any damage.
Keeper/Tainted Keeper: Drops 0-1 pennies instead.
Piggy Bank: Multiple copies will only add 3 more coins on pickup, with no additional coins dropping on taking damage.

name: Mom's Perfume
description: Adds a chance to shoot fear tears. Decreases tear delay by 1. +0.5 fire rate.
effects: Adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
+0.5 fire rate.

synergies.text: Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / Haemolacria / The Parasite: If the main tear causes fear, the split tears cause fear too.
Finger!: Finger can also apply the fear effect.
Lachryphagy: If a fear tear is fed, all burst tears cause fear. If a normal tear is fed, the burst tears cannot cause fear.
The Ludovico Technique: The tear flickers yellow, capable of inflicting fear when it does.

interactions.text: Abaddon: The chance to inflict fear does not stack.

name: Monstro's Lung
description: Replaces normal tears with a charged shot that fires 14 tears in the same fashion as Monstro.
effects: Grants a charged shot that fires 14 tears in the same fashion as Monstro.
The attack can be released only when fully charged.
Each tear deals 100% Isaac's damage.
Each tear has a random size multiplier between 0.9x to 1.33x, but there is no effect on damage.
Tears down: Tear Delay x 4.3 / Fire Rate / 4.3 (roughly 0.23x).

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider
Adds 2.4 extra tears to the barrage per extra tear added by the item, rounded down to the nearest whole number. For the latter two, greatly slows down the charge.
Almond Milk / Soy Milk: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge, regardless of fire rate.
Anti-Gravity: Hover effect is overidden, but tear delay down still applies, which greatly reduces the charge time.
Blood Clot: All tears are larger, with increased damage (as opposed to every 2nd tear like Blood Clot alone).
Tears have a 50% chance to be Blood Clot tears.

Brimstone: Brimstone has priority. Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. Fires 3-5 additional beams in random directions around Isaac. This effect also applies to Azazel and Tainted Azazel's versions of Brimstone.
Brimstone + Eye Sore: Overrides this synergy with a chance to shoot 1-3 additional beams in random directions.
This does not apply to Lilith's Incubus; picking up Chocolate Milk will significantly reduce damage and increase charge time.
The tear damage and the barrage size scale with charge amount. At 50% charge, the tear damage is 100%, the barrage size reaches 100% and is capped there. At 100% charge, the tear damage is 200%.
Charge Time (s) = (1)/(30)(Roundup(Tear Delay * (5)/(2) + 1)) approx (5)/(2 * Fire Rate)
This makes damage per second drop to 80%.
Monstro's Lung has priority. Does not apply Dr. Fetus' tears down. Fires 6 mini-bombs which detonate at different times. Multi-shot effects add 1 bomb to the barrage, up to 21 bombs.
Epic Fetus: Epic Fetus has priority. Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. 2-4 extra cursors rotate around the main cursor before the missiles land.
Eye Sore: Adds a chance to fire 1-3 additional barrages in random directions.

The Forgotten: Melee swing is unaffected, but the throw attack is replaced by the burst attack with small bones instead of tears. Each additional copy of Monstro's lung adds 5 bone clubs in his melee attack, up to a limit of 16. The Soul behaves normally, including the tears down.
Flat Stone: All tears bounce simultaneously; the effective range is greatly increased.

Haemolacria: Monstro's Lung has priority. Applies +43 Tear Delay after Haemolacria tears down, instead of Monstro's Lung tears down. The barrage size is reduced to 4/7 (roughly 0.57), tears of which all burst.
The barrage size is 8 without any multi-shot effect. The resulting amount is rounded, and is capped at 29.
Immaculate Heart: Fires a large number of extra tears alongside the burst that begin orbiting Isaac once they reach the orbit range.
Ipecac: Fires Ipecac tears, with no increase in charge time.
Applies Ipecac's tears down.
Technology: Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. Grants a charged shot, fires 12 lasers in 30° spread that arc 3-4 times. A laser can hit an enemy multiple times between their arcings.
Charge Time (s) = (1)/(30)(Roundup((43)/(10) (Tear Delay + 1))) approx (43)/(10 * Fire Rate)
This is equivalent of applying Monstro's Lung's tears down and its charge time, without actually altering tear delay.
Multi-shot effects add 12 lasers to the barrage, up to 128 lasers total.
Technology + Mysterious Liquid: The lasers leave creep each time they arc, resulting in a massive amount of creep.
Technology + Proptosis: The 6x damage is recovered each time they arc, nearly nullifying the distance penalty.
Tech X: Fires 3-5 extra rings in 30° spread. Extra rings deal from 50% to 100% damage of the main ring.
Additional copy of Monstro's Lung adds 3-5 more rings.
Fire Rate is divided by 3.1.
The Ludovico Technique: The Ludovico Technique has priority. Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. A cluster of variably sized tears orbit the main tear.
Mom's Knife: Mom's Knife has priority. Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. Fires additional knives depending on charge amount, each dealing 2x tear damage. Fires 3-5 knives at maximum charge.
Spawns spiders upon firing, not charging. The amount of spiders spawned is dependent on luck.
Monstro's Lung: Additional copies of this item, such as from Diplopia / Crooked Penny, add 10/ 12 tears to the barrage.
This effects is equivalent of adding 4/ 5 multi-shot effects. The items which have priority over Monstro's Lung or override it (e.g. Brimstone/C Section) benefit from this multi-shot effect.
My Reflection: Tears stay in the air much longer and consistently, allowing better reach and more focused blasts before the tears returning to Isaac.
Tractor Beam: All the tears follow the beam at different heights without spreading out, making it much easier for multiple tears to hit a target.

interactions.text: Tears have a 50% chance to be Chemical Peel tears.
C Section: Overrides Monstro's Lung.
Cursed Eye: Overridden by Monstro's Lung.
Epiphora: Tears stat is increased properly but firing cancels the effect.
Isaac's Tears / Sad Bombs / Tammy's Head: Fires 8 normal tears.
Only stat effects from Kidney Stone apply.
Kiney Stone will work if technology has been picked up.

Lachryphagy: The tears merge into one giant tears a while after being fired, and instantly burst. Without piercing, most of the damage is often wasted. Without spectral, the tears often collide against obstacles due to their size.
Adds a chance to fire barrages in the other direction(s).
Works as expected. Fires automatically upon reaching full charge.
Neptunus: Overridden by Monstro's Lung.
Pop!: The tears still fall after being fired.
Spirit Sword: Overrides Monstro's Lung.
Strange Attractor: Due to the high concentration of tears enemies will be pulled into Isaac at great force, in certain cases enough force to pull enemies through rocks.
Tech.5: Occasionally fires a linear laser while charging.
Technology 2: Fires a linear laser while charging.
Ipecac + Dr. Fetus: Removes explosion immunity.
Adds a multi-shot effect (see Notes section). Full-sized barrage on each diagonal direction.

dpsNote: fires a burst of 14 tears per charged shot
needsReview: Grants a charged shot that fires 14 tears in the same fashion as Monstro.
Each tear deals 100% Isaac's damage.
Each tear has a random size multiplier between 0.9x to 1.33x, but there is no effect on damage.

name: Abaddon
description: +1.5 damage, +0.2 speed. Removes all Red Heart containers, grants six Black Hearts, and adds a chance to shoot fear tears. +1.5 damage, +0.2 speed. Grants two Black Hearts, converts all Red Heart Containers into Black Hearts, and adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
effects: +1.5 damage.
+0.2 speed
Converts all current Red Heart containers into Black Hearts, and adds 2 additional Black Hearts.
Empties all Bone Hearts without removing them.
Adds a chance to shoot fear tears.

synergies.text: Black Feather: Grants a damage boost.

interactions.text: Bethany: Leaves her with half a Red Heart with her other Heart Containers removed.
Greed's Gullet: If heart containers are being granted, removes them as well as 25 cents.
Keeper/Tainted Keeper: Sets Coin Hearts to 1 on pickup.
Mom's Perfume: The chance to inflict fear does not stack.
Tainted Bethany: Does not remove stored Red Hearts nor converts them into Black Hearts.

name: Ball of Tar
description: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears. Isaac leaves a trail of slowing creep behind as he moves, impeding enemies' speed.
effects: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing the speed of enemy movement and any projectiles they fire.
Isaac leaves a trail of slowing Black creep.

name: Stop Watch
quote: Let's slow this down a bit...
description: +0.3 speed. Automatically inflicts slow to all enemies in every room. +0.3 speed. Upon taking damage, inflicts slow to all enemies for the current room. +0.3 speed. Slows all enemies in every room to 80% speed.
effects: Slows all enemies to 80% of their original movement speed and attacking speeds. This is separate from the slow status, and fully stacks with it. Isaac's tears and enemy shots are also slowed.
+0.3 speed.

synergies.text: All Slow effects: Stacks with the status resulting in enemies moving at about 41% of their original speed.

interactions.text: Both the slow effect and the rarer speed up can trigger at the start of a room.
This results in enemies being sped up by 12%.
Tech X: Unlike most shots which are slowed down by Stop Watch, Tech X laser rings move at normal speed and gain no benefit they would get from slower shots.

needsReview: Slows all enemies to 80% of their original movement speed and attacking speeds. This is separate from the slow status, and fully stacks with it. Isaac's tears and enemy shots are also slowed.

name: Tiny Planet
description: Massively increases Range and grants spectral tears. Tears orbit around Isaac at a fixed distance until they hit the ground.
effects: +6.5 range.
Grants spectral tears.
Tears now revolve around Isaac at a fixed distance until they hit the ground.
The tears orbit close to Isaac, offset slightly in the direction fired. Changing the firing direction will redirect all previously fired tears.

synergies.text: 20/20: Each shot fires two tears in opposing orbital directions.
This synergy is effectively the same for The Wiz, with the exception of 20/20's damage penalty not being applied.
Anti-Gravity: Tears orbit around Isaac at a short range while fire button is held. When the fire button is released, tears snap to their normal range.
Azazel: Increases Azazel's range with Brimstone, and wraps the beam around the character.
Brain Worm: Tears will home directly towards nearby enemies in a line from the center of the orbit.
Brimstone: The beam will wrap around the character and shoot straight forward.
Brimstone + Mom's Knife: The knives shot after the Brimstone beam similarly wrap around the character and shoot forward.
Cricket's Body: Tears will split into 2 close groups of 2 tears that follow the orbit. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
Euthanasia: Euthanasia's tear bursts will follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 5 tears. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
Eye of Belial: After piercing an enemy, instead of homing in on enemies, tears will continue to orbit, but each tear can pierce multiple enemies to gain more size and damage multipliers.
Eye of the Occult: Tears struggle to move outside of the pre-set path Tiny Planet gives.
Flat Stone: Tears will bounce and orbit around the character.
Godhead: Tears with damaging auras orbit the character, creating a damaging barrier.
Ipecac: Explosive tears orbit around Isaac. Host Hat or Pyromaniac is highly recommended.
Kidney Stone: The stone and barrage of tears that follow orbit the character.

Lachryphagy: Tears will orbit until they are behind the character. Tears will burst into 8 tears that follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 4. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
Tears orbit the player without slowing down, and can be fed as normal. When a tear bursts, the created tears orbit the place of burst.
Loki's Horns: Effectively grants a great tear multiplier, as the extra tears from Loki's Horns will follow the trajectory given by the Tiny Planet.
Lost Contact: Shielded tears will orbit Isaac, granting a partially successful 360-degree projectile protection around him. Works better with a faster fire rate or Anti-Gravity.
A Lump of Coal: This item drastically increases the screen time of tears because it makes them orbit around Isaac for a few seconds. A Lump Of Coal adds a lot of damage to tears in "outer orbit".
The tears do not fall during The Beast fight, allowing tears to grow bigger and bigger.
Marked: Isaac will continuously fire orbiting tears, which allows him to not touch the attack keys and focus just on moving (with giant tears it makes it hard to see as he can't stop firing).
Mom's Knife: Increases range. Causes Mom's knife to orbit around Isaac at very high speeds until it reaching it's maximum range, where it will circle back to Isaac at the same speed.
My Reflection: After reaching their maximum range, the tears will circle back around to Isaac.
Revelation: The beam of light wraps around Isaac and shoots forward at a slight angle, similar to Brimstone.

Rubber Cement: Tears bounce off enemies then keep orbiting Isaac. Very powerful as the tears are not destroyed upon damaging an enemy. When near walls, the orbiting tears tend to get stuck against the walls until Isaac moves away.

Spirit Sword: The sword's melee attack becomes disjointed from Isaac, hitting in an increased range in front of him but creating a blind spot where the strike used to be. Spin attacks also occur in front of Isaac instead of around him. Sword projectiles orbit around Isaac as normal.
Tainted Eve: Blood clot familiars will each fire tears in their own individual orbits, rather than all orbiting around the character.
Tainted Lilith: Tears orbit around the Gello instead of the character.
Technology: A laser creates a circle around Isaac's body before being fired forward normally. The laser becomes spectral.
Technology + A Lump of Coal: The extra distance covered by the laser more than doubles damage right in front of Isaac, and it increases as normal further away.
