The beam decreases in damage and width the farther it travels. Tears become virtually powerless across large rooms like the Boss Rush and the Hush fight, reaching its minimum of 0.1 roughly at 8 tiles.
The beams do 6x damage at point blank range.
Tech X: Ring size and damage is substantially increased, but decreases as the ring travels further from Isaac.
Damage slightly increased, beam damage is doubled. Blasts lose no power with distance.
Bird's Eye: Size and damage of fires is increased, but does not decrease with range.

interactions.text: Athame/Maw Of The Void: The ring is much larger and deals 1.5× damage.
The ring deals normal damage.
The ring is now normal size.
Broken Watch: The speedup effect applies to tears and increases the effective range.

Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Tears will often disappear before they can burst. Tears created from bursts will also shrink, but due to their already low range, the difference may not be noticeable.
Era Walk card/I'm Drowsy... pill/Stop Watch: The slowdown effect applies to tears and reduces the effective range of Proptosis.
Flat Stone: At base range and tear size, tears will bounce twice against the floor and then disappear.
Immaculate Heart: Tears that appear around Isaac disappear quickly.
Ipecac: Tears almost disappear completely but are still able to do massive damage.
Tears no longer deal massive damage at the end of the arch. Damage decreases rapidly with range.
Isaac's Heart is a very good item to have, as you can run up to most enemies to deal maximum damage to them with little downside.
Lachryphagy: Tears disappear too quickly to be fed.
The Ludovico Technique: The closer the tear floats to Isaac, the larger it is. The farther away, the smaller it becomes.
Monstro's Lung/Lead Pencil: Tears will disappear at different distances depending on how big they were when fired.
My Reflection: Tears disappear before they can return to Isaac.
Pop!: Tears will disappear extremely quickly after being fired.
Saturnus The ring tears from Saturnus disappear nearly instantly upon entering a room.
Soy Milk: Very poor combination. Tears disappear nearly instantly in front of Isaac, decreasing his range and damage to nearly nothing.
Tears no longer disappear instantly. Range is only minimally shorter.

needsReview: The tears shrink and lose damage the more time they stay airborne, starting at 3x damage at point blank range. After 0.8 seconds, they deal no damage at all.

name: Missing Page 2
quote: Evil up. Your enemies will pay!
description: Grants one Black Heart. Upon taking damage that reduces Isaac's health to one heart or less, deals damage to all enemies in the room. Increases the damage of Black Hearts and The Necronomicon-like effects by 40.
effects: Grants one Black Heart.
Activates The Necronomicon effect upon taking damage if Isaac's total health (Red Hearts, Soul Hearts, and Black Hearts) is at one heart or less afterwards.
Adds +40 damage to The Necronomicon and similar effects, such as Black Hearts.

synergies.text: Black Feather: Counts as an 'evil' item, granting a damage up.
Blood Rights / Dry Baby / The Negative / Heartbreak / XIII - Death / Black Rune: The damage boost is applied to these items.
A Missing Page/Missing Page 2: The damage increase from the trinket/copies of Missing Page 2 stacks, adding +40 damage per stack to The Necronomicon and similar effects.

name: Clear Rune
description: Copies the effect of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the rune. Drops a random rune when first picked up.
effects: Upon use, copies the effects of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac.
Drops one random rune upon being picked up for the first time.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Essentially uses the rune or soul stone twice.

Jera: Allows Isaac to copy pickups with every use. This combination can double Lil' Battery, which can both circumvent the rune's high charge time and allow for game-breaking combos with repeated use of the synergy.

interactions.text: Tarot Cloth: No effect.

Void: If Void absorbs both Clear Rune and a consumable-producing item like Mom's Bottle of Pills the latter takes effect first, shifting any held rune out of the primary consumable slot and rendering the Clear Rune effect useless.

name: Smart Fly
description: Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots. Upon taking damage, the familiar will pursue enemies for the rest of the room, dealing damage.
effects: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits Isaac, blocking enemy shots. If Isaac takes damage, this fly will seek out nearby enemies and attack them for the current room.
The fly always deals 1.5 damage per tick or 6.4 damage per second on contact with enemies.

interactions.text: Duct Tape: Fly will stay in place when orbiting Isaac but will still pursue enemies.

needsReview: The fly always deals 1.5 damage per tick or 6.4 damage per second on contact with enemies.

name: Dry Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a chance of triggering The Necronomicon effect.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a 25% chance of triggering The Necronomicon effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room. This effect of the familiar has a cooldown of 150 frames.

synergies.text: A Missing Page / Missing Page 2: Dry Baby will deal an additional +40 damage. Effects stack together and with multiple copies.
Duct Tape: Picking up Duct Tape while Dry Baby has the same position as Isaac will result in Dry Baby blocking almost all projectiles that would hit him while holding the trinket.
This can be achieved by standing in a doorway, dropping Duct Tape, leaving the room, then re-entering the room slowly.

interactions.text: BFFS!: No effect on damage or blocking radius; only the visual size is changed.
Isaac's Heart: No longer follows Isaac in a way where Dry Baby can constantly block it from tears.

name: Juicy Sack
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and drips a trail of slow creep, spawning 1-2 Blue Spiders after each room.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac, leaving a trail of white creep that slows enemies.
Spawns 1-2 Blue Spiders after every room.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Juicy Sack spawns an extra Blue Spider.

name: Robo-Baby 2.0
quote: We worked out all the kinks
description: Spawns a familiar that fires lasers at any enemy in its line of sight and moves based on the direction Isaac is firing tears.
effects: Spawns a familiar who moves in the direction Isaac is firing and automatically fires Technology lasers that each deal 3.5 damage towards enemies when it aligns with them.

name: Rotten Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that spawns a Blue Fly when Isaac shoots. It can only have one Fly at a time.
effects: Spawns a familiar which spawns friendly blue flies in a room with monsters when Isaac holds down a fire key.
The initial blue fly will target a monster once nearby, in which Rotten Baby will lock its blue flies automatically onto the same one, immediately heading towards and damaging it until it dies.

synergies.text: Fish Tail: Rotten Baby will spawn two flies at a time.
Mongo Baby: Mongo Baby will also spawn flies.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Rotten Baby becomes larger, but this is only a cosmetic change.
Hive Mind: Fly damage is doubled.
The Twins: Unlimited flies can be slowly generated by walking back and forth between rooms while firing. A new fly will generate each time Rotten Baby is duplicated.

name: Headless Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac, leaving blood creep on the ground.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around, leaving a trail of red creep that damages enemies.
The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
The creep deals damage much more rapidly at 20 damage per second.

synergies.text: Lost Cork: Creep trail size is bigger.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Familiar is bigger; however, no effect on creep damage.

needsReview: The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
The creep deals damage much more rapidly at 20 damage per second.

name: Leech
description: Spawns a leech familiar that chases enemies, dealing ~3 damage per second. Heals a Half Red Heart whenever Leech kills an enemy.
effects: Spawns a crawling Leech familiar that follows Isaac. If an enemy comes near, the Leech will attack and chase it, doing 1.5 damage per tick or about 3.2 damage per second. If an enemy is killed by the Leech, Isaac will be healed by a Half Red Heart.

synergies.text: Arcades: The player can let the Leech eat Fly from the Shell Game and use the resulting health to gamble on the Blood Donation Machine.
BFFS!: Leech grows bigger and does double damage. Still only heals for a Half Red Heart.
Gnawed Leaf: The player can stand still and allow the Leech to clear a room, granting simple clears and easy health.
Tainted Bethany: The leech can grant blood charges by killing enemies.
Tainted Magdalene: Leech restores a full Red Heart.

interactions.text: E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop are now treated as regular poop and can't be damaged by Leech.
Maggy's Bow: No effect on healing.

needsReview: Spawns a crawling Leech familiar that follows Isaac. If an enemy comes near, the Leech will attack and chase it, doing 1.5 damage per tick or about 3.2 damage per second. If an enemy is killed by the Leech, Isaac will be healed by a Half Red Heart.

name: Mystery Sack
description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Heart, coin, Bomb, or Key every 5-6 rooms.
effects: Spawns a familiar that drops a Heart, coin, Bomb, or Key (or any of their variations) alternatively every 5 or 6 rooms.

synergies.text: BFFS!: The familiar drops pickups alternatingly every 4 or 5 rooms.

name: BBF
description: Spawns a familiar that flies around the room in a zig-zag pattern and explodes on contact with an enemy. Respawns after ten seconds.
effects: Spawns a familiar that flies around the room like a Boom Fly and explodes on contact with an enemy.
Deals 100 damage to all enemies within its blast radius and 10 damage to the enemy it touched.
It will respawn 10 seconds after exploding, or upon entering a different room.

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles the contact damage to 20 and increases explosion damage by 25.
Contact damage becomes 20 and explosion damage increases to 125.
Mr. Mega: The explosion damage increases by 50 points.

interactions.text: Effects applied as normal
Blood Bombs
Brimstone Bombs
Butt Bombs
Glitter Bombs
Hot Bombs
Nancy Bombs
Sad Bombs
No effect
Bobby-Bomb
Fast Bombs
Ghost Bombs
Rocket in a Jar
Scatter Bombs
Sticky Bombs
Bob's Curse: The explosion applies poison effect.
Does not leave the poison cloud.
Explodes in a cross-shaped pattern. Damage from the main explosion deals a flat 37.5 damage, and any additional explosion deals flat 75 damage to which Bomber boy's damage reduction is not applied.
Bomber Boy + BFFS! / Hive Mind: Explosion damages are increased to 1.25x, which are 46.875/93.75 each.
Bomber Boy + Mr. Mega: Explosion damages are increased to 1.5x, which are 56.25/112.5 each.
Bomber Boy + BFFS! / Hive Mind + Mr. Mega: Explosion damages are increased to 1.75x, which are 65.625/131.25 each.

name: Bob's Brain
description: Spawns a familiar that charges forward when shooting tears and explodes upon contact with an enemy, damaging and poisoning them. The familiar respawns after a few seconds.
effects: Spawns a floating brain familiar that can be fired towards enemies as a projectile.
Bob's Brain is fired directly from where it is located in the chain of familiars behind Isaac, making aiming it slightly more difficult.
If it hits an enemy, it deals 3.5 damage and explodes, further damaging and poisoning monsters.
The explosion deals 100 damage. The poison damage is dealt 4 times, inflicting Isaac's Damage per tick.
The explosion ignores armor.
The explosion can hurt Isaac, dealing a full heart of damage.
This can make picking up the item a risky choice, as Bob's Brain will always fire, regardless of whether or not Isaac will be caught in the explosion.
Once it explodes, it takes a few seconds to re-appear.

synergies.text: BFFS!: The impact damage is increased to 7 and the explosion deals an additional 25 damage.
Mr. Mega: The explosion deals an additional 85/50 damage.

interactions.text: Effects applied as normal
Blood Bombs
Brimstone Bombs
Butt Bombs
Glitter Bombs
Hot Bombs
Nancy Bombs
Sad Bombs
No effect
Bobby-Bomb
The poison effect of Bob's curse is applied which deals only 2 ticks of damage, resulting in inflicting halved damage.
Fast Bombs
Ghost Bombs
Rocket in a Jar
Scatter Bombs
Spiders do not spawn, however the explosion leaves behind a puddle of slowing creep.
Explodes in a cross-shaped pattern. Damage from the main explosion deals a flat 37.5 damage, and any additional explosion deals flat 75 damage to which Bomber boy's damage reduction is not applied.
Bomber Boy + BFFS!: Explosion damages are increased to 1.25x, which are 46.875/93.75 each.
Bomber Boy + Mr. Mega: Explosion damages are increased to 1.5x, which are 56.25/112.5 each.
Bomber Boy + BFFS! + Mr. Mega: Explosion damages are increased to 1.75x, which are 65.625/131.25 each.
Duct Tape: Bob's Brain stays in place relative to Isaac until it is fired.
Bob's Brain no longer explodes upon hitting poops made from enemies.

needsReview: If it hits an enemy, it deals 3.5 damage and explodes, further damaging and poisoning monsters.
The explosion deals 100 damage. The poison damage is dealt 4 times, inflicting Isaac's Damage per tick.

name: Best Bud
description: When hit, spawns a quickly orbiting attack fly similar to Forever alone for the current room that deals high damage.
effects: Upon taking damage, spawns a white attack fly for the duration of the current room. The fly orbits Isaac at medium range, similar to Forever alone, but with much higher speed.
The fly deals 10 damage per tick (150 contact damage per second).

interactions.text: Best Bud: Multiple copies of Best Buds do not stack, only 1 fly can be spawned

needsReview: The fly deals 10 damage per tick (150 contact damage per second).

name: Lil Brimstone
description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires a thin Brimstone beam that charges while holding the fire button and shoots when released.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires a thin Brimstone beam that deals 3 damage per tick and can strike an enemy up to 8 times, for a total of 24 damage. It needs to be charged up and will only fire when the fire button is released.

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: Brimstone beams will home in on enemies.
BFFS!: The beam deals double damage.

Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone beam deals to 8 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone beam under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
Hemoptysis + BFFS!: The curse causes the beam's damage to be increased to 13 damage per tick.
King Baby / Marked: While firing, Brimstone will be charged automatically and fired immediately upon full charge, the beam will now target the nearest enemy/crosshair.

interactions.text: Eye of the Occult: When used with a laser attack (such as Brimstone), Lil Brimstone will not automatically fire as it would with Marked.

name: Isaac's Heart
description: Isaac himself is now immune to all damage, and a heart familiar follows him. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt. The heart charges up as Isaac shoots, firing 8 blood shots, knocking back enemies, and leaving a puddle of creep when released.
effects: Isaac's body becomes immune to all damage from enemies and the environment. This does not include interactable objects such as Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.
A heart familiar appears and closely follows Isaac. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt.
The heart tries to position itself in the opposite direction of where Isaac is shooting.

The heart charges up as Isaac fires. At full charge, upon releasing the fire button, it knocks back nearby enemies and tears, creates a small puddle of red creep on the ground, and releases blood shots in 8 directions that deal 8 damage.
Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles by the knockback blast take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.
Enemies that come in contact with Isaac take 2x Isaac's current damage per tick or 4x Isaac's damage per second.

synergies.text: 120 Volt/Monstrance: These items become much safer to use offensively as they are centered around Isaac's body which no longer takes damage.
Box of Friends: Box of Friends does not duplicate the heart, making it safe to use.
Works as normal except for the fact that the damage to the heart must be blocked to spawn the 4 beams.
Duct Tape: Makes dodging significantly easier.
E. Coli: Isaac can turn enemies into poop without taking damage.
Holy Mantle: The shield effect carries over to the heart.
Gigante Bean: Makes the heart much easier to defend as it increases the knockback amount and radius of the heart when fully charged and the heart makes farting noises when it shoots.
Items granting invulnerability or a shield: The invincibility carries over to the heart.
Due to the contact damage, Gnawed Leaf allows Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
Kamikaze!: As long as the heart is away from the blast radius, no damage is taken. The character must be at high enough speed for this.
Pyromaniac / Host Hat: Explosion immunity carries over to the heart.
The heart must be in range of explosion for Pyromaniac to heal Isaac.
Sacrificial Altar now doesn't remove Isaac's Heart.
Serpent's Kiss: Isaac can poison enemies by contact without taking damage, allowing for free black hearts.

interactions.text: Aries: The invulnerability does not extend to the heart.
Baby-Bender: The heart's tears do not gain homing.
BFFS!: Fires additional shots in random directions, and leaves larger puddles of creep.
Isaac's Heart no longer follows Isaac in a way where Dry Baby can constantly block it from tears.
Isaac's Heart no longer follows Isaac in a way where Farting Baby can constantly block it from tears.
A Pound of Flesh: Consumables can no longer be picked up in Shops.
The Soul: Isaac's body repels projectiles, but Isaac's Heart doesn't.
Tainted Forgotten: The heart follows Tainted Soul.

needsReview: Enemies that come in contact with Isaac take 2x Isaac's current damage per tick or 4x Isaac's damage per second.

name: Lil Haunt
description: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 4 damage per second and inflicting fear.
effects: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 2 damage per tick (4 damage per second) and inflicting fear.
The familiar has an exceptionally higher detection range than most other familiars that chase down enemies.
needsReview: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 2 damage per tick (4 damage per second) and inflicting fear.

name: Dark Bum
quote: He wants to take your life
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every 1½ Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will give a reward.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every one-and-a-half Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will generate one of the following
A single Black Heart.
A hostile Spider.
A friendly Blue Spider.
A random pill, card, or rune.

synergies.text: Humbleing Bundle / Equality!: Most Red Heart drops will become Double Red Heart drops. This counts as two full Red Hearts for Dark Bum, essentially doubling the value of it.

interactions.text: BFFS!: No effect, but familiar is bigger.
Dark Bum / Cambion Conception: Each Dark Bum tracks the collected hearts separately.
King Baby / RC Remote: No effect.
Options?: If one of the options is a Red Heart variant, Dark Bum may collect it, making the other option disappear.

name: Big Fan
description: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 30 damage per second to enemies. Reduces the speed other orbitals rotate at.
effects: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 2 damage per tick (~8.57 damage per second) on contact.
Reduces the rotation speed of all of Isaac's orbitals. This excludes Pretty Flies.

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Big Fan becomes visually larger and deals more damage.
Guillotine: Reduces the head's rotation speed, making it easier to aim.

interactions.text: Friendship Necklace: No effect.
Guardian Angel: Overrides Guardian Angel's speed boost. If Guardian Angel was obtained first, it will retain its own increased speed. If Big Fan was obtained first, Guardian Angel will be slower.
Psy Fly: Rotates slower, but moves at full speed while blocking incoming projectiles.

needsReview: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 2 damage per tick (~8.57 damage per second) on contact.

name: Sissy Longlegs
description: Spawns a familiar that wanders randomly, occasionally spawning Blue Spiders. Briefly charms enemies on contact.
effects: Spawns a familiar that wanders around the room and occasionally spawns friendly Blue Spiders.
Blue Spiders are spawned once every 10-15 seconds, as long as there are enemies in the room.
Only up to 5 Blue Spiders can be spawned at a time.
Charms enemies briefly on contact.

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Spawn delay is decreased to 7-11 seconds.
Mom's Wig: The maximum number of Blue Spiders is increased to 10.

name: Punching Bag
description: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that wanders randomly. Enemies will attack the Mulligan if it's closer.
effects: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that walks around the room and acts as a decoy for monsters.
If the monsters are closer to the decoy than Isaac, they will attack the decoy.
Homing shots from enemies will always be attracted to the decoy if they are closer to it than Isaac.
Punching Bag will also block enemy shots.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Adds another Punching Bag. This may cause enemies to become unpredictable, so use with caution.
If the Punching Bag has died, it can be forced to respawn with a double upon using the Box of Friends.

name: How to Jump
description: Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving, allowing travel over obstacles and enemies.
effects: Upon use, Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving. The distance of the jump depends on how fast Isaac was moving and for how long he was holding the button when the item was activated. Jumping allows Isaac to travel over obstacles such as rocks and pits.
While mid-jump, enemies, projectiles, Bombs, and spikes cannot damage Isaac. Isaac cannot interact with pickups or Chest mid-jump.

synergies.text: Broken Remote: Isaac can teleport indefinitely, but the jump will instantly be cancelled by the teleport.
Panic Button: Makes Isaac immune to contact and projectile damage while moving.

Familiars that orbit Isaac (such as Sacrificial Dagger, Sworn Protector, etc.) can damage enemies when Isaac jumps over them. However, items that activate on contact (e. g. Serpent's Kiss, Midas' Touch, etc.) cannot trigger during jumps.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

Void: If this item is activated by Void, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.

name: D100
description: Activates the combined effects of D4, The D6, and D20. Activates the combined effects of D1, D4, The D6, D7, D8, D10, D12, and D20.
effects: Rerolls all passive items on Isaac (like the D4).
Rerolls all pedestal items in the room (like The D6).
Rerolls all pickups in the room (like the D20).
Restarts the room and respawns all enemies (like the D7).
Rerolls Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed (like the D8).
Rerolls all enemies in the room into weaker ones (like the D10).
Doesn't go into effect in rooms the D7 works in.
Rerolls all rocks in the room (like the D12).
Duplicates 1 random pickup in the current room (like the D1).
The pickup is rerolled by the D20 before being duplicated, essentially just granting a random extra pickup.
needsReview: Rerolls Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed (like the D8).

name: D4
description: Rerolls all of Isaac's passive items.
effects: Upon use, rerolls each of Isaac's passive items into new ones.
The new items will be drawn from the item pool where the original item was acquired.
If health upgrade items are removed by a reroll, the health they granted is subtracted.

synergies.text: Abyss: Locusts created by Abyss are not rerolled.

name: D10
description: Rerolls all monsters in the room. Replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters.
effects: Upon use, replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters. Each monster type has a specific weaker monster it will transform into. If the monster is already at its weakest level, it usually transforms it into a background critter or kills it outright.
Some enemies can be transformed into obstacles or pickups instead.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Weakens affected enemies twice.

name: Blank Card
description: Copies the effect of the card or rune currently held by Isaac. Copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the card.
effects: Upon use, copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. Blank Card's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the card Isaac was holding when he used it.

synergies.text: Butter!: As Blank Card is dropped upon usage, the recharge time for it is reset to 4, allowing to use more expensive cards much more frequently.
Car Battery: Uses the card twice. For example, if used with the Two of Hearts/Diamonds/etc. cards it will quadruple whatever amount Isaac has.
Tarot Cloth: Invokes the extra effect when used.
Only certain cards gain the Tarot Cloth effect with Blank Card.
Car Battery + Tarot Cloth: The effect of the active card is quadrupled.
Only certain Tarot Cloth effects will be doubled again.
2 of Diamonds + Restock or in Greed mode

This cannot be repeated infinitely outside of Greed Mode, as Restock now increases the price of a shop slot each time something is purchased from it. Having 12 coins will very slowly allow Isaac to obtain 99 coins, however.
Deep Pockets allows this to once again be repeated infinitely, as the price will cap at 99 coins, while up to 999 coins can be obtained.
? Card: Teleports Isaac to the I AM ERROR room. This will consume both the Blank Card and the ? Card.

An exception is when they are used on Chest, Dark Room, The Void, Ultra Greed, Mausoleum/Gehenna II leading to Ascent, Corpse II, or Home floors. Using them here consumes both the Blank Card and the ? Card, spawning an I AM ERROR Shopkeeper.
Jera: Copies pickups with every use. This combination can double Lil' Battery, which can allow for game-breaking combos, due to repeated use of the synergy.
Spawning too many items will cause objects to despawn. This can even despawn the End Chest after finishing a final boss fight.

interactions.text: Little Baggy: All cards are replaced by pills, rendering Blank Card useless unless Isaac also has Starter Deck.
Wild Card: Does nothing if used through Blank Card. Wild Card can, however, copy the last card used through Blank Card.

name: Book of Secrets
description: Gives the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor. If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.
effects: Randomly grants the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor.
If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead.
Repeated activations will continue to add the other items' effects.

Book of Secrets cannot give mapping effects that Isaac already has (whether from a previous activation or through possessing the equivalent item). After all effects have been given, further activations do nothing.
Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.

synergies.text: Car Battery
Gives 2 different mapping effects and extends the duration of the glow effect applied onto special rocks.
The Mind: Immediately gives the X-Ray Vision effect for the floor upon use.

name: Box of Spiders
description: Spawns 1-4 / 4-8 Blue Spiders where Isaac is standing.
effects: Spawns 4-8 Blue Spiders.

synergies.text: Hive Mind: Doubles the spiders' damage.

name: Red Candle
description: Throws out a flame that damages everything in its path, diminishing in size as it hits enemies or blocks shots.
effects: On use, Isaac raises the candle above his head. On pressing a fire button, a red flame, similar to a Red Fire Place, will fire in the chosen direction. It can pass over pits, but can not travel through obstacles.

The flame can hit up to 4 times, and the damage decreases as the flame shrinks. The first hit deals 23 damage, the second hit deals 17.5 damage, and the last two ticks deal 11.5 damage, for a maximum of 63.25 damage per flame.
The flame also destroys enemy shots it comes into contact with, which decreases its size each time being hit until the flame is entirely extinguished by this process.
Flames will disappear automatically after 10 seconds.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Spawns a second flame that travels a shorter distance.

needsReview: The flame can hit up to 4 times, and the damage decreases as the flame shrinks. The first hit deals 23 damage, the second hit deals 17.5 damage, and the last two ticks deal 11.5 damage, for a maximum of 63.25 damage per flame.

name: The Jar
description: When at full health, up to 4 extra Red Hearts can be stored in The Jar. Activating drops the stored hearts on the ground.
effects: Isaac can store up to 4 extra Red Hearts in The Jar if there are no remaining empty Heart Containers.
When used, all Red Hearts in the jar are dropped on the floor, rather than directly consuming them.

synergies.text: Mom's Locket: Any half red hearts stored by The Jar will be converted to full hearts when dropped on the ground. Since The Jar will store any leftover health from healing Red Heart Containers, this can allow for potentially infinite health when healing half-empty containers. Especially effective in conjunction with Cancer or The Wafer.

interactions.text: Broken Remote: Allows for teleportation with no recharge; however, it drops the contained red hearts in the room it was used.
Car Battery: The Jar acts as usual, and doesn't double the hearts dropped upon activation.
Schoolbag: The player cannot pick up extra hearts while The Jar is in the inactive slot.
Shard of Glass: Storing a heart in the jar without healing does not stop the bleeding effect, despite playing the "heart collected" sound effect.
Keeper/Tainted Keeper: Hearts of any type turn into Blue Flies upon spawning, rendering the item useless.

name: Flush!
description: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop. Instantly kills poop-themed bosses. Floods the current room.
effects: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop.
Floods the whole room with water (same effect as seen in Flooded Caves).
Floods the room with blood if used in Womb and its alts.
Instantly kills most poop-themed bosses (Dingle, Dangle, Brownie, Clog, and Turdlings).
Extinguishes all Normal and Red Fire Places in the room.
Turns lava-filled pits in the Mines into solid rock, allowing them to be walked over.

synergies.text: 120 Volt / Jacob's Ladder: Since Flush! floods the room with water, it is now considered a wet environment, which significantly increases the arcing distance of the electricity created by these items.
Blood Puppy: Instantly tames a hostile Blood Puppy and leaves behind a poop.
Butt Penny/Petrified Poop: Grants poops made from enemies a chance to drop pickups.
Death's List: Enemies that die by being turned into poop do not disrupt the Death's List chain and clearing a room by turning all its enemies into poop still grants Isaac the Death's List reward.
Dirty Mind: Enemies that are turned into poop generate double the normal amount of Dips.
Isaac can heal by destroying poops created from enemies.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Destroying poops created from enemies do not heal Isaac.

name: Satanic Bible
description: Grants one Black Heart. Replaces the boss room item on the current floor with a Devil Deal.
effects: Gives one Black Heart.

Once used, the boss for the floor will drop a Devil Deal instead of a . This item must be paid for with hearts and will prevent Angel Rooms from generating under most circumstances if taken, just like a normal Devil Deal.
This does not affect The Polaroid, The Negative, or Dad's Note.

synergies.text: Converter: Allows for generation of Heart Containers. (Schoolbag required)
Car Battery: Gives Isaac two black hearts.
Soul of the Lost: The Devil Deal can be taken for free.
There's Options: 2 Devil Deals will be offered, but only one can be taken.
Coupon: The Devil Deal can be taken for free. Schoolbag is recommended.
Dream Catcher: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, and the player has no interest in the Cube of Meat, or doesn't mind paying health for it, Satanic Bible can be used early.

interactions.text: Book of Revelations: The spawned Ball of Bandages or Cube of Meat will cost hearts like a normal devil deal.
Chaos: The item spawned will be chosen from a random item pool instead.
IV - The Emperor?: The extra boss room's reward is also transformed into a devil deal.
Genesis: The boss item is still a devil deal even after using Genesis.
Lemegeton: Will generate wisps from the Devil Room item pool when used inside the Boss Room after Satanic Bible is used.
Redemption: Taking the boss's item when it's affected by Satanic Bible will remove the cross however the Boss Room can't give the cross.
Vanishing Twin: The second boss spawned will also drop an item from the Devil Room item pool that must be paid for.
Vanishing Twin + Ascent: After using Satanic Bible If an Item spawned by Vanishing Twin is not bought with hearts it can be bought with coins during the Ascent.

name: Head of Krampus
description: Fires a powerful Brimstone beam in four cardinal directions. Has a 50% chance to rotate all beams around Isaac 90 degrees.
effects: Upon use, fires a powerful Brimstone beam in the four cardinal directions, similar to that of the attack used by The Fallen and Krampus.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Doubles the damage the brimstone beams deal, but not their durations.
Each beam now deals 20 damage per tick, ticking a total of 20 times, dealing a total of 400 damage per use.

name: Butter Bean
description: Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies and projectiles. Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.
effects: Upon use, Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies.
Projectiles are also deflected.
Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.
The deflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

synergies.text: Bird's Eye/Ghost Pepper: Shoots a flame behind Isaac upon each use of Butter Bean. Two flames will be shot if Isaac also has Car Battery.
Panic Button: Activates Butter Bean upon taking damage. If the damage was from a projectile that Butter Bean can knock away, it will be negated.

needsReview: Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.

name: Magic Fingers
description: Consumes one Penny to deal damage to all enemies in the room.
effects: Upon use, consumes one Penny to deal damage to all enemies in the room.
Damage dealt is twice Isaac's damage +10.

synergies.text: Mysterious Candy: Allows for effectively infinite uses with extreme patience - efficiency can be greatly increased with Petrified Poop.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Ipecac: Damage boost is mostly ignored.

needsReview: Damage dealt is twice Isaac's damage +10.

name: Converter
description: Converts two Soul Hearts or Black Hearts into one filled Red Heart Container. Converts one Soul Heart or Black Heart into one filled Red Heart Container.
effects: Converts one Soul Heart or Black Heart into one filled Red Heart container.

synergies.text: Book of Revelations / Satanic Bible: Allows for generation of Heart Containers. (Schoolbag required)
9 Volt + Habit: Allows for an easy setup to get max health as long as one has a self-damage source, such as a Blood Donation Machine or a Devil Beggar.
Guppy's Paw
Allows Isaac to attain up to 12 Red Heart Containers or any combination of Red Heart Containers and Soul Hearts.
Potato Peeler + Sharp Plug: Allows Isaac to generate infinite damage upgrades and Cube of Meat.
??? + Birthright: Removes one Soul Heart and grants two, effectively becoming a 3-room charge Book of Revelations.
Tainted Eden: Heart containers gained from Converter are kept, even after rerolling.
Black Judas / Tainted Judas: Converts one Black Heart into one Black Heart, keeping Judas’ health the same as before but activates The Necronomicon effect regardless.

interactions.text: Bethany: Bethany cannot activate the Converter whether she has soul charges or not.
Car Battery: Consumes 2 Soul Hearts and produces 2 Red Heart Containers.
The Soul: Consumes Soul Hearts and produces Bone Hearts for The Forgotten. Does nothing when used by The Forgotten.

Tainted Bethany: When used while fully charged, adds 2 Blood Charges to her pool at no cost to her Heart total. When used with no charges, consumes 3 Blood Charges and produces 2, resulting in a net loss.
With Car Battery: Consumes 3 Blood Charges and produces 4, still at no cost to Heart total, resulting in infinite Blood Charges.

name: Pandora's Box
description: Spawns specific pickups or items depending on the floor it is used on. Disappears after use.
effects: Upon use, spawns specific pickups or items depending on the floor it is used on. Disappears after use.

synergies.text: Strange Key: Instead of its normal effect, Pandora's Box spawns six items from a set of item pools. Both items are consumed.
This will prevent unlocking Moving Box if it hasn't already been unlocked, when used in Dark Room.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
? Card
Will activate Pandora's Box without consuming it, allowing for multiple activations.
If Isaac is holding Strange Key, using the ? Card will consume the card and trinket, spawning 6 items, but Pandora's Box will not be consumed.
Void After Pandora's Box is absorbed by Void, using Void again while holding Strange Key will spawn 6 items. Strange key will be consumed.

name: Unicorn Stump
description: Gives invulnerability and increased speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears.
effects: Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears while the effect is active.

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt: With some damage source while this item is active, it can be permanently invulnerable inside the room while you have enemies.
???'s Only Friend: The fly can still be controlled while invincible.
Car Battery: Doubles the duration of invulnerability.
Mom's Knife: Does contact damage in the same direction it was being held at the time of using the Unicorn Stump, giving a massive amount of free damage by ramming into an enemy.
Works the same with the transformation's knife.
On contact items (Aries, The Virus, etc.): Freely usable in basically every room.
Orbital Familiars (Cube of Meat, Sacrificial Dagger, etc.): The orbital can be used freely in every single room, making it a great alternative source of damage.

interactions.text: The Ludovico Technique: The tear stays in place while Isaac is invincible; although Isaac cannot move the tear, it will continue to damage enemies during his invincibility. This is very useful for stationary enemies.
Marked: Isaac's tears will still fire, but he will be unable to move the crosshair while invincible.

conditionalEffects: Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears while the effect is active.

name: Taurus
description: -0.3 Speed. Isaac builds speed while in a room with enemies. At max speed, he gains the My Little Unicorn effect for 5 seconds.
effects: -0.3 speed.
When in a room with enemies, Isaac gradually gains speed at a rate of +0.065 per tick.
Once Isaac's speed reaches 2.0, he gains the My Little Unicorn effect for 5 seconds, becoming invulnerable, and loses the speed bonus from Taurus afterward.

synergies.text: Isaac will still take damage from Blood Rights during the invincibility.
Camo Undies: Isaac will be able to move around unnoticed, letting Taurus charge up.
Dark Arts: Using Dark Arts provides a temporary +1.0 speed boost, allowing Isaac to activate Taurus earlier.
Gnawed Leaf: Isaac's speed will still increase while he is invincible from Gnawed Leaf, allowing Taurus to activate with only a very small period of vulnerability when first entering a room.
Rock Bottom: Isaac keeps the maximum speed boost after reaching it once.
Serpent's Kiss/The Virus: Isaac will poison enemies in addition to dealing damage to them on contact.

interactions.text: Damage, Range, and Tear delay increase as speed increases. Speed increases much slower than normal.
The Ludovico Technique: Isaac cannot control the tear while invincible, but any enemies touching it will still take damage from it.
A Pony/White Pony: The lower limit for Isaac's speed is lowered from 1.50 to 1.20.
Strawman: Taurus will not affect Isaac's speed if it's held by the Strawman Keeper, effectively rendering the item useless until Isaac is at 2.00 speed naturally.

conditionalEffects: When in a room with enemies, Isaac gradually gains speed at a rate of +0.065 per tick.

name: Aries
description: +0.25 speed. Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal damage. Prevents Isaac from taking contact damage while moving at high speed.
effects: +0.25 speed.
Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal 25 damage.
At least 0.85 Speed is required to be able to move quickly enough.
Moving at this speed also prevents contact damage.

synergies.text: Serpent's Kiss: Allows Isaac to poison enemies without needing to take a hit, allowing for an impressive amount of Black Hearts to be collected.
Tainted Forgotten: Throwing the skeleton will deal 80 damage on contact.

Tainted Magdalene's hugs stack with Aries, dealing insane combined contact damage to enemies. This also makes T. Magdalene invulnerable at high speeds, whilst still generating a decent amount of red hearts.

interactions.text: Isaac's Heart: The invulnerability does not extend to the heart.

needsReview: At least 0.85 Speed is required to be able to move quickly enough.

name: Cancer
description: Adds 3 Soul Hearts. Grants The Wafer effect for the current room after taking damage.
effects: Grants three Soul Hearts.
After taking damage, grants The Wafer effect of damage reduction for the current room.

name: Leo
description: Isaac can destroy rocks by walking into them.
effects: Isaac can break obstacles by walking into them.
Increases Isaac's size.

name: Virgo
description: Adds a chance to give a shield that nullifies all incoming damage for 10 seconds upon taking damage. Also converts bad pills into good pills.
effects: Grants a chance to trigger the Book of Shadows effect upon taking damage, creating a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 10 seconds.
The activation chance depends on the luck stat and goes up to 100% with 10 Luck.
Converts all negative pills into positive ones, but does not identify them.

synergies.text: Celtic Cross / The Polaroid: Virgo can trigger at the same time as Celtic Cross or The Polaroid, cumulating to up to 22 seconds of shield.

interactions.text: False PHD: Pills can be both good and bad again. Taking bad pills still applies the benefits from False PHD.

name: Libra
description: Gives 6 Penny, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys and balances out all attributes.
effects: Continually balances Isaac's primary attributes - damage, range, tears, and speed (has no effect on luck, shot speed, or tear falling speed).
This effect is NOT one time only - Libra will rebalance Isaac's attributes whenever they are changed by an item, effect, etc. including temporary effects such as the The Book of Belial.
Grants 6 Penny, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys.

synergies.text: Berserk!: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra would instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stat with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit as the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.
Soy Milk: As tear delay is valued very highly by the formula, greatly increases all stats.
Soy Milk is only a minor DPS upgrade, and as such a very minor all stats up.
Ipecac: Can be rapidly fired with decreased damage.

Rock Bottom: Stats will increase as a result of items, get locked at the highest point, and then be balanced out via Libra allowing items like Ipecac and Soy Milk to have higher damage/shot speed respectively.
Taurus: Gradually increases all stats in an incomplete room. Libra prevents Isaac from becoming invincible (unless with high stats), and stat increases will remain until the end of the fight.
Tape Worm: As range is valued very highly by the formula, greatly increases all stats. Synergizes well with Mom's Box.
Tape Worm is a flat +3 range instead of x2, resulting in only a small all stats up.

interactions.text: 120 Volt / Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The attacks from these items ignore Libra: the unbalanced damage value is used.
Almond Milk: Almond Milk is only a minor DPS upgrade, and as such a very minor all stats up.

D8: D8's stat changes depend on which stats end up with which multipliers and their base values. Range has a high weight and is uncapped, and thus can result in a massive boost if it scores a high multiplier. Damage is also uncapped but, on the other hand, has a low weight.

The changes in Libra's formula and the uncapping of speed bonuses beyond 2.0 mean D8 has a good chance of giving a strong all stats up, its magnitude depending on Isaac's other items and which stats were emphasized.

Dark Arts: Libra is extremely detrimental to how Dark Arts works, and should not be used together: The speed boost during the invincibility phase is transferred into attack bonuses (Which are useless as tears cannot be used), and afterwards, the temporary damage boost is divided across all of Isaac's stats, resulting in very negligible stat boosts.
Epiphora: The stat bonus for continuously firing in one direction applies to all stats. The accuracy penalty is unaffected.
Eve's Mascara: Gives an overall stat downgrade, due to tears being weighted heavier than damage.
Eve's Mascara is a DPS up with no other relevant stats, and as such is a small all stats up.
Experimental Treatment: The greater number of stat upgrades compared to stat downgrades results in an effectively guaranteed all stats up. Health, Shot Speed, and Luck are still subject to chance.
Purity: At base stats, the tear delay and damage aura give a greater stat bonus than the range or speed aura.
All the auras grant a small all stats up of similar magnitudes.
Succubus: When in the aura, affects re-balanced stats rather than just damage.

Tiny Planet: The significant range increase results in a large stat boost to speed and tears and a small boost to damage. However, the decrease in range causes orbiting tears to no longer complete a full 360° lap around Isaac, instead dropping off at about half that.

name: Scorpio
description: Grants poison tears, which deal damage over time when inflicted.
effects: Grants poison tears, dealing damage over time when inflicted.
The poison hits twice, dealing a total of double Isaac's damage.

name: Sagittarius
description: Increases speed by +0.2 and grants piercing tears.
effects: +0.2 speed
Grants piercing tears.

synergies.text: Lost Contact: Tears will pierce right through enemy projectiles, deleting them. A very strong offensive/defensive combo.

interactions.text: 8 Inch Nails: Knockback overridden by Sagittarius.
Blister: Overridden by Sagittarius.
Dr. Fetus: Bombs travel through enemies. When combined with Ipecac, bombs do not explode upon hitting enemies.
Bombs also deal 2.5x Isaac's damage to enemies when passing through them.
Pisces: Knockback overridden by Sagittarius.

name: Capricorn
description: Adds 1 Red Heart container, gives +0.5 Damage, +0.1 Speed, +1.5 Range, and -1.0 Tear Delay, and gives 1 Bomb, Penny, and Key. Adds 1 Red Heart container, gives +0.5 Damage, +0.1 Speed, +0.75 Range, and +0.5 Fire Rate, and gives 1 Bomb, Penny, and Key.
effects: Adds 1 Red Heart container.
+0.5 Damage.
+0.1 Speed.
+0.75 Range.
+0.5 Fire Rate.
+1 Bomb, Penny, and Key.

name: Aquarius
description: A trail of blue creep is left behind Isaac, which damages enemies. The creep scales with damage and inherits most tear effects.
effects: Isaac leaves a trail of blue creep where he walks that damages enemies that walk over it.
The creep deals 66% of Isaac's damage 10 times per second.

synergies.text: Apple! / Knockout Drops / Tough Love: Creep does not appear visually different but has a chance to inflict the respective bonus effects.
Homing tears: Creep moves towards nearby enemies that are on the ground, ignoring ones that fly.
Ipecac: Creep becomes green and poisons enemies but does not explode.
Lost Cork: The creep is 50% larger.
A Lump of Coal: Creep does more damage the farther Isaac is from the enemy.
Proptosis: Creep deals 2x Isaac's damage instead of 66%.

interactions.text: Eye of the Occult: Turns the creep purple but creep can't be controlled.
Fire Mind: Turns the creep orange and burns enemies but does not explode.
Godhead: Creep becomes homing as expected but does not have a larger radius.
Montezuma's Revenge: Turns the creep brown despite the item not affecting Isaac's tear color.
Sulfuric Acid: Occasionally turns the creep yellow but doesn't destroy obstacles.

needsReview: The creep deals 66% of Isaac's damage 10 times per second.

name: Pisces
description: -1 Tear Delay, adds knock-back shots and increases tear size. +0.5 Fire Rate, adds knock-back shots and increases tear size.
effects: Increases tear knockback.
If the player has piercing tears, the knockback effect is reduced.
+0.12 tear size.
+0.5 fire rate.

interactions.text: Blister: Overrides Pisces.
Brimstone: The beam gains knockback.
Cupid's Arrow/Death's Touch/Dead Onion/Sagittarius: Tears gain knockback.
Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Ipecac: Explosions also gain increased knockback.
Mom's Knife: The knife gains knockback.
Technology/Technology 2/Tech X: The lasers gain knockback.
Technology 2's constant laser has such strong knockback, it can pin enemies to walls.
Trisagion: Adds knockback to blasts, which can not only significantly repel enemies when used correctly, it can deal a high amount of damage to enemies unable to escape the knockback.

name: Eve's Mascara
description: Doubles damage, halves tears stat, and greatly reduces shot speed. Doubles damage, 0.66x tears multiplier, and greatly reduces shot speed.
effects: 2x damage multiplier.
-0.5 shot speed.
0.66x fire rate multiplier.

synergies.text: Abyss: When Eve's Mascara is picked up instead of being converted into a locust, it grants all of Abyss's locusts the high damage up without suffering the fire rate reduction allowing Isaac to increase his damage rate substantially the more items he uses Abyss on.
Epic Fetus: Missiles are not affected by low shot speed and the fire rate difference is negligible, granting double damage with nearly no downside.
Mom's Knife: The Knife is not affected by shot speed. Fire rate reduction down and 2x damage multiplier still apply.
Trisagion: Beams turn black and do double damage. The low shot speed makes beams damage enemies more frequently.
Tech X: Tech X benefits from a lower shot speed due to it staying on enemies longer and is also not affected by range, giving little downsides.
The fire rate reduction can be a major downside as it takes longer to charge Tech X and shots deal less damage when not fully charged.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus / Ipecac: Shots travel a very short distance, so having Host Hat or Pyromaniac is strongly recommended.
Eve's Mascara: No further effect when stacked.
The Ludovico Technique: Not recommended. Tear travels very slowly, making it hard to kill mobile enemies.

name: Judas' Shadow
description: Upon death, respawns Isaac as Black Judas with two Black Hearts in the previous room.
effects: Upon death, respawns Isaac as Black Judas with two Black Hearts in the previous room.

synergies.text: Tainted Judas: Revived as Tainted Judas instead of Black Judas.

name: Maggy's Bow
description: Gives one Red Heart Container and doubles the healing provided by Red Hearts. Also heals 1 Red Heart when obtained.
effects: Adds one Red Heart Container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart

Red Hearts heal double their value. A Half Red Heart replenishes one Red Heart, a Red Heart or Scared Heart replenishes two Red Hearts, and a Double Heart replenishes four Red Hearts. Blended Hearts either replenish two Red Hearts or replenish one Red Heart and add one Soul Heart, depending on how many empty Red Heart Containers Isaac has.

synergies.text: Candy Heart: Doubles the stat boosts from any picked up Heart. Half Red Hearts give two boosts, full Red Hearts give four, and Double Red Hearts give eight.

IV Bag + Old Bandage + Humbleing Bundle / Maggy's Bow: The damage from IV Bag has a chance to spawn 2 hearts, which can be picked up to create further coins and possibly even heal hearts with enough Luck.
Humbleing Bundle only has a 50% chance to double the hearts dropped, but Old Bandage may still drop 1 heart.
Tainted Bethany: Doubles all blood charges gained from Red Hearts.

interactions.text: 0 - The Fool?: Due to doubled healing, extra hearts will be left on the ground to be used for later.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: No effect.
Yum Heart: No effect; will still only replenish one full Red Heart.

name: Holy Mantle
description: Grants a shield that negates the first instance of damage taken from a hostile source once per room.
effects: Grants a shield that negates the first instance of damage taken from a hostile source in each room.

synergies.text: Belly Jelly / Host Hat / Infamy / Metal Plate: The chance of blocking projectiles is applied before the Holy Mantle, allowing the Holy Mantle shield to be saved.
Blanket / Dogma / Holy Card / Wooden Cross: All stack with Holy Mantle. Holy Mantle applies last.
Shield-type items stack in the following order
Wooden Cross
Blanket
Holy Mantle
Holy Card
Dogma
Blind Rage: Doubles the invincibility frames given when damage is negated.
Damocles: The nullified first hit does not trigger the chance of the sword falling. It will not, however, protect Isaac from the falling sword.
E. Coli / Midas' Touch: On-contact effects still apply to enemies if Holy Mantle negates the contact damage taken.
Isaac's Heart: The shield effect transfers to the heart.
Tainted Lazarus + Greed Mode: The shield regenerates every wave if broken. This allows one form of Tainted Lazarus to press the button for free on every wave.

interactions.text: Bad Trip: Damage is blocked by Holy Mantle.
Dull Razor: Ignores Holy Mantle's shield and works normally.
IV Bag: IV Bag ignores the shield's protection, resulting in Isaac taking damage regardless.
Holy Mantle / The Lost: An extra shield is given in the room it was found in, but the shield is removed when leaving that room and does not reapply.

name: Thunder Thighs
quote: HP up + speed down + you feel stompy
description: Destroys rocks upon contact with Isaac. Adds one Red Heart container and lowers Speed.
effects: +1 Red Heart container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
-0.4 speed down.
Isaac gains the ability to destroy obstacles by walking into them.

interactions.text: A Pony/White Pony: The lower limit for Isaac's speed is decreased from 1.50 to 1.10.

name: Strange Attractor
description: Pickups, trinkets, and monsters are magnetically attracted to Isaac's tears.
effects: Monsters, pickups, and trinkets are magnetically attracted to the player character's tears.
This also applies to Isaac's bombs.
Tears increase in magnetization as they travel, pulling enemies and items with less force at first but becoming stronger when they land.

The effect may not affect certain immobile enemies; Round Worms will start to vibrate in the presence of multiple magnetic tears, but will not change their position, Hosts will only be attracted when readying to launch an attack.

synergies.text: Brimstone: Enemies and pickups are sucked towards the beam, increasing accuracy significantly.
Dr. Fetus: Enemies are sucked towards bombs, increasing accuracy and making enemies easier to kill.
Explosivo: When the shot sticks to an enemy, every enemy near it will be attracted to them.
Godhead: Enemies will be pulled into Godhead's damaging aura, increasing the aura's effectiveness at causing damage.
Ipecac: Enemies and pickups are pulled towards the shots, increasing accuracy. The color of shots and their explosive effect is a darker green.

The Ludovico Technique: Enemies, items, and even most bosses will be sucked to the single floating tear, dealing constant damage while keeping Isaac well away from harm, making this combination extremely effective in almost all scenarios.
Mom's Knife: Enemies are pulled towards the knife. The effect is minor while not firing and much stronger while the knife is launched.

Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Attraction effect will remain on the booger shot stuck to an enemy. This can drag the enemy across the whole room until they reach one wall and get stuck on it, effectively disabling their normal movement.
Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten attracts enemies, putting them in range of his bone club attack.
Technology/Technology 2/Tech.5: The beam will attract enemies, often sucking them into the beam and holding them there.
Tech X: Enemies and pickups are attracted to the outer ring, increasing accuracy.
Tractor Beam: The lack of random spread and momentum-based trajectories on tears makes the way enemies are pulled around more predictable.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: The magnetic effect is stronger when multiple tears are stacked in the same position.
Cricket's Body/Compound Fracture: Since tears will split into more tears, all traveling in different directions, enemies will be randomly moved around.
Epic Fetus: Overrides Strange Attractor.
Enemies get drawn towards the target mark on the ground, ensuring that the missile will hit.
Explosivo: Enemies will be pulled toward the stuck on tears, dragging them helplessly or grouping them for the explosion.
Haemolacria: Enemies and pickups are attracted to the main tear, but not burst tears.
Lachryphagy: Enemies will often get sucked into tears, making it more difficult to feed tears or let them burst.

Monstro's Lung: Due to the high concentration of tears, enemies will be pulled towards Isaac at great force; in certain cases, enough force will be generated to pull enemies through rocks. This can greatly increase accuracy but depending on enemies' movements and positions can also damage Isaac.

The Parasite: Enemies will be pulled towards both fired tears and split tears. However, because they both travel in opposite directions, the split tears' magnetic effects tend to cancel each other out.

Rubber Cement: Due to tears being reflected, enemies tend to be pulled towards Isaac with much force. Additionally, the random angle of tears being reflected results in erratic enemy movement. Not recommended.
Soy Milk: The rapid tears will pull enemies quickly and erratically around the room. Not recommended.
Tiny Planet/Immaculate Heart/Saturnus: The orbiting tears will cause enemies to be pulled towards Isaac. Not recommended.

name: Cursed Eye
description: Grants charged tears that can be fired in a tight burst. Getting hit while charging will teleport Isaac to another room.
effects: Grants charged tears which fires a tight burst of tears. Firing mid-charge will shoot fewer tears depending on the charge time.
The full burst size is five tears.
Charging while a burst is currently firing will prevent the rest of the shots from being fired.
Taking damage while mid-charge (holding fire, but not fully charged) will teleport Isaac into another room.

synergies.text: Black Candle: Teleport effect is removed.
Holy Mantle: Losing Holy Mantle while charging Cursed Eye will not teleport Isaac.
Incubus
Incubus has the same charge shots as most characters would. Getting hit while charging will have the chance to teleport, as usual.

Marked: Tears are charged and automatically fired to varying levels depending on the distance between Isaac and the reticule. The firing rate is greatly increased without affecting the tears stat, even beyond normal maximum fire rate. The teleport effect is removed.
Technology: Becomes a quick charging laser that shoots multiple lasers on release.
Epiphora: Epiphora's tear rate multiplier affects the number of tears in a burst for a total of ten shots with a full Epiphora charge.
Technology 2: Laser fires while charging Cursed Eye. Tear delay for the charge is unaffected by Tech 2. Allows Cain to fire normal tears.
Tears are replaced with lasers, fired from the same eye of Tech 2. transformation removes the synergy.
Mutant Spider / The Inner Eye / 20/20 / The Wiz / : Isaac shoots multiple tears from each eye, the amount is item-dependent.
The Lost/Tainted Lost: Since The Lost dies in one hit, it is effectively immune to its teleportation effects, making this item much safer to use.

interactions.text: Almond Milk/Kidney Stone (when the barrage of tears is fired)/Soy Milk: Cursed Eye is automatically charged and fired when the fire key is held. The charge bar of Cursed Eye becomes invisible. The teleport effect remains.
Having a tears stat of 30 or higher will trigger this effect as well, the above items will trigger this effect regardless of Isaac's tears stat.
Lilith + Kidney Stone: When the kidney stone is shot, Incubus is unable to shoot for the duration of the effect, making this a anti-synergy.
Anti-Gravity: Anti-Gravity effect cannot be used, as releasing a tear fire button also releases the Anti-Gravity Effect.
Azazel/Brimstone/Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/The Ludovico Technique/Mom's Knife/Monstro's Lung: Overrides Cursed Eye.
With Tainted Samson/The Forgotten/Berserk!: While charging your bone you will be teleported if hit.
C Section/Neptunus/Spirit Sword/Tainted Azazel: Overrides Cursed Eye.
With Tainted Samson/The Forgotten/Berserk!: While charging your bone you will be teleported if hit.

description: Grants a brief moment of invincibility when the charge bar hits zero. Isaac begins taking damage if the item is held any longer. Isaac loses invincibility once the active item button is released.

The item will recharge on its own, but cannot be used again until it is fully charged (even if the charge bar wasn't fully depleted).

Despite the tears having a stronger magnetic quality as they travel, it is still possible for enemies to get knocked wildly around the room. It is advised to play the long-range game when utilizing this synergy.

Tech X: Automatically charges and fires fully charged Tech X rings. Non-fully charged rings can still be fired by releasing the fire key during charging, but much harder due to the high fire rate and removal of charge bar.

Technology Zero: The near-constant stream of tears will have electricity chained between them, providing an electrical net of damage making it almost impossible to not hit an enemy. This can greatly help offset the lowered damage by increasing the number of hits.
