Stitches: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc.
However, it can still be used to telefrag enemies.
Tear Detonator: Multiplies detonated tears, resulting in 6x more tears than normal.
Telekinesis: Grants 7 seconds of protection, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.
Ventricle Razor works normally.

We Need To Go Deeper! / Mom's Shovel: In most cases, no extra effect. When used near the entrances to a room, the item can occasionally open 2 trapdoors at once, increasing the chance of opening a Crawl Space.

name: Box of Friends
description: Duplicates all of Isaac's familiars for the current room. If Isaac has no familiars, spawns a Demon Baby for the room instead.
effects: Upon use, it adds one copy of each of Isaac's familiars for the duration of the current room.
If Isaac has no familiars, a Demon Baby will spawn for the duration of the current room.

synergies.text: Ball of Bandages / Cube of Meat / Potato Peeler: Upgrades the cube/ball for the current room. This can be used to easily unlock the Super Meat Boy and Bandage Girl achievements.
Cubes of Meat from Potato Peeler cannot be duplicated or upgraded.
Blood Puppy: Tames an angry Blood Puppy and spawns another temporary one.
Bob's Brain: When used upon entering a room, Box of Friends eliminates the item delay, which allows Isaac to launch Bob's Brain immediately.
Car Battery: Adds two copies of each familiar.
Charged Baby: All around useful, can charge box of friends mid room to spawn more of itself creating a charging loop.
Daddy Longlegs: Familiar will be copied.
Incubus: Creates additional Incubus familiars, which share the same tear modifiers as the player.
Lil Dumpy: Will copy Lil Dumpy, effectively adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's Holy Mantle-like protection.
This process can be repeated to make Isaac near-invincible.
Smart Fly: Very useful on Greed mode, as using it will add an attacking fly, killing enemies and bosses very quickly.
Twisted Pair: Creates additional Twisted Pairs with the same tear modifiers as the player. Multiple twisted pairs will line up horizontally, covering a broader area.

interactions.text: ???'s Soul / Dead Bird / Eve's Bird Foot / Isaac's Head / Scissors: These familiars are not copied.
1up! / Dead Cat: No longer copies the familiar either.
Abyss: Flies gained from Abyss do not count as familiars for Box of Friends, and are not copied.

Best Bud: If used before taking damage, the white fly will circle Isaac. However, multiple white flies cannot be spawned, so using Box of Friends after taking damage or using it multiple times in a room creates no effect.
Buddy in a Box: Creates another randomly generated familiar, rather than copying the same one.
Bumbo: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.
Tinytoma: Сreates an orbital even if it is destroyed. If the copy splits into smaller versions, they will remain when moving between rooms.
Guillotine: Duplicates the Head circling Isaac's body. Only one head will shoot tears.
Considers the second head as an extra copy, granting Isaac a temporary stat boost for the room
Hallowed Ground: All poop familiars turn into white poop at the same time, and their effects are accumulative. A new poop familiar appears even if the previous poops have been used up.
Isaac's Heart / : Not copied. They will not spawn a Demon Baby if no other valid familiars are found, unlike other familiars that aren't copied.
Key Piece 1 / Key Piece 2: Key pieces are multiplied, but do not complete the other half.
Key pieces are not copied.
Knife Piece 1 / Knife Piece 2: Knife pieces and the knife are not copied.
Lil Spewer: Creates a random spewer rather than copying the current one.
Lost Soul: Cannot be duplicated.
No extra tear delay is granted, neither before or after breaking.

Monster Manual: Familiars spawned by Monster Manual are not copied. It will still spawn a Demon Baby if a familiar from Monster Manual is generated and there are no other valid familiars that can be duplicated.
Multidimensional Baby: Each copy of Multidimensional Baby follows the previous copy with a 2-second ( 0.66-second) delay. Tears shot through multiple babies will only be duplicated once.
Pickup generation familiars: The copied familiars will drop pickups independently.
Quints: Existing Quints familiars will not be duplicated, nor more will be created. If Isaac has no other familiars, the generated Demon Baby will hover with the Quints instead of following Isaac.
Shade: A new follower Shade spawns even if Isaac has already absorbed the original.
XV - The Devil?: The Seraphim familiar is not copied.

name: The Wiz
description: Grants spectral tears. Tears simultaneously fire out of both eyes diagonally, similar to the effect of the R U a Wizard? pill.
effects: Isaac fires tears from both eyes at the same time.
Isaac's tears are fired diagonally outwards, similar to the effect of the R U a Wizard? pill.
Isaac's tears become spectral.

synergies.text: 20/20 / : Fires 2 tears in both diagonal directions.
Each additional copy of The Wiz will make Isaac fire one extra tear, starting with one tear fired forwards.
Eye of the Occult: Both tears shoot much closer together and can be controlled, creating for a better double shot similar to what Tractor Beam would grant.
The Inner Eye/Keeper: Fires 2 tears to both diagonal directions with a wider spread.
Mutant Spider /Tainted Keeper: Fires 3 tears to both diagonal directions.
Spirit Sword: Beams and sword swings are fired forwards instead of diagonally. Isaac spins an additional time when doing a charged attack.
Technology Zero: Electricity arcs between both tears, damaging enemies between them.
Tractor Beam: Both tears will follow the beam, making it easier to hit enemies with them.
Tractor Beam + Mom's Knife: Knives ignore the path of the beam and remain flying diagonally.
Tiny Planet: Each shot fires two tears in opposing orbital directions. The orbit can be controlled as normal.

interactions.text: Analog Stick: Will make one tear go forwards and the other tear fire at a 90-degree angle to the other tear.
Azazel/Brimstone/Tainted Azazel: Fires two Brimstone beams diagonally. Beams remain diagonal even if Isaac has Tractor Beam.
Cain / Tainted Cain: Makes Cain fire in the two diagonal directions instead of just his right eye as the R U a Wizard? pill does.

Epic Fetus: The crosshair is controlled diagonally as if rotated 45 degrees clockwise from usual (i.e.: the up arrow will move it in a northeast direction), and two missiles are fired, similar to the effect of 20/20. The crosshair can be moved in the cardinal directions by pressing two arrow keys at once (e.g.: pressing the up and right arrows will move the crosshair right).
Homing tears: Tears are more likely to home in on enemies if enemies are coming towards Isaac diagonally. With big enough tears or a big enough enemy, homing tears are very powerful with The Wiz.
The Ludovico Technique: Small tear orbits the main tear. Tear controls rotated 45 degrees clockwise - holding up makes it move northeast and so on.
Marked: Fires two shots aimed diagonally from the crosshair.
Monstro's Lung: 7-8 tears are fired at each diagonal direction instead of a full burst.
R U a Wizard? pill: Makes Isaac fire forward with a normal fire rate and 90 degrees outwards with half fire rate.
Sad Bombs: Does not affect the number of tears when bombs explode.

name: 8 Inch Nails
description: +1.5 damage. Replaces Isaac's tears with nails, which have increased knockback.
effects: +1.5 damage.
Isaac's tears are replaced with nails, which have increased knockback.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Ipecac: Explosions also gain increased knockback.
Piercing tears: Allows tears to knock enemies back again.

Brimstone / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2 / Tech X / Mom's Knife / Trisagion: They gain knockback. Especially powerful with Tech X, as the knockback helps keeps enemies within the ring for longer.

interactions.text: Blister: The knockback from Blister is stronger than from 8 Inch Nails, and knockback boosts do not stack.

name: Incubus
description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires copies of Isaac's tears with reduced size (or width for some special attacks).
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires copies of Isaac's tears with reduced size (or width for some special attacks).
Incubus' damage is reduced by 25% when playing as characters other than Lilith and Tainted Lilith.

synergies.text: The laser fired by Incubus has the same width as Lil Brimstone's.
When playing as Azazel, Incubus' Brimstone laser has the same range as him.
Multiple copies of Brimstone will not grant Incubus the mega brimstone effect.
Berserk! / The Forgotten / Spirit Sword: Incubus will carry the respective melee weapon, using it exactly like Isaac.
BFFS!: Shoots tears that do 1.5x (2x as Lilith) Isaac's damage.
Incubus now charges and fires a burst of up to 5 tears just as Isaac would.
Forgotten Lullaby: Doubles the fire rate of Incubus. This notably makes it fire and charge-attack faster than Isaac does.
Immaculate Heart: Incubus can create its own orbiting tears, which will orbit the Incubus that created it, and not Isaac.
Technology 2: Incubus can fire the Technology 2 laser too.
Tractor Beam: The Incubus tears will follow the beam. This makes it seem as if the tears come directly from Isaac, even if blindfolded.

interactions.text: Bird's Eye
Ghost Pepper
Large Zit
Maw Of The Void
R U a Wizard?
Tech.5

interactions.group: Only stat effects are applied; otherwise no effect on Incubus
interactions.text: Eye Drops
Dr. Fetus: A dangerous combination, since familiars naturally stay behind the character, and the character's movement may block the bomb, which causes self-damage easily.
Guillotine: Incubus will fire tears in relative position to its body depending on where Isaac's head is currently.
Incubus' tears contribute to the item charge.
Kidney Stone: Incubus ignores the range down from this item, and will fire the tear barrage but not the stone.
Incubus is still able to fire tears while Kidney Stone is charging.

name: Fate's Reward
description: A blue head familiar that will follow Isaac and fire tears copying his tear effects and damage.
effects: Spawns a familiar that fires tears with the same damage and tear effects as Isaac's tears.
Fires at half the normal fire rate of a familiar.
Since the normal fire rate of familiars (such as Little Steven, Robo-Baby or Seraphim) is once per second / 1.36 times a second, Fate's Reward shoots once every 2 seconds / 0.68 times a second.
The familiar is not affected by range/ tear height; only tear falling speed.

Since increasing tear height and shot speed lowers tear falling speed in order to adjust Isaac's range, increases to either stat will decrease the familiar's range, and decreases to either stat will increase the familiar's range.

synergies.text: Flat Stone: Familiar's tears will travel very far and then bounce once, traveling up and hitting the nearest wall.
Haemolacria: Will fire tears that burst into split tears. Does not affect fire rate.
Ipecac: Will fire explosive tears. Does not affect fire rate.
Lachryphagy + Brimstone: The tears fired by the familiar will eventually explode in a star-like pattern of Brimstone lasers if they don't hit anything.

interactions.text: Following tear modifiers do not affect Fate's Reward, and the familiar will only fire normal tears
Brimstone
C Section
Dr. Fetus
Epic Fetus
The Ludovico Technique
Mom's Knife
Monstro's Lung
Technology
Tech X
20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Fate's Reward only fires single tears. The items do not affect the fire rate of Fate's Reward.
Chocolate Milk: Familiar's tears will turn a brown color but can not be charged.
Fate's Reward will aim and fire at the crosshair, wherever it's pointed.
Soy Milk / Almond Milk / Polyphemus: Does not affect fire rate, but does affect damage.

needsReview: Since the normal fire rate of familiars (such as Little Steven, Robo-Baby or Seraphim) is once per second / 1.36 times a second, Fate's Reward shoots once every 2 seconds / 0.68 times a second.

name: Lil Chest
description: Spawns a chest familiar that spawns a random pickup (25% chance) or trinket (10% chance) upon clearing a room.
effects: Spawns a chest familiar that has a 25% chance to spawn a pickup and a 10% chance to spawn a trinket after clearing a room. The possible rewards are
Red Heart
Penny
Bombs
Keys
Pills
Cards
Runes
Lil' Battery
Trinkets

synergies.text: BFFS!: The chance to spawn a pickup increases to 31.25%, and the chance to spawn a trinket increases to 12.5%.

name: Sworn Protector
description: Spawns an orbital familiar which does 105 / 53 damage per second and attracts and blocks enemy shots. Upon blocking 10 shots in a room, it drops an Eternal Heart.
effects: Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick or 105 / 52.5 damage per second on contact.

It also attracts enemy shots to itself, making them more likely to be blocked. A shot actively being attracted can no longer damage Isaac and is essentially nullified, but if it slips outside the Protector's range, it can again deal damage.
Sworn Protector has a chance to drop an Eternal Heart upon blocking 10 shots in one room.
This can only happen once per room, but leaving and re-entering a room will allow another eternal heart to be dropped.

synergies.text: Sacrificial Altar: This familiar will also reward 2 Black Hearts when sacrificed.

interactions.text: Extension Cord: Familiar and Isaac are occasionally connected by electricity, but it is very hard to notice because Sworn Protector orbits so close to Isaac.
Friendly enemies: Friendly enemy tears are ignored by Sworn Protector.

needsReview: Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick or 105 / 52.5 damage per second on contact.

name: Friend Zone
description: Spawns a white attack fly that orbits somewhere between Distant Admiration and Forever alone, dealing 45 damage per second.
effects: Spawns a white fly familiar that slowly orbits Isaac and deals 3 damage per tick or 45 damage per second on contact.
needsReview: Spawns a white fly familiar that slowly orbits Isaac and deals 3 damage per tick or 45 damage per second on contact.

name: Lost Fly
description: Spawns a fly familiar that moves in a straight line and circles around the first wall or obstacle it hits. It deals 105 damage per second on contact. It deals 56 damage per second and forces nearby enemies to attack it.
effects: Spawns a fly familiar that moves in a straight line and attaches itself to the first wall or obstacle it comes into contact within each room.
The Lost Fly will then move around the room functionally similar to the Guts.
Lost Fly deals 7 contact damage every 7 ticks, or 30 damage per second. Enemies near Lost Fly will target it instead of Isaac.
Some enemies that do not normally give chase to Isaac, such as Mulligans, will chase after the Lost Fly if nearby it.
If the obstacle it is attached to is destroyed, then it will continue rolling in the direction it was previously traveling until it meets another wall or obstacle.
needsReview: Lost Fly deals 7 contact damage every 7 ticks, or 30 damage per second. Enemies near Lost Fly will target it instead of Isaac.

name: Scatter Bombs
quote: We put bombs in your bombs!
description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs explode into 2-4 tiny bombs.
effects: Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.
Isaac's bombs split into 4-5 tiny bombs after exploding.
Tiny bombs deal half damage and have decreased blast radius.
Tiny bombs retain most of Isaac's bomb synergies.
Tiny bombs explode immediately upon landing.

interactions.text: Anarchist Cookbook/Curse of the Tower/XVI - The Tower: Not recommended. The extra bombs makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.
Anarchist Cookbook: No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.
Best Friend: The explosion creates mini decoys.
Blasting Cap: Tiny bombs can also drop bomb pickups.
Blood Bombs/Bob's Curse: Area-of-Effects from extra explosions have decreased size but deal the same damage.
Bob's Rotten Head/Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: Explosions are unaffected.
Bob's Bladder: Tiny bombs will also create creep.
Brimstone Bombs/Sad Bombs: Lasers/tears from extra explosions deal 65% of their normal damage.
Butt Bombs: The room damage from extra explosions deal 6.5 damage instead of 10.
Diplopia: No effect other than the +5 bombs.
Dr. Fetus/Mr. Boom: Explosions are affected.
Ghost Bombs: Extra explosions create ghosts that instantly launch themselves at enemies and explode, similar to Purgatory. They each deal 2x Isaac's damage, up to 4 times.
Glitter Bombs: Each additional explosion created has a chance to spawn a pickup or trinket.
Hot Bombs: Extra explosions create additional fires. Fires from extra explosions start with 1 less durability.
Nancy Bombs: Extra bombs will have the same bomb modifiers as the original.
Rocket in a Jar: Rockets create normal tiny bombs when they explode.

name: Sticky Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Bombs stick to enemies and spawn 2-5 Blue Spiders on kill. Bombs leave a long-lasting puddle of slowing creep. Spawns 1-2 Blue Spiders or Blue Flies when bombs damage enemies.
effects: +5 Bombs.
Bombs stick to enemies.
Spawns 2-5 Blue Spiders when one of Isaac's bombs kills an enemy.
Spawns 1-2 Blue Spiders or Blue Flies when it damages an enemy.
Bombs leave a puddle of slowing white creep on the ground when they explode.

synergies.text: No longer sticks to enemies.
Bomber Boy: Greatly increases the size of the creep puddle.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus: Dr. Fetus bombs retain the sticky effect ( unless Isaac has piercing). Dr. Fetus bombs will not spawn spiders even if they stick to an enemy.
The bombs always spawn slowing white creep after exploding.
Mr. Mega / Lost Cork: No effect on the creep puddle size.

name: Epiphora
description: Shooting in one direction increases Isaac's rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as Isaac changes direction or stops shooting, rate of fire is reset to its normal amount.
effects: At max "charge", it will reduce tear delay by half, rounding down.
Fire rate gradually increases by intervals as the player shoots in one direction. Accuracy also decreases as the fire rate increases.
Fire rate increases smoothly instead of intervals.
At max "charge", it will increase fire rate by double.
The time required to reach max charge is 9 / 6 seconds.
Rate of fire returns to its original value if Isaac stops firing, changes firing directions, uses an active item, or is hit.
Being hit, changing rooms, and using items no longer reset the Epiphora bonus.
During the delay when transitioning between rooms, picking up an item, or using an active item, it's possible to change the firing direction without resetting the bonus.

synergies.text: Analog Stick: Epiphora's bonus will not reset when switching fire diagonally, as long as Isaac's head doesn't turn.
Continuum: Reduces the need to change firing direction, allowing Isaac to maintain the increased rate of fire.
Cursed Eye: Epiphora's tear rate multiplier affects the number of tears in a burst for a total of ten shots with a full Epiphora charge.
Dr. Fetus / Ipecac: Firing bombs continually will decrease tear delay, although doing so is not recommended since it increases the risk of self-damage.
The Forgotten: When tapping the attack button in a single direction repeatedly, the Ephiphora effect will cause the bone swings to speed up.
How to Jump: Changing firing direction while jumping does not reset the bonus, similar to when changing rooms.
Incubus: Incubus's fire rate will match Isaac's.
The Ludovico Technique: Fire rate increases while moving the tear in one direction; it has a negligible effect during normal gameplay.
Marked: Both items work as normal, with tear rate gradually increasing until Isaac turns his head, which can happen via him or the crosshair moving too out of parallel.
Rubber Cement: Reduces the need to change firing direction allowing Isaac to maintain the increased rate of fire.

Rock Bottom: Isaac will never lose the benefits of Epiphora, even after he stops firing. This effectively makes Epiphora a substantial tears up. Fully charging Ephiphora is still needed to gain a higher tears stat if an item that would increase the tears stat is picked up.
Tractor Beam: Fire rate still increases when shooting in one direction, but will stay on the line (i.e. no loss in accuracy).
Loki's Horns / Mom's Eye: Allows for firing in multiple directions at once, decreasing need to change firing direction.

interactions.text: Charging items such as Brimstone, Chocolate Milk, Cursed Eye, Mom's Knife, Monstro's Lung, and Tech X: Effect only activates when holding charge in a specific direction, and deactivates when the charge is released, effectively making Epiphora useless unless Isaac has exceedingly low fire rate.
Soy Milk / Almond Milk + Chocolate Milk / Cursed Eye / Monstro's Lung / Tech X: Due to constant firing, Epiphora's fire rate bonus can now be used.
Soy Milk / Almond Milk + Brimstone: The Brimstone laser only gains the increased damage from higher tear rates when the laser starts firing, making Epiphora's bonus useless.
Epic Fetus: Overrides Epiphora.
Lilith: Lilith and her Incubus cannot gain extra fire rate from Epiphora.
Incubus' fire rate will increase without the accuracy penalty
Tainted Isaac: If you pick up an item and drop Epiphora while holding the attack button you will keep the fire rate. The effect will disappear upon entering a new floor.
Bag of Crafting: Bag of Crafting can be used to switch directions without reducing fire rate when activated.

name: Continuum
description: Grants spectral tears and increases range. Tears travel through walls and appear at the opposite side of the room.
effects: Grants spectral tears.
When tears travel off-screen, they loop back around through the opposite wall.
+3 range.

synergies.text: Azazel / Brimstone / Revelation / Tainted Azazel / Technology: The laser continues behind Isaac and back once again, potentially hitting enemies twice in one blast.
Does not travel through the wall; instead bounces off it like with Rubber Cement.
The Forgotten: The skeleton form's charge attack can loop through walls.
A Lump of Coal: Tears will continually gain damage when passing through walls.
Mom's Knife: Causes Mom's Knife to appear on the opposite wall if thrown through one. It then returns through the wall to Isaac.
Mom's Knife + Brimstone: The barrage of knives flies across the room until it hits the wall twice.
My Reflection: When shooting through a wall, tears speed up towards Isaac rather than returning through the original wall. With enough shot speed and range the tears can loop twice.
Tech X: Laser rings will go through walls, extra distance depending on shot speed.
Tech X + Incubus: Laser rings travel through walls and continue on the other side of the room.
Tractor Beam: Causes the tears to loop right back in front of Isaac after they go offscreen.

interactions.text: Tears will split on contact with walls. Only one split will occur on contact with walls and objects.
Dr. Fetus: Bombs cannot go through walls, but are spectral.
Epic Fetus / Rubber Cement: Overrides Continuum, stat effects apply.
The Ludovico Technique: When the tear is moved offscreen, it loops back through the opposite wall.
Tears will split on contact with walls. Only one split will occur on contact with walls and objects.
Proptosis: Tears shrink while traveling through walls and often disappear before they can reappear on the other side.

Technology Zero: Tears will travel through walls; however, the electricity will not connect the tears while they are outside the room. Once tears have passed through walls, the electric arcs connect very erratically to other tears.
Tiny Planet: Tears that travel through walls will travel until they reach Isaac and start orbiting him again.

name: Mr. Dolly
description: +0.7 tears, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed, Spawns a combination of 3 Red Hearts, Soul Hearts or Black Hearts on the floor when picked up. +0.7 tears, +2.5 range, spawns 3 random types of Red Hearts on the floor when picked up.
effects: +0.7 tears.
+2.5 range.
Spawns a combination of 3 Red Hearts, Soul Hearts or Black Hearts on the floor when picked up.
These hearts are not subject to the Red/Soul/Black Heart chances; each type has an equal chance to spawn.

name: Curse of the Tower
description: Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of XVI - The Tower.
effects: Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of XVI - The Tower.

synergies.text: Blasting Cap: Spawned Troll Bombs can drop extra bomb pickups.
Glitter Bombs: Each troll bomb has a chance to spawn a pickup or a trinket including hearts for repeated use.
The Polaroid: If Isaac is damaged when he has half a Red Heart or less, the shield will activate and protect him from the Troll Bombs.
Pyromaniac: Troll Bombs will heal Isaac instead, allowing for essentially infinite health with proper usage.
Due to Pyromaniac being weakened to healing half a heart per explosion in Repentance, this synergy requires The Wafer to continue being effective past Chapter 3/Chapter 3.5.
Remote Detonator: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until Remote Detonator is activated, unlike regular Troll Bombs.
Safety Scissors: The Troll Bombs generated will be converted into bomb pickups rather than exploding.

interactions.text: Blind Rage: Normally, the invincibility frames will end before most of the explosions take place. However, if Isaac takes a full heart of damage (e. g. from a champion), the invincibility will protect him from all spawned Troll Bombs.
Damage sources that scale up from half a heart of damage to a full heart of damage starting on Chapter 4 don't provide enough invincibility frames to ignore the explosions.

Blood Oath: Not recommended. Spawns 6 Troll Bombs for each Half Red Heart removed, making death highly likely if Isaac does not leave the room immediately after being stabbed by Blood Oath, and leaving the starting room unsafe.
Sharp Plug: Not recommended. Spawns 6 Troll Bombs for each Half Red Heart removed, making extra damage highly likely if Isaac does not leave the room immediately after using Sharp Plug.
Bomber Boy: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.
Mr. Mega: No effect.
Scatter Bombs: Not recommended. Each Troll Bomb will spawn several smaller bombs upon exploding, making it very hard to avoid taking damage.
No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.

name: Charged Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that occasionally drops a Lil' Battery, gives an active item charge, or petrifies all enemies in the room.
effects: Spawns a battery familiar that, while Isaac is in an uncleared room, every 30 seconds, starting from the moment it has been picked up, does one of the following
Spawns a Lil' Battery. It does this a maximum of 2 times per room.
Can also spawn a Micro Battery or Mega Battery instead.
Adds a charge to Isaac's activated item. It does this a maximum of 2 times per room.
Petrifies all enemies for 1.3 seconds.
Nothing.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Familiar is bigger and drops Lil' Batteries more often. No effect on its other abilities.

name: Dead Eye
description: Isaac's damage increases each time an enemy is hit. Damage is reset upon missing a shot.
effects: Isaac's damage increases for each successive tear hit on enemies.
The multiplier increases by 0.25x for each hit, going up to a maximum of 2x after 4 successive hits.
If a tear misses and hits nothing (wall/floor), there is a chance for the multiplier to be reset back to 1.
The chance is 20% for the first miss, 33% for the second miss, and 50% for the third miss and beyond.
As the multiplier increases, Isaac's tears glow red and increase in size.

synergies.text: Compound Fracture/Haemolacria/Lachryphagy: Main tears and burst tears will contribute to damage multiplier.
Lachryphagy Firing into the floating tear won't reset the multiplier unless it hits a wall. The burst tears never reset the multiplier.
Dark Arts: Hitting enemies/bullets successfully with Dark Arts contributes to Dead Eye's damage multiplier.
The Ludovico Technique: Damage bonus increases until it hits the max of 2x. Since the controllable tear never hits the ground or wall, the bonus cannot be lost.
Petrification/Slow items: Enemies will be petrified or slowed, making them easier to hit without missing.
Pop!: Tears that miss an enemy and do not hit a wall or obstacle will not fall to the ground immediately, allowing many damage-amplified tears to be fired before the damage boost is lost.

Proptosis: Tears are larger and easier to hit with at a low range. Additionally, if the tear fades out of existence instead of running out of range or hitting a wall/obstacle, it does not count as a miss.
Spirit Sword: Dead Eye will increase the damage every slash until it hits the max of 2x. The bonus can be lost if a sword projectile doesn't hit anything.
Tiny Planet: Isaac's tears no longer hit walls and stay in the air for longer, allowing many damage-amplified tears to be fired before the damage boost is lost.
Akeldama: The tears in the trail will contribute to the damage boost, making it possible to stack damage while having items that do not interact with Dead Eye on their own (such as Brimstone).

interactions.text: Brimstone / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: Will not increase or decrease Dead Eye's bonus, resulting in it remaining as it was prior to their pickup.

20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider/Cursed Eye: If all tears hit, they all contribute to the damage multiplier. However, the spread shot granted by The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider may make it hard to retain the damage multiplier.
Azazel: Gains no benefit by picking up Dead Eye unless his tear effect has been replaced.
Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Split tears that do not hit enemies are considered misses, nearly guaranteeing the chance of losing the multiplier.
Flat Stone: Each skip counts as missing.

The Forgotten: The Forgotten's swing increases the multiplier when successfully hitting enemies, making it much easier to maintain the damage buff. Resets the multiplier upon swinging and missing. The multiplier changes normally when firing tears as The Soul, and the two forms share the same multiplier.

The Forgotten + Soy Milk: Damage multiplier will not reset as long as the fire key is held, and will quickly build up to the maximum value of x2. The multiplier will only reset if, upon releasing the fire button, the thrown bone does not hit any enemy.
Rock Bottom The damage multiplier stays, even if you reset the item bonus.
Host Hat: Tears fired by the Host are affected by Dead Eye.

Immaculate Heart: The tears from Immaculate Heart can add to the damage multiplier and cannot lower it by missing. This can be particularly useful with items that normally prevent the damage multiplier from increasing, such as Brimstone.
Incubus + Monstro's Lung: Tears fired by Incubus are now affected by Dead Eye.
Isaac's Tears: If the tears fired by Isaac's tears miss, they cause the multiplier to reset.
Jacob's Ladder: Electricity sparks do not contribute to damage multiplier.
Marked: Damage buff often lost quickly because of the constantly firing tears.
Piercing tears: Damage buff is halved, .125x, reaching the 2x multiplier with 8 successive hits.
Sad Bombs: Tears spawned by sad bombs that miss will reset the multiplier.

Saturnus: Tears spawned when entering the room and enemy tears collected by the ring can add to the damage multiplier and cannot lower it by missing. This can be particularly useful with items that normally prevent the damage multiplier from increasing, such as Brimstone.

name: Restock
description: Causes Shops to instantly restock their items when they are bought. Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.
effects: Upon purchasing an item from the Shop, a new purchasable item is added to the store's inventory.
Collectibles created correspond to the shop's item pool.
Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.

For items, the price increase is 2 coins times the number of purchases. For example, an item starting at 15 cents would next be +2 to 17, then +4 to 21, +6 to 27, etc. The cost follows the formula 15+n(n+1) with n being the number of times restock has triggered.

For everything else, the price increase is 1 coin times the number of purchases. For example, a heart starting at 3 cents would be +1 to 4, +2 to 6, +3 to 9 etc. This follows the formula (original price)+(n(n+1))/2

The increase is not affected by discounts occurring naturally or through Steam Sale: costs will increase at the same rate, though the base price is still discounted. Once the item's cost goes over what it would naturally be, the price is no longer highlighted red.
The maximum price is 99 cents.
A small restock icon appears under the map, just like Treasure Map, Blue Map, The Compass and any active curses.

name: Tech X
description: Tears are replaced with laser rings that pierce through enemies and deal damage to enemies within them. Can be charged to increase the effectiveness of the ring.
effects: Isaac's tears are replaced with ring-shaped lasers.
Shots can be charged to increase the size of the rings.
The rings deal damage 15 times per second. Only the outer circumference of the rings will deal damage.
Rings pass through obstacles and enemies. Rings have infinite range and will travel until they hit a wall.
Damage dealt is based on the amount charged, starting at around 25% Isaac's damage and approaches 100% at maximum charge.
Charge Time = (1)/(30)(Roundup(Tear Delay * 3) + 1) approx (3)/(Fire Rate)
Max Charge Damage per Tick = Damage * (5)/(4)(Fire Rate * (Roundup(Tear Delay * 3) + 1) - 10)
Min Charge Damage per Tick = Damage * (5)/(4)(Fire Rate * (Roundup(Tear Delay) + 1) - 10)
At 30.00 fire rate or above (0 tear delay or lower), charging is no longer needed and fires 30 rings per second. Higher fire rate results in higher laser damage.
Damage per Tick = Damage * (5)/(4)(Fire Rate - 10)
Damage per Tick is capped at 100% Isaac's Damage, at 90.00 fire rate.

name: Explosivo
description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.
effects: Isaac's tears have a 25% chance to stick to enemies and explode a few seconds afterward, dealing 60 damage plus Isaac's tear damage.

synergies.text: Brimstone/The Ludovico Technique/Mom's Knife/Tech X: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.

Shielded Explosivo tears are no longer destroyed by shots while they're stuck to enemies. Up to the point that they explode, they block all enemy shots that come into contact with them, effectively cutting off an entire direction of attack (much like Dry/Fart Baby, but with a larger area of blockage and without forcing the player to waste time positioning). As such, this is an extremely powerful synergy between otherwise adequate items.

name: Glowing Hourglass
description: Rewinds time, putting Isaac back in the previous room and undoing anything that happened in the current room. Can only be used three times per floor, after which it functions like The Hourglass until the next floor.
effects: On use, Isaac will be returned to the previous room and everything that happened in the current room will be undone.
Health, bombs, coins, keys, cards / runes / pills, items, and trinkets, gained or lost, will be restored to their state before having entered the room.
Time spent and score gained or lost within the room are reverted.
Most permanent unlocks will be reverted (see below).
Can only be used 3 times on each floor, after which it functions like The Hourglass until a new floor is entered.

synergies.text: Any reroll item/collectible: Items in the room can be rerolled, and if the result is undesirable, then Isaac can go back in time to save whatever was used to reroll. However, note that activating the reroll on the same items again will result in the same items being generated as the first time. Rerolling different items from the same type of room (such as going to a different Shop) will result in the reroll effect creating new and different items. This technique is useful for saving charges on items like The D6, or getting multiple options with consumables like the Perthro.

Anything that spawns an item such as Mystery Gift / XVII - The Stars?: After the player activates them, they can then go back in time if the item is undesirable. However, unlike reroll effects, using something that spawns an item/collectible will always generate that same item, dependent on the room type, even if the player goes to a different one in the future. For example, activating XVII - The Stars? in a Secret Room will create two items from the Secret Room item pool, and even if the player goes to the next floor and uses it again in a new Secret Room, the same exact items will be generated. So, the best way to use something that spawns an item is to activate it in rooms with different item pools (Secret, Devil/Angel, Treasure, Shop, etc.) and see which item would be the best before accepting it.

If Tainted Eden's active item re-rolls into Glowing Hourglass, it can be used immediately to return Tainted Eden to their previous state. This allows the player to have practically infinite attempts to keep their loadout of passive items as long as they travel back in time before being hit again.
While playing as Tainted Eden and rerolling an active item into the Glowing Hourglass, you can infinitely spawn wisps as much as possible until you reroll it again.

Duality: The doors to the Devil Room and Angel Room can stay open if you use the Glowing Hourglass inside their rooms, so Duality lets you check the items of both of them before deciding which room to use, provided two charges are still available by the end of the floor.

Forget Me Now + Schoolbag: Using Forget Me Now will fully recharge Glowing Hourglass on the new floor, using Glowing Hourglass after that will take Isaac back to the previous room while also giving back Forget Me Now. This allows for infinite usage of Glowing Hourglass as well as infinite retries of any room as long as Forget Me Now is used before the room is cleared.

Saturnus: Using the Glowing Hourglass will activate the effect of Saturnus again, essentially allowing for double the amount of orbiting tears, if the player returns to a room, where the tears created by Saturnus were not destroyed.

If activated while under the effect of Soul of Azazel, as long as you had the consumable in the previously visited room, you will keep the Megablast effect while having another copy of the soul in your inventory.

Stationary duplicated tears will release normally.

Isaac's bombs have a 63% chance to spawn a pickup or trinket when they explode, but the chance for either to generate decreases by 1% for each spawn until Isaac enters a new floor. Isaac's bombs have a 15% chance to charm random enemies in the room when they explode.
