description: Spawns a finger familiar that faces in the same direction as Isaac, rapidly damaging enemies it points at for 10% of Isaac's damage.
effects: Spawns a floating finger familiar that can be aimed with the fire buttons in all directions.
The finger fires invisible spectral lasers, doing 10% of Isaac's Damage. The lasers fire 10 times per second and are not affected by Isaac's tear rate.
The lasers have thickness based on Isaac's Damage, making it easier to inflict damage on higher Damage.
While not being aimed with the fire buttons, the finger points in the direction of movement or downwards if standing still.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the finger's damage, but does not affect its lasers' thickness.
Box of Friends: Adds another finger on top of the previous one, effectively doubling its damage.
Finger!: Multiple fingers will stack on top of each other and move simultaneously, effectively boosting the damage of the original one.
Having too many fingers can cause the game to lag.
Spirit Sword: When doing a spin attack, the familiar will spin with the sword.
Flies are generated from the damage the finger does.
Ipecac: The finger gains massive damage boost as expected.
Proptosis
Triples the finger's damage, but does not affect its lasers' thickness. Has no penalty with range.
Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The finger has a chance to destroy rocks when pointing at them.

interactions.text: Godhead: Only increases damage.
Terra: Causes the finger to constantly destroy obstacles in its line of sight.
Homing tears: The finger's lasers do not become homing.
A Lump of Coal: No effect on the finger's damage.
Marked: While actively aiming, the finger behaves as normal and while fire keys are not pressed, it points towards the targeting crosshair.
Trinity Shield: When not firing, the finger will point towards the nearest cardinal direction as to where the shield is left. This favors the vertical directions when the shield is at a 45° angle.
Trisagion: No effect on the finger's damage.
Angelic Prism: No effect on the finger's fire.

needsReview: The finger fires invisible spectral lasers, doing 10% of Isaac's Damage. The lasers fire 10 times per second and are not affected by Isaac's tear rate.

name: Shade
description: Spawns a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 1 second delay and deals contact damage to enemies. After dealing enough damage, it is absorbed by Isaac and spawns friendly My Shadows.
effects: Grants a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 1-second/ 0.66-second delay and deals 2/ 5 contact damage per tick, or 30/ 75 damage per second, to enemies.
Shade is absorbed by Isaac after dealing over 600 damage over 666 damage.
The familiar disappears and turns into friendly dark My Shadows, identical to those spawned by My Shadow.
Isaac will now do equal contact damage at the same rate as the Shade used to.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.
BFFS!: Will continue to work on Isaac even after Shade is absorbed, doubling contact damage.

Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly Chargers as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly Chargers however friendly Chargers can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly chargers.
Eraser: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning as the item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.
Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly chargers.
Shade: Isaac's contact damage increases when absorbing multiple Shade familiars.

needsReview: Grants a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 1-second/ 0.66-second delay and deals 2/ 5 contact damage per tick, or 30/ 75 damage per second, to enemies.
Shade is absorbed by Isaac after dealing over 600 damage over 666 damage.

name: Depression
description: Spawns a familiar that leaves a trail of creep that damages enemies at 6 damage per second. Has a chance to spawn damaging beams of light onto enemies that touch the cloud.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of blue creep that damages enemies.
The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging Holy Light beam onto the enemy.
The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Increase cloud size but does not increase damage.

needsReview: The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.

name: Hushy
description: Spawns a Hush familiar that bounces diagonally around the room and deals contact damage. While firing tears, it stops moving. When stationary, Hushy will periodically fire out rings of projectiles.
effects: Spawns a Hush familiar that floats and travels diagonally around the room, bouncing on walls, and deals contact damage to enemies. While firing tears, Hushy stops moving. In this state, it will
Block enemy projectiles.
Fire out rings of 8 blue projectiles that deal 6 damage each, once every 1.033 seconds.
Hushy deals 2 contact damage per tick or 30 damage per second.
needsReview: Fire out rings of 8 blue projectiles that deal 6 damage each, once every 1.033 seconds.
Hushy deals 2 contact damage per tick or 30 damage per second.

name: Lil Monstro
description: Spawns a familiar that fires clusters of tears. Must be charged before shooting.
effects: Spawns a small flying Monstro familiar that charges up and fires a large cluster of tears, similar to Monstro's main attack.
It fires between 12 and 14 tears that do 3.5 damage each.
It can do a minimum of 3.5 damage to 49 damage, depending on how many shots are fired and how many hit.

name: King Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and makes other familiars follow it. While firing tears, other familiars stop moving.
effects: Grants a familiar that follows Isaac and always appears first in the familiar chain.
While firing tears, King Baby stops moving and glows white.
When Isaac stops firing tears, King Baby moves rapidly back towards Isaac.
While King Baby is stationary, other familiars remain stationary as well. This affects every familiar that has priority in how closely it follows behind Isaac.
Shooting familiars fire at nearby enemies automatically and throwable familiars launch themselves at nearby enemies automatically.

Familiars that have charged attacks will operate on similar rules to Marked: they will immediately fire at full charge, and variable-charged attacks will be released earlier the closer that King Baby is to the target.

synergies.text: Lil Brimstone: Can fire in full 360 degrees and will fire as soon as he's fully charged, making him extremely effective.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Increases King Baby's size. No other effect.
Child Leash: Familiars stay closer to King Baby while Isaac is firing.
Cain's Other Eye: Cain's Other Eye will attempt to fire directly at enemies but only when they are on the same side as the random direction it is firing in.
Duct Tape: King Baby will stay in place relative to Isaac until Isaac starts firing tears. Then King Baby will remain stationary until Isaac has stopped firing and will rapidly move back to him.
Friendship Necklace: Familiars will orbit King Baby at all times instead of Isaac, even while not firing. King Baby itself is unaffected.
GB Bug: GB Bug will only throw itself at nearby enemies automatically if a fire button is double tapped while King Baby's effect is active.

Gemini: Suture will rest near King Baby as long as there are no enemies near Isaac. When Isaac gets near enemies, Suture will rapidly snap from King Baby toward the enemy. Functionally, King Baby has no real effect on Gemini.
Visually, this can result in the umbilical between Isaac and Suture getting stretched to a long length.
Jaw Bone: After being thrown, Jaw Bone will return to Isaac and then reappear behind King Baby.
RC Remote: Overrides King Baby's halting; familiars will mimic Isaac's movements even while firing. King Baby's auto-targeting remains active.

name: Big Chubby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and charges across the room when Isaac fires, blocking shots and dealing 40.5 damage per second on contact.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and charges across the room when Isaac fires, dealing 2.7 damage per tick or 40.5 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
The familiar's charging speed is very slow, unlike its counterpart Little Chubby.
The familiar blocks enemy shots.

interactions.text: Duct Tape: Big Chubby stays in place relative to Isaac until it is fired.

name: Broken Glass Cannon
description: Begins with no charges and turns into Glass Cannon when used. Only acquired by taking damage while holding Glass Cannon.
effects: This item is acquired when Isaac takes damage while holding Glass Cannon. It begins with no charges.
Once fully charged, it automatically turns back into Glass Cannon.

name: Plan C
description: Kills all enemies in the room, then kills Isaac three seconds later.
effects: Upon use, deals 9,999,999 damage to every enemy in the room, then kills Isaac 3 seconds later.
Kills Isaac 10 seconds later in Delirium's room and 11.5 seconds later in Mother's room.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Multiplayer: Only the player who uses Plan C dies.
If the user dies from other causes before the effects of Plan C can conclude, their ghost will die, resulting in a run loss, regardless of there being other players alive.

name: D1
description: Duplicates a random pickup in the room. The new pickup may be different than the original (i.e. a different card, etc).
effects: Upon use, duplicates one random pickup in the current room, including Cards, Runes, Chests, and trinkets.
Duplicated pickups may not be identical to the original; for example, a duplicated card may be a different one than the original.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Generates two pickups instead of just one.

Car Battery + Lil' Battery: Allows for infinite generation of Lil' Batteries. While it's still possible to generate infinite batteries with this synergy, it is slow to do so since mostly Micro Batteries will spawn. The occasional Lil' Battery or other battery spawn is needed to build up the battery pile.
An endless supply of Lil' Batteries allows for an endless supply of every kind of unlocked pickups, chests, and trinkets, as long as there is at least one of the initial pickup type on the floor.
Card: Allows for an infinite supply of every kind of unlocked card.
Pill: Allows for an infinite supply of every kind of pill in the current run's pill pool.
Pill + PHD: Allows for an infinite supply of beneficial pills.
Tainted Lost: Duplicated cards have an increased chance to be Holy Cards.

interactions.text: Guppy's Eye: Guppy's Eye can be used to see what changed when duplicating a chest. It will not immediately show the new contents, but leaving the room and returning will reveal the changes. This essentially allows rerolling the rewards within them, especially useful in Chest and Dark Room.
The contents are immediately updated upon reroll.

name: Void
description: Consumes all pedestal items in the room. Activated items will have their effects added to Void, and passive items will grant random stat upgrades.
effects: Upon use, destroys all pedestal items in the room. Items that require payment cannot be absorbed unless they are bought first.

If Void destroys an activated item, it gains the activated ability of that item; whenever Void is used, it will simultaneously use all previous active items that were absorbed in the same order they were absorbed. Passive effects of absorbed active items will not apply (e.g., the passive effect of Mom's Box). The active item effects happen after the initial destruction of current pedestal items, and in the order that the active items were absorbed.
If Void destroys a passive item, Isaac gains 2 random stat boosts. Possible stat changes include
+1 flat Damage
+0.5 Fire Rate
+0.2 Speed
+0.2 Shot Speed
+1 Luck
+2.5 Range

synergies.text: Alabaster Box: Allows the box to be charged through normal means, rather than by absorbing soul hearts.
Breath of Life: Immediately grants invincibility frames.
Panic Button: Getting hit with Breath of Life stored inside Void will negate the damage.
If Crooked Penny deletes the contents of the room, they will not be consumed by Void.
Eraser: Allows the Eraser to be used multiple times per floor.
Glass Cannon: Can be used without it ever breaking or causing damage to the player.
Moving Box: Moving Box will not be added to Void; instead, it is converted into stat boosts like a passive item.

interactions.text: Abyss: Since consumed activated items are used before absorbing new items in a room, using Void with Abyss stored inside will destroy pedestals with Abyss' effect first, essentially overriding Void's item consumption effects. Previously consumed active items will still function as normal when using Void. Passive items can still be consumed with Void by picking them up before using Void.
Blank Card + ? Card: Using the ? Card with an absorbed Blank Card simply activates Void. Isaac will not be teleported to the I AM ERROR room and Void will not be deleted.
Broken Remote / Teleport! / Teleport 2.0 / Undefined / any other teleport method: Void will still consume any item pedestals in the room, after which the teleport occurs.
The D6 and D100 can't roll items while being absorbed since their effect isn't triggered the first time anymore but any subsequent Void uses will still roll items before absorbing them.

Death Certificate: Only allows the consumption of one item per Death Certificate room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice D infinity can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.

Single-use items won't be used upon their absorption, instead being invoked on the next usage of the Void, which allows Isaac to use the absorbed item later when needed. Their effects will still only be invoked once.
Car Battery: As Void will be activated twice, single-use items are immediately used when absorbed.
When multiple copies of a given single-use active are in Void, only half of them will be used each time Void is activated, rounded up.
Diplopia: On the next use, the pedestal items in the room will be consumed but another copy of the items will be spawned afterward.
Diplopia + Mystery Gift: If both items are absorbed in the same room, the next use of Void will only trigger Mystery Gift, with the use afterward activating Diplopia
Everything Jar/Larynx: Will only replicate the 1-charge version of the effect.
Flip/Jar of Flies/The Jar/Stitches/Notched Axe/Esau Jr.: None of these items do anything when absorbed by Void.

When playing as Tainted Lazarus, and Flip is absorbed by the void, it will still flip the character. But it is not normally possible to obtain a second Flip, and therefore not normally possible to absorb it.

Genesis: All effects granted by absorbed items including stat ups and activated item abilities Void takes are removed without creating items to replace them. Since Void is stripped of any active item abilities it would have gained, any other Void found will also have no other active effects stored in it.
Void's active effects are reset even if Isaac is currently not holding it.
Hourglass can now be used indefinitely per floor, but every use will cost the entire charge of Void. Makes most active items and Apollyon's Birthright useless.

How to Jump: If this item is activated by Void, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.
Jar of Wisps: Each use will spawn only one wisp.
Mega Blast / Mega Mush: Allow to use it every 6 or 4 charges instead of 12. Batteries will also full charge Void, instead of giving 3 or 6 charges to Mega Blast.
Remote Detonator: Absorbing it with Void does not cause bombs to remain on the ground until Void is used, but using Void explodes all player-placed bombs as usual.
Sharp Key: Using the Void will cause Isaac to shoot a key the next time he will press the fire key. Keys are consumed as normal.
Spin to Win: A spinning top orbital will spawn every time the Void is used. The orbitals will last until Isaac leaves the room.
Urn of Souls: Although a sound effect will play, using Void will do nothing.

conditionalEffects: +0.5 Fire Rate
+0.2 Speed
+0.2 Shot Speed
+1 Luck
+2.5 Range

name: Pause
description: Freezes all enemies until a fire button is pressed.
effects: Stops all enemies including bosses until a fire button is pressed.
This does not affect troll bombs.
Touching frozen enemies will still damage Isaac.
Co-op babies can fire without ending the effect.
Stops Red Fire Places/Purple Fire Places from shooting projectiles.
Bosses will resume their actions after 30 seconds have passed, while non-boss enemies (except Lil' Haunt) are still paused.
All enemies resume actions after 30 seconds

synergies.text: 120 Volt / Monstrance / Mom's Knife: Continues to damage enemies even while paused, allowing for insane amounts of damage.
Items that can be used without firing, such a Mom's knife and orbitals can do massive amounts of damage.
Any item that does damage without firing + 4.5 Volt: Pause can be recharged while the effect is active, allowing for potentially infinite uptime.

Daddy Longlegs: Hitting pause stops all enemies from moving but Daddy Longlegs will continue his normal attack pattern, potentially clearing many rooms without any risk of damage unless spawn-on-death enemies are killed and Isaac has trouble avoiding them, forcing him to fire. This strategy is also time demanding so if going for Boss Rush etc. this synergy is detrimental.

Tainted Jacob: Dark Esau will also be affected by Pause. With proper timing, this allows him to melt through endgame bosses with large amounts of armor-piercing damage by having Dark Esau sit on top of them.
The Ludovico Technique: The giant tear keeps dealing damage in stopped time, making it easy for boss kills.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Marked: While the crosshair is out, immediately ends Pause's effect upon use. The player can cancel the use of Marked by pressing the "drop" key or button to then use Pause.
Using the item in Greed Mode will freeze all enemies but will not pause the timer. New waves of enemies will continue to spawn even while the effect is active.

name: Smelter
description: Consumes Isaac's currently held trinket and applies its effects permanently.
effects: Upon use, any trinkets that Isaac is holding are destroyed, and their effects are permanently applied to him.
Trinkets that are absorbed show up on the HUD's item tracker.
Increases the chance for a trinket to drop after clearing a room. (Has a 2% chance to turn the pickup variant into a trinket.)

synergies.text: Glyph of Balance: Allows a trinket to appear every time there's a room clear drop as long as the other room clear drop criteria aren't satisfied, as it empties the trinket slot.
Tainted Eden: Absorbed trinkets are not rerolled by Tainted Eden's passive effect.
Tainted Isaac: Absorbed trinkets do not take up an item slot.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

name: Compost
description: Doubles Isaac's Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, or spawns one if Isaac has none. Converts pickups in the current room into Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
effects: Upon use, converts pickups within the current room to Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
Doubles Isaac's current amount of Blue Flies and Spiders.
If Isaac has no Blue Flies or Spiders, spawns one Blue Fly or Spider.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Spawns 2 Blue Flies or Blue Spiders for each pickup removed, quadruples the current amount and spawns two if there is none.
Fish Tail: Isaac will gain twice as many flies per use, meaning each fly will be tripled.

name: Dataminer
description: Displaces enemy sprites for the current room and randomly increases one of Isaac's stats while decreasing another. Turns all items in the room into glitched items with random effects.
effects: Upon use, rotates every enemy and pickup 90 degrees and moves its sprite up and left for the current room.
Enemy hitboxes remain the same.
Increases one of Isaac's stats and decreases another. Possible stat changes include
± 1 flat damage
±0.5 fire rate
±0.2 speed
±0.2 shot speed
±1 luck
±2.5 range
Adds random tear effects for the current room.
Distorts the music for the current room.
Rerolls any item in the room to a glitched TMTRAINER item.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: The stats are locked to the highest number achieved, though the lowered stat will still be more difficult to increase.

needsReview: ± 1 flat damage
±0.5 fire rate
±0.2 speed
±0.2 shot speed
±1 luck
±2.5 range

name: Clicker
description: Transforms Isaac into another random character and has 100% / 50% chance to remove the last item collected.
effects: Upon use, transforms Isaac into a random character and removes the last item collected (not including Clicker) or gulped trinket.
Now has a 50% chance to remove the last item collected or gulped trinket.
All stat changes of the new character are applied.
Non-tainted characters can only transform into other non-tainted characters, and tainted characters can only transform into other tainted characters.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Isaac will transform twice and have the last two picked up items removed.

Rock Bottom: Stat upgrades given by removed items are retained, and the best stats of each character you turn into are retained, possibly creating some powerful characters, like Tainted Keeper with all the Berserk stats of Tainted Samson.

name: Mama Mega!
description: Deals immense damage to all enemies, opens all bombable doors, and destroys all obstacles in the room. The effect occurs every time a new room is entered for the rest of the floor.
effects: Upon use, destroys all obstacles in the current room and deals 200 damage to every enemy (including bosses). This effect also applies to every room for the remainder of the floor.
Also destroys all Machines, Beggars, Shopkeepers, and Fire Places.
Also destroys all obstacles in rooms that have already been cleared.
Will destroy Donation Machines as well, reducing donated coin count and removing them for the rest of the run.
Opens all Secret Room and Super Secret Room doors on the current floor.
Mama Mega! opens the paths to Boss Rush and the ??? even after the time limits expire.

synergies.text: Mama Mega! + Safety Scissors: Allows for infinite uses of Mama Mega! after finding a Golden Bomb or ? Card, as the extinguished Golden Troll Bombs will turn into Golden Bombs.
Bag of Crafting: The infinite golden bombs created can be used to easily craft high quality items.
Broken Padlock: Mama Mega!'s blast will also open locks.

Golden Bomb: While holding a golden bomb, Mama Mega! can be used once on that floor without consuming it, using it a second time consumes it as normal. It may be used again for free on another floor if yet another golden bomb is collected, and so on. Using Mama Mega once will remove the golden bomb from Isaac's consumables. Mama Mega! also receives a unique golden sprite in the HUD.
Schoolbag + Everything Jar: Reliable source of Golden Bombs for the above use.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
If consumed by Void, the Mama Mega! effect will be activated once only, the next time Void is activated.
? Card: Mama Mega! will be activated and consumed.
Mama Mega!'s effect can be activated through the card without consuming the actual item.

name: Wait What?
quote: I can't believe it's not butter bean!
description: Isaac farts, sending out a circular rock wave that destroys obstacles and hurts enemies.
effects: Upon use, Isaac farts, knocking back enemies and their shots. It also sends out a circular rock wave around him that deal 10 damage per tick to nearby enemies and break obstacles.
Shots deflected by Wait What? farts deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

synergies.text: Ghost Pepper / Bird's Eye: Shoots a flame behind Isaac upon each use of Wait What. Despite Car Battery not duplicating Wait What's shockwave, the flame shot is duplicated.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

name: Crooked Penny
description: Has a 50% chance to double all items, Chest, trinkets, and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, spawns a Penny and the other items and pickups disappear.
effects: Upon use, has a 50% chance to double all items, pickups, trinkets, and Chest in the current room.
If the effect fails, the items, pickups, and chests disappear, and a Penny is spawned.

synergies.text: Void does not absorb the item if Crooked Penny fails, but one penny still appears. Void absorbs only the original item if Crooked Penny succeeds, leaving behind a copy.

interactions.text: Activates the item twice, quadrupling all items/drops in the room at a 25% chance but having a combined 75% chance to fail. A failure followed by a success generates 2 pennies.

name: Dull Razor
description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.
effects: Hurts Isaac without taking away health, giving him invincibility frames equal to a full heart damage and activating any items that trigger upon getting hit.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Dull Razor activates twice, triggering on-damage items twice. Invincibility frames are the same.
Cambion Conception: Dull Razor triggers a damage, allowing for free familiar spawn on repeated use.

interactions.text: Cone Head / Star of Bethlehem / Aura from White Poops or White Dips: Can block the "hit" Dull Razor inflicts, nullifying the invincibility frames and causing no effect.
Crown Of Light: Disables the effect for the current room.
Habit: Will try to charge Dull Razor itself, but fails due to the effect trigger before the charge bar is emptied.
Habit + The Battery: Will charge Dull Razor itself only when the charge bar is not filled by extra charges.
Habit + The Battery + Car Battery: Will fully charge Dull Razor itself, allowing for infinite uses of the item.
Habit + Schoolbag: The secondary item will be charged.
Habit + Schoolbag + 9 Volt: If Dull Razor is copied into the second active item through an effect such as Diplopia or Crooked Penny, the two Dull Razors can be switched between infinitely.
Perfection: Is not destroyed by a use of Dull Razor, as it counts as self-damage.
Purity: Cancels the current effect of Purity, allowing a different aura to be gained instead.

name: Potato Peeler
description: Removes a Heart Container, increases Damage and Range, and grants a Cube of Meat. If Isaac has a Ball of Bandages, it will instead give additional copies of that.
effects: On use
Removes one Red Heart Container.
Increases damage by a flat +0.2.
Grants one Cube of Meat.
The Cube of Meat is not added as a real item in Isaac's inventory.
If Isaac has Ball of Bandages, Potato Peeler will give additional copies of that instead.
Grants an active Anemic effect for the current room.
Counts as self-damage for the purposes of damage-triggered items.

synergies.text: Cubes of Meat created by Potato Peeler will always reroll into , regardless of where Potato Peeler was obtained or the rooms it was used in.
III - The Empress?/XI - Strength: The temporary hearts granted by the cards can be used to create a Cube of Meat.
Tainted Eden: The Cube of Meat is not re-rolled when Tainted Eden takes damage, but the loss of a heart container is permanent.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: The Cubes of Meat from Potato Peeler cannot be duplicated by Box of Friends.
Car Battery: No effect.
Car Battery + Book of Virtues: Summons 2 wisps and one Cube of Meat upon use.

needsReview: Increases damage by a flat +0.2.

name: Metronome
description: Grants a random item effect for the current room.
effects: Grants a random item's effect for the current room.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Isaac keeps any stat upgrades gained by a random temporary item as long as the item brings his stats over their highest value reached on that run.

interactions.text: Some items behave unusually after leaving the room while the Holy Mantle shield was active
Items that grant flight: Isaac's appearance is reset back to normal, but he is still able to fly.
1up!: the mushroom familiar continues to follow Isaac, but doesn't grant an extra life.
Cupid's Arrow: the tear appearance is reset back to normal, but the tears still travel through enemies.
Fire Mind: the tear appearance is reset back to normal, but tears can still explode when they hit an enemy.
Mysterious Liquid: the tear appearance is reset back to normal, but tears will still leave green creep on the ground.
Car Battery: Metronome is activated twice at once as expected, but the item chosen for the first activation is shown raised above Isaac's head, instead of the second one that actually remains active.
Moreover, active item effects chosen by Metronome are only activated once.
Bird Cage: Spawns the familiar for the current room, leaving the room it spawned in will only left the sprite over Isaac's head without doing nothing.

name: D infinity
description: Has the effect of a random die item that changes each use. Replicates the effect of a selected die item (except Spindown Dice), and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.
effects: Each die item has a 2 room charge.
D infinity is able to use all the available effects, regardless of whether the individual die mimicked by this item has been unlocked prior or not.
Upon use, acts as any die item except for Spindown Dice, and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.
The charge time when picked up is 4, but changes to that of the last used die. Cycling does not change the charge time.
The table below shows charges and effects.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Activates 2 dice. The second activation die cannot be predicted.
The second activation die is determined by the seed and never changes.
Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice D infinity can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.
? Card: Activates the selected die, updating the charge time and keeping the charges stored.

name: Eden's Soul
description: Spawns two random items from the current room's Item Pool and then disappears. Starts with no charges.
effects: Upon use, spawns two random item pedestals using the item pool of the current room. Eden's Soul is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.

synergies.text: ? Card: Activates the item without consuming it, allowing for potential multiple uses.
Wild Card: Gives the effect of Eden's Soul if it was the last item/card used.

interactions.text: The Battery: Eden's Soul cannot be activated twice with a double charge.
Car Battery: Does not affect Eden's Soul. Only two items will spawn upon use.
Void: If absorbed, Eden's Soul is stored, and allows for a single use in a desired location. Also effectively reduces charge time to 6 / 4 rooms.

Car Battery + Void: Eden's Soul is Voided and then immediately consumed, spawning 2 items from the current item pool. This is likely to be the Angel Room as that is where Eden’s Soul is usually found. Effectively removes the charge time of Eden’s Soul.
If Car Battery is picked up after Eden's Soul was absorbed, the next Void use will spawn 2 item pedestals and immediately Void them.

name: Acid Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random pill every 3 / 7 rooms. Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room are poisoned.
effects: Spawns a familiar that drops random pills.
Acid Baby drops a pill every 3 / 7 cleared rooms. The first drop happens after 2 / 6 rooms.
Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room will be poisoned.
The poison lasts for 6 ticks. Enemies also take 10 additional damage.

synergies.text: Acid Baby drops a pill every 6 cleared rooms.
Vurp!: If Isaac's last used pill is a Vurp! pill and Isaac finds another Vurp! pill afterward, he can infinitely generate Vurp! pills and repeatedly use them for mass poison damage.

interactions.text: Second Hand: No effect.
Starter Deck: All pills dropped by Acid Baby will turn into cards.

needsReview: The poison lasts for 6 ticks. Enemies also take 10 additional damage.

name: YO LISTEN!
description: +1 luck. Spawns a fairy familiar that points out Secret Rooms, Crawl Space entrances, and tinted rocks.
effects: +1 luck.
Spawns a familiar that sporadically moves around the room.
Upon entering a room with a Secret Room/Super Secret Room entrance, tinted rock, or a rock with a Crawl Space underneath, it will fly towards it.
If there are multiple secrets, then it will fly from one to the other.

name: Adrenaline
description: Increases damage based on how many empty Red Heart containers Isaac has.
effects: Gives Isaac a flat damage up based on how many empty Red Heart containers he has.

The damage up given is ((2 x MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) x 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
Damage ups are only applied for every fully empty heart container.

synergies.text: Birthright + Magdalene: Allows Magdalene to gain more damage than the other characters can because of her 6 additional heart containers.
Blood Oath: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.
Empty Heart: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if an empty heart container is granted at the beginning of each floor.
Rock Bottom: Allows Isaac to keep the damage up after refilling hearts.

conditionalEffects: Gives Isaac a flat damage up based on how many empty Red Heart containers he has.

The damage up given is ((2 x MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) x 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
needsReview: The damage up given is ((2 x MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) x 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.

name: Jacob's Ladder
description: Tears fire sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.
effects: Tears fire 1 short-ranged spark of electricity in a random direction upon hitting an obstacle or enemy. When an arc strikes an enemy, it will strike another nearby enemy, chaining up to four times.
Sparks deal half of the tear's damage.
Sparks behave like spectral and piercing lasers and will arc to hit enemies that are close enough, even striking multiple ones in a row.
An enemy can take damage multiple times from sparks of a single chain. If an enemy take damage from a tear, it does not take any damage from the chain which the tear causes.
Tears that hit the floor due to running out of range do not generate arcs.
If the floor is wet, such as Downpour, Dross, Flooded Caves, some rooms in Scarred Womb and Corpse, and after using Flush!, the arcing distance is increased.

synergies.text: Multiple battery-themed items have special synergies with the sparks
Sharp Plug / Car Battery: Electricity deals 75% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, and 100% if Isaac owns both.
9 Volt / Watch Battery / Hairpin: Increases arcing distance of sparks.
The Battery / Jumper Cables / AAA Battery: Increases amount of arcs a spark can generate.
Old Capacitor: Allows sparks to arc on the same enemy multiple times.
Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Jacob's Ladder it turns into a pale blue locust.
The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 25% of Isaac's damage per tick.
Angelic Prism: All of the split tears will be electrified. Also, the sparks that pass through the prism will be split.
Brimstone / Azazel / Tainted Azazel: The beam gains a light blue tint, spawning sparks at the end of the beam and near enemies hit by the beam.
C Section: Spawns the sparks for each tick they hit.
Little Horn: Enemies hit by the sparks also get hit with Big Horn's hand.
Lost Contact: Tears block enemy shots as normal and will then spawn the sparks where the shot was blocked.
A Lump of Coal: Sparks deal damage based on the tear's range, increasing with distance. No extra damage is applied by the distance covered by the spark.
Mom's Knife: The knife will occasionally generate sparks when hitting an enemy.
Piercing tears: A tear will generate sparks for each enemy it hits.
Spectral tears: The tears can spawn sparks while passing through obstacles, and a tear can spawn sparks only once in this way.
Tainted Magdalene: Hugs cause sparks to spawn.
Tear effects: The tear effects will be applied over the sparks as well.
Serpent's Kiss: The poison caused by the sparks will not drop black hearts.
Nose Goblin / Sinus Infection: The boogers do not spawn sparks when directly hit on an enemy, but their sparks spawn the boogers for each enemy hit.
Euthanasia: The sparks coming off of needle shots also act as needle shots themselves, allowing entire rooms to be killed instantly.
Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2 / Tech X: Lasers gain a light blue tint and generate sparks.
Trisagion: Spawns the sparks for each tick they hit.

interactions.text: Backstabber: The sparks cannot hit the enemies' backs for the extra damage and bleeding.
Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Split tears can spawn the sparks.
Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: The bombs do not spawn the sparks.
Haemolacria
Burst tears can also spawn the sparks.
Ipecac: The sparks spawn only when they hit a wall.
The Ludovico Technique: The Ludovico tear spawns a large number of sparks when in contact with an enemy, but not on obstacles.
Proptosis: The sparks will decrease in damage based on how much damage the tear has lost. The spark's damage also dereases by the distance covered by the spark.
Rubber Cement: Tears will only spawn the sparks when hitting enemies.
Spirit Sword: Both swing attacks and projectiles can spawn the sparks.

name: Ghost Pepper
description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them. Gives a chance to shoot blue fires alongside tears that become smaller as they travel.
effects: Shooting tears sometimes spawns a blue fire similar to The Candle, damaging enemies and destroying shots it comes into contact with. It lasts on the ground for a limited time and can pass through obstacles.
The fire deals 6x Isaac's damage at base, gradually fading to 3x damage with the size of the flame.
Creating farts through items/pills such as Re-Lax, The Poop, Butter Bean, and etc. causes fire to shoot out alongside the fart.

synergies.text: Bird's Eye: Changes the activation rate to frac1 8 - left lfloor Luck right rfloor
At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck. Only one type of fire can be spawned at a time; however, each flame has an equal chance of being launched.
Occasionally emits a flame while the beam is firing.
Butter Bean, Mega Bean, The Black Bean, Wait What?: Will spawn fires upon use/activation.
Dr. Fetus: Fires can be spawned while firing bombs.
Epic Fetus: Fires can be spawned while moving the crosshair.
Farting Baby: The familiar has a chance to spawn a flame upon farting.
Ipecac: Fires are spawned as normal and can be hit by Ipecac tears, making this especially dangerous with a multi-shot ability.
Occasionally spawns a fire when thrown.
Occasionally fires a barrage of flames along with the blast. The trajectory of the flames is unaffected, making them stack on top of each other.
The Poop: Fire will appear behind Isaac.
Pupula Duplex: The fires gain a large size and duration increase.
Technology/Tech X: Will occasionally spawn a fire while firing lasers. The lasers will not douse the flames.
Trisagion: Will occasionally spawn a fire while firing beams. Fires' damage is not reduced.
Urn of Souls: Causes the Urn to emit Ghost Pepper's flames in addition to its regular flames.

interactions.text: 20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: Will only spawn one fire.
Blood Clot: No effect.
Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Fires cannot split.
Ghost Pepper: No effect. Extra copies will not boost the chances of shooting out a fire like with Bird's Eye.
Homing tears: Flames will not be homing.

IBS: Not recommended. IBS can trigger farts that automatically release a flame, which detonate the toxic cloud left behind and hurt Isaac, unless he has explosion immunity. While less of a risk than Bird's Eye, the flames spawned by Ghost Pepper can detonate stinky poops held by Isaac when IBS activates.
Contagion: Has a chance to make Isaac shoot a fire in a random direction after killing an enemy affected by Contagion.
Tear-copying Familiars like Incubus/Lil Clot/Evil Eye: Any fires that would be spawned from the familiars will be shot from Isaac instead.
Lilith: Spawns fire from her mouth.
Isaac now periodically creates fires that shoot towards the Ludovico Technique tear.
A Lump of Coal: No effect.
Flame damage is tripled at base, follows Ghost Pepper's damage decay formula instead of the one from Proptosis.
Sprinkler: The sprinkler will not spawn flames.
Jupiter: No effect.

needsReview: The fire deals 6x Isaac's damage at base, gradually fading to 3x damage with the size of the flame.

name: Euthanasia
description: Adds a luck-based chance to fire needles that instantly kill basic enemies and deal triple damage to bosses. If a needle kills an enemy, it bursts into more tears/needles.
effects: Adds a chance to fire needles which deal triple Isaac's tear damage.
Needles will instantly kill regular enemies and cause them to burst into 10 more tears in all directions.
The chance to fire a needle depends on luck.
At base luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 100% at 14.5 luck.
The formula used to determine the chance is: min(frac1 30 - left lfloor Luck * 2 right rfloor,25%)
At base luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 25% at 13 luck.
The tears released upon an instant-kill also have a chance to be needles, though these ones do not have the instant-kill ability. They do retain the 3x damage, however.

interactions.text: Brimstone / Dr. Fetus: Enemies killed by a needle burst into normal tears.
Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Needles will always split into needles, although some of them may be incorrectly displayed as regular tears. Burst tears will split as normal.
Ipecac: No tear burst or instant kill, but triple damage still works.
Enemies killed by a needle burst into ipecac shots.
Jacob's Ladder: The electric arcs released from a needle shot also retain the needle's instant kill and tear burst properties.
Little Horn: If a tear has both the Euthanasia and Little Horn effects and instantly kills an enemy, it does not cause a tear burst.
Tech.5: The tears that Isaac fires work normally, and the laser has a chance to deal triple damage with no other effects.
Laser Rings will sometimes deal triple damage/instantly kill regular enemies, and enemies killed by needles burst into normal tears.
Technology: Killed enemies can burst into black tears normally.
Technology 2: The tears that Isaac fires work normally, but the laser is completely unaffected.
The laser has an extremely high chance of executing normal enemies.
Tiny Planet: Euthanasia's tear bursts will follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 5 tears. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
Spirit Sword: Each swing of the sword has a chance to do 3x damage and instantly kill a non-boss enemy, causing a tear explosion.

conditionalEffects: The tears released upon an instant-kill also have a chance to be needles, though these ones do not have the instant-kill ability. They do retain the 3x damage, however.
needsReview: Needles will instantly kill regular enemies and cause them to burst into 10 more tears in all directions.

name: Camo Undies
description: Isaac becomes camouflaged at the beginning of each room. Until he shoots, all non-boss enemies will be confused. Isaac gains +0.5 Speed while camouflaged, and gains Tears and Damage upon breaking it.
effects: Upon entering a new room, Isaac will become camouflaged and all enemies become confused. The effect will last until Isaac presses a fire button.
Bosses will not be confused when Isaac is camouflaged.

While camouflaged, Isaac gains +0.5 Speed. When the camouflage is dropped, enemies in a short radius around Isaac take 15 damage, and he gains a temporary +10.5 Damage and +7.5 Tears up which both rapidly scale down to 0. The tears up ignores the soft tears cap.
If Isaac is firing tears while walking into a room, the camouflage and stat boost will not apply.
This also applies when pressing a fire button to skip boss transition cutscenes.

synergies.text: Active items: May be used to deal damage without canceling the effect.
Chasing familiars: Familiars like these can chase and damage enemies with little risk. Best ones for the task are 7 Seals and Daddy Longlegs, since they have long aggro range.
Orbital familiars: Enemies can be damaged with little risk, as the camo effect allows Isaac to get close enough for the orbital to deal damage with low risk of taking damage in return.
120 Volt / Jupiter / Monstrance / Salvation: Great sources of passive damage without disrupting camo.
Aries: Isaac can run into enemies without disrupting the camouflage.
Blood Puppy: Like most enemies, a hostile Blood Puppy will not target Isaac while the camo effect is active, but it will still target and attack other enemies.
Dark Arts: The stealth mode given by Camo Undies won't be removed by activating Dark Arts. However, Dark Arts only gives +0.5 speed while Camo Undies is active.
Mars: Can be used to deal damage without cancelling the effect.
Mom's Knife: As long as it's not being charged, the knife can deal damage passively.
Will not break camouflage while using mouse controls to aim.
Neptunus: The passive charge of Neptunus does not disrupt Camo, and the initial burst of damage is enhanced by Neptunus.
Rock Bottom: Temporary tears and damage up do not go away, causing a permanent boost for the rest of the run.
Tainted Judas: Gets a lot of use out of Camo Undies due to his in-built Dark Arts not disrupting camo.
Venus: Charm effect activates while in stealth.

interactions.text: Brimstone / Chocolate Milk / Cursed Eye / Monstro's Lung / Spirit Sword / Tech X: Charging ends the camo effect, and the effect doesn't happen when entering a room with a full charge.
The Ludovico Technique: Camo Undies will remain active until the tear is moved by pressing a button.
Tear no longer follows Isaac, but will still not remove Camo effect until moved.
Tainted Forgotten: The item does not affect Tainted Soul, making it useless.

conditionalEffects: While camouflaged, Isaac gains +0.5 Speed. When the camouflage is dropped, enemies in a short radius around Isaac take 15 damage, and he gains a temporary +10.5 Damage and +7.5 Tears up which both rapidly scale down to 0. The tears up ignores the soft tears cap.

name: Duality
description: Whenever a Devil Room or Angel Room would spawn after defeating a boss, both rooms spawn. Only one can be entered.
effects: Whenever a Devil Room/Angel Room spawns after defeating a boss, the other will also spawn.
Upon entering one, the other one will disappear.
Both rooms will spawn even if a devil deal was made before.
In rooms without enough accessible walls, only one of the two will spawn.

synergies.text: Goat Head / Eucharist: Guarantees an Angel & Devil room to spawn after every boss.
Glowing Hourglass: Time can be reversed while inside one deal to go into another.

name: Eucharist
description: An Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.
effects: Sets the Angel Deal chance to 100% and the Devil Deal chance to 0% regardless of all other modifiers (except Duality), guaranteeing an Angel Room Door will spawn whenever possible and preventing it from closing.

synergies.text: Duality: Both Angel and Devil Room doors spawn after every boss, and the selected door will never disappear.
Filigree Feather: Due to Angel Rooms being guaranteed, a large influx of items can be obtained over time.
Red Key: Devil rooms can still be spawned via the creation of red rooms.

interactions.text: Goat Head: Overridden by Eucharist.

name: Sack of Sacks
description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Grab Bag every few rooms cleared.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and drops a Grab Bag once every few rooms cleared.
The rate alternates between every 7 or 8 rooms.

synergies.text: The drop rate is improved to every 6 rooms.

name: Greed's Gullet
description: Grants a Red Heart container for every 25 Penny Isaac has.
effects: Grants an extra Red Heart container for every 25 Penny Isaac has, up to a maximum of 4 hearts at 99 coins.
Dropping below the number of coins required for a Red Heart container removes the Red Heart container.

synergies.text: Deep Pockets: After exceeding 100 coins, Isaac gains an extra heart container for every 100 coins instead of every 25.

Strawman: The assisting Keeper may also gain extra coin hearts, and in fact will retain the extra health containers even if coin loss would otherwise drop him below the threshold. However, exiting the game and then continuing thereafter will update Keeper's health.

interactions.text: Abaddon: Removes heart containers by removing coins in 25 cent increments.

Dead Cat: Any extra Red Heart containers granted by Greed's Gullet will be removed upon pickup. If Isaac had more than 24 coins when picking up Dead Cat, then the remaining Red Heart container will be removed if enough coins are lost.
A Dollar: Isaac will instantly gain the max amount of Red Heart containers.
Eye of Greed: Coins will be lost for every 20th tear fired, risking Red Heart container loss if Isaac has more than 24 coins.
Money Power: Isaac will gain both damage and health.
A Quarter: Isaac will gain a Red Heart container.

name: Large Zit
description: Adds a chance to fire a creep shot that deals double damage and leaves a trail of slowing white creep.
effects: While firing, Isaac has a chance to fire an additional creep shot that deals double damage, slows enemies, and leaves a short trail of white creep that also slows enemies.
The chance is not affected by luck.
The creep shots don't take on any tear effects.
The creep shots are not affected by range but affected by shot speed, which determines their effective range.
Their tear sizes are not affected by their damage. They always retain their small size.
The creep shots can be fired diagonally.
A creep shot will also be fired in a random direction when taking damage.
Large Zit does not fire when

synergies.text: Brimstone / Chocolate Milk / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Monstro's Lung / Tech X: Creep shots will still be fired occasionally while holding the fire button.
Dr. Fetus: Creep shots will occasionally be fired along with bombs.
Ipecac: High tear damage from Ipecac is doubled, causing very powerful creep shots.
Multidimensional Baby: Creep shots can be duplicated.
Polyphemus: High tear damage from Polyphemus is doubled.
Technology Zero: Creep shots will be connected to other tears via electricity.
Urn of Souls: Creep shots still shoot as normal while using the urn.

interactions.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Isaac will still fire one creep shot.
Bird's Eye / Ghost Pepper: Firing creep shots does not spawn the fires.
Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Creep shots will not burst into split tears.
Dead Eye: Creep shots do not grant or reset the damage multiplier, although their damage still benefit from the multiplier.
Eye of Belial: Creep shots are not affected.
Eye of Greed / Lead Pencil: Creep shots are not counted for shots fired.
Eye of the Occult: Creep shots are not controlled. Creep shots will only fire in cardinal or diagonal directions unless there is a cross-hair, in which case creep shots will fire directly toward it.
Incubus / Twisted Pair: The familiars does not fire creep shots.
Immaculate Heart: Firing creep shots does not spawn the orbiting tear.
Lachryphagy: Creep shots are not affected from Lachryphagy, but Lachryphagy tears can feed on them.
The Ludovico Technique: Movable tear behaves as normal. Isaac will occasionally fire a creep shot while moving the tear, and creep shots will only fire in cardinal or diagonal directions.
A Lump of Coal: Creep shots are not affected.
My Reflection / Tiny Planet / Tractor Beam: Creep shots are not affected by the trajectory altering effect. Stat changes are applied as normal.
Pop!: Creep shots are not affected. Pop! tears do not bounce off of creep shots.
Proptosis: Creep shots are not affected.

name: Little Horn
description: Adds a chance to fire a piercing tear that instantly kills any enemy that it touches. Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons Big Horn's hand to crush the first enemy it hits, instantly killing monsters or greatly damaging bosses.
effects: Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons Big Horn's hand. It will grab and crush any non-boss enemy, killing them instantly, and attacks bosses 3 times for 12 damage each hit (even Big Horn himself).
If the tear kills an enemy, it will be feared for a moment before being crushed.
Running into enemies deals 3.5 damage to them.
Damage is dealt up to twice per second per enemy.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Little Horn tears can be split by the prism and will be quadrupled when they pass through it.
Brimstone/Mom's Knife: Each damage tick may trigger Little Horn's effect.
Evil Eye: Eyes can fire Little Horn tears. Little Horn tears won't destroy other eyes.
Jacob's Ladder: Enemies hit by Jacob's Ladder's arcs produced by a Little Horn tear will be hit by Big Horn's hand.
Kidney Stone: The stone can have the Little Horn effect.
Soy Milk: Due to its high tear rate, the effect will trigger very often, even with average luck stats.
Saturnus: Little Horn tears can orbit around Isaac upon entering a room.
Tech.5/Technology/Tech X: Occasionally fires a Little Horn laser beam.
Technology 2: The laser can also trigger Little Horn’s effect with the laser’s chance to apply the effect being determined rapidly every tick.

interactions.text: Black-tinted bombs can summon Big Horn's hand to instantly kill non-boss enemies or to deal damage against bosses.
Lachryphagy: If Little Horn tears are fed, they will burst into split tears with the same effect. If Little Horn tears feed normal tears, however, the effect is lost.
Technology Zero: Electricity connected to Little Horn tears will not instantly kill enemies.

needsReview: Running into enemies deals 3.5 damage to them.

name: Brown Nugget
description: Spawns a stationary fly turret that lasts for the current room and fires tears at nearby enemies.
effects: Spawns a stationary fly turret that shoots at enemies up to 3 tiles away
The flies are completely invulnerable and ignored by enemies.
The flies deal 2 / 3.5 damage per shot.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Two flies will be spawned instead of one.
BFFS!: Flies are larger and deal double damage.
Hive Mind: Flies are larger and deal double damage.
Sacrificial Altar: Spawned fly turrets count as regular blue flies for sacrificing, and thus are converted to pennies.

needsReview: The flies deal 2 / 3.5 damage per shot.

name: Poke Go
description: Upon entering a room with enemies in it, has a chance to spawn a random friendly enemy that persists across rooms.
effects: Adds a 20% chance to spawn a friendly enemy upon entering a room with enemies in it. The following enemies can spawn from Poke Go
Attack Fly
Fat Bat
Frowning Gaper
One Tooth
Pooter
Vis

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.
Eraser: Enemies erased via Eraser will never spawn again. This can be a detriment if Vises are erased, as it greatly reduces the usefulness of Poke Go.
Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.

name: Backstabber
description: Isaac's tears deal double damage and inflict bleeding on enemies if they're facing away from Isaac.
effects: When Isaac's attacks land on the "back" of enemies, they deal double damage and inflict bleeding.

Enemies bleed for 5 seconds, bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies.
The extra damage is dealt even if the enemy is already bleeding.

synergies.text: Dark Arts: Freezing an enemy from its back using Dark Arts will apply bleeding, though there is no extra direct damage.
Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Ipecac: These explosives can backstab but deal only 3.5 bonus damage instead of double damage.
The Ludovico Technique: The Ludovico tear will nearly always backstab when over an enemy.
Trisagion: The Trisagion blasts' shape and size make them almost guaranteed to backstab.
Worm Trinkets, like Hook Worm and Wiggle Worm make Backstabber's effect possible even if the enemy is facing Isaac.

interactions.text: Akeldama: Akeldama tears cannot backstab.
Bag of Crafting: The melee swing cannot backstab.
Bombs: Unlike Dr. Fetus bombs, normal bombs cannot backstab.
Breath of Life: Neither normal contact beams or the perfectly timed ones cannot backstab.
Divine Intervention: The shield cannot backstab.
Hemoptysis/Tainted Azazel: The sneeze cannot backstab.
Lost Cork: No effect on enemy blood creep.
Salvation: The beams cannot backstab.
Spear Of Destiny: The spear cannot backstab.

name: Sharp Straw
description: Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart or Half Soul Heart if an enemy is hit. Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart if an enemy is hit.
effects: Damages all enemies in the room.
The damage dealt is equal to Isaac's current tear damage plus 10% of the enemy's max health.
Has a 15% chance to drop Half Red Hearts when it damages an enemy.
The amount of enemies damaged does not improve the chance.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Damage is doubled and two half hearts may be dropped.

interactions.text: Ipecac: Only provides a +2 damage bonus instead of +40.

needsReview: The damage dealt is equal to Isaac's current tear damage plus 10% of the enemy's max health.

name: Mom's Razor
description: Spawns an orbiting razor that deals contact damage and inflicts bleeding on enemies, causing them to slowly take damage over time.
effects: Grants a razor familiar that orbits Isaac. Enemies that touch the razor take damage equal to 20% of Isaac's tear damage per tick or 300% of Isaac's damage per second ( 150% of Isaac's damage per second) and start to bleed.

Bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies.
The razor blocks enemy shots.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Increases razor's size and contact damage. No damage increase on bleed effect.

needsReview: Grants a razor familiar that orbits Isaac. Enemies that touch the razor take damage equal to 20% of Isaac's tear damage per tick or 300% of Isaac's damage per second ( 150% of Isaac's damage per second) and start to bleed.

name: Bloodshot Eye
description: Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage and fires a tear every 2 seconds. Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage, blocks shots, and fires tears at enemies in its line of sight.
effects: Summons an orbital familiar eye that deals contact damage and occasionally fires tears that deal 3.5 damage. It also blocks enemy shots.
The eye deals 2 contact damage per tick or 20 contact damage per second. It shoots a tear once every 1/3rd of a second as long as an enemy is in its line of sight.
needsReview: Summons an orbital familiar eye that deals contact damage and occasionally fires tears that deal 3.5 damage. It also blocks enemy shots.
The eye deals 2 contact damage per tick or 20 contact damage per second. It shoots a tear once every 1/3rd of a second as long as an enemy is in its line of sight.

name: Delirious
description: Spawns Delirium as a random friendly boss that fights for Isaac. The boss lasts the for the current room. The boss persists between rooms. The charge time is based on the power of the boss summoned.
effects: Upon use, spawns Delirium in a form of a friendly boss.

The boss persists between rooms until killed. Using the item again will kill the current summoned boss if it is still alive. Any friendly monsters spawned by the previous boss will also be killed. Their health will deteriorate steadily and their color will slowly turn more gray until they reach 1 health.

If used on a boss that has a phase change which requires the boss to die, the boss will still persist in its new phase (i.e. The Frail or Fistula). (This may be a bug as some bosses, such as Blastocyst, are unaffected)
Changes the appearance of the current room so it looks like a different chapter.

synergies.text: Monstro: Fires an inaccurate spray of 6-10 tears, similar to Lil Monstro but without the charge time.
The Duke of Flies: Creates Blue Flies instead of firing tears. Each wisp can have a maximum of 3 flies at a time.
Loki: Fires four tears that alternate between cardinal and ordinal directions.
The Haunt: Fires Brimstone lasers. The laser does not need to be charged to be fired, and can tick up to 8 times for a total of 8 damage.}}

Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly bosses and projectiles created by them.

effects: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 2 damage per tick/30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
