needsReview: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 2 damage per tick/30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

name: Black Hole
description: Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.
effects: Upon use, Isaac throws a black hole that lands on the ground and forcefully sucks in enemies and their shots, which lasts for about 6 seconds.
It deals 0.4 damage per tick very rapidly to enemies in the area, for a maximum of 6 damage per second.
Isaac and pickups are slightly sucked towards the black hole.
Nearby obstacles are occasionally destroyed by the black hole.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Gnawed Leaf: The black hole does not pull Isaac in while he is a statue.

needsReview: It deals 0.4 damage per tick very rapidly to enemies in the area, for a maximum of 6 damage per second.

name: Bozo
description: +0.1 flat damage, grants a Soul Heart. Enemies can randomly become briefly charmed or feared. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop.
effects: +0.1 flat damage.
Grants a Soul Heart.
Enemies may randomly become briefly charmed or feared.
Taking damage has a 5% chance to spawn Rainbow Poop.

synergies.text: Blood Oath: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.
IV Bag: Each use has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop.
With max red hearts, The Wafer, and careful timing to get the maximum healing from each rainbow poop, Isaac's effective health pool could be extremely high.

name: Broken Modem
description: Enemies, enemy shots, tears, and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals. The reward from clearing a room will sometimes be duplicated.
effects: Enemies, enemy shots, tears and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals.
The frequency of the effect depends on Isaac's luck.
Frozen enemy shots will disappear, but are still able to inflict damage if touched.
Room clear rewards have a 25% chance to spawn a duplicate, except for chests, pills, or cards.

synergies.text: Magneto + Options?: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a TMTRAINER item if the chest contained an item.

interactions.text: Contract From Below: Broken Modem has an independent chance to duplicate each item spawned by Contract From Below.
Options?: Chests that were an alternative reward can be duplicated. The two chests contain different items.

name: Mystery Gift
description: Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.
effects: Upon use, spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a base ~17% chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.

synergies.text: Damocles: When Damocles is activated, a second item will be spawned with adherence to the item pool for the current room. Even if Mystery Gift "fails" and spawns either The Poop or A Lump of Coal, a second item from the current room's item pool will always be rewarded.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect, Mystery Gift will only spawn a single item.
Void: Like all single-use active items, this item cannot be absorbed by Void. Instead, it will consume and use the Mystery Gift.
Mystery Gift will be absorbed and will spawn the item upon Void's next use.

name: Sprinkler
description: Creates a stationary sprinkler for the current room that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.
effects: Upon use, creates a stationary sprinkler that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: The sprinkler fires multiple tears simultaneously.
Anti-Gravity: Sprinkler tears are affected only while Isaac is firing, and are released at the same time Isaac releases the fire button.
Baby-Bender: The sprinkler will shoot homing tears.
Blood Clot / Chemical Peel: The sprinkler will fire either normal tears or tears with the items' effects depending on which tear Isaac fired last.
Brimstone/Azazel: The sprinkler fires somewhat short-ranged Brimstone lasers instead of tears.
Camo Undies: Isaac stays camouflaged after placing the sprinkler.
Car Battery: Spawns two sprinklers on top of each other.
Dead Eye: Sprinklers increase the damage multiplier when hitting an enemy, and do not reduce it when they miss.
Kidney Stone: Sprinklers will fire a barrage of tears whenever Isaac does, but will not fire the stone.
Loki's Horns: The sprinkler has four eyes and simultaneously fires tears in four directions.
Mom's Eye: The sprinkler has two eyes and simultaneously fires tears forwards and backward.
Mom's Knife: The sprinkler fires knives instead of tears. The knives fire straight outwards, deal double / 1.5x Isaac's tear damage and do not return.
Mom's Knife + BFFS! The knives deal triple Isaac's tear damage.
Monstro's Lung: The sprinkler fires disorganized clusters of tears.

Star of Bethlehem: When Isaac is in the aura, the Sprinkler will rotate faster and its tears will be affected by the Star of Bethlehem. The Sprinkler does not need to be in the aura for this to work, just Isaac.
Tech X: The sprinkler fires laser rings that are smaller than the central spark and have a correspondingly small hit area, which deal 100% of Isaac's damage.
Technology: The sprinkler fires lasers instead of tears.
Tiny Planet: Tears will travel toward and orbit Isaac, wherever he is in the room.
Trisagion: Sprinklers will shoot beams.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Sprinkler increases in size but does not do extra damage.
Dr. Fetus: The sprinkler fires bombs which can damage Isaac.
Epic Fetus: The sprinkler fires crosshairs; missiles will strike the crosshairs after a short delay. This can damage Isaac.
Eye of the Occult: Sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.
Ipecac: The sprinkler fires explosive shots which can damage Isaac.
Ipecac + Dr. Fetus: The bombs fired by the sprinkler will not damage Isaac.
The Ludovico Technique / Spirit Sword: The sprinkler will not fire tears at all.
My Reflection: Tears fired from the sprinkler will boomerang towards Isaac instead of the sprinkler.

name: Fast Bombs
description: +7 Bombs. Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly. Bombs will no longer knock each other away.
effects: +7 Bombs.
Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly.
Fast Bombs inflict no knockback on Isaac's bombs.

synergies.text: Remote Detonator: Since bombs can be placed rapidly, this can be used to do lots of damage at once to a boss or enemy.

interactions.text: Bob's Rotten Head: No effect.

name: Buddy in a Box
description: Spawns a familiar with a random tear effect. The familiar is randomized at the start of each floor.
effects: Grants a familiar with random tear effects, fire rate, and damage.
The familiar's damage scales from ~2-6, and tear delay scales from ~12-30.
The familiar takes the appearance of a random co-op baby.
The familiar is randomized upon entering a new floor.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Spawns a new randomly generated familiar.

name: Lil Delirium
description: Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.
effects: Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.
The familiars it turns into are normal familiars that look white and melted like Delirium.
Familiars deal the same damage as their normal non-Delirium counterparts.
Familiars will not do contact damage.

synergies.text: Box of Friends: The copy of Lil Delirium will be a different random familiar.
Tainted Lilith + Birthright: Lil' Delirium will only stack on top of Gello if it transforms into a familiar that does.

name: Jumper Cables
description: Grants an active item charge every 15 enemies killed.
effects: Grants an active item charge every 15 enemies killed.

synergies.text: Jacob's Ladder / 120 Volt: Increases the amount of arcs a spark can generate.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don't count towards the kills needed to grant an active item charge.
E. Coli/Flush!: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t count towards the kills needed to grant an active item charge.
Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen don't count towards the kills needed to grant an active item charge.
Frozen enemies do contribute to the charge counter.
Isaac's Tears: No effect.

name: Coupon
description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale for half price. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.
effects: Upon use, turns a random item in the current room that costs money or hearts into a pedestal item that can be taken for free.
While held, guarantees a random item or pickup from the Shop to be half price.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Makes two items free upon use.
Satanic Bible: The Devil deal in the boss room can be acquired for free.

name: Telekinesis
description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.
effects: Upon use, for the next three seconds, any enemy shots that come near Isaac are held in place.
Reflected tears always do 3.5 damage.
When the effect is about to end, all shots are fired back.
Reflected normal tears do 6 damage if they would normally do a half heart damage to Isaac.
Reflected normal tears do 7 damage if they would normally do a full heart damage to Isaac.
Reflected Ipecac shots do 50 damage, and do not harm Isaac.
Reflected rocks thrown by Polty do 35 damage.
The emanating blue pulse pushes enemies away for the duration of the item's usage.

interactions.text: ? Card: The cooldown applies even when used through the ? Card.
9 Volt grants half charge on use, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.
Car Battery grants 7 seconds of protection, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.

needsReview: Reflected tears always do 3.5 damage.
Reflected Ipecac shots do 50 damage, and do not harm Isaac.
Reflected rocks thrown by Polty do 35 damage.

name: Moving Box
description: If the box is empty, picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them. If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room. Can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once.
effects: If the box is empty, it picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them.
Moving Box can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once, randomly picked (i.e. items are not prioritized).
If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room.

synergies.text: Glowing Hourglass: If a charged Glowing Hourglass is stored in the Moving Box, it can be unpacked and used to rewind time and regain some item charges.
Moving Box charges are regained, but Glowing Hourglass will lose one charge.

interactions.text: No effect.
Death Certificate: Takes one random item from a Death Certificate room which is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.

Flip: Moving items that are able to be swapped by Flip will still be able to be swapped after placing them down again. However, empty item pedestals that only contain the "ghostly" item cannot be moved unless flipped.
Options?: Only one of the choice pickups will be packed up and the other will disappear.
Void: This item's effect cannot be absorbed by Void. It will be treated as a passive item by the Void.

name: Technology Zero
description: Connects Isaac's tears with electricity that can damage enemies.
effects: Connects tears with electricity that damages enemies.
The electricity deals 30% of Isaac's Damage, 15 times per second, for a total of 4.5 times his damage per second.
A tear can generate one connection. The tear does not generate another connection even after the connection is lost. However, other tears can still make connections with it.
Each of Isaac's tears can connect to other allied tears, including those of shooting familiars.
The number of connections is limited by the number of Isaac's tears.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: All of the tears fired are connected by electricity, creating a series of electric fences.
Apple! / Tough Love: The damage of the electricity can be multiplied by the items. This occurs independently from the tears which generated the electricity.
Cricket's Body / Compound Fracture / The Parasite: Split tears will be connected via electricity.
Evil Eye: Tears fired by eye will be connected via electricity to Isaac's tears.
Eye of the Occult: Allows you to move the electrified tears, allowing you to hit more enemies and do more damage.
Haemolacria: Main tears and bursts can be connected via electricity.
Proptosis: Triples the electricity damage. Has no penalty with range.
Sinus Infection/Nose Goblin: Boogers will have electricity flowing between them even if attached to the same enemy, dealing massive damage to bosses.
Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The lasers are capable of destroying terrain, but are unable to apply knockback, allowing them to easily destroy large quantities of obstacles.
Tiny Planet: Creates moving laser fields that orbit the character.
The Wiz: The diagonally-spreading tear shots will be connected by electricity, effectively making up for the item's blind spot and providing an attack with a very wide range.

interactions.text: The following items override Technology Zero. Tears from other sources such as Lead Pencil can still generate electricity with each other.
Brimstone
Dr. Fetus
Epic Fetus
Mom's Knife
Technology
Tech X
Trisagion: Tears from other sources can be connected with the base of Trisagion's blast.

Continuum: Tears will travel through walls; however, the electricity will not connect the tears while they are outside the room. If a tear was connected before it pass through a wall, it will not be connected after passing through, limiting the efficiency of the combination.
Flat Stone: Tears lose their connection as they bounce. As such, tears cannot make connection to another tear once they bounce, but other tears can make connection to them.

Lachryphagy: Tears will generate arcs of electricity until they burst. As the tears will hang in the air for several seconds, this significantly increases the uptime of electricity arcs. Burst tears are similarly connected to each other by electricity.
Pop!: Tears in midair and tears that knock around each other will still be connected, effectively creating electric barriers and letting the electricity hit multiple times.
The Ludovico Technique + 20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: Main tear and orbiting tears are connected.

needsReview: The electricity deals 30% of Isaac's Damage, 15 times per second, for a total of 4.5 times his damage per second.

name: Leprosy
description: Taking damage grants a body part orbital that blocks shots and deals contact damage, up to a maximum of three. The body parts are destroyed after blocking enough damage.
effects: Upon taking damage, Isaac gains a body part as an orbital, which blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick (35 damage per second) to enemies it comes in contact with.
A maximum of three body parts can be active at once.
The body parts will be destroyed after dealing 30 ticks of damage and/or blocking 3 shots.
The body parts persist between floors.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Will not multiply orbitals.

needsReview: The body parts will be destroyed after dealing 30 ticks of damage and/or blocking 3 shots.

name: 7 Seals
description: Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. Harbingers have different behaviors and spawn themed Locusts.
effects: Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. All harbingers deal contact damage to enemies and periodically spawn locusts if Isaac currently doesn't have any, though each harbinger behaves slightly differently

Famine wanders around the room, leaves a trail of slowing black creep, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns yellow locusts every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and slows enemies.

Pestilence wanders around the room, leaves a trail of green creep that deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns green locusts every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and poisons enemies, which deals double Isaac's damage over time.

War chases enemies, moves faster than the other Harbingers, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns red locusts every 5 seconds which detonates upon impact with enemies, dealing double tear damage for the impact of the locust and 60 damage for the explosion. The explosion synergizes with multiple bomb related items.
Death chases enemies, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns black locusts every 3 seconds that deal quadruple Isaac's damage, applied as two hits of double damage.
Conquest wanders around the room, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns two white locusts at a time every 2 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Increases Horsemens' size and doubles their contact damage. Does not affect locusts spawned.
Bomber Boy: War's locusts explode in a small horizontal cross-shape pattern.
Box of Friends: Creates another random horseman that can be different from the original.
This makes it possible to gain multiple varying horsemen and gain all of their locusts at one time.
Brimstone Bombs: War's locusts will shoot out four brimstone beams in a + formation after hitting an enemy.
Glitter Bombs: Locust explosions have a chance to spawn pickups or trinkets.
Hive Mind: Increases locusts' size and doubles their damage.
Red locusts’ impact damage is doubled and the explosion damage is increased to 85.
Sad Bombs: War's locusts fire a ring of ten tears outward upon detonation, which are affected by Isaac's tear modifiers, and deal damage equal to 15 + 0.6x, where x is Isaac's Damage.
King Baby / RC Remote: No effect.

interactions.text: Fish Tail: Despite working with the locust trinkets, it does not double locusts from any of the 7 Seals Horsemen.

needsReview: Famine wanders around the room, leaves a trail of slowing black creep, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns yellow locusts every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and slows enemies.

Pestilence wanders around the room, leaves a trail of green creep that deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns green locusts every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and poisons enemies, which deals double Isaac's damage over time.
Death chases enemies, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns black locusts every 3 seconds that deal quadruple Isaac's damage, applied as two hits of double damage.
Conquest wanders around the room, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns two white locusts at a time every 2 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage.

name: Mr. ME!
description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.
effects: Summons a ghost near Isaac that will follow him around, and summons a controllable blue crosshair. After a few seconds, the crosshair disappears, and the ghost will act depending on what the crosshair was targeting
Items / Pickups / Trinkets / Chests / Red Chests / Spiked Chests / Mega Chests: Brings it to Isaac.

Can steal from Shops, Devil Rooms, and Black Markets, making the item/pickup free. Stealing an item has a 33% chance to fail. If that happens, a buzzer sound will play and the ghost will disappear without doing anything.
Locked Chests / Eternal Chests / Bomb Chests: Opens the chest for free.
Pressure Plate/Reward Plate: Presses the button. This includes the wave pause button in Greed Mode.
Enemies: Attacks the enemy until it dies or can no longer be targeted due to a form change or similar cause. The ghost does 3 damage per tick, for 9 damage per second.
Doors: Opens the door, even if it is locked. Functions the same as Dad's Key when being used in this way. This includes the door to Mega Satan, exiting Hush's room, and exiting Boss Rush.
This does not work on . However, it does work on doors leading to alternate path levels.
This does not work on the flesh door leading to Mom's Heart that appears after defeating Mom in Mausoleum or Gehenna.
This does not work on the hidden closet in Home to unlock the tainted characters.
Secret Room entrances: Explodes, opening the entrance.
Some destructible obstacles, Shopkeepers, Slot Machines, Beggars, and angel statues: Explodes and destroys them.
Can't target regular rocks, bomb rocks, spiked rocks, fool's gold rocks, blocks, key blocks, normal and red fire places, any poop, or angel statues.
If the room has nothing to interact with, the ghost will disappear without doing anything.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Does not increase the ghost's damage when attacking enemies.
Car Battery: May sometimes glitch pedestal items, resulting in Isaac being unable to pick them up without leaving and re-entering the room. Otherwise has no effect.
Flip: Ghostly items cannot be targeted.
Restock: Stolen items will not be restocked, even in Greed Mode.
Sack Head: If Mr. ME! successfully stole a consumable from the shop, there is a chance he will drop a sack instead.

Glitched Crown/Binge Eater/Tainted Isaac/Soul of Isaac/Everything Jar: Stealing a cycling item pedestal will give you whichever item is currently present when Mr. ME! picks up the item, making it risky to steal items this way, and entirely unreliable with Glitched Crown

name: Angelic Prism
description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
effects: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

synergies.text: Akeldama: Turns the chain of tears into four multi-colored chains.
Anti-Gravity: Tears that are floating in the air when they hit the prism will quadruple but will not move. Tears that begin moving before they hit the prism will travel outwards normally.
By releasing the built up tears as the prism passes by, significantly more tears can be affected than normal.
With Flat Stone, split suspended tears will bounce in place until their duration ends.
Duct Tape: By keeping the prism in the same spot, damage output can be significantly increased in that direction.
Duct Tape + Incubus: By stacking the incubus familiar on top of the prism before picking up Duct Tape, the shots will be affected no matter what direction Isaac is firing.
Immaculate Heart: The extra spectral tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.
Jacob's Ladder: All of the split tears will be electrified. Also, electric arcs that pass through the prism will be split.
The Ludovico Technique: While the tear is in contact with the prism, it will fire 4 additional tears in cardinal directions at Isaac's tear rate.
Saturnus: Since the prism and the orbiting tears have the exact same orbital radius, orbiting tears will immediately be split into 28 multi-colored tears upon entering a room.
Tractor Beam: Tears will split but continue stacked on top of each other along the tractor beam, essentially quadrupling the shot's damage.

interactions.text: Bot Fly: Its tears are split in four.
BFFS!: Only a visual size change, with no difference in the hitbox and thus usefulness of the Prism.
Brimstone / Revelation / Salvation / Shoop da Whoop! / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2: The laser is split in four.
C Section: Fetuses split in four.
Chaos Card: Four cards are shot out if Chaos Card hits the prism.
Epic Fetus: No effect.
Eraser: The Eraser splits, like normal tears.
The duplicated knives deal full damage and return to Isaac normally.
My Reflection: Tears made by the prism will not quadruple once more if they hit the prism again.
Proptosis: Tears that hit the prism will continue to shrink as normal even after they split until they disappear.
Rocket in a Jar: Rockets do not split, unless its paired with Dr. Fetus, and even then only normal attacks are affected.
Rubber Cement: Tears will split and will bounce if they hit a wall. However, if split tears hit the prism, they will not split again.
Sharp Key: Key projectiles can split through the prism.
Tech X: Laser rings are split into four.
Tiny Planet: Tears that hit the prism will quadruple, but all four tears will overlap and follow the same orbit.
Urn of Souls: The flames split into four multicolored flames.

name: Pop!
description: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other. The eyeballs are not limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
effects: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other.
Isaac's tears are no longer limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
Eyeball tears will start to fall to the ground after bouncing off of each other 8 times.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: Tears will force each other out of the way if placed on top of another tear. Releasing the trigger button propels the tears in the direction Isaac was firing at the time before slowing down to a stop.
Azazel/Brimstone/Tainted Azazel/Technology 2: Fires out multiple Pop! tears at the end of the laser, which is dramatically shortened.
Brimstone + Tainted Azazel: The beam is shortened to around double the range of Azazel's, while a constant stream of red eyeballs come out of the end.
Continuum: The tears will bump into each other, increasing in speed as they go through the room until they dissipate or hit an enemy.

Tractor Beam + Continuum: Occasionally, some tears will glitch out of their position for a short while. Contact with an enemy while a glitched tear is on-screen will fling Isaac to a corner of the room. This can potentially cause a softlock if Isaac is blocked by obstacles and does not have How to Jump or flight to escape. Bombs will not work either, as the explosion will not trigger despite the sound of one playing once the bomb sets off.
Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body: Split tears can also be knocked around.

Eye of the Occult: Tears will continuously try to follow the crosshair, virtually extending their lifespan ad infinitum until they hit an enemy or obstacle. This can cause tears to quickly fill the room.
Godhead: Tears gain a damaging aura and become damaging aura fields.
Godhead + A Lump of Coal: Tears will quickly fill up the screen and increase in damage, easily killing any enemy.
Haemolacria: Tears fire a burst of smaller tears in random directions when hitting an obstacle or stopping and falling to the ground.

Immaculate Heart: Tears that orbit Isaac will be constantly moving and therefore will never disappear until they hit an enemy or Isaac leaves the room. Filling the orbit with enough tears can potentially cause a chaotic, vibrating ring of eyeballs enveloping Isaac as the tears constantly collide with one another.

Ipecac: Tears do not arc and will instead shoot straight. They retain their explosive abilities on impact with enemies or obstacles, or when they eventually fall. Tears also do not explode when bouncing off of each other, which can be used to propel the high-powered tears to other enemies.
Lead Pencil/Monstro's Lung: Removes the arcing effect from the tears, greatly increasing air time. The tight cluster the tears are shot in will cause unpredictable spread, however.
A Lump of Coal: Tears will increase their damage and size as they travel, and they are not limited by range.
My Reflection: Tears constantly swarm around Isaac, quickly filling the room.
The Parasite: When tears hit an enemy, obstacle, or wall, they split into many smaller tears that have the same behavior as eyeball tears.
Rubber Cement: Allows tears to never disappear when hitting enemies and objects, increasing the uptime of tears greatly.
Rubber Cement + A Lump Of Coal: Tears continuously increase in size and damage as they bounce endlessly around the room. Eventually the damage can be enough to kill bosses in a single frame.
Tech.5/Technology/Technology 2: The laser's range is drastically reduced, and an eyeball is created at the end of the laser each shot.
Technology + Monstro's Lung Lung will fire laser beams as normal, but Pop eyeballs will appaear at the tail end of every shot, including obstacles hit by the beams.
Tiny Planet: With enough tears and/or fire rate, the Pop! tears can constantly collide with each other, causing them to orbit Isaac indefinitely.
Trisagion: Every damage tick will shoot out a Pop! tear making this synergy a potent combination. Trisagion shots will also hover in the air longer than normal.

interactions.text: Angelic Prism: The Prism will split eyeballs that it passes over.
C Section: Fetuses' movements do not extend their lifespan, it is still limited by Range. Fetuses do not fall after bouncing off of each other 8 times.
Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Mom's Knife/Tech X: Overrides Pop!.
Immaculate Heart: Tears will be blocked by orbiting the eyeballs, severely reducing damage output.
Flat Stone: Eyeball tears bounce repeatedly against the floor when they're about to disappear.
The Ludovico Technique: Overridden by The Ludovico Technique, though the tear looks like an eyeball.
Lachryphagy: Chance of tears to bounce off each other when the first tear is eaten or the tear bursting.
Sinus Infection: Boogers that are stuck to enemies will cause other tears to bounce off them, making the enemy unable to be hit from that side until the boogers dissipate.
Tractor Beam: Tears can now only knock each other forward.

(Not Recommended) Any kind of piercing shots (i.e. Cupid's Arrow) except for Trisagion (which can damage the same enemy more than once) will gradually fill the room up with 'expired' shots that do no damage to enemies. This can greatly reduce the overall damage output rate in longer boss fights.

needsReview: Eyeball tears will start to fall to the ground after bouncing off of each other 8 times.

name: Death's List
description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.
effects: Upon entering a room, a skull appears over an enemy's head.
The marked enemy will have a bigger shadow.
Killing the marked enemy will cause the skull to move to a different enemy.
If all enemies in the room are cleared in the order they are marked, Isaac gains one of the following rewards at random
A Soul Heart, a pill, a Key, a Bomb, or a Nickel.
+0.2 speed, +0.5 range, +0.5 tears, +0.5 fire rate, +0.2 shot speed, +1 flat damage, or +1 luck.
If a non-marked enemy is killed, the skull will disappear and no bonuses will be granted for that room.

synergies.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that die by being turned into pickups don't disrupt the Death's List chain and clearing a room by turning all its enemies into pickups still grants Isaac the Death's List reward.
Door Stop: If Isaac has failed Death's List but hasn't cleared the room, leaving and re-entering will reset the list.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that die by being turned into poop do not disrupt the Death's List chain and clearing a room by turning all its enemies into poop still grants Isaac the Death's List reward.
Eraser: Erasing enemies makes it easier to complete the list as erased enemies do not disrupt the Death's List chain and rooms cleared by Eraser's effect will also reward the bonus.

interactions.text: Freezing attacks: Enemies that die by freezing do not disrupt the Death's List chain and clearing a room by freezing its enemies still grants Isaac the Death's List reward, though the shards caused by them breaking do.
Frozen enemies do disrupt Death's List's chain.

Toxic Shock: Not recommended. If multiple enemies are killed by Toxic Shock at the same time, the mark will disappear and no reward will be given, even if the enemy next in line to be marked was killed at the same time as the marked one.

conditionalEffects: +0.2 speed, +0.5 range, +0.5 tears, +0.5 fire rate, +0.2 shot speed, +1 flat damage, or +1 luck.

name: Haemolacria
description: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into many smaller tears in all directions. Increases tear delay.
effects: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into smaller tears in all directions.
The number of burst tears is random between 6-11 and they have an equal chance of occurring.
The scattered tears deal random damage that is 50-83.33% of the main tear. On average, they deal 66% damage.
Tear Delay x 2 + 11
The tear delay adjustment is applied after additive fire rate modifiers (e.g. Cancer) and multipliers less than 1 (e.g. Polyphemus), and before fire rate multipliers greater than 1 (e.g. Soy Milk).

I.e. calculate tear delay from tears, then fire rate from tear delay, then apply additive modifiers and multipliers less than 1, then recalculate tear delay from fire rate, then multiply by 2 and add 11, then recalculate fire rate from tear delay, then apply fire rate multipliers greater than 1.
+1 damage and 1.5x damage multiplier.
Range down: 0.8x range multiplier.
The main tear has a roughly 1.71x size multiplier.

synergies.text: Bob's Rotten Head: When the head lands, tears are fired.

Brimstone: Haemolacria has priority. +20 Tear Delay after Haemolacria tears down, instead of Brimstone tears down. The main tears burst into 4-7 brimstone beams instead of smaller tears. The beams deal 100% damage per tick.
This does not apply to Azazel/Tainted Azazel's default brimstone beam, which is overridden but with no special effects.
If the powered-up version is acquired through another Brimstone or through Sulfur, the 1.2x damage multiplier is overridden by Haemolacria's own 1.5x damage multiplier. The beams' width doubles.

Brimstone + Chocolate Milk: The brimstone beams deal 100% damage regardless the charge. Chocolate Milk allows for rapid firing of Haemolacria tears, giving Isaac the ability to flood the room with Brimstone lasers.
Brimstone + Technology: The lasers coil the beams, which is purely visual, and Technology does not grant 1.5x damage multiplier.
Dangerous when combined with Ipecac.

Berserk! / The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: Burst effect occurs on each enemy hit. It also increases the size of the club, similar to Polyphemus. The throw is unaffected and does not scatter blood tears.
The Soul uses Haemolacria as normal.
Chocolate Milk: Completely charged shots and their burst tears are larger and deal higher damage than normal. Chocolate Milk also allows low-damage Haemolacria shots to be fired rapidly.

Compound Fracture / The Parasite: The main tears can split as they burst upon hitting an obstacle, or an enemy, but not upon hitting the floor. The split tears can burst, but burst tears from the main tears do not split.
Cricket's Body: Main tears can split as they burst upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy. The split tears can burst, but burst tears from the main tears do not split.
Haemolacria's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Cricket's Body's own x0.8 range multiplier.
Dead Eye: Both the main tear and the burst tears can increase the damage bonus, but missing the burst tears won't reset it.

Dr. Fetus: Haemolacria has priority. +10 Tear Delay after Haemolacria tears down, instead of Dr. Fetus tears down. The main tear is reminiscent of a bomb and scatters into 3-5 bombs that explode simultaneously. The split bombs deal half of Dr. Fetus' damage calculation based on the main tear's damage.
Double Dr. Fetus: Isaac fires one additional Haemolacria tear, essentially a multi-shot effect, without stat change.
Dr. Fetus + Sad Bombs: Sad bombs from Haemolacria tears shoot 10 Haemolacria tears, which then scatter into bombs without Sad Bombs' property.
Ipecac: Tear delay is increased by 1/3 compared to either of the items on their own, but Isaac now fires Ipecac shots that release poisonous, high-damage but non-explosive split tears on impact.
Haemolacria's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Ipecac's own x0.8 range multiplier. Can be dangerous when combined with Brimstone.

Lachryphagy: Main tears can feed on other main tears or burst tears while burst tears cannot feed. The main tears will burst into 8 tears that have Haemolacria's burst effect upon impact or being fed enough. If they impact too soon after being fired or hit an enemy, they will burst into Haemolacria's burst tears. Lachryphagy's burst tears do not benefit from Haemolacria's synergies with other items, such as Brimstone or Tech X.
Lead Pencil: Fires 12 Haemolacria tears, all of which will burst.
Mom's Knife: Haemolacria tears fire while Mom's Knife is charging.
Overridden by Mom's Knife. Stat changes still apply; however, the tears down is instead a +10 Tear Delay.
Monstro's Lung: Monstro's Lung has priority. Fire rate is reduced. Fires 8 Haemolacria tears, all of which will burst.
My Reflection: Range becomes extremely high, making Haemolacria tears follow Isaac for a long time before hitting the ground. Burst tears do not have a boomerang effect.
Proptosis: Effects combine to create large tears that bounce off each other and burst into smaller, standard tears that are not affected by Proptosis.
Technology: Haemolacria has priority. Fires arcing tears that release Technology lasers upon bursting. The lasers deal 100% of Isaac's Damage.
Double Technology: Isaac fires one additional Haemolacria tear, essentially a multi-shot effect.
Tech X: Haemolacria has priority. The tears burst into 3-5 Tech X rings on impact. The sizes of the rings are various, but they deal 100% of Isaac's Damage.
Double Tech X: Isaac fires one additional Haemolacria tear, essentially a multi-shot effect.
Trisagion: Both Trisagion and Haemolacria fire at the same time, Haemolacria does not keep spectral tears despite its tears sprite change but the arced tear keeps piercing.
Haemolacria becomes one big Trisagion beam that splits into more beams when it reaches its max range.

interactions.text: Azazel: Haemolacria overrides Azazel's Brimstone.
The Book of Belial + Blood of the Martyr/Cricket's Head/Magic Mushroom: Haemolacria's 1.5x damage multiplier stacks with these items' own 1.5x damage multipliers as expected.
C Section: C Section has priority. +4 Tear Delay, instead of Haemolacria tears down. Fetuses explode into a burst of tears when they hit the ground.
Epic Fetus: Epic Fetus has priority. +10 Tear Delay, instead of Haemolacria tears down.
Flat Stone: At the base range, the main tear bounces once, releasing burst tears which do not bounce, and then burst normally. At a high range, the main tear can bounce multiple times.
Burst tears also bounce.
Godhead: The main tear retains all effects, but burst tears do not.
The main tear has the damaging aura as well as the burst tears.
Haemolacria: Additional copy of this item, such as from Diplopia / Crooked Penny, grants +1 damage instead of normal stat changes.
Holy Light: The main tear can be a holy tear and bursts normally in addition to the light beam. Burst tears have an independent chance of being holy tears.
The burst tears inherit the effect from the main tear. They do not have an independent chance.
Kidney Stone: Overridden by Haemolacria. Only stat changes apply.
Works as expected. The kidney stone also bursts when it reaches its max range.
The Ludovico Technique: Overridden by Haemolacria, provides piercing.
Mysterious Liquid: Only the main tear will leave creep.
Both main and burst tears spawn creep.
Number One: Not recommended. Unlike other similar items, Haemolacria's x0.8 range multiplier does stack with Number One's own x0.8 range multiplier, thus drastically reducing range.
Piercing tears / Spectral tears: The main tear gains these effects, but the burst tears don't inherit them.
Burst tears inherit these effects.
Polyphemus: Stat changes applied as normal. The main tear gains the semi-piercing ability and may not burst when hitting a weaker enemy. Burst tears do not semi-pierce.
Burst tears do semi-pierce.
Pop!: Tears no longer arc, but will still burst when hitting an obstacle or stopping and falling to the ground. Burst tears do not bounce off of each other.
Sharp Key: Split tears from thrown keys are normal tears.
Sinus Infection: If the main tear is a booger, it will get stuck and not burst on hitting an enemy. Split tears have an independent chance of being booger tears.
The burst tears inherit the effect from the main tear. They do not have an independent chance.
Spirit Sword: Spirit Sword has priority. +10 Tear Delay, instead of Haemolacria tears down. The projectiles from the sword arc and burst.
Technology Zero: Only main tears can be connected.
Main tears and bursts can be connected via electricity.
Tractor Beam: The main tear follows the beam, but the burst spreads normally.

dpsNote: tears burst into a spread on impact
needsReview: The scattered tears deal random damage that is 50-83.33% of the main tear. On average, they deal 66% damage.
The tear delay adjustment is applied after additive fire rate modifiers (e.g. Cancer) and multipliers less than 1 (e.g. Polyphemus), and before fire rate multipliers greater than 1 (e.g. Soy Milk).

name: Lachryphagy
description: Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into 8 tears in all directions. Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage.
effects: Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into tears that fly in all directions. Hitting an enemy will not cause them to burst.
They burst into 5-8 tears, depending on tear size.
Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage and the damage of the burst tears.
If one tear is fed 5 other tears, it will immediately burst.
The tears will have their damage added together, with the first consumed tear giving additional damage.
Tears in the burst will deal half the damage the main tear would have.
This also applies to Familiar tears.

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Tears tend to clump together soon after firing for high damage shots. It may take more than 5 tears in total to cause a burst.
Akeldama: Akeldama tears can feed and be fed by the Lachryphagy tears. Fed Akeldama tears will gain increased damage but will not burst, and will cap at 5 tears fed each.

Bob's Rotten Head: The head act as a tear, dividing itself if enough time has passed and interacting with other tears. The five heads coming from the main head deal half damage. Feeding a head with another increases damage by the amount of damage Isaac has. If a tear is fed with a head, the tear will gain the head's damage.
Book of Virtues / Jar of Wisps: Wisps' tears can feed the Lachryphagy tears.
Brimstone: Brimstone's range is now limited, but piercing Lachryphagy tears will quickly form at the end of the beam.
Azazel: Lachryphagy effectively leaves Azazel's brimstone unchanged given it already has limited range.
Rubber Cement: Reflected brimstone will still have its full range.
Compound Fracture: Bone tears split into a random spread of fractured tears and bone tears.
Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Fed tears split into 12 tears.
Dead Eye Firing into the floating tear won't reset the multiplier as long as that tear doesn't hit a wall. The burst tears will never reset the multiplier.
Euthanasia: Needle shots will allow the tears to burst at least twice.

Eye of Belial: Tear burst retains Eye of Belial's effect, greatly increasing the effectiveness of the tear burst due to the piercing, spectral, and increased tear damage. By proxy, piercing, spectral, and continuum tears all improve the value of Lachyphagy.
Evil Eye: can compound tears with Lachryphagy.
Haemolacria: Tears look like Haemolacria. They can be fed and will burst into 8 tears that have Haemolacria's burst effect upon hitting obstacles or enemies.

Haemolacria + Brimstone / Tech X / Technology: The tears behave like Lachryphagy tears. On hitting enemies, they always burst into respective Lachryphagy-synergized lasers (if available), but on hitting a wall or an obstacle, slower-moving shots burst into normal shots and faster ones into lasers.

Kidney Stone: When a barrage of tears is fired, tears clump together and burst at a high rate. The stone also behaves as a Lachryphagy tear. Because of the tear height decrease, burst tears cover much shorter distance before falling, making the combination less effective.
Lost Contact: Both the original tear and the burst tears can block enemy shots. The tears' size is increased, so it is easier to feed them.

A Lump of Coal: Tears continually grow in size without being fed other tears, but they will still only deal bonus damage based strictly on how far they travel. Burst tears will still grow in size and damage as they travel.
Monstro's Lung / Lead Pencil: The tears clump together soon after firing, causing potentially up to 20x tear damage on a direct hit on an enemy.
My Reflection: Causes tears to float back towards Isaac and clump together with any tears they come along.
Pulse Worm: The fluctuating hitboxes of the tears causes them to clump together at a faster rate.
Revelation: The beam's range is now limited, but piercing Lachryphagy tears will form at the end of it.

Sinus Infection: Boogers will always burst into more boogers, though some of the boogers may incorrectly appear to be normal tears. When a booger sticks to an enemy, it will burst into 8 boogers which have a high chance of sticking again to the same enemy.
Technology: Technology's range is now limited, but piercing Lachryphagy tears will form at the end of the beam.

Technology 2: Significantly shortens the range of the laser. A piercing Lachryphagy tear spawns at the end of the laser every tick, rapidly feeding off of each other and bursting when standing still. This is an extremely powerful combo that alone can provide enough damage output to challenge any boss in the game.
A fire rate reduction such as from The Inner Eye or a few Tears Down pills makes the combo even stronger, as tears will grow even larger before bursting.

Tiny Planet: Tears will orbit until they are behind the character. Tears will burst into 8 tears that follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 4. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.
Tears orbit the player without slowing down, and can be fed as normal. When a tear bursts, the created tears orbit the place of burst.
Trisagion: Trisagion tears will fade faster, but will constantly spit out more piercing Lachryphagy tears while they are active.

interactions.text: Chaos Card: Counts as a tear and will be wasted if thrown into another tear.
Dr. Fetus: Overrides Lachryphagy.
Epic Fetus: Overrides Lachryphagy.
Flat Stone: Overridden by Lachryphagy.

Ipecac: Lachryphagy tears will burst into ipecac shots and explode. The Ipecac tear burst will travel like a normal tear instead of an arc. Due to tear slowdown effect it becomes hard to hit enemies without standing in the explosion radius.
The Ludovico Technique: Overrides Lachryphagy.
Mom's Knife: No effect.
Pop!: Tears behave erratically, with freshly fired tears usually behaving like Lachryphagy and burst tears like Pop!.

Saturnus: Orbiting tears are Lachryphagy tears, including enemy tears caught in orbit. Tears will still burst after a set duration, greatly the reducing the amount of time the tears orbit for. Burst tears will remain in an orbital path instead of spreading out.
Stop Watch / Broken Watch / Era Walk: Tears are slowed/sped up along with enemies.
Tech X: Overrides Lachryphagy.

Technology Zero: Tears will generate arcs of electricity until they burst. As the tears will hang in the air for several seconds, this significantly increases the uptime of electricity arcs. Burst tears are similarly connected to each other by electricity.

conditionalEffects: They burst into 5-8 tears, depending on tear size.
needsReview: If one tear is fed 5 other tears, it will immediately burst.

name: Trisagion
description: Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light that deal less damage but can damage the same enemy multiple times.
effects: Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light.
Blasts deal 33% of the regular tear damage, but can hit each enemy they are in contact with up to 15 times per second.
Blasts decrease in size until disappearing.
Despite the blasts decreasing in size after passing through obstacles, this purely visual as the blast will only damage enemies adjacent to the obstacle.

synergies.text: 8 Inch Nails / Blister / Pisces: Adds knockback to blasts, which can not only significantly repel enemies when used correctly, it can deal a high amount of damage to enemies unable to escape the knockback.
Chocolate Milk: Fully charged Trisagion blasts deal 4 times more damage, exceeding Isaac's normal damage.
Cricket's Body: Original blast shoots four white tears in a cross pattern during its travel time and four blast tears in a cross pattern at the end of its range. Only the original blast splits.
Euthanasia / Explosivo / Head of the Keeper / Holy Light / Nose Goblin / Sinus Infection: Beams can apply the effects on each damage tick, potentially triggering them in rapid succession.
Evil Eye: Eyes will fire beams. Occasionally causes Trisagion beams to stay static in the air for a few seconds, dealing damage to enemies that come in contact with them.
Godhead: Although the damaging aura isn't visible, it still exists and is not affected by Trisagion's damage reduction. Still grants homing effect and shot speed down which can be very beneficial.
As it hits multiple times, it spawns multiple flies per tear making it very strong.
Haemolacria becomes one big Trisagion beam that splits into more beams when it reaches its max range.

Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the blasts deal to 0.66x and +3 flat damage (instead of just x0.33). Enemies who die to the blasts under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies. Since the flat damage ignores the multiplier, this is a huge increase to Isaac's damage.
Hemoptysis + Soy Milk/Almond Milk/20/20: The flat damage increase ignores the multiplier reductions, which results in a massive increase in damage.
Homing tears: Tears slow down and stay on top of the enemy, doing continuous damage.
Jacob's Ladder: Small electric arcs generate from the blast every tick.
The Ludovico Technique: The beam becomes controllable, still dealing reduced damage but at a very high rate.
Mucormycosis: The spore effect can stack multiple times on the same enemy.
My Reflection: In addition to the usual effect, lengthens the Trisagion blasts into short flexible beams for a much larger damage-dealing area.
Mysterious Liquid: Causes a large trail of creep. The effect stacks, which causes heavy damage (even to Hush).
Ocular Rift: Creates multiple rifts as the projectile pierces enemies.
Pop!: Every damage tick will shoot out a Pop! tear. Trisagion shots will also hover in the air longer than normal.
Blasts now deal 2x Isaac's damage instead of 0.33x. Damage only slightly decreases in the front of the blast.
Spirit Sword: The sword will shoot Trisagion beams instead of energy beams, with the Trisagion beams having increased damage.

description: Repeatedly zaps enemies that are close to Isaac.
effects: Repeatedly zaps enemies that are in close proximity to Isaac with electricity beams for light damage.
Enemies can be zapped up to five times per second, with each zap dealing 0.75x Isaac's damage.
Each zap can hit up to 4 enemies, if they are sufficiently close to each other.

If the floor is wet, such as in Downpour, Flooded Caves, some rooms in Dross, Scarred Womb, and Corpse, as well as under the effect of Flush!, the initial distance is unchanged, but enemy-to-enemy arcs reach further.
Trigger range appears to be approximately two tiles wide — it's possible to zap an enemy standing directly on the other side of a rock.

Sharp Plug / Car Battery: Electricity deals 100% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, and 150% if Isaac owns both.

Old Capacitor: Allows zaps to arc on the same enemy multiple times.

The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 25% of Isaac's damage per tick.
Camo Undies: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely zap enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.
Isaac's Heart: 120 Volt becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.
Items granting invulnerability or a shield: 120 Volt zaps enemies while Isaac is invincible.

Dark Arts: Enemies and bosses will be zapped while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.

name: Rock Bottom
description: Prevents Isaac's attributes from being lowered.
effects: Prevents Isaac's attributes from falling below their highest values reached.
Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use Isaac's current stats, items and effects will impact Isaac the same way they would as if he did not have Rock Bottom.

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider / Conjoined: Multiple tears will be shot without the source's respective stat downgrades. The damage and tear multipliers will still affect future stat ups.

Azazel's Stump: Isaac will keep Azazel’s base stats after transforming back. This includes 1.25 base speed, +0.5 tears per second, and a 1.5x damage. The tear delay multiplier will not be given, including while Isaac is Azazel.
Berserk!: +3 flat damage and +0.4 speed last indefinitely. Will also give a tears up if (½ tears fired per second + 2), unless Isaac’s tears fired per second is already 4 or higher.
Binge Eater: Speed down from picking up food items no longer applies, and all temporary stat boosts are permanent.
Brimstone / Chocolate Milk / Monstro's Lung: Charged shot can be fired at Isaac’s normal fire rate.
VII - The Chariot?: The 4x fire rate bonus from the card makes it possible to reach and keep extremely high values.
Clicker: Will keep stat bonuses from items removed, and will retain the best stats of all characters that are cycled through.
D8 / Cracked Dice: With repeated use, 1.5-2x higher values can be applied to Isaac’s speed, tears, range, and damage.
Dataminer: If one overflows Isaac's tear rate to 120 before picking up Rock Bottom, the tear rate stays at 120.
Deck of Cards /Ace of Spades: Allows for more cards to spawn, which can then all be used in the same room to maximize stats gained.
Eve's Mascara / Polyphemus: Gives 2x damage multiplier without immediate reduction to tears or shot speed.
False PHD: When using a pill applies only the damage up with no downside.

The Forgotten / The Soul: Allows transfer of stat-ups between the two. For example, collecting Ipecac as The Forgotten doesn't give him the +40 damage boost, but it does give it to The Soul. Switching to the Soul, then switching back to the Forgotten prevents him from losing the +40 damage.
Ipecac: Gives Isaac a massive damage up without the tears down.

Ipecac + Brimstone / Tech X: If Ipecac is taken before Brimstone / Tech X, its full damage up is applied to the beam/ring properly, but if the order of the items is reversed, Ipecac will only give +2 damage.
Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus: Only the character that has Rock Bottom will be immune to stat downgrades.

Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 armor (effective health is ~140-180).
After getting 25 more kills (40 total), the angry version evolves, gaining the following modifications
Becomes much larger and deals 15 damage per tick instead of 7.5 (30 per second, or 180 per second while charging).
Destroys obstacles it runs into while charging.
Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac instead of half a heart.
Drops a Red Heart after every 10 kills instead of a half red heart.
Has 50 health instead of 20 (effective health is ~400-500).
Each boss killed by Blood Puppy counts as killing 4 enemies.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Only increases the size and damage of Blood Puppy during its first phase.
Box of Friends: Spawns another tamed Blood Puppy.
C Section: C Section babies do not home on angry Blood Puppy.
Camo Undies: While the camo effect is active, stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy will not target Isaac, but will still target other enemies.
Eraser: Using Eraser on Blood Puppy while it's angry will permanently prevent it from advancing to the erased phase. Using it on phase two will prevent it from becoming angry altogether.
Flush!: Using Flush! will instantly tame an angry Blood Puppy and create a Poop.
Freeze effects: "Killing" an angry Blood Puppy by freezing it will cause it to stay frozen until Isaac touches it or leaves the room, causing the frozen Blood Puppy to revert back to its tamed phase.
Friendly Ball: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.

Friendly enemies: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies; however, friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
GB Bug: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.
God's Flesh: If an angry Blood Puppy is shot with a God's Flesh tear, Isaac can instantly change it back to a tamed Blood Puppy by touching it.
Humbleing Bundle: Allows an angry Blood Puppy to drop Double Hearts.
Meat Cleaver: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.
Spider Mod: An angry Blood Puppy can be inflicted with a random status effect if the spider comes into contact with it.
Status effects will persist through multiple rooms.
Using Horse Pill Pheromones on angry Blood Puppy will make it friendly until it becomes angrier or dies, preventing it from dealing damage to Isaac.

needsReview: Spawns a familiar that chases nearby enemies and deals 2 contact damage to them per tick (~8.57 per second).
Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 armor (effective health is ~140-180).

name: Dream Catcher
description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's Treasure Room, as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.
effects: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the item that will be found in the Treasure Room and what Boss will be at the end of the floor.
items will be revealed, as well as the hidden second item on the alternate floors (Downpour, etc.)
Grants a Half Soul Heart upon entering a new floor (this includes each floor of the Ascent).

synergies.text: Book of Revelations: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, therefore Book of Revelations can be used early, as the downside is no longer relevant.
Satanic Bible: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, and if the player has no interest in the Cube of Meat or doesn't mind paying health for it, Satanic Bible can be used early.

interactions.text: Devil's Crown: Dream Catcher will show what the Treasure Room will have if Isaac chooses to enter the room without the crown.

Found Soul: The soul will receive half a soul heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to, allowing him to survive multiple hits and gather up to a maximum of 12 soul hearts. His health resets when the trinket is dropped.
More Options + Downpour / Dross, etc.: Dream Catcher will not show the third item if going to the alternate floors.

Red Key: When on alt path, if a bonus Treasure Room is encountered before the regular Treasure Room, the left item showed in the dream sequence will appear in that red Treasure Room, but the right item showed in the dream sequence will still be in the regular Treasure Room.

Tarot Cloth + XVII - The Stars: The boosted reverse Stars card converting a Treasure Room into a double choice treasure room will make Dream Catcher's prediction inaccurate, neither of the items offered is likely to be the one displayed.

name: Paschal Candle
description: Gives Isaac a familiar that grants +0.4 Fire Rate for each consecutive room he's cleared without taking damage. The bonus stacks up to five times.
effects: Gives Isaac a candle familiar that grants a Fire Rate bonus of +0.4 for each room cleared in a row without taking damage, which stacks up to 5 times (Max. +2 Fire Rate), represented by how brightly the flame burns. Starts at 1 stack, and resets to zero if damage is taken.

synergies.text: Holy Mantle / any similar item: The flame is not snuffed out when damage is negated by the shield.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The candle appears larger, but otherwise does not change.
Paschal Candle: No extra familiars or stat boosts are granted from copies.

conditionalEffects: Gives Isaac a candle familiar that grants a Fire Rate bonus of +0.4 for each room cleared in a row without taking damage, which stacks up to 5 times (Max. +2 Fire Rate), represented by how brightly the flame burns. Starts at 1 stack, and resets to zero if damage is taken.

name: Divine Intervention
description: Double tapping a fire key creates a shield that pushes away enemies and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers.
effects: Double tapping a fire key creates a Divine Shield that slowly moves in the chosen direction.
The Divine Shield has a variety of effects.
Enemies are pushed back in the opposite direction, completely reversing their trajectory with some added momentum.
Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.
Enemy tears are reflected, dealing damage back to enemies depending on the source of the tear.
The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
Reflected projectiles do not gain Tear effects from Isaac.
Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle) explode as normal, dealing as much damage as they would have.
Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) can harm Isaac and be reflected.
Homing projectiles (e.g. from Psychic Horf) do not retain their homing effect after being reflected.
Can reflect
Fire projectiles (e.g. from Mega Satan).
Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti, dealing a flat 35 damage.
Does not reflect
Lines of fire (e.g. from Dragon Fly), but can reflect fireballs (e.g. from Crackle) and their lines of fire do not harm Isaac.
Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.
Enemy Brimstone lasers are reflected, dealing 7 damage per tick (105 damage per second) to enemies hit by the reflection. It can even deflect the colossal brimstone laser fired by The Beast.
White beams, such as those used by Dogma in its second phase, are reflected into Revelation beams.
The shield lasts 1 second and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.

interactions.text: Divine Intervention: Multiple copies of this item (from effects such as Diplopia or Crooked Penny) have no effect aside from being counted for .

needsReview: Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.
Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti, dealing a flat 35 damage.
Enemy Brimstone lasers are reflected, dealing 7 damage per tick (105 damage per second) to enemies hit by the reflection. It can even deflect the colossal brimstone laser fired by The Beast.

name: Blood Oath
description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.
effects: Spawns a familiar that stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor if Isaac has more than a Half Red Heart. This drains as much red health as possible without killing him, leaving a half red heart if Isaac only had red health, or none at all if Isaac has soul/black/bone hearts.
For the rest of the floor, Isaac gains extra damage and speed for each heart lost. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
The exact formula is about +(0.15 * HeartsLost ^ 2) damage and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) speed, where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).

synergies.text: Adrenaline: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.
BFFS!: Adds 2 full hearts' worth of bonuses if any health is drained at all, e.g. losing 1 heart gives the bonuses of 3 hearts. This allows for up to 14 hearts' worth of bonuses.
14 hearts' bonus gives +29.6 damage and +1.4 Speed.
Damage-triggered items: Activate a number of times equal to the total half hearts drained.
Does not activate the Panic Button trinket.
Bozo: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.
Fanny Pack: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a pickup, which can include hearts.

Gimpy / Old Bandage / Shard of Glass: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a full red/soul heart, allowing Isaac to heal back some of the damage immediately if he has high luck or a large amount of hearts lost.
Scapular: Gives Isaac a soul heart if he had only red heart containers upon entering a floor.
Magdalene + Birthright: With full Red Health, Magdalene can achieve up to +46.3 damage and +1.75 speed, and up to +49 and +1.8 with at least one heart being a Bone Heart.
Myosotis: Can transport Red Hearts left on the previous floor, allowing early healing from the damage of Blood Oath.
The Jar: Red hearts can be stored for use on the next floor.
Placenta: With enough patience, health can be safely restored each floor by waiting in the starting room.
Stem Cell: The healing occurs before health is drained, allowing for a greater stat bonus.
Sol: Fills all empty heart containers upon defeating a boss, maximizing potential stat bonuses.
Whore of Babylon: Activates the Whore of Babylon effect at the start of each floor.

Gnawed Leaf / Tooth and Nail: Effectively give Isaac the choice to trigger Blood Oath, by either standing still at the start of the floor or by immediately moving with Gnawed Leaf, or by timing going to the next floor right before Tooth and Nail triggers (at about the third "tick" before triggering).

interactions.text: Cursed Eye: The stab will trigger the teleport if tears are charging.
Curse of the Tower: Not recommended. Spawns 6 troll bombs for each half heart removed, typically filling the starting room with troll bombs.
Invulnerability, Shield, & Statue Effects: Prevent Blood Oath from triggering, causing health to not drain and no bonuses being given
Active items or consumables that trigger these effects can be triggered at the start of the floor to prevent Blood Oath from triggering if desired
Perfection: The forced damage does not destroy the trinket or count against its acquisition.

needsReview: The exact formula is about +(0.15 * HeartsLost ^ 2) damage and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) speed, where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).

name: Playdough Cookie
description: Grants multicolored tears. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect.
effects: Every tear has a different color and different corresponding effect. One of the following effects can be granted
Brown: None
Red: 2x damage, Fire Mind, or Petrify
Pink: Charm
Purple: Homing or Brain Worm
Dark Blue: chance for Proptosis tears
Does not gain 3x damage, effectively making it a damage down.
Light Blue: Slow, and Freeze on kill
Green: Poison
Yellow: Fear
Orange: Bait

synergies.text: Aquarius: Each individual puddle will grant a different effect, and will copy the corresponding color.

Brimstone (including Azazel's and Tainted Azazel's) / Trisagion / Technology 2 / Tech X: Beam(s) apply a different effect every tick, and have an RGB filter. This can be used to rapidly apply different effects.
All of Trisagion's lasers will share the same color at any given moment, regardless of when they were fired. The same is true for Tech X's rings.

Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Explosions still use the effects the tears give them, while also inheriting their synergies with the items they're based on and (for Dr. Fetus) visually resembling them. (e.g. Dark Red becomes Hot Bombs, Green becomes Bob's Curse).
They don't gain damage from Red, or lose damage from Blue, however.
Spirit Sword: Every swing gains a different color and effect based on that color. This can be used to rapidly apply different effects.

interactions.text: 120 Volt: No effect.
Compound Fracture / The Parasite / Lachryphagy / Haemolacria: All split shots copy the color and effect of the first shot.
The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten / Notched Axe: Every swing gains a different color and effect based on that color. It lacks the ability to be spammed that Spirit Sword has, however.
Ipecac: Fire Mind tears drop a fire pit upon exploding.
Jacob's Ladder: Lasers use the same effect as the tear.
Tainted Lilith: The whip attack will apply different effects normally.
The Ludovico Technique: The tear changes color at your tear rate and gives the corresponding effects.
Maw Of The Void: No effect.
Mom's Knife: Applies a different effect every tick.
Revelation / Montezuma's Revenge: Applies the RGB filter, but does not gain its effects.
Technology: Beam applies a different effect every hit, and gains the RGB filter.
Varicose Veins: Each one of the 10 tears spawned on hit has one of the available random effects applied to it.

conditionalEffects: Does not gain 3x damage, effectively making it a damage down.
needsReview: Red: 2x damage, Fire Mind, or Petrify
Does not gain 3x damage, effectively making it a damage down.

name: Orphan Socks
quote: Speed up + your feet feel stronger
description: Prevents creep and floor spikes from damaging Isaac. Also gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.
effects: Gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.
Isaac becomes immune to spikes and creep.

interactions.text: A Pound of Flesh: Does not offer immunity against spikes placed around pickups.

name: Eye of the Occult
quote: DMG up + range up + controlled tears
description: +1 damage, +2 range, -0.16 shot speed. Isaac's tears can be controlled mid-flight with tear controls.
effects: Firing in a direction causes all of Isaac's tears to move in that direction. Tears will stay in place if a fire button is not being pressed.
The flight duration of tears is determined by the range stat.
+1 damage.
+2.0 range.
-0.16 shot speed.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity + Proptosis: Tears travel and keep their initial size as long as the fire key is held, allowing for massive damage.
Bob's Rotten Head: Isaac can control the mid-flight direction of the head, however its air-time is not increased.

Brimstone/Technology: The laser becomes dark purple and automatically fires at a controllable crosshair. The crosshair behaves nearly identically to the one created by Marked (including in its synergies and interactions with other items), but the laser itself always fires in the cardinal directions and bends toward the crosshair rather than directly targeting it.
Azazel: Like Brimstone, except that his short beam becomes a lasso. The loop starts where the beam would normally end and extends out to the cross-hair.
Brimstone/Technology + Chocolate Milk: The closer the crosshair is to Isaac, the less charged the laser will be, and vice versa.
Brimstone/Technology + Incubus/Twisted Pair: The familiars fire a straight laser towards the crosshair.

Brimstone/Technology + Marked/Analog Stick: The laser more closely follows the crosshair's position relative to Isaac. In Brimstone's case, moving the crosshair while the laser is firing makes the laser bend toward it rather than changing the firing angle of the laser itself.
Brimstone/Technology + Montezuma's Revenge: The brown beam has a similar interaction as Azazel's beam but cannot create the crosshair on its own. Corn shots are unaffected.
Brimstone/Technology + Revelation/Tech.5/Technology 2: The Revelation, Tech.5, and Technology 2 lasers are also affected by the crosshair but cannot create the crosshair on their own.
Cain's Other Eye/Sprinkler: The familiar's and sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.
/Eye Sore/Loki's Horns/Mom's Eye/The Wiz: Extra tears fly in the same direction making it easier to hit every shot increasing damage substantially.
Isaac's Tears/Tammy's Head/Tear Detonator/Varicose Veins: Generates a halo of tears that don't break their shape.
The Ludovico Technique: While holding a direction, the Ludovico tear will constantly shoot out controllable tears in random directions. The air time of these tears scales with the range stat.
Marked: Turns the Marked crosshair purple. Tears target the crosshair's exact position. Upon reaching it, tears follow and hover on top of the crosshair for their remaining airtime.

Technology: The laser becomes dark purple and automatically fires at a controllable crosshair. The crosshair behaves nearly identically to the one created by Marked (including in its synergies and interactions with other items) with the exception that lasers often arch towards the crosshair rather than traveling towards it directly and any other projectiles affected by Eye of the Occult that are not lasers (such as from Eye of Greed or Fate's Reward) will chase the crosshair and hover above it for the remainder of their range.
Technology Zero: Static beams persist between tears while moving.
Trisagion: The Trisagion beams will fire in the direction of cross-hair and after the fire button is released they stay in place until they fade away.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: Overridden by Eye of the Occult. Tears up still applies.
Brain Worm: Tears will veer slightly towards enemies when travelling by, but will quickly return to player control.
Brimstone + Twisted Pair: Twisted pair will only fire brimstone when the crosshair is moved.

Brimstone + Taurus: When Taurus' effect triggers, Isaac will be unable to move the crosshair, but he'll keep firing the Brimstone laser at wherever the crosshair remained before Taurus triggered, effectively circumventing Taurus' penalty of being unable to fire during the invincibility period.
Chocolate Milk: Not Recommended. Releasing the key to fire tears will stop the tear's movement, making it difficult to shoot enemies.
C Section/Epic Fetus/Mom's Knife: Overrides Eye of the Occult, stat effects still apply.
Cursed Eye: The tears stack on top of each other, and only move forward when holding a direction afterwards.
Dr. Fetus: Bombs will now be controlled both in direction and range.
Evil Eye: Eyes cannot be controlled, but the tears they shoot can be.
Homing Tears: Tears still home towards enemies, but controlled movement is stronger than the homing effect.
Immaculate Heart: Extra tears are not affected by Eye of the Occult. Stat changes still apply.
The Ludovico Technique + Technology: Overrides Eye of the Occult, stat effects still apply.
My Reflection: Causes the pull to be lessened while actively controlling the tears. Pull returns to normal when not firing.
Pop!: When being actively moved, tears can stay in the air until the fire button is let go.

Saturnus: Extra tears are only affected by Eye of the Occult when holding fire while moving between rooms causing some of the orbiting tears' spacing and shot speed to be uneven. Stat changes still apply.
Sprinkler: Sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.
Tech X: Overrides Eye of the Occult; however, the shot speed down is still beneficial for Tech X.
Tiny Planet: Not Recommended. The tears will stop moving when not shooting in the direction of their orbit, making it nearly impossible to control where they go.
Tractor Beam: Tears will only move forward while being fired, but control is otherwise overridden.

name: Immaculate Heart
description: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully restores health. x1.2 damage multiplier. Isaac will occasionally fire extra tears that orbit around him.
effects: Isaac will frequently fire extra spectral tears that orbit around him until they hit the ground, similar to Tiny Planet. These tears mimic Isaac's in most cases.
x1.2 damage multiplier. This multiplier does not stack with multiple Immaculate Hearts.
Adds one Red Heart Container and fully replenishes Isaac's health.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: The extra tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.
Chemical Peel: Some of the orbiting tears will gain Chemical Peel's 2 flat damage bonus.
Chocolate Milk: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.
Death's Touch: Death's Touch tear modification will also affect the orbiting tears.
Eye of Belial: Orbiting tears get piercing and homing on nearby enemies on contact, and return orbiting after no targets left.
Haemolacria: The orbiting tears will be affected by Haemolacria but the tears created upon hit will not orbit.

Lachryphagy: Lachryphagy will affect the orbiting tears and become bigger when in contact with other tears. The Lachryphagy tears will split upon hit and the split shots will orbit around the point where the original tear had split.
The Ludovico Technique: Isaac will frequently shoot tears that orbit around him, even without pressing any fire buttons.
Monstro's Lung: Fires a large number of extra tears alongside the burst that begin orbiting Isaac once they reach the orbit range.
Urn of Souls: Each individual flame shot from the Urn has a chance to spawn an orbiting tear.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: Tears will orbit very close and fast around Isaac's body, and return to normal orbit once he stops firing.
Brimstone / C Section / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
Eye of the Occult: Orbiting tears cannot be controlled.
Hallowed Ground: The damage multiplier does not stack with that from a white poop.
Incubus: The orbiting tears will orbit whoever fired it, whether it be Isaac or the Incubus.
Ipecac: Orbiting tears explode.
Tainted Bethany: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.
Technology 2: The laser does not contribute in generating orbiting tears.

name: Monstrance
