description: Isaac gains an aura that deals damage to enemies inside it.
effects: Gives Isaac a large pulsing aura around him that deals damage to enemies inside of it.
The aura deals more damage the closer enemies are to Isaac, ranging from 0.4 on the edge up to 3.9 + 0.3 * floor damage.
The aura deals damage up to 7.5 times per second.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely damage enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.
Isaac's Heart: Monstrance becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.
Items granting invulnerability or a shield: Monstrance damages enemies while Isaac is invincible.
This includes Gnawed Leaf / VII - The Chariot? allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
Dark Arts: Enemies will still be damaged while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.
Pause: Monstrance will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.
Tainted Forgotten: The aura surrounds Tainted Forgotten allowing Tainted Soul to damage enemies from a safe distance.

needsReview: The aura deals more damage the closer enemies are to Isaac, ranging from 0.4 on the edge up to 3.9 + 0.3 * floor damage.
The aura deals damage up to 7.5 times per second.

name: The Intruder
description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.
effects: Gives Isaac a spider familiar that burrows in Isaac's head, firing four slowing tears in addition to Isaac's normal tears.
The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.
These tears are unaffected by Isaac's damage and tears stats; they have fixed damage and fire rate.

Upon taking damage, there is a chance that Isaac's head will pop, spawning friendly spiders, and release the Intruder familiar, who will leap at enemies to deal contact damage, and fires four slowing tears towards nearby enemies instead of Isaac.
The spider familiar deals up to 4.5 contact damage depending on how fast it's moving and fires slowing tears twice as fast compared to when it's in Isaac's head.
The chance for activation goes up to 100% at 4 luck.
The familiar lasts for the current room, and Isaac's head is reattached upon entering a new room.

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: The shots are homing even while in Isaac's head.

Box of Friends: Doubles the number of tears fired from Isaac's head (if both copies fire at the same time, the tears will stack perfectly so it can be difficult to tell). If The Intruder is released, then interacts normally and spawns a copy.
Hive Mind: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage.
BFFS!: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage. Does not stack with Hive Mind.

interactions.text: Azazel: The Intruder's tears come from Azazel while charging his Brimstone.
Guillotine: The Intruder's tears come from Isaac's body.
Lilith: The Intruder's tears come from Lilith, despite her blindfold.
Sacrificial Altar: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while in Isaac's head.
Transcendence: When The Intruder is released, only Isaac's shadow will be visible.

needsReview: The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.

name: Dirty Mind
description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.
effects: Converts all enemy Dips and Drips into Dip Familiars.
Rocks have a chance to be replaced with poop when generated.
The formula to calculate the chance is: Chance = Luck * 0.5 + 6.25, capped at 10% at 7.5 Luck.
Destroying Poops spawn 1-4 Dip Familiars, which loosely follow Isaac around, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies.
Dips deal contact damage to enemies equal to the damage Isaac had at the time it spawned, and can deal up to 2 ticks of contact damage and/or block 2 shots before dying.
Destroying different types of poop will spawn special Dips
Corny Poops create Corny Dips that spawn 1 Blue Fly on death.
Brownie Dips spawned by Brownie and Dangle have the same behavior.
Red Poops create Red Dips that deal twice as much damage and autonomously charge at enemies, but automatically die after 15 seconds.

Golden Poops create Gold Dips that have a chance to inflict the Midas' Touch effect on enemies they hit. They can also take 5 hits before being destroyed, at which point they will drop 2-3 random coins.
Rainbow Poops create Rainbow Dips that charm enemies they hit and have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart on death.
Black Poops create Black Dips that leave a trail of slowing creep.
White Poops create White Dips that recreate the effect of Hallowed Ground and can take 3 hits before being destroyed.
Poops unique to Tainted ??? and IBS also spawn Dips with special effects
Stone Poops create Rock Dips that deal an additional 3.5 damage per hit and can take 6 hits before dying instead of 2.
Stinky Poops create Stinky Dips that release toxic gas as they move and a larger cloud of toxic gas when they die.
The toxic gas does 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (~1.2x Isaac's damage per second) and poisons enemies; clouds left behind while alive last 1.5 seconds and the cloud created on death lasts 8 seconds.
Fire Poops create Flaming Dips that burn enemies they hit and leave behind a fire when they die.
The burn deals 3.5 damage up to 6 times, and the fire deals 8 damage at full durability, 6 after taking 1 hit, and 4 otherwise, for a maximum of 22 damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles damage dealt and halves damage taken by Dips, as well as increasing their size.
Butt Penny: Grants a chance to spawn a Dip each time a coin is picked up.
A Card Against Humanity: Allows Isaac to obtain a large number of Dips.
E. Coli / Flush!: Poops generated by these items spawn double the normal amount of Dips.
Mom's Bracelet: Friendly Dips can be picked up and thrown.
Mysterious Candy: Allows a steady supply of Dips, with time. Useful for later chapters.
The Poop: Allows generation of extra Dips after every room.

interactions.text: Compost: Compost does not multiply Dips.
Sacrificial Altar: All Dips are sacrificed and a coin is spawned for each Dip sacrificed. The Dips do not count towards the 2 familiar limit of Sacrificial Altar.

conditionalEffects: The burn deals 3.5 damage up to 6 times, and the fire deals 8 damage at full durability, 6 after taking 1 hit, and 4 otherwise, for a maximum of 22 damage.
needsReview: Destroying Poops spawn 1-4 Dip Familiars, which loosely follow Isaac around, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies.
Dips deal contact damage to enemies equal to the damage Isaac had at the time it spawned, and can deal up to 2 ticks of contact damage and/or block 2 shots before dying.
Red Poops create Red Dips that deal twice as much damage and autonomously charge at enemies, but automatically die after 15 seconds.
Stone Poops create Rock Dips that deal an additional 3.5 damage per hit and can take 6 hits before dying instead of 2.

name: Damocles
quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.
effects: Upon use, summons a sword that hangs directly above Isaac. As long as the sword hangs above Isaac, all item pedestals are doubled, spawning an additional free item next to them.
Items spawned via other means, like Machines, Beggars, and certain items and cards, are also doubled.
The extra item will be pulled from the current room's item pool, even if the original item is from a different pool (ex. Beggars or items from Alabaster Box).

After Isaac takes damage (with exceptions, see below) once with the item activated, at any time with only a brief warning, the sword may fall, instantly killing Isaac regardless of his health. The sword has a 1/10000 chance every 4 game ticks (every 0.133 seconds) to fall, so on average, 50% of all Damocles runs will not drop the sword until after at least 15 minutes and 24 seconds have passed.

Self-damage (such as from a , , Curse Room, Sacrifice Room, Spiked Chest, Bad Trip pill, or self-damage Active Items) does not count as damage taken for Damocles, and will not give it the chance to fall.

synergies.text: Blanket / Holy Mantle / Holy Card / Wooden Cross: Damage blocked by the shield doesn't count as damage taken. It will not, however, protect Isaac from the falling sword.
Book of Shadows / Empty Vessel / Algiz / other items that give shield: Nullifies the instant kill of Damocles if the shield is active when the sword falls.
Cone Head / Host Hat / Infamy / Metal Plate: Blocked damage does not count as damage and can delay the triggering of Damocles.
Crooked Penny / Diplopia: An extra item is spawned per each item cloned.
However, duplicating Damocles itself and activating additional copies has no effect.
Dark Arts: When in the shadow state, Isaac can survive the instant kill of Damocles, though this requires precise timing and can be impossible if Dark Art's charge is empty as the sword is falling.
Filigree Feather: Angels spawn 2 items when defeated. However, if a Key Piece spawns, a second pedestal will not appear.

Genesis: If the player acquires Damocles and uses it before all items have been collected, then each subsequent item spawned after using it will each spawn an extra item. Unlike the Genesis choices, the other extra items will not disappear upon collecting one of them, potentially allowing the player to obtain a much higher amount of items than usual.
Using Genesis will remove the hanging sword and its effects.
Gnawed Leaf: If in the form of the statue, Isaac will be immune to the falling sword.
Tooth and Nail's statue form can also save Isaac, but the statue transformation time lining up with the sword falling is unlikely.
Lazarus' revival mechanic allows him to continue the run after dying to Damocles.
This extends to other extra-life items such as 1up! or Dead Cat.

The Lost / Tainted Lost: Any damage the Lost would take is likely to kill him instantly, meaning that the item's downside is greatly mitigated. Dying and respawning, however, will still trigger the chance of falling.
Magic Skin: Spawns 2 items on every use instead of 1.
My Little Unicorn / Unicorn Stump / other items that give invulnerability: If active, will negate the sword's lethal fall, saving Isaac.
Mega Mush: When activated, protects from falling Damocles.

Mystery Gift: When Damocles is activated, a second item will be spawned with adherence to the item pool for the current room. Even if Mystery Gift "fails" and spawns either The Poop or A Lump of Coal, a second item from the room's item pool will be rewarded.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The sword will appear larger, but will gain no actual benefits.
Blood Oath: Getting stabbed by Blood Oath does not trigger the chance of falling.
Car Battery: No effect.
Clicker: The sword cannot be removed from Isaac's inventory.
D4 / D100 / Tainted Eden: The sword does not get rerolled.
Devil's Crown: The Devil Room items that appear are not doubled.
Flip: The extra item will not have a "ghost" item to flip to.
Glitched Crown: Duplicated item pedestals do not reroll.
Holy Mantle: Does not protect Isaac from death when the sword falls.
Isaac's Heart: Taking damage still allows it to fall, and the sword will still kill Isaac if it falls.
Jacob and Esau: The sword only gains the chance to fall if the brother who used it takes damage.
Metronome: Can invoke the effect of Damocles, which applies permanently.
Panic Button: Not recommended. Panic Button will activate Damocles right before Isaac takes damage, guaranteeing Damocles will fall later in the run even if Isaac hasn't activated it yet.
Spirit Shackles: Does not protect Isaac from death when the sword falls.
Apollyon / Void: Using Void on Damocles will activate the effect and begin hanging the sword above Isaac on the next use of Void. Subsequent uses of Void will do nothing in regards to Damocles.
If the player has Damocles and Birthright on Apollyon and after using Void, a previously destroyed item appears, Damocles will spawn an additional item.
Tainted Eden: Taking damage does not reroll an active Damocles.
Tainted Forgotten: The sword will hang over Tainted Forgotten's body but will still kill the character despite being invincible.
Tainted Isaac: Damocles does not count toward his passive item count, and cannot be removed.
Tainted Lazarus / Esau Jr.: The character that used Damocles must be active for double items to spawn.
In the case of Boss Room, the form of Lazarus that did not use Damocles must fight the boss for it to drop double items.
If the player has Birthright as Tainted Lazarus and the inactive form has Damocles, the sword can fall on them and kill the player, bypassing the inactive form's immunity to damage.
XVII - The Stars?: The sword will not be removed from Isaac's inventory.

name: Free Lemonade
description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.
effects: Spawns a pool of Lemonade similar to the Lemon Party pill effect underneath Isaac.
The creep deals 8 damage per tick (24 per second) and lasts ~19 seconds.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

needsReview: The creep deals 8 damage per tick (24 per second) and lasts ~19 seconds.

name: Spirit Sword
description: Instead of tears, Isaac swings a sword. Charging does a spin attack and fires a projectile, and a projectile is sometimes fired with normal swings if Isaac has no empty Red Heart.
effects: Replaces Isaac's tears with a sword he can swing in front of him.
The swing does 3x Isaac's damage +3.5 and deals knockback to both enemies and Isaac if it hits.
The sword can be swung as rapidly as the fire button can be tapped.
The sword swing can collect pickups and open chests.
If Isaac's total health is equal to or greater than his number of Red Heart (same rule as regular Challenge Rooms), the sword fires a projectile when swung.
The projectile deals damage equal to Isaac's damage +2, and has a cooldown equal to 2x Isaac's normal tear rate.

Holding an attack button charges a spin attack, ready when the sword flashes, which damages all enemies around Isaac. It also deflects enemy projectiles, which can damage enemies who get hit, and launches a projectile with higher shot speed regardless of Isaac's current health.
The circular swing deals 8x Isaac's damage +10, and the projectile created from it deals 4x Isaac's damage +4. It can also collect pickups and open chests.
The charge time is based on Isaac's tears stat, at ~4x Isaac's normal tear rate.
While charging, the sword will damage the first enemy that contacts it. This will cancel the spin attack.
Swinging the sword normally while performing the circular swing cancels it.

synergies.text: 20/20/Keeper/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider/: Isaac spins one additional time for each extra tear, firing extra projectiles on each spin. No effect on the normal swing.
Cain's Other Eye: The eye holds its own sword that slashes in random directions whenever Isaac attacks.
C Section: C Section has priority. Fetuses hold small swords and perform the charged spin attack as they travel.
Cricket's Body: The fired projectile will burst into multiple swords.
Decap Attack: The body holds the sword while the head will only block projectiles.
Euthanasia: Each swing of the sword has a chance to do 3x damage and instantly kill a non-boss enemy, causing a tear explosion.
Evil Eye: The fired eyes swing a miniature Sword instead of tears.
Eye Sore: Random chance to swing extra swords in random directions.
Haemolacria: Sword becomes larger. The projectile is now fired in an arc and splits on collision with enemies and obstacles.
Haemolacria + Brimstone: Arcing sword beams burst into Brimstone lasers in random directions.
Holy Light: Both the sword swing and the projectile can trigger Holy Light.
Homing tears (e.g. Spoon Bender): The projectile will be homing.
Isaac's Tears: The item fires normal tears but can be charged as fast as the sword can be swung. Doing a spin attack will fully charge Isaac's Tears.
Lachryphagy: The fired projectiles will combine and split.
Loki's Horns: Random chance upon swinging to have a sword in all 4 cardinal directions. Performing a spin attack when this occurs results in a 4-way spin.
Lost Contact: Sword swings reflect projectiles.
Maw Of The Void: An additional ring will appear upon fully charging it. Spin is delayed by a bit.
Mom's Eye: An additional sword is added to Isaac's back, and can be swung as normal.
Mom's Knife: When doing the spin attack, Isaac throws the sword a short distance, which spins as it travels.
Mom's Knife + Technology: A technology laser connects Isaac and the sword while it's being thrown.
Mom's Knife + Brimstone: Launches a barrage of knives from Isaac's mouth after doing the spin attack.
Mom's Knife + Tech X: Full charge launches a sword surrounded by Tech X that swings back to Isaac.
My Reflection: The fired projectile will return to Isaac.
Pointy Rib/Finger!: When doing a spin attack, the familiar will spin with the sword.
Polyphemus: The sword and fired projectile become gigantic. Charge time is increased, but swing rate remains the same. Swings will also shake the screen.
Proptosis: The swing attack deals 9x Isaac's damage instead of 3x. Fired projectiles behave as expected.
Rubber Cement: The fired projectile bounces.
Technology: Sword becomes a lightsaber. Surrounds Isaac with a laser on every swing. Enemy projectiles are deflected by both normal and charged attacks.
Technology 2: Laser fires when the sword is being swung or charged.
Trisagion: The fired projectile is a Trisagion blast.
The Wiz: Beams and sword swings are fired straight instead of diagonally. Isaac spins an additional time on a charged attack.

interactions.text: Brimstone
Cursed Eye
Dr. Fetus
Epic Fetus
Kidney Stone
The Ludovico Technique
Monstro's Lung
Neptunus
Tech X
Anti-Gravity: Sword beams are affected normally by Anti-Gravity. Regular sword swipes are unaffected, but spin attacks freeze for a short time before firing.
Blood Clot/Chemical Peel: Sword swing has a 50% chance to become red and deal increased damage.
Chocolate Milk: Increased knockback when fully charged, no effect on the regular sword swings.
Death's Touch: Visual effect overridden by Spirit Sword including the ranged attack.
Explosivo: The sword swing has a chance to stick Explosivo shots to enemies it hits. The beam can stick to enemies and explode.
Eye of the Occult: The projectile can be controlled.
Fire Mind: Sword strikes and beams can burn enemies, and beams have a chance to explode.
The Forgotten: Spirit Sword will only work with The Soul, no changes to The Forgotten.
Gello/Tainted Lilith: The sword is held by the fetus.
Godhead: The fired projectile receives Godhead effects. No effect on the swing aside from stat changes.
Incubus: Incubus tears are replaced with a sword, identical to Isaac.
Ipecac: Sword beams are exploding shots that deal Isaac's damage. Does not apply Ipecac's +40 damage modifier to beams or sword swings.
Jacob's Ladder: Both the sword shots and sword swings create electricity.
Jacob and Esau: Knockback from the sword will separate the brother carrying the sword from the other.
Marked/Tractor Beam: Overridden by Spirit Sword. Stat upgrades still apply.
Mysterious Liquid: The charged sword attack spawns creep, the projectiles do not / projectiles spawn creep as well.
Parasitoid: The sword projectiles can still spawn flies and spiders, but the swings themselves won't / the swings can now leave slowing creep and spawn flies and spiders.
Playdough Cookie: Every sword swing gains a different color and effect based on that color.
Pupula Duplex: No effect.
Sinus Infection: The sword swing has a chance to stick boogers to enemies it hits. The beam can stick to enemies.
Sulfur: Overridden by Spirit Sword. Damage up on second and subsequent uses while in the same room still applies.
Tainted Forgotten: No effect.
Tech.5: Fires as normal while charging and swinging the sword.
Technology Zero: Sword shots are connected with electricity, swings are unaffected.
Terra/Sulfuric Acid: Only the sword's beams can destroy rocks.

needsReview: The projectile deals damage equal to Isaac's damage +2, and has a cooldown equal to 2x Isaac's normal tear rate.
The circular swing deals 8x Isaac's damage +10, and the projectile created from it deals 4x Isaac's damage +4. It can also collect pickups and open chests.

name: Red Key
description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.
effects: Upon use, creates a Red Room next to a wall where there would be no conditions that could prevent a room from spawning there (i.e., the same conditions for a Secret Room to spawn). This is indicated by red door outlines on walls.
These rooms are most commonly normal rooms, but have a 10% chance to be a special room instead, even including Red Devil Rooms or Angel Rooms.
Red special rooms of any kind can appear on every floor.
These rooms use a special Red Room icon on the map.

synergies.text: Broken Glasses / Devil's Crown / More Options: Affects Red Treasure Rooms.
Judas' Tongue / Keeper's Bargain / Number Magnet / A Pound of Flesh / Sanguine Bond: Affects Red Devil Rooms.
Luna: Affects Red Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms.
Mama Mega!: Will trigger its effect in new Red Rooms, provided it has already been used on the floor.
Spelunker Hat: Instantly reveals the Ultra Secret Room if it is adjacent to the Red Room created.
Found Soul: If Found Soul is positioned against a different wall, activating the Red Key will open two red rooms at once: One near Isaac, and one near Found Soul.

interactions.text: 4.5 Volt: Usually generates fewer than 1 charge per room, as Red Rooms are always 1x1.
Car Battery: No effect.
Member Card: The trap door will always lead to the same special room as the regular Shop.
Pay to Win: No effect on Red Treasure Rooms.

name: Psy Fly
description: Spawns a fly orbital familiar that seeks out incoming enemy shots and destroys them.
effects: Spawns a fly orbital familiar that chases and blocks enemy shots.
After a certain amount of shots are blocked, it enters a short cooldown period where it still blocks shots, but does not actively chase them.
Psy Fly also deals 1 contact damage to enemies per tick (15 per second).
Instantly kills some Fly enemies upon contact.
Flies affected include: Army Fly, Attack Fly, Fly, Ring Fly, Swarm, and Willo.
needsReview: Psy Fly also deals 1 contact damage to enemies per tick (15 per second).

name: Wavy Cap
quote: Tears up. A mind changing experience!
description: Increases tears, decreases speed, and distorts the screen. All effects become more pronounced with repeated use, and wear off by clearing rooms.
effects: Upon use, grants +0.75 fire rate, -0.03 speed, and distorts the screen and background music. The effects can be stacked in the same room, and the distortion becomes more pronounced with repeated use. After repeated uses, the colors begin to turn very bright and intense.

Each use increases the recharge time, which starts at 0.5 seconds with the 1st use, and ends with 15 seconds on the 9th use. After the 10th use, it no longer recharges automatically though it can be recharged and used even more through Lil' Battery.
Leaving the room doubles the speed penalty and multiplies the fire rate bonus by x0.4, for the uses in that room.
Clearing a room removes one use's worth of penalties and bonuses, giving +0.06 speed and -0.3 fire rate.
Isaac's costume will change the stronger the Item's effects get.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: The distortion effect will wear off eventually, but the highest reached fire rate bonus won't. However, Wavy Cap will no longer have any positive effects until an even higher bonus is reached.

interactions.text: Tainted Lazarus / Esau Jr.: The distortion effect will not be removed when flipping between characters.

conditionalEffects: Upon use, grants +0.75 fire rate, -0.03 speed, and distorts the screen and background music. The effects can be stacked in the same room, and the distortion becomes more pronounced with repeated use. After repeated uses, the colors begin to turn very bright and intense.
Clearing a room removes one use's worth of penalties and bonuses, giving +0.06 speed and -0.3 fire rate.
needsReview: Leaving the room doubles the speed penalty and multiplies the fire rate bonus by x0.4, for the uses in that room.

name: Rocket in a Jar
description: +5 Bombs. If Isaac is currently firing, placing a bomb will instead shoot a fast-moving, explosive rocket in the direction he's facing.
effects: Adds 5 Bombs.
If any firing input is given when placing a bomb, a fast-moving, explosive rocket will be shot in the direction corresponding to the input.
The rockets accept analog firing input. This means they can be shot diagonally or in any other angle with a mouse or joystick.
Isaac will place a regular bomb if no firing input is received.

synergies.text: Bob's Bladder: Rockets leave creep, albeit slowly.
Bobby-Bomb: Rockets become homing.
Dr. Fetus: Shoots rockets as normal tears. All synergies that would normally apply are given to the rockets.
Giga Bombs: Fires a giant rocket that moves slower and has the same effects as a normal Giga Bomb.
Ring Cap: Fires two rockets simultaneously.

interactions.text: Best Friend/Bob's Rotten Head/Epic Fetus/Mr. Boom: No effect.
Blasting Cap: Rockets can drop bomb pickups.
Marked: Rockets will fly to the location of the crosshair.
Sticky Bombs: Rockets will not stick onto enemies.
Remote Detonator: Rockets do not explode on impact with surfaces, requiring manual detonation.
Remote Detonator + Dr. Fetus: Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will still explode on impact, but can be manually detonated.
Worm trinkets: Rocket's trajectory is unaffected.
Wiggle Worm + Dr. Fetus: Rocket will wiggle from side to side mid-flight. This is the only worm trinket that affects Rocket in a Jar.
My Reflection: No effect.
My Reflection + Dr. Fetus: Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will turn back at Isaac, but will not explode in contact with the player. However, it will explode after a duration, possibly damaging Isaac.

name: Book of Virtues
description: Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp familiars on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.
effects: Upon use, spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac and fires small spectral tears alongside him. The wisps can block shots and deal contact damage to enemies, but take damage when doing so and will be destroyed when enough damage is taken.
When a wisp is destroyed, the sound of fire being extinguished plays.
A normal wisp is white and blue, has 2 health and spectral tears which deal 3 damage, and is summoned in the middle ring.
A wisp's health can be represented by its size, shrinking as its health decreases.
Most wisps deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage. Doing damage this way usually destroys the wisp unless Isaac is invulnerable.
Multiple wisps can exist at once. Some combinations have an upper limit of 26 wisps: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.
If another active item is picked up, Book of Virtues will become a passive item that causes active items to spawn wisps when used, often with special effects.
While held, changes the first Devil Room encountered to be an Angel Room, and increases the chance of an Angel Room appearing by 25%.
Allows for Angel Rooms to appear even if a Deal with the Devil was taken before.

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: Wisps gain homing tears.
BFFS!: Increases the tear size and doubles the damage of wisps.

'M: If an active item is combined with the Book, only the active item is rerolled; the Book remains unchanged. If no active item is combined with the Book, the Book will be rerolled on use. 'M also cannot give Book of Virtues from rerolling other items, as it is considered a passive item.
Car Battery: Doubles the spawned wisps on activation.

Glowing Hourglass: Its wisps are kept between uses, allowing for wisp farming on the current floor by picking up Glowing Hourglass and using it to go back to the previous room before Glowing Hourglass was picked up.
Tear Detonator: The wisps' tears are also detonated; the resulting tears are based on Isaac's own, rather than the wisps'.

interactions.text: Analog Stick: Wisps are unable to shoot diagonally, and will shoot orthogonally instead.
Lodestone: The wisps' tears are attracted to the magnetic enemy, making it much easier to connect all of the wisps' tears on an enemy.
NO!: Will not prevent Book of Virtues from spawning, as it's considered a passive item.
Void: Book of Virtues is considered to be a passive item, so stat boosts will be gained by using Void on it and further uses of Void will not have the Book's effects.
XVII - The Stars?: Book of Virtues will be removed if it's the oldest collected item, even if another active item is not being held.

needsReview: A normal wisp is white and blue, has 2 health and spectral tears which deal 3 damage, and is summoned in the middle ring.
Most wisps deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage. Doing damage this way usually destroys the wisp unless Isaac is invulnerable.

name: Alabaster Box
description: Upon use, spawns three Soul Hearts and two Angel Room items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.
effects: This item starts with no charges. Rather than gaining charges by clearing rooms or picking up batteries, Alabaster Box has to be charged through Soul Heart or Black Heart. Instead of being added to Isaac's health bar, they charge the box at a rate of one charge per half heart.
Both Soul or Black Hearts that are picked up, or directly added to Isaac's health will count towards Alabaster Box's charges.
Upon use, Alabaster Box is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory, spawning three Soul Hearts and two items from the Angel Room item pool.
There's a small chance for each of the spawned Soul Hearts to be replaced with an Eternal Heart.
If a Devil Deal was taken previously, it spawns only two Soul Hearts and one Angel Room item instead.

synergies.text: ? Card: Activates Alabaster Box without consuming it, allowing for multiple uses.
Bethany / Tainted Bethany: Soul/blood charges count as charges for Alabaster Box.
Found Soul: Found Soul will also activate Alabaster Box when Isaac does, doubling the rewards.

Guppy's Paw + Schoolbag: Heart containers converted to Soul Hearts contribute to Alabaster Box's charge instead of being added to Isaac's health. This enables a full charge for just two heart containers.
Metronome: When Metronome chooses Alabaster Box, it will immediately activate without requiring Soul Hearts.
Void: Can activate Alabaster Box without consuming Soul Hearts. The effect is only used by Void once.
Wild Card: Allows for multiple uses of Alabaster Box so long as no other activated item, card, pill or rune has been used following the initial activation.

interactions.text: 4.5 Volt / 9 Volt / 48 Hour Energy / The Battery / Battery Pack / Car Battery / Charged Penny / Hairpin / Habit / Jumper Cables : No effect.

Abaddon: Red Hearts will be converted to Black Hearts, which will be used to charge the box. If Isaac would die as a result of picking up Abaddon (he only has Red health), he is given a Half Soul Heart.
Battery Bum: No effect, even though there's a cue that the item was charged.
Converter: Cannot use charges stored in Alabaster Box.
Devil's Crown / Satanic Bible: The extra Devil items will count as taking a deal, lowering Alabaster Box's payout.

Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Though Keeper cannot encounter Soul Hearts normally, it is possible to charge the Alabaster Box by having something that adds them directly to health, such as Schoolbag with Book of Revelations or Dream Catcher, purchasing soul hearts spawned by Keeper's Box, or playing in Co-op alongside someone not playing as Keeper.
Tainted Magdalene: Not recommended. If Tainted Magdalene has any soul hearts as health, then soul hearts will leak from the box, taking priority over soul health.
The Lost / Tainted Lost: Alabaster Box does not gain charges from Black Hearts. Soul Hearts still function as expected.
Magic Skin / Sumptorium: Will use Soul Hearts from the box before removing the ones in health.
Mother's Kiss: Taking this trinket as a character that can't use red hearts grants a Soul/Black Heart instead of giving it to Alabaster Box.
Schoolbag: Picked up Soul Hearts are consumed by Alabaster Box, even if it's in the second slot.
Sharp Plug: Takes up to 6 full hearts if possible without giving charge, even when having Soul Hearts.
XI - Strength and III - The Empress? cards apply a temporary charge on characters that can only use Soul/Black Hearts such as ??? or Tainted Judas.

name: The Stairway
quote: May you get what you came for
description: Generates a ladder at the start of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop.
effects: At the start of every floor, generates a ladder which leads to a special Angel Room Shop, regardless of whether a devil deal has been taken. These angel shops always contain the following
Three items/pickups for sale. These items/pickups can be on sale, just like with normal Shops.
An item from the Angel Room Item Pool for 15 or 30 pennies.
An Eternal Heart for 5 pennies.
A Soul Heart for 5 pennies.
A Key for 5 pennies.
A Holy Card for 5 pennies.
An Angel statue. The Angel can be fought for a Key Piece like normal.
A normal or next to the entrance.
A , if it has been unlocked.
The ladder to the angel room disappears if Isaac leaves the starting room, regardless of whether Isaac has climbed it or not.

interactions.text: Adoption Papers: Does not affect the Angel shop.
Coupon / Credit Card / Mr. ME!: Can be used to obtain items for free.

Death Certificate: An additional ladder will spawn in one room of the Death Certificate area. This ladder leads to the same Angel Shop as the one in the starting room of the floor. Purchasing an item will remove Isaac from the Death Certificate area as though he had collected an item normally. Sometimes, the ladder will spawn directly on top of an item pedestal, making the Angel Shop impossible to enter without collecting that item and subsequently being removed from the area.
Keeper's Sack: Buying items grants stats, same as with other shops.
A Pound of Flesh: Makes Angel Shops cost health just like regular Shops.
Restock / Store Credit: No effect in the Angel shop.
Steam Sale: Reduces the prices of the items on offer.
Glowing Hourglass: When used in the Angel shop, uses all three charges and removes the ladder.

name: Sol
description: Reveals the location of the Boss Room. Upon defeating a boss, activates XIX - The Sun, fully recharges Isaac's active item, grants bonus damage and luck for the rest of the floor, and removes curses.
effects: Shows the location of the Boss Room on the minimap.
After killing the boss in the Boss room shown on the map, has the following effects
Activates the effect of XIX - The Sun.
Gives Isaac +3 damage and +1 luck for the rest of the floor.
Fully recharges Isaac's active item.
Removes any Curses from the current floor except the Curse of the Labyrinth.

interactions.text: The Battery: Provides an extra level of charge if the item was fully charged when the boss was defeated.
IV - The Emperor?: Clearing the extra boss room does not trigger the effect.
Mega Blast: Only grants 3 charges.

Tainted Lazarus: The item recharge, full heal, map reveal, and curse removal only occur if the character with Sol defeats the boss. If the boss is defeated by the character without Sol, the character with Sol still gets the damage and luck bonus for the rest of the floor.

conditionalEffects: Gives Isaac +3 damage and +1 luck for the rest of the floor.

name: Luna
quote: The moon's blessing shines upon you
description: Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor. Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that increases Fire Rate for the current floor and gives a Half Soul Heart.
effects: Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor.
Reveals one random Secret Room on the map on pickup and at the start of each floor.
Each newly discovered Secret Room has a shining beam of light that will raise tears for the current floor and gives Isaac a Half Soul Heart when walked under.
The first light gives Isaac +1 tears fired per second, and all subsequent ones give +0.5 tears fired per second.
This gives a potential +2.5 tears per second for a given floor, on top of 2 soul hearts.
The tears up breaks the default 5 tears per second cap.
Once the effect is triggered for the floor, a silver-bluish shine will appear around Isaac. This light will be strengthened for every beam of light "gathered".
While this effect is mostly cosmetic, it also partially counteracts both the and the "dark rooms" in the Mines/Ashpit.

synergies.text: X-Ray Vision: Opens every Secret Room generated for free, allowing for the maximum tear bonus every floor.
Fragmented Card: The effects stack, spawning three Secret Rooms on the floor. All three Secret Rooms will contain beams of light.

Glowing Hourglass: If Glowing Hourglass is used while Isaac touches the beam of light but before the animation where he raises Luna above his head is complete, the bonuses will be granted after time is rewound, allowing the same beam of light to be used multiple times.

XVIII - The Moon: The Moon will always teleport to an unexplored secret room. If one has already been explored, it will teleport to the other one. If both have been explored, it will teleport randomly in one of the two.

conditionalEffects: Each newly discovered Secret Room has a shining beam of light that will raise tears for the current floor and gives Isaac a Half Soul Heart when walked under.
The first light gives Isaac +1 tears fired per second, and all subsequent ones give +0.5 tears fired per second.
This gives a potential +2.5 tears per second for a given floor, on top of 2 soul hearts.
The tears up breaks the default 5 tears per second cap.
needsReview: The first light gives Isaac +1 tears fired per second, and all subsequent ones give +0.5 tears fired per second.
This gives a potential +2.5 tears per second for a given floor, on top of 2 soul hearts.
The tears up breaks the default 5 tears per second cap.

name: Mercurius
description: +0.4 speed. Doors stay open after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies.
effects: +0.4 speed.
Opens most doors after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies, allowing Isaac to leave at any time.

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt / Jumper Cables: Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.
Camo Undies: Allows the player to go through rooms at a quicker pace due to the invisibility.
Charm of the Vampire / Leech: Allows for unlimited healing.
Gimpy / Sharp Straw: Allows the possibility to generate unlimited Hearts.
Head of the Keeper: With enough patience, Coins can be gathered infinitely.
Tainted Keeper: Leaving and re-entering the room allows for unlimited coin farming; however, enemies in rooms Tainted Keeper has already visited will eventually stop dropping coins.

name: Venus
description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.
effects: Grants one Red Heart Container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
Charms enemies close to Isaac. The effect wears off quickly after enemies move away from Isaac.

interactions.text: 2Spooky: Overridden by Venus.

name: Terra
description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.
effects: +1 damage.
Isaac's tears become rocks that have extra knockback and have a chance to destroy obstacles (including walls to Secret Rooms, entrances to Mines/Ashpit and Bedrooms, and normal closed doors).
Rocks can be pushed onto holes to cover them as if they were bombed normally.
Rock tears randomly deal increased/decreased damage, ranging between x0.5 and x2 Isaac's damage per tear.

synergies.text: Broken Padlock: Locked doors can be opened by shooting at them.
Finger!: The finger will destroy rocks.
The Ludovico Technique: Controllable rock tear that will destroy rocks. The size of the tear changes per room.
Mom's Knife: The knife will sometimes destroy rocks. Rocks can be destroyed by walking into them.

interactions.text: Azazel/Brimstone/Technology/Technology 2/Tech.5/Tech X: Lasers will sometimes destroy rocks and gains increased knockback, but will not open doors or Secret Room entrances.
Lasers can now open doors.
Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Explosions retain the extra damage and knockback, but cannot destroy Key Blocks.
Spectral tears: Tears continue to destroy obstacles.
Spirit Sword: Sword swings and spin attacks cannot destroy rocks, only its projectiles.
Tainted Lilith: The damage from hitting enemies with the fetus is affected by Terra's damage randomization.

needsReview: Rock tears randomly deal increased/decreased damage, ranging between x0.5 and x2 Isaac's damage per tear.

name: Mars
description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again. Knocks away nearby enemies and briefly grants i-frames after dashing.
effects: Double tapping a direction makes Isaac quickly dash in that direction.
Isaac is immune to damage from all sources during the dash, with the exception of Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and similar self-damage active items.
At the end of the dash, Isaac gains i-frames that protect him against Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars damage. They will also not activate if touched during those i-frames.
The dash deals damage equal to 4x Isaac's damage + 8.
The direction of the dash can be angled by holding another button.
The dash has an approximate 3 second cooldown.
If Isaac collides with a wall or obstacle, he releases 8 columns of fire that deal 10 damage and can burn enemies.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Can be used to deal damage without breaking the confusion effect.
Kamikaze!: Kamikaze can be used without taking damage while dashing.
A Pony / White Pony: Lowers the dash cooldown to approximately 1.5 seconds.

Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten will charge on double-tap if Tainted Soul is not holding him. This can be used to let Tainted Forgotten attack enemies from a resting position, or move him away from damaging hazards so Tainted Soul can pick him up.

needsReview: The dash deals damage equal to 4x Isaac's damage + 8.

name: Jupiter
description: +2 red Heart containers, -0.3 speed. Isaac builds speed while standing still, and releases poison gas clouds when he moves afterwards.
effects: Grants two full Red Heart containers.
-0.3 Speed.
Standing still causes Isaac to build up speed at a rate of +0.25 per second, up to a +0.5 speed bonus.

Isaac charges up while standing still. Moving releases a fart cloud behind Isaac, damaging and inflicting Poison on enemies that pass through it and draining the speed buff at a rate of -0.25 speed per second. The fart clouds are left behind for the duration of the speed buff.
The fart clouds deal 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (1.5x Isaac's damage per second), and last ~2.5 seconds.
Isaac is immune to Poison from enemies, such as Gasbag or Mushrooms.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Damaging enemies with the fart clouds will not take away Isaac's camouflage.
Dark Arts: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.
Gigante Bean: Greatly increases size of fart clouds.
Tainted Forgotten: Gives a flat +0.20 speed boost and +2 soul hearts with no other effects.

conditionalEffects: Isaac charges up while standing still. Moving releases a fart cloud behind Isaac, damaging and inflicting Poison on enemies that pass through it and draining the speed buff at a rate of -0.25 speed per second. The fart clouds are left behind for the duration of the speed buff.
needsReview: Standing still causes Isaac to build up speed at a rate of +0.25 per second, up to a +0.5 speed bonus.
The fart clouds deal 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (1.5x Isaac's damage per second), and last ~2.5 seconds.

name: Saturnus
description: Upon entering a room, a circle of 7 tears orbits Isaac, which last for 13 seconds before falling to the ground. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.
effects: A circle surrounds Isaac. When entering a room, the circle is filled with 7 orbiting tears that copy Isaac's tear properties.
The tears will deal 1.5x Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.
After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.
Orbiting tears are spectral, although they don't visually appear to be.
The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.
Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in the orbit, making them able to damage enemies.

Captured tears deal damage based on their size rather than how much they would've hurt Isaac: basic enemy shots deal 3.5 damage, and most champion shots deal 4.9 damage, but there is further variance.
Enemy tears caught disappear after a short time or upon leaving the current room.

synergies.text: A Lump of Coal: The tears grow in size and damage as they orbit around Isaac.
Angelic Prism: The prism and tears share the same orbit, making them easy to split.
Blood Clot/Chemical Peel/Stye: Orbiting tears will be the same as the last fired tear before leaving the previous room.
Having an item that randomly applies the bonus (Mom's Knife, Brimstone, Stapler, etc), will give each tear a 50% chance to have the bonus.
Cricket's Body: The orbiting tears will split as normal, but the tears produced by the split will orbit Isaac instead of spreading out.
Godhead: The orbiting tears have Godhead's damaging aura without the homing effect.
Homing tears: Tears will break orbit to home into nearby enemies. With piercing, tears will return to the orbit after dealing damage.
Kidney Stone: It's possible for one of the tears surrounding Isaac to be the stone.
Multidimensional Baby: Because both the orbiting tears and multidimensional baby start on top of Isaac when entering a room, all of the tears are immediately doubled.
The Parasite + piercing tears: The tears continuously create two smaller tears as they hit enemies, all of which in turn orbit and pierce enemies as well, resulting in far higher damage.

interactions.text: Brimstone / C Section / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
Crown Of Light: Functions as intended, but the tears surrounding Isaac will appear normal.
Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection/Mucormycosis: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
Friend Finder: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.
Hook Worm: No effect upon ring's tear.

Ipecac: Tears surrounding Isaac will not cause self damage if at maximum distance until high tear size. If Isaac enters a room and his Saturnus tears have not spread out, they could hit an entity and cause self damage.

Lachryphagy: Orbiting tears are Lachryphagy tears, including enemy tears caught in orbit. Tears will still burst after a set duration, greatly the reducing the amount of time the tears orbit for. Burst tears will remain in an orbital path instead of spreading out.

Proptosis: Causes the tears to immediately fall, making Saturnus almost irrelevant. Enemy tears caught in the orbit will not fade away, and its defensive benefits helps slightly to maintain the aggressive playstyle required by Proptosis.
Ring Worm / Ouroboros Worm: The trinkets cause the ring tears to move with a very anarchistic movement in and out of the circle.
Sulfuric Acid / Terra: As the orbiting tears can destroy rocks, Isaac can unintentionally detonate Bomb Rocks, causing self damage.
Tractor Beam: No effect on surrounding tears.

needsReview: The tears will deal 1.5x Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.
After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.
The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.

name: Uranus
description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.
effects: Isaac's tears become icicles that freeze enemies upon death, turning them into ice statues.
Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be frozen.
Frozen enemies can be kicked, sliding and leaving damaging creep across the room and shattering when they hit a wall, obstacle or an enemy, releasing 10 icicle tears in a circle.
These icicles can either slow enemies for 4 seconds or turn them into ice statues as well if they deal the lethal hit.
Killing an enemy by freezing them will prevent any on-death effects from occurring (i.e. splitting into other enemies, firing any post-death tears, exploding, etc.), even after shattering.
Isaac's tears have a chance to petrify enemies.

synergies.text: Athame / Maw Of The Void / Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The beam will freeze enemies upon death.
Bob's Rotten Head: Enemies are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.
Brimstone / Jacob's Ladder / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2 / Tech X: The normally firing laser gets an icy white color and freezes enemies upon death.
Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs will freeze enemies upon death.
Gello/Tainted Lilith: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide similarly to when kicked by Isaac.
Suplex!: Provides another method of shattering the ice statues.
Trisagion: Can help break statues faster due to tears hitting multiple times.

interactions.text: 4.5 Volt: Damage dealt during the killing blow doesn't provide charge.
120 Volt/Technology Zero: No effect on lasers.
Freezing enemies properly extends effect duration.
Contagion: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.
D10: Even though frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, rerolling them into a different enemy will bring them back to life.
Friendly Ball: Cannot be used to capture frozen enemies.
Shoop da Whoop!: The beam is unable to freeze enemies.

name: Neptunus
description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.
effects: While Isaac is not firing tears, a charge bar will start to fill up. Holding down the fire button will release the stored tears rapidly. The fire rate is greater and the bar drains faster when more full.
The charge time and maximum tears per charge scale with Isaac's tears stat, with higher tears charging faster and having more of them.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: The passive charge of Neptunus does not disrupt Camo, and the initial burst of damage is enhanced by Neptunus.
Chocolate Milk: Neptunus' passive charge overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.
Once Neptunus' charge is used up, Isaac will fire uncharged Chocolate Milk tears, resulting in a much lower damage output than without Chocolate Milk.
Chocolate Milk + Kidney Stone: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.
Kidney Stone: Tear bursts stack, firing a very large number of tears in combination with each other.

interactions.text: Azazel/Brimstone
C Section
Dr. Fetus
Epic Fetus
The Ludovico Technique
Mom's Knife
Monstro's Lung
Spirit Sword
Technology
Tech X
However, Haemolacria + Tech X does work with Neptunus.
Cursed Eye: Overridden by Neptunus.
Soy Milk: The charge bar is not present and charged tears are released instantly.
Chocolate Milk + Marked: Not recommended. Isaac will not be able to fire any tears, effectively softlocking the run.

name: Pluto
description: +0.7 tears. Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.
effects: +0.7 tears
Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.

interactions.text: Cricket's Body: Split tears' range is dropped drastically. Range ups do not mitigate the effect.
Dr. Fetus: Drops the bombs' range drastically despite no change in the range stat, greatly increasing chance of self-damage. Range ups do not mitigate the effect.

name: Voodoo Head
description: Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor. Curse Rooms have improved layouts.
effects: Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor, if possible.
Doesn't work on the Ascent.
Curse rooms have improved layouts and rewards while Voodoo Head is held.
A coin is guaranteed to spawn in Curse Rooms.

synergies.text: Cursed Penny: The coin can be used to teleport out of the curse room and avoid the damage from exiting through the curse room’s door.

name: Eye Drops
description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.
effects: Increases the fire rate of tears fired from Isaac's left eye by 40%.
The difference in fire rates causes Isaac's tears to be fired at a staggered rate.
The first shot in a while is always a double shot.

synergies.text: Blood Clot/Chemical Peel/The Peeper: The bonuses these items give go to Isaac's left eye, making them more beneficial.

interactions.text: Bag of Crafting/Crooked Penny/Diplopia: Multiple copies of Eye Drops do not stack.

name: Act of Contrition
description: +0.7 tears, grants an Eternal Heart. Allows Angel Rooms to appear even if a Devil Deal has been taken before. Reduces the Devil/Angel room chance penalty for taking Red heart damage.
effects: +0.7 tears up.
Grants an Eternal Heart.
Allows Angel Rooms to spawn even after Isaac has taken a Deal with the Devil.
Mitigates the penalties to the chance for a deal to appear from taking red heart damage.
Damage during the stage replaces the 99% no-damage bonus with 40% instead of removing it.
Damage against the boss replaces the 35% no-damage bonus with 15% instead of removing it.
In practice, this results in a -24% chance instead of -64% for taking damage during the stage, and -44% instead of -99% for taking damage against the boss.
needsReview: Damage against the boss replaces the 35% no-damage bonus with 15% instead of removing it.

name: Member Card
description: Adds a trapdoor to every Shop that leads to a second shop with a unique stock and marked-up prices.
effects: Spawns a trapdoor in each Shop that leads to an additional underground shop that can sell 2-5 of the following
A Trinket for 15 cents.

An Item for 15-30 cents. Items will be from the Secret Room, Shop, Devil/Angel Room, or Boss Room items; there can be multiple items from different item pools, but items will stay to their chosen item pool if rerolled.
Devil/Angel room items can cost up to 50 cents, and Secret Room items can cost up to 99 cents.
A Card/Rune/Soul Stone for 6-8 cents.
A Black Heart/Bone Heart for 8 cents.
An Eternal Heart for 15 cents.
A Rotten Heart for 5 cents.

interactions.text: Eden's Soul/Magic Skin/Mystery Gift: Only shop pool items are created if used in the underground shop.
Restock: Items bought in the underground shop will also be restocked.

name: Battery Pack
description: Recharges Isaac's currently held active item and drops 2-4 batteries.
effects: Fully charges the current activated item.
Spawns 2-4 random battery pickups.

interactions.text: Alabaster Box / Eraser / Notched Axe: No effect.
Mega Blast: Will only give 3 ticks of charge.

name: Mom's Bracelet
description: Lets Isaac pick up and throw rocks, TNT, Poops, friendly Dips, Bombs, and other obstacles.
effects: Upon use, picks up the obstacle in front of Isaac. The obstacle can be thrown at enemies, dealing 40 damage and breaking on impact, dropping any contents they may contain.
Obstacles can be carried between rooms.
Using it on a Host / Mobile Host will lift the shell off and transform it into a Red Host / Flesh Mobile Host. Isaac can throw the shell after picking it up.
The affected hosts will still fire 3 shots instead of 5.
Isaac can throw bombs using this, either his bombs or Troll Bombs.
Golden Troll Bombs grant Isaac unlimited bombs for the floor as they can be carried through rooms this way.
Tainted Forgotten can be picked up by any other player using it.

synergies.text: Best Friend: The explosive decoy can be picked up and thrown.

Cube Baby: Can be picked up and thrown by using the bracelet while trying to kick the Cube Baby. When thrown, Cube Baby deals around the amount of damage as a higher speed kick, but it will also leave the creep that a frozen enemy would create when kicked.
Dirty Mind / Dingle Berry: Friendly Dips can be picked up and thrown at enemies.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Multidimensional Baby: Rocks thrown through the baby will turn into tears, thus removing the possibility to get any rewards from rocks that spawn them.
Stompy transformation: Isaac will raise his hands, but be unable to pick up any rocks, effectively rendering the bracelet useless. Can still be used on Hosts.

name: The Scooper
description: Summons The Peeper for the current room, which leaves a trail of red creep.
effects: Summons The Peeper for the current room, which also leaves a trail of red creep.
The Peeper deals 12 contact damage per tick (36 per second) and the creep it trails deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second).
The Peeper can block enemy shots.
All tears shot from the right eye will deal 35% more damage, same as with The Peeper affecting the left eye.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Will summon 2 peepers in a bifurcated direction.

needsReview: The Peeper deals 12 contact damage per tick (36 per second) and the creep it trails deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second).

name: Ocular Rift
description: Adds a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which suck enemies, pickups, and shots towards them and damage enemies in the area.
effects: Gives Isaac a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which damage nearby enemies and pull in enemies, pickups, and tears/shots from all sources for 2 seconds.
Rifts deal half of the tear's damage twice each tick (3x its damage per second), and enemy shots pulled into the rift will damage other enemies.
The size of the rift increases with Isaac's damage.

synergies.text: Brimstone: Rifts may appear where a brimstone beam hits rock, walls or enemies.
The Parasite / Compound Fracture: Causes many smaller rifts to also spawn.
The Ludovico Technique: Each tick of damage has chance of creating rift, which will be slightly bigger in size.
Tech X: Rifts may appear where a laser ring hits rock, walls or enemies.
Technology / Technology 2: Rifts may appear where a laser hits rock, walls or enemies.
Trisagion: May spawn a line of rifts where the laser travels.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: Overridden by Epic Fetus.
Mom's Knife: Overridden by Mom's Knife.

needsReview: Rifts deal half of the tear's damage twice each tick (3x its damage per second), and enemy shots pulled into the rift will damage other enemies.

name: Boiled Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions at random intervals while in a room with enemies, shooting faster the closer it is to an enemy, similarly to Boils.
Each tear fired by Boiled Baby does either 3.5 or 5.3 damage, with no in-between.
needsReview: Each tear fired by Boiled Baby does either 3.5 or 5.3 damage, with no in-between.

name: Freezer Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires icicles have a chance to petrify enemies and freeze monsters they kill.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires icicles once every 0.75 seconds that each do 3.5 damage and have a chance to petrify enemies they hit and freeze enemies they kill.
Frozen enemies will block enemy shots, and will slide away when walked into by Isaac.
After colliding with an obstacle or getting sufficiently shot by Isaac, frozen enemies will explode into a ring of 10 ice tears that can slow and freeze.

synergies.text: Mongo Baby: Will copy Freezer Baby’s tears.

needsReview: After colliding with an obstacle or getting sufficiently shot by Isaac, frozen enemies will explode into a ring of 10 ice tears that can slow and freeze.

name: Eternal D6
description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.
effects: Upon use, replaces every pedestal item in the current room with other random items corresponding to the current room's item pool.
Each pedestal item rerolled has a 25% chance to disappear.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Re-rolls twice like The D6, but the 25% chance of the item disappearing is increased to approx 44%.
Crooked Penny: If a reroll would make an item disappear, all items on pedestals spawned by Crooked Penny will disappear.

name: Bird Cage
description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to Dead Bird.
effects: Gives Isaac a fat bird familiar that sits on Isaac's head until he takes damage.

Upon taking damage, it will jump off of Isaac's head and land on the nearest enemy, dealing damage and creating a rock line in a random direction. For the rest of the room, it acts like Dead Bird, flying around, albeit slower, and dealing contact damage to enemies.

Bird Cage does 45 damage to enemies it lands on and 10 damage per rock wave that hits enemies, then does 3 contact damage per tick while chasing enemies (~6.43 damage per second). The rock waves can destroy obstacles.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Spawns 4 rock waves in an X pattern and doubles contact damage. Damage of the jump and the rock waves is unaffected.
Sacrificial Altar: Can be used after the familiar has jumped.
Spin to Win: Boosts the familiar's damage while spinning, although has no effect on its speed.

interactions.text: Bird Cage: Multiple copies of the item provide no benefit and won't make more than one familiar appear.
Box of Friends: Immediately makes the familiar jump, leaving a ghost copy on Isaac's head until he takes damage. This has no benefit to the damage dealt and will not spawn more than one familiar.
The Twins: If Bird Cage was active in a previous room and it was chosen by the trinket, it skips the jump and enters its flying phase. Behavior otherwise identical to that with Box of Friends.

name: Larynx
description: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The shout gets stronger the more charges the item has. Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, in addition to charging normally.
effects: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The item can be used when not fully charged, and deals more damage and has increased range the more charges it has when used.
The initial shout deals 20 damage + 28 per charge and destroys enemy shots, obstacles, Shopkeepers, Beggars, and machines, and opens bombable doors in range.
A number of extra pulses are released equal to half the charges used (rounded up) that deal 2.5 damage + 3.5 per charge.
Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, as well as through normal means.

synergies.text: Habit: Both on-hit charge effects stack, charging 2 points per hit.

interactions.text: 9 Volt: The first bar gains an automatic timed recharge, but the further bars will not be affected.
The Battery: Larynx can hold up to two full charges. Only up to 12 charges will be used at a time.
Void: If Larynx is absorbed, its effect is only replicated at 1 charge.

conditionalEffects: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The item can be used when not fully charged, and deals more damage and has increased range the more charges it has when used.
needsReview: The initial shout deals 20 damage + 28 per charge and destroys enemy shots, obstacles, Shopkeepers, Beggars, and machines, and opens bombable doors in range.
A number of extra pulses are released equal to half the charges used (rounded up) that deal 2.5 damage + 3.5 per charge.

name: Lost Soul
description: Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, but respawns at the start of the next floor. Each time it survives until the next floor, it rewards Isaac with Soul Hearts, Eternal Hearts, or an Item.
effects: Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, respawning at the start of the next floor.
If Lost Soul survives until the start of the next floor, it rewards Isaac with one of the following
3 Soul Hearts.
2 Eternal Hearts.
A Treasure Room item or an Angel Room item.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Gives Lost Soul a once-per-room shield, similar to Holy Mantle.
If BFFS! is dropped, the shield will still remain active until taking one hit of damage, acting similarly to Holy Card.
Forget Me Now / R Key: Restarting a floor/run causes Lost Soul to give a reward if it's alive when used.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Cannot duplicate the ghost and won't spawn a Demon Baby, even when the ghost is dead.
Bursting Sack / Skatole: Does not provide immunity to contact damage from spiders/flies to Lost Soul.
Chaos: Items dropped by Lost Soul are drawn from a random pool.
Child Leash / Duct Tape / Friendship Necklace / King Baby / RC Remote / The Twins: No effect.
Diplopia / Crooked Penny: Picking up multiple Lost Souls has no effect, even if one died previously.
Missing No.: If a new floor is entered and Missing No. rerolls into this item, it will immediately give a reward.
Tainted Forgotten: The ghost follows Tainted Forgotten, making it very difficult to protect.

name: Blood Bombs
description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Restores 4 Red Hearts.
Causes Isaac's Bombs to leave a pool of red creep on the ground when they explode.
The creep deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second) and lasts 15 seconds.
Leaves one large creep in the middle, and four small creeps on random direction and distance.
Multiple creeps do not inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously.
If Isaac has no bombs, allows him to place a bomb at the cost of taking half a heart of damage. This prioritizes Red Hearts over Soul Hearts.

interactions.text: Creeps from following items do not inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously
Anemic
Aquarius (overrides the damage)
Bob's Bladder (overrides the damage)
Depression
Isaac's Heart
The Scooper
Shard of Glass
Lost Cork: Does not increase the radius of creeps.

needsReview: The creep deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second) and lasts 15 seconds.

name: Lil Dumpy
description: Spawns a Dumpy familiar that pushes away nearby enemies and projectiles just before Isaac is about to be hit, then falls asleep. He can be awoken by walking to him.
effects: Gives Isaac a Dumpy familiar, which follows behind him. When Isaac is about to take damage (as with Panic Button), Lil Dumpy farts, knocking back nearby enemies and shots while also propelling itself in a random direction. Enemies that collide with obstacles or walls take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage. Pushed shots that hit an enemy deal 6 damage normally and 7 damage if they would deal a full heart of damage to Isaac.
Lil Dumpy has a larger, hidden secondary radius that may randomly trigger its fart effect if an enemy projectile enters it.
After farting, Lil Dumpy goes on cooldown and "falls asleep" until Isaac walks up to it to wake it up. Lil Dumpy resets upon entering a new room.
Lil Dumpy deals contact damage, which depends on its speed. If it hits an enemy right after farting, it will deal 8.33 damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: The contact damage is boosted greatly. For instance, if the familiar hits an enemy right after farting, it will now deal 33.33 damage.
Gigante Bean: Applies to Lil Dumpy and causes the fart to become much bigger and also deal 10 damage.
The Twins: Can duplicate Lil Dumpy, practically adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's Holy Mantle-like protection.
Box of Friends: Will copy Lil Dumpy for extra protection, this process can be repeated many times to make Isaac near-invincible in Greed mode, Greedier mode, Boss Rush or with 4.5 Volt.
Ventricle Razor / Other methods of teleportation: Lil Dumpy will quickly fly to Isaac instead of teleporting, dealing damage to everything in its path.

name: Bird's Eye
description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.
effects: Gives Isaac a chance to shoot fires alongside his regular tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them, similar to those shot by Red Candle.
Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.
Fires deal 4x Isaac's damage at full durability, 3x Isaac's damage after taking damage once, and 2x Isaac's damage otherwise, for a max possible damage output of 11x Isaac's damage per fire.
Any fart-related effect that occurs will also generate a flame, like using The Poop or when generating a bomb with No. 2.

synergies.text: Butter Bean / Wait What? /The Black Bean / Mega Bean: Spawn a fire upon activation.

Chocolate Milk: As each flame's damage is unaffected by the charge of each tear, a flame-thrower-like effect with very high damage can be achieved with a decent luck stat and rapidly fired low-charge tears.
Contagion: Creates a fire behind Isaac for each enemy that produces a gas cloud on death.
Farting Baby: Farts have a chance to spawn a fire.
Ghost Pepper: Changes the activation rate to frac1 8 - left lfloor Luck right rfloor
At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck. Only one type of fire can be spawned at a time; however, each flame has an equal chance of being launched.
Monstro's Lung: When releasing the tear barrage, multiple fires are fired.
Mucormycosis: When a mucormyosis spore explodes, Isaac has a chance to spawn a fire
The Poop: Creates a fire behind Isaac.
Proptosis: Size and damage of fires is increased but does not decrease with range.
Pupula Duplex: The fires and their hitbox get a lot bigger.
Urn of Souls: Causes the Urn to emit Bird's Eye's red flames in addition to its regular flames.
Tear-copying Familiars like Incubus / Lil Clot / Evil Eye: Don't shoot fires, but make Isaac shoot fires more often.
Lil Dumpy: Every time Lil Dumpy farts, Isaac emits a flame too.

interactions.text: Brimstone: Will occasionally spawn a fire when firing and with high luck will spawn four fires.
The Ludovico Technique: Will occasionally shoot fire from Isaac toward the floating tear.
20/20/Mutant Spider/The Inner Eye: Only one fire spawns at a time.
1=Bird's Eye: No effect. Will not boost the chances of shooting out a fire like with Ghost Pepper.
Dr. Fetus / Tech X / Technology: fires spawn when firing.
Epic Fetus: Fires spawn when moving the crosshair and are launched in the direction of the crosshair similarly to Marked.
Homing Tears: Fires aren't homing.

IBS: Not Recommended. Farts caused by IBS release flames, which will automatically detonate the toxic cloud and hurt Isaac, unless he has explosion immunity. Similarly, stinky poops can explode while held by Isaac if he happens to be near flames when IBS activates
Ipecac: Fires spawn as normal, but can be hit by ipecac tears, making them especially dangerous.
A Lump of Coal: No effect on fires.
Mom's Knife: Fires spawn occasionally when fired.
Sprinkler: No effect. Sprinkler doesn't shoot fires.
Jupiter: No effect.

needsReview: Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.

name: Lodestone
description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, causing them to attract nearby pickups and enemies, as well as tears/shots from all sources.
effects: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, giving them properties similar to tears fired by Isaac when he has Strange Attractor
Enemies and pickups that are near magnetized enemies are pulled towards them. This includes live Bombs.
All tears/enemy shots (from Isaac, his familiars, and all enemies, including the magnetized one) will be strongly pulled towards magnetized enemies.
Enemy shots that get pulled in will now also damage enemies other than the ones that fired them.

synergies.text: Book of Virtues: The wisps' tears are attracted to the magnetic enemy, making it much easier to connect all of the wisps' tears on an enemy.

E. Coli: If an enemy is hit by a lodestone tear perfectly simultaneously with it being turned into poop, the resulting poop will be tinted black and have a lodestone aura that sucks in enemies. This poop will return to normal after a few seconds.
Pop!: Magnetizing an enemy causes all active eyeball tears to rush to the enemy.
Rotten Tomato: Enemies affected by Lodestone and Rotten Tomato will be quickly swarmed and killed by other enemies.

Tech X: Changes the color of rings to gray. They still apply the magnetized effect, but the effect being applied is random for each enemy damaged with the same ring. Has increased chance of magnetizing enemy.
Tech X + Dr. Fetus: Only the explosions from Dr. Fetus' bombs can magnetize enemies.

The Ludovico Technique: Isaac's tear has a chance to magnetize and stick to enemies or bosses, making it impossible to move the tear until the enemy dies or until the magnetization effect somehow doesn't get reapplied long enough for the effect to end.

interactions.text: Brimstone: Changes the beam to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The beams are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.
Technology: Changes the laser to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The lasers are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.

name: Rotten Tomato
description: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait are attacked by other enemies.
effects: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait will move slower and be attacked by other enemies until it is killed or the effect wears off.
Tears that apply the effect are red.

synergies.text: Brimstone: Firing can mark enemies as bait.
Dr. Fetus: Fired bombs can mark enemies as bait.
Jacob's Ladder: Chaining electricity arcs can mark enemies as bait.

name: Birthright
description: Grants a character-specific effect that enhances their special abilities.
effects: Grants a passive ability that varies from character to character. The effect typically enhances/magnifies the character's special traits or helps mitigate some of their downsides.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar + Tainted Eve: Clots won't drop half red hearts after getting sacrificed.

name: Red Stew
description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.
effects: On pickup, fully heals Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 damage up.

The damage upgrade scales down to 0 over the course of three minutes. Due to how the damage formula works, the damage upgrade scales down faster over time, starting at -~0.015 per half second and increasing to -~.1 per half second as the bonus approaches 0.

While Red Stew is active, Isaac gains an effect similar to Lusty Blood, gaining a small damage bonus every time he kills an enemy. This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: The damage up becomes permanent and if Isaac kills enemies fast enough it can increase even further. It would be difficult to gain further damages 3 minutes later, but the first damage up is so high that this isn't a real problem.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn’t grant the damage bonus.
E. Coli/Flush!: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t grant the damage bonus.
Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen don't grant the damage bonus.
Frozen enemies do grant the damage bonus.
Red Stew: Picking up another stew will reset the bonus to its full amount.
Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

conditionalEffects: On pickup, fully heals Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 damage up.

While Red Stew is active, Isaac gains an effect similar to Lusty Blood, gaining a small damage bonus every time he kills an enemy. This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.

name: Genesis
description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique Clean Bedroom with some pickups and Chests and a passage to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.
effects: On use, Isaac is teleported to a unique Clean Bedroom that acts like an I AM ERROR room. It has a Bed, two random Chests, two Grab Bags, and a random Trinket. The only way out is through the beam of light, which teleports Isaac to the next floor (with some exceptions, seen below).

Isaac loses all items and is reset to a state exactly like if he started a new run, though keeping quest items to not block progression. All stats, consumables, trinkets, and all items except for starting items and quest items, are removed. Isaac gains back all of his starting trinkets and consumables.
For every item removed using Genesis, there will be a set of three items from the removed item's pool to choose from, each set appearing one after the other at the bottom of the room.

interactions.text: ? Card: If ? Card is used in place of Genesis, Genesis will be counted as an extra item for the choice set.
Abyss: The locusts created by Abyss are removed without creating items to replace them making Genesis one of the few effects that can remove them.
Azazel / Tainted Azazel: Both have the ability to return to the floor Genesis was used on, due to them starting with a 0 - The Fool card.
Book of Revelations/Satanic Bible: Effects on the Boss Room and boss item still apply to the floor even after using Genesis.
Brittle Bones: Genesis removes the fire rate upgrades upon use.
Car Battery: No effect.
Crooked Penny: Using it on the choice pedestals has the 50/50 chance of duplicating them as normal, or make them disappear, in which case no new ones will spawn.
Damocles / Missing No.: Genesis removes these items as well, making it the only item or effect that can remove them besides Butter!.
