Death Certificate: After taking an item in the Death Certificate area, Isaac will return to the Genesis room and the current 3 item pedestals can all be taken, with the next set spawning on top of them.
Echo Chamber: The consumable pool is reset when Genesis is used, so if it's re-obtained after using Genesis, the previously stored consumable types won't be activated.
Eden's Blessing: Eden's Blessing will be consumed, and the next run Isaac starts will begin with a random item.
Esau Jr.: Using Genesis as Esau Jr. will revert back to the original character.
Lazarus' Rags / Ankh / Clicker: Using Genesis after Lazarus' Rags, Ankh or Clicker activates will continue as the new character.
Glowing Hourglass: Using it works as intended and will give back all previous stats, items, pickups, and health.
Magic Skin: Genesis does NOT remove the downside of Magic Skin; any of the choice pedestals can be replaced by Magic Skin.
Sacred Orb: Will affect future items while inside the Genesis Room.
Teleport! / Teleport 2.0 / Telepills / Teleport Cards: Should such items/consumables be obtained in the Genesis room, they can be used to circumvent the forced floor skip.
In the case of pills, unidentified pills should only be consumed after taking all of the items in case telepills is rolled, for the Genesis room cannot be returned to after leaving.

Void: All effects granted by absorbed items including stat ups and activated item abilities Void takes are removed without creating items to replace them. Since Void is stripped of any active item abilities it would have gained, any other Void found will also have no other active effects stored in it.
Void's active effects are reset even if Isaac is currently not holding it.
Wild Card: Can't activate Genesis.
Tainted Lost: Will lose his Holy Mantle shield on use but will gain a new Holy Card.

name: Sharp Key
description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.
effects: Gives five Keys.

On use, Isaac holds a key above his head. Pressing a fire button removes one key and throws it as a piercing projectile. The key damages enemies, as well as opens locked doors and Locked Chests it hits.
The key will also break the first rock it hits, as well as Key Blocks.
The thrown key does damage equal to 5x Isaac's damage + 30.
Enemies killed by Sharp Key have a chance to spawn the contents of a chest; the contents they can drop includes the rewards of any possible chest contents, including items.

synergies.text: Ace of Spades / Child's Heart / Lucky Toe / Match Stick / Rusted Key / Safety Cap: If an enemy drops pickups, it has a ⅓ chance to drop an extra pickup; the pickup will be the one the trinket is associated with (random in the case of Lucky Toe).

Angelic Prism: A thrown key will duplicate into 4 keys, which can be used to open multiple rooms or chests with only 1 key. If Isaac stands at the middle far left or middle far right of the first room in Chest, a thrown key can open all 4 chests.
Continuum: Thrown keys can unlock multiple doors it passes through.
Gilded Key: Enemies will only give the contents of locked chests. The pickups they can drop will also include runes and Lil' Battery.
The Left Hand: Enemies will only give the contents of red chests.
As locked/red chests are able to give Items whereas normal chests cannot, the previous two trinkets also allow items to be obtained through Sharp Key more consistently.
Mom's Key: Doubles the amount of pickups dropped by enemies.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Daemon's Tail: Enemies are much less likely to drop hearts; these hearts will still be Black Hearts.
Dead Eye: Keys thrown will contribute to Dead Eye's damage modifier.
Golden Keys: Ignored by Sharp Key; it will still require and consume keys to use.
Guppy's Eye: There will be no overlay on enemies that would drop pickups on death.
Haemolacria/The Parasite: Split tears from thrown keys are normal tears.
Kidney Stone / Number One / Pluto / Inner Child's revive: Sharp Key loses almost all of its range, and can only be improved with tear height ups.
The Ludovico Technique: No effect.
Multidimensional Baby: Keys passing through the baby turn into normal tears and loses all of its effects.
Pay To Play: The key cannot unlock doors that originally were accessible by keys, but can still open chests and open secret room doors.
Poker Chip: Enemies have a 50/50 chance to spawn extra pickups or an Attack Fly: The attack fly will be instantly killed by the thrown key.
Spectral Tears: Rocks that thrown keys pass over have a chance of being destroyed.
Trisagion: Thrown keys become Trisagion blasts and no longer cause enemies to drop chest contents on kill.

needsReview: The thrown key does damage equal to 5x Isaac's damage + 30.

name: Booster Pack
description: Drops 5 random cards.
effects: Drops 5 random cards.

interactions.text: Little Baggy: Spawns 5 random pills instead.

name: Mega Mush
description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.
effects: Upon use, gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, persisting between rooms and floors. While gigantic, Isaac gains the following effects
A 4x damage multiplier, +2 range, and -1.9 tears.
Cannot take damage for the duration of the effect.
Can destroy Objects, Obstacles, and Pitfalls when walking over them. This includes Metal Blocks and Key Blocks without using keys.
Can break through normal doors, Secret Rooms, and any doors that require Bombs such as Clean Bedrooms, by walking into them.

Cannot break through Challenge Rooms, Boss Rooms, Mini-Boss Rooms, Curse Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms, or any doors that require Keys such as Shops. Bedrooms also cannot be broken back into if they are closed but no longer boarded up.
Deals extremely heavy contact damage to enemies (80 per tick, or 2,400 per second).

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt: The contact damage dealt by Mega Mush will allow it to be recharged and used multiple times in the same room.
Car Battery: Mega Mush's active time will be doubled to 60 seconds.
Rock Bottom: Retains massive damage increase after Mega Mush's timer is up, though can make it nearly impossible to raise it afterwards without another use.
Serpent's Kiss: Enemies killed with contact damage will frequently drop hearts.

interactions.text: Book of Virtues: Spawns a basic wisp.
Keeper's Kin: Destroying rocks and blocks will allow Isaac to amass a lot of blue spiders.

conditionalEffects: A 4x damage multiplier, +2 range, and -1.9 tears.
needsReview: Deals extremely heavy contact damage to enemies (80 per tick, or 2,400 per second).

name: Knife Piece 1
description: Combined with Knife Piece 2, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.
effects: Spawns a knife handle familiar that follows Isaac.
Generates a room in Mines / Ashpit II for Knife Piece 2 to spawn in.
Combines with Knife Piece 2 to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
Launching it at the red door at the end of Mausoleum/Gehenna II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
needsReview: Combines with Knife Piece 2 to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.

name: Knife Piece 2
description: Combined with Knife Piece 1, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.
effects: Combines with Knife Piece 1 to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
Launching it at the red door at the end of Mausoleum/Gehenna II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
needsReview: Combines with Knife Piece 1 to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.

name: Death Certificate
description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
effects: Upon use, transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which has one copy of almost every item the player has unlocked on that save file on pedestals. After taking an item from a pedestal, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
There are also several pickups and Chest in the area. Picking them up/opening them will not cause Isaac to leave the area.
If a chest in the area contains an item, picking it up will not cause Isaac to leave the area.
Items spawned through the use of pre-obtained items brought into the area, such as Eden's Soul or Mystery Gift, will also not cause Isaac to leave the area.

synergies.text: ? Card: Mimics the effect of Death Certificate without consuming it.
Diplopia: Has no use inside of the Home area, as Isaac can only take 1 item. However, it can be used to duplicate the Death Certificate item, allowing Isaac to enter the area twice.

Jacob and Esau: Both characters can take an item from any given room if they're lined up correctly and take them at the same time. This can be very powerful in the case of Brimstone and Mom's Knife, as they are both close together.

Red Key: Using the Red Key in this area has a chance of spawning rooms with many items from the Treasure Room pool in them, all of which can be taken without being returned back to the floor. It can also spawn special rooms from Home. If Mom's bedroom is spawned and Isaac sleeps in the bed, it will behave like a normal bed, but can be slept in while at full health.
Schoolbag: Allows Isaac to hold another Active item in the area along with Death Certificate.

Tainted Cain: Unlike his modified pedestal behavior in the rest of the run, Tainted Cain can pick up an item like normal in this area, effectively allowing him to craft any specific item for the cost of 8 bone hearts (the guaranteed recipe for Death Certificate in the Bag of Crafting).
Wild Card: Will use Death Certificate if it was the item/card Isaac most recently used.
Metronome: Can invoke the effect of Death Certificate as normal, even if it is not unlocked.

interactions.text: Abyss / Black Rune / Void: Only allows the consumption of one item per room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
Binge Eater/Glitched Crown: No effect; items will not cycle through multiple items.
Car Battery: No effect.
Moving Box: Takes one random item which is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
Book of Virtues: Spawns a single, regular wisp with no special properties.
Damocles: No effect; Damocles doesn't duplicate the item pedestals in any room.
NO!: causes Death Certificate to no longer spawn. inside Death Certificate floor Ignores changes to item availability.
Sacred Orb / Tainted Lost: Ignores changes to item availability caused by characters, items.
IX - The Hermit?: When used with items present no coins are spawned and the floor exit sequence is triggered as if Isaac had taken an item.

name: Bot Fly
description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.
effects: Spawns a robotic Pooter familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.
The shielded tears home in on projectiles, but not enemies.
The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.
The shielded tears deal 3 damage if they hit an enemy.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Increases contact damage but does not increase the damage of the tears.

needsReview: The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.

name: Meat Cleaver
description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.
effects: Upon use, splits enemies in the current room into two smaller versions with ~40% health each.
Normal enemies can be split twice, while champions and bosses can be split three times. If an enemy cannot be split, they instead take 25 damage.
If the enemy splits as part of their mechanic, such as Squirt, Teratoma, or The Fallen, they will instead take the damage required to split them.
If the enemy has segments, such as Larry Jr. or Buttlickers, they will have their segments cut down to half, rounding down. There are several exceptions listed in the notes section.
If the enemy has a cable between them, such as Mr. Maw, it will immediately be cut. Mr. Maws specifically will be left with just their head.

synergies.text: Lusty Blood: Each split enemy killed grants a damage boost.
Sigil of Baphomet: Split enemies will allow the shield to activate and stack up more easily.

interactions.text: Blood Puppy: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.

name: Evil Charm
description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.
effects: Gives Isaac +2.0 luck.
Makes Isaac immune to
Confusion and fear status effects.
Burn effects.
And damage from Fire Places, enemy fires (i.e. Candler), and fire projectiles (i.e. Great Gideon).
Toxic clouds (i.e. Gasbags).
This includes poison effects such as those from destroying Mushrooms.
The Godhead aura from Dogma's projectiles.
Slowdown from cobwebs.
Isaac can stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

name: Dogma
description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the Holy Mantle effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating Dogma.
effects: Grants flight.
Grants a one-time Holy Mantle-like effect. This effect wears off upon leaving the room.
Prevents Isaac's speed from going under 1.1.
+2 damage.

If Isaac has fewer than six full hearts of health, Isaac is given enough hearts to get to six full hearts, first by restoring empty red heart containers, and then by granting soul hearts if that isn't enough.
Does not affect The Lost or Tainted Lost normally.
Keeper and Tainted Keeper's coin heart containers are affected by the red heart healing, but they will gain Blue Flies instead of soul hearts.
The Forgotten will have all his bone hearts replenished, and any soul hearts earned will go to The Soul.
Bethany will gain soul charges instead of soul hearts.

Tainted Lazarus will receive the flight and stat bonuses for both forms. Since defeating Dogma will swap between forms, the active character before the cutscene will not receive the healing and shield effect, which will instead be given to the form present after the cutscene.
Alabaster Box will take the soul hearts before they're given to Isaac, like normal.
On Normal mode, grants The Wafer effect, reducing all damage taken to half a heart.
needsReview: Prevents Isaac's speed from going under 1.1.

name: Purgatory
description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.
effects: Spawns a red crack in the ground somewhere in the room while Isaac is in a room with enemies. Walking over the crack summons a ghost that homes in on the nearest enemy, exploding when it hits it. After the ghost is summoned, cracks will keep showing up in the room until it is cleared.
The ghost spends one second spawning in before it attacks.
The ghost deals double Isaac's damage per tick, up to 4 times.

interactions.text: Dark Arts: Walking over cracks will not summon ghosts while under the effect of Dark Arts.
Spindown Dice: When used on Purgatory, turns the item into Dogma, a unique item usually only able to be obtained by killing the boss Dogma.

needsReview: The ghost deals double Isaac's damage per tick, up to 4 times.

name: Stitches
description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.
effects: While held, spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. Activating the item causes Isaac to swap places with Stitches. Isaac is briefly immune to damage after teleporting.
Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).
If Isaac teleports onto an enemy, they will take 40 + 3x Isaac's damage.
If Stitches teleports onto an enemy, it deals an additional hit for Isaac's damage.
Teleporting next to a Fire Place will put it out, including blue fires.
Teleporting on top of Shopkeepers will destroy them.
Teleporting on top of an angel statue in an Angel Room will not break it.

synergies.text: 9 Volt: Halves Stitches' charge time.

BFFS!: On teleport, fires 8 tears outwards at Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects and deal Isaac's damage. Stitches' teleport-on-enemy damage is increased to 3 + 2x Isaac's damage.
Serpent's Kiss / The Virus: Can poison enemies during the brief immunity granted after teleporting.
Midas' Touch: Enemies that survive being teleported onto will immediately turn into gold due to contact with Isaac. Thanks to the brief immunity, Isaac will not be harmed by this.
Panic Button: As long as Stitches is charged, Isaac will teleport right before getting hit, negating damage. This can effectively be used as a 3-second-recharge Holy Mantle.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc. It will deal telefrag damage in both places (where Stitches is and where Isaac was).

needsReview: Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).

name: R Key
description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.
effects: Returns Isaac to the beginning of the run in Chapter 1, with all stat boosts, items, pickups, and trinkets intact, similar to a Victory Lap. Unlike a Victory Lap, however, no effects are applied after a certain number of uses, and the timer is not reset.

synergies.text: ? Card: Activates R Key without consuming it, allowing for multiple run restarts.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Dad's Note: Using R Key during the Ascent sequence will end it.

name: Knockout Drops
description: Adds a chance to shoot a fist tear that has extremely high knockback and confuses enemies.
effects: Adds a chance to shoot red fist-shaped tears that deal extreme knockback and cause confusion for 2 seconds.
Enemies will take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage when they are knocked into a wall/obstacle or when hit by another knocked back enemy.

synergies.text: Aquarius: The trail of tears has a chance to knockback enemies.
Brimstone: Gives the lasers high knockback.
Jacob's Ladder: Enemies that are shocked by a knockback tear will also be knocked back.
The Ludovico Technique: Hovering tear alternates between a normal tear and a fist.
Technology: Laser receives knockback effect as with normal tears.

name: Eraser
description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.
effects: Upon use, Isaac holds an Eraser above his head, which can be thrown in any cardinal direction. Upon hitting a monster, the enemy will be "erased", preventing any of the same enemy from appearing for the rest of the run.
Deals 15 damage to bosses. If fatal, erases the boss for the rest of the run.
Can only be recharged by entering a new floor. Batteries and most other methods of recharging have no effect.

synergies.text: ? Card: Can throw an additional Eraser.
Angelic Prism: Throwing the Eraser through the Angelic Prism will cause it to split into four.
The Battery: The eraser can gain an extra charge if it is not used on one floor.
Bethany / Tainted Bethany: Soul and blood charges can be used with the Eraser, allowing multiple uses per floor.
Blood Puppy: Throwing the Eraser at an enraged Blood Puppy (second stage) will 'erase' its enraged form, keeping it permanently tame.
Throwing the Eraser at its third stage will make it cycle through its normal and second stage as it kills enemies.
Void: An eraser can be thrown with each use of Void after absorbing it, allowing multiple uses per floor.
Tainted Lazarus: Enemies erased in one form will still be erased when Tainted Lazarus flips.

interactions.text: 9 Volt / Battery Pack: Item doesn't fully charge the Eraser when picked up.
Car Battery: No effect.
Kidney Stone / Number One / Pluto / Inner Child's revive: Lowers the Eraser's range drastically and can only be improved with tear height ups.

My Shadow / Shade: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning, rendering the item useless as this item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.
Sharp Plug: Attempting to recharge the Eraser with the Sharp Plug hurts Isaac for half a heart without recharging the item.
Habit: Taking damage with Habit will not charge Eraser.

name: Yuck Heart
description: Grants Isaac a Rotten Heart.
effects: Grants a Rotten Heart upon use.
If Isaac has an empty red heart container or empty bone heart, the rotten heart will fill it.
If Isaac has only filled red and/or bone hearts, it will replace the contents.
If Isaac has no red or bone hearts, or they all are already rotten, there is no effect.

name: Urn of Souls
description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.
effects: Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.
Isaac is also pushed backwards slightly while using it.
The flames destroy enemy projectiles, Poop, and other fires, but bounce off rocks.

Killing enemies grants a soul charge to the Urn, up to a maximum of 20. Killing bosses grants a larger boost. Charges must be used to power Urn of Souls, with each charge being equivalent to 15 flames over the course of half a second.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Flames can be split into four multi-colored flames.
Bird's Eye / Ghost Pepper: The urn can emit flames from these items. Ghost Pepper flames are indistinguishable from Urn of Souls flames, but persist on the ground for longer.
Eye of Greed / Large Zit / Tech.5 / Technology 2: Tears from these items will still shoot as normal while using the urn.
/ The Mulligan: Fires have a chance to spawn Blue Flies.
Immaculate Heart: Each individual flame has a chance to cause Immaculate Heart to generate an orbiting tear.
Lead Pencil: Every 15 flames shot out of the urn will shoot a barrage of Isaac's tears.
Multidimensional Baby: All flames shot through Multidimensional Baby are doubled, providing a burst of flashing black-and-white tears.
Tear Detonator: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t grant soul charges.
Car Battery: No effect.
E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't grant soul charges.

Kidney Stone: Firing the urn counts as fire time but the urn must be put away for Isaac to charge and shoot the kidney shot. Switching to the urn while auto-firing from Kidney Stone forces the urn to fire as well.
Void: No effect when absorbed by Void.

conditionalEffects: Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.

name: Akeldama
description: While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.
effects: While in a room with enemies, creates a trail of tears that Isaac drags behind him.
Each tear deals 3.5 damage, regardless of Isaac's damage.
Tears are spawned at an irregular rate, roughly between once every 0.1 to 1 seconds.
The tears are spectral.
Once the room is cleared, the trail will remain but will stop regenerating.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Splits the trail of tears into four multi-colored chains.

Lachryphagy: Some Akeldama tears will absorb tears shot by Isaac and gain size and damage as expected, but will not burst from being overloaded and can be fed infinite amount of tears. Meaning that each tear, if fed enough, can deal massive amounts of damage.
Lodestone: Magnetized enemies will attract the tears from Akeldama's trail, making it easier to use.
Multidimensional Baby: Akeldama tears that passes through Multidimensional baby will be cloned and may also create a separate trail if enough tears are cloned.
Tear Detonator: Will burst tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.
Technology Zero: Shot tears will create a laser between it and the Akeldama tear closest to Isaac.
Dead Eye: The tears in the trail will contribute to the damage boost, making it possible to stack damage while having items that do not interact with Dead Eye on their own (such as Brimstone).
IBS: Holding a White Poop above your head will give Akeldama tears homing.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: Akeldama tears are unaffected by Anti-Gravity.
Brimstone: Akeldama creates normal tears.
Godhead: Akeldama tears do not have the aura.
Ipecac: Akeldama creates normal tears.
Pop!: Akeldama blocks the eyeballs created by Pop!, making it quite difficult to hit enemies.
Scissors: The trail will follow Isaac's body.

needsReview: Each tear deals 3.5 damage, regardless of Isaac's damage.
Tears are spawned at an irregular rate, roughly between once every 0.1 to 1 seconds.

name: Magic Skin
description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.
effects: Upon use, spawns an item pedestal from the current room's item pool.
Consumes one of Isaac's heart containers, one Bone Heart, or two Soul Hearts, replaced by a broken heart container.
The priority order of hearts that will be consumed is: one heart container, one bone heart, and two soul hearts.
After using Magic Skin, if Isaac is not currently holding it, Magic Skin has a chance to replace any item that spawns in the future.
The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.
The chance is 33% after one use, 50% after two uses, and 100% after three uses.
If Magic Skin is on a pedestal somewhere on the current floor, the replacement chance is reduced to 1% per use. Unpurchased Shop and Devil Deal items do not count.
Each new Magic Skin is fully recharged.

If Isaac's entire health bar is filled with broken heart containers by using Magic Skin (which kills him, but an extra life will remove one broken heart container), this item will disappear and future items won't be replaced.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Spawns 2 items and adds 2 broken hearts (removing 2 heart containers or 4 soul hearts) with each use. Two broken hearts are added regardless of Isaac's remaining health. If Isaac already has 11 broken hearts and uses Magic Skin, it will only be used once.
Damocles: Spawns 2 items on every use instead of 1.

Esau Jr.: Since Esau Jr.'s health is separate from Isaac's, one character can use Magic Skin at no cost to the other. Future items will still be replaced when playing as the character that hasn't used Magic Skin.
Schoolbag: Isaac can keep Magic Skin in the inactive slot to prevent its respawning while still being able to use another active item.
Spindown Dice: Using Spindown Dice on Magic Skin 6 times turns it into R Key.
Spindown Dice + Schoolbag: Allows Isaac to keep Spindown Dice between runs, allowing a theoretically infinite run with enough luck.
Restock: If Isaac can find a Battery in the shop, as long as one has enough coins, runs can actually be infinite.

interactions.text: Alabaster Box: Magic Skin can use Soul hearts from the box, and will prioritize them over those in health.
Binge Eater: Will still offer a food item even if Magic Skin replaced an item.
Dream Catcher: If Magic Skin has replaced the item in the Treasure Room, it will be shown in the dream sequence.
Holding Magic Skin or having a pedestal with it on the same floor can cause the item in the Treasure Room to not be replaced by Magic Skin.
Genesis: Removes all broken hearts as well as items. Magic Skin can still replace items in the Genesis room.

Glowing Hourglass: Recovers a broken heart when used after using Magic Skin. Using Magic Skin in the same type of room will spawn the same item, it must be used in a different room type first to spawn a different item in the previous room type.
Lemegeton: Magic Skin can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run. As long as Isaac has this flame, Magic Skin will not respawn/replace items.
Metronome: Getting Magic Skin from Metronome has a chance to instantly apply the item replacement and spawn Magic Skin as an item pedestal.
Mystery Gift: Does not replace A Lump of Coal or The Poop.
NO!: Does not prevent Magic Skin from replacing items, despite it being an active item.
Tainted Eden: Broken hearts persist even after Magic Skin is rerolled.
TMTRAINER: Prevents Magic Skin from replacing items, since future Magic Skins will be glitched.
R Key: Magic Skin still replaces items after using R Key.

Void: Absorbing Magic Skin does not prevent future items from being replaced, including items spawned by the absorbed Magic Skin. Additional Magic Skins can be absorbed, allowing multiple items to be spawned per use at the cost of adding more broken hearts.

name: Revelation
description: Grants flight. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser. Also grants two Soul Hearts.
effects: Grants flight.
Continuously firing for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a powerful holy laser when Isaac stops shooting, similar to the attacks used by the Angel bosses.
The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
With the EnableMouseControl enabled or an analog controller, the laser can be aimed in any direction, similarly to Analog Stick.

synergies.text: Revelation, Maw Of The Void, No. 2, and Montezuma's Revenge all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at the same time.
Angelic Prism: When the laser hits the prism, it will split in four.
Brain Worm: The laser can bend completely to hit an enemy, effectively acting as a better form of homing on single enemies and bosses.
Continuum The laser loops around. The laser cannot hit the same enemy twice.

Cricket's Body: Spawns 4 split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits every other tick. The tears are Piercing and deal half damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
Eve's Mascara / Polyphemus: As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly increased.
Homing tears: The laser will home in on enemies in a very effective way.
Lachryphagy: The laser has reduced range, but spawns a red Lachryphagy tear per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
Marked: The laser is fired automatically upon reaching full charge in the direction of the mark. Combined with charged attacks, this allows them to keep their DPS.
Multidimensional Baby: The baby can duplicate the laser.

Multidimensional Baby + Lachryphagy / Pop!: Lasers modified by Multidimensional Baby are no longer affected by Lachryphagy or Pop!, being normal length and not firing additional tears/eyes out the end.
The Parasite: Spawns two perpendicular lasers on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits. The laser and its split lasers cannot hit the same enemy.
Also spawn small split tears.
Pop!: The laser has reduced range, but shoots out an eyeball per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
Proptosis: The beam deals ~2.47x Isaac's Damage at point blank range.
Rubber Cement: The laser will bounce off the walls for a short distance.
Tiny Planet: The laser will wrap around Isaac once and then shoot straight forward.
Jacob's Ladder: Upon hitting an enemy, wall or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: The laser fires in place, not following Isaac.

Almond Milk: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased. The laser do not gain worm trinket effects.
Diplopia: Multiple copies of Revelation have no extra effect.
Explosivo / Mucormycosis / Sinus Infection: No effect.
Eye of the Occult: No effect.
Eye of the Occult + Brimstone/Technology: The Revelation beam also automatically fires at the crosshair.
Ipecac: The laser will poison enemies and repeatedly explode on contact with an enemy or obstacle. Despite its high damage increase, Ipecac only adds +2 damage to the beam, similarly to Brimstone.
Kidney Stone: The laser can be fired as normal while the kidney stone is charging. The laser is charged and fired automatically after the kidney stone is fired.
Luck-based tear effects: No effect.
Libra: The laser ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
My Reflection: The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac and then shoots straight backwards.
Mysterious Liquid: The laser leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the laser hits per tick.
Playdough Cookie: The laser rapidly flashes between different colors while firing, with a chance to inflict status effects.
Soy Milk: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased.
Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The laser will occasionally break obstacles.
Tech X: If the Revelation beam and the Tech X are both charged, it will sometimes fire the Revelation beam first and the Tech X ring at the end of it.

needsReview: The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).

name: Consolation Prize
description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Penny, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.
effects: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts, depending on what attribute Isaac has the least of
+1.0 flat damage
+0.5 fire rate
+0.2 speed
+2.5 range
Also drops either 3 Penny, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key on the ground.
Bombs and keys are valued at 3 coins' worth. The pickup dropped will be what Isaac has the least value of, and in case of a tie one is chosen randomly.
As Bethany and Tainted Bethany, one Soul Heart or two Red Hearts can also be dropped if they are low on charges.
Charges are valued at 2 x Charges - 1 coins' worth. For instance having 7 charges would be valued at 13 coins.
conditionalEffects: +0.5 fire rate
+0.2 speed
+2.5 range

name: Tinytoma
description: Gives Isaac a Teratoma orbital that blocks shots, deals contact damage, and splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking damage. The smaller versions break into blue spiders.
effects: Grants a large orbital similar to Teratoma that slowly orbits Isaac.
The orbital repels enemies that touch it and deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies, once per second.

After blocking 3 shots and/or dealing 3 ticks of contact damage, the orbital splits into two smaller ones that orbit opposite of each other. They behave the same as the original, except they are smaller and can only take 2 hits before being destroyed, bursting into 3 blue spiders in the process.
5 seconds after both orbitals are destroyed, the original, full-size orbital respawns.
needsReview: The orbital repels enemies that touch it and deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies, once per second.

After blocking 3 shots and/or dealing 3 ticks of contact damage, the orbital splits into two smaller ones that orbit opposite of each other. They behave the same as the original, except they are smaller and can only take 2 hits before being destroyed, bursting into 3 blue spiders in the process.

name: Brimstone Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.
effects: Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.
Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions.
Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.
Multiple lasers cannot hit the same enemy simultaneously.
The lasers cannot damage Isaac.

synergies.text: BBF / Bob's Brain: Inherits the effect in full, firing lasers every time they explode.
Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Attacks have a small chance to trigger this effect. Chance goes up to 100% at 30 luck.

Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone lasers deal to 19 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone lasers under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
/ The Mulligan: The lasers can create Blue Flies when they deal damage.
Kamikaze!: Activating Kamikaze! sends Brimstone lasers in all 4 directions.
Red Locusts / Scatter Bombs: Explosions made by the red locusts and tiny bombs create thinner lasers that deal 4.8 damage per tick instead of 8.
Multidimensional Baby: Placing Multidimensional Baby in front of the beam will transform it into two black-and-white beams.

interactions.text: Bomber Boy: Only the center explosion will fire lasers.
Anarchist Cookbook: The lasers fired by the troll bombs will push other troll bombs around, likely to the edges of the room.

needsReview: Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.

name: 4.5 Volt
quote: Beat the juice out of them!
description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.
effects: Causes Isaac's active item to charge when Isaac deals damage to enemies, rather than when he clears rooms.
Damage dealt by charmed/friendly enemies, active items, orbitals, and familiars (including blue flies and spiders) works as well.
Charges are gained at a rate equal to the following formula: (40 + (20 x stage)). For example
In Basement I / Downpour I, it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge.
In Caves II / Mines II, it takes 120 damage.
In Womb I / Corpse I, it takes 180 damage.
In Sheol / Cathedral, it takes 240 damage.
In Home, it takes 300 damage.
Ascent floors use the values of their regular floors, meaning the amount of damage 4.5 Volt needs to gain charges steadily decreases during the Ascent sequence until reaching Home.
Multiple charges cannot be gained at once.
Overkill damage does not count towards a charge.

synergies.text: Book of Shadows: With sufficient damage, the Book of Shadows can be kept active indefinitely.
If combined with 9 Volt, it becomes even easier to achieve invincibility.
Door Stop / Mercurius / any means of room resetting (infinite bombs): Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.
Jumper Cables: Increases the rate of charge by appending its 15-kills-per-charge quality on top of 4.5 Volt's damage-based charge.
Old Capacitor: Since the 4.5 Volt also makes it so that active items don't charge when clearing rooms, this trinket can be picked up with no downside.
Unicorn Stump + Sacrificial Dagger: In most boss fights, charges are regenerated faster than invincibility wears off.

White Pony: Since the beam trail from the charge attack deals so much damage, if used on a boss with a high amount of health, 4.5 Volt will often completely recharge the item after each use, allowing for repeated usage while the boss is still alive.
For the same reason (so much damage against bosses that the active item is recharged from its use), Tammy's Head + Brimstone / Azazel / Tainted Azazel is also a strong synergy.

interactions.text: Does not charge items which gain charge over time by default. (e.g. Sharp Straw, The Candle, Butter Bean etc.)
Items converted to charge-over-time by 9 Volt are not affected and may gain charge in both ways.
Alabaster Box: No effect. It still must be charged with Soul Hearts.
Dim Bulb: Does not deactivate until the first charge bar is completely filled. A partial charge of the first bar will retain Dim Bulb's bonus.
Schoolbag: The item in the second slot gets charged when the first one is full. Overcharges on the first item also jump to the second one.

needsReview: In Basement I / Downpour I, it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge.
In Caves II / Mines II, it takes 120 damage.
In Womb I / Corpse I, it takes 180 damage.
In Sheol / Cathedral, it takes 240 damage.
In Home, it takes 300 damage.

name: Fruity Plum
description: Gives Isaac a miniature Baby Plum familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.
effects: Gives Isaac a familiar that mimics Baby Plum's attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room. It deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies (6 per second). It fires 15 tears per second behind itself while moving which deals 3 damage.
Fruity Plum will prioritize moving towards nearby enemies.
If there are no enemies, Fruity Plum loosely orbits Isaac.

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: The homing effect is applied as normal which drastically improves its damage output.
BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles its contact damage and tear damage. The effect does not stack.

interactions.text: Child Leash: No effect.
Forgotten Lullaby: Does not increase its fire rate.
Friendship Necklace: No effect.
RC Remote: No effect.

name: Plum Flute
description: Summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac for roughly 10 seconds, dealing high damage.
effects: On use, summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac in the current room for roughly 10 seconds.
Baby Plum will always twirl, jump, then spit blood and bounce around the room before waving goodbye and flying away.
Baby Plum does 12 contact damage per tick (24 per second), 3.5 damage per shot, and 2 damage per tick with creep (20 per second).

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Baby Plum's shots that pass through the Prism will be split into four.
BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles Baby Plum's contact damage, but not projectile damage. Plum is also larger.
Car Battery: Summons two Baby Plums, the Baby Plums start out overlapped but can sometimes split up when using different attacks.
Lost Cork: Affects Baby Plum's blood puddle.
Sacrificial Altar: Baby Plum can be sacrificed for free, instead of a familiar. Plum Flute can still be used as normal afterwards.

interactions.text: Baby-Bender: No effect.
Eraser: Plum Flute will still function normally if the boss Baby Plum is erased.

name: Star of Bethlehem
description: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels towards the Boss Room, giving an aura that increases damage and tears and grants homing tears.
effects: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels toward the Boss Room, fading through doors as it travels towards it. Once it reaches the boss room, the familiar stands in the center of the boss room for the rest of the floor.

The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a 1.8x / 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5x fire rate multiplier, and homing tears. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to Cone Head's effect except with a higher chance.

synergies.text: Blood Rights/IV Bag/Kamikaze!/Razor Blade: The aura has a chance to block the damage inflicted, but the effects will still occur.
Rock Bottom: Isaac will keep the stat upgrades even after leaving the aura. However, it won't keep the homing effect outside of the aura.
Sprinkler: The tears that the Sprinkler shoots will also be buffed, along with its rotation speed.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The star appears larger, but the aura's size does not increase and neither do the stat gains.
Hallowed Ground: The damage multiplier from the aura does not stack with white poop.
Immaculate Heart: The damage multiplier is reduced to 1.5x while in the aura / does not stack.

conditionalEffects: The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a 1.8x / 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5x fire rate multiplier, and homing tears. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to Cone Head's effect except with a higher chance.

name: Cube Baby
description: Spawns an ice cube familiar that slides around when walked into. It slows and deals contact damage, freezing monsters it kills.
effects: Spawns an ice cube familiar. It cannot move on its own, but slides around when Isaac walks into it, uses a melee attack on it, or when Isaac or enemies shoot at it.
The familiar damages and slows enemies it touches while moving. It can deal up to 17.5 damage when it collides with enemies, depending on how fast it's moving.
Monsters killed by Cube Baby are frozen.
Frozen monsters will follow the same physics as Cube Baby, and will shatter on impact creating ice shards that are capable of freezing other monsters
Cube Baby can block enemy projectiles.

synergies.text: Mom's Bracelet: Cube Baby can be picked up and thrown. It will then slide at maximum speed in the direction it's thrown at and leave a trail of damaging white creep until it slows down.
BFFS!: Increases the size and doubles the damage dealt.

name: Vade Retro
description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.
effects: While held, enemies leave behind small, red ghosts on death; using the item causes the ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying nearby enemy projectiles. The explosions will not destroy obstacles, move pickups, or damage Isaac.

The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.
Enemies with high health, such as champion enemies, minibosses, and bosses will leave behind a larger ghost that creates three explosions.
Isaac will also leave a ghost upon death, which deals 200 flat damage if detonated.
Using the item will instantly kill any enemy that has the 'ghost' tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t leave ghosts.
E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t leave ghosts.
Void: When absorbed, enemies no longer leave behind ghosts on death. Retains ghost instant kill effect when void is used.

needsReview: The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.

name: False PHD
description: Converts good pills into bad pills and identifies all pills. Bad pills now have secondary positive effects. Grants one Black Heart.
effects: Identifies all pills upon pickup.
Spawns a pill.
Grants one Black Heart on pickup.
Converts all good pills into their bad counterparts.
Grants +0.6 damage for each stat down pill and +1.2 damage for each stat down horse pill Isaac has taken, including those taken before acquiring False PHD.
Using a non-stat down bad pill drops a Black Heart.

synergies.text: A Pony/White Pony: Effectively converts all Speed Down pills into Damage Up as long as one of the ponies are being held, since they will always give a minimum of 1.5 speed.
Black Feather: Counts as an evil item, granting a damage up.
Lucky Foot / PHD / Virgo: Pills can now be both good and bad again. The other effects of False PHD still apply when taking bad pills.
Getting multiple of the pill-upgrading items has no effect, bad pills can still appear.
The Wafer: Using a Bad Trip pill will only deal half a heart of damage and spawn a full Black Heart, resulting in a net gain of health.
The Wafer + Placebo: Allows for farming infinite health using Bad Trip pills.
Rock Bottom: Prevents stat-decreasing pills from decreasing your current stats. They still have an effect in the background, making it more difficult to raise that stat in the future.

interactions.text: Libra: The balancing of stats mostly leads to a net decrease between Stat Downs and +0.6 damage up, while Luck Down provides +0.6 damage and -1 luck.

scaled.source: Grants +0.6 damage for each stat down pill (and +1.2 per horse pill) Isaac has taken

conditionalEffects: Grants +0.6 damage for each stat down pill and +1.2 damage for each stat down horse pill Isaac has taken, including those taken before acquiring False PHD.

name: Spin to Win
description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.
effects: While the item is held, grants a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage (3.5 per tick, or 35 per second).

While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 speed and increases the contact damage on Isaac's familiars, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, orbital familiars spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.
The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.
Blue flies and blue spiders are also affected, and don't disappear while the item is in use.
The recharge timer is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used.
Isaac can stop using Spin to Win at any time by releasing the use item button, at which point Spin to Win starts recharging.
Spin to Win can be used while it is not fully charged, gradually draining however much charge there is.

synergies.text: All wisps, including those produced by Lemegeton, become invulnerable while using Spin to Win, regardless of whether the Book of Virtues is active.
Duct Tape/RC Remote: Allows Isaac to use familiars' contact damage without getting close to enemies.
The Forgotten: While playing as The Soul, channeling Spin to Win will cause the Forgotten's skeleton to deal contact damage.

Gnawed Leaf: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac. Activating or deactivating Spin to Win will remove Gnawed Leaf's invincibility.
Guardian Angel: The orbital speed boost from Guardian Angel can be combined with that of Spin to Win, causing all the orbital familiars to spin extremely fast around Isaac.
Panic Button: Has a chance to spawn additional wheels upon taking damage that last only for the current room. This is most likely a bug.

Pluto: The exceedingly high speed and small hitbox enables Isaac to clip into obstacles such as rocks or pits, allowing him to effectively fly over them. Isaac can potentially get stuck, which can be fixed by exiting and continuing the run.
Taurus: Spin to Win's speed boost can instantly trigger the item's invincibility effect if it puts Isaac at 2.0 speed.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The damage bonus of BFFS! is removed while Spin to Win is active. Most notably, this means familiars without natural contact damage do not gain additional damage, and others gain less than expected. Familiars that deal over 12 damage per hit before BFFS!' damage bonus is applied will deal reduced damage with Spin to Win active.
Bob's Brain / BBF / Holy Water / GB Bug: While Spin to Win is active, prevents the familiar from exploding/being destroyed on enemy contact.
GB Bug wont reroll enemies on contact while Spin to Win is active.
Car Battery: No effect.
Metronome: When Metronome chooses Spin to Win, Isaac gains two orbitals with no other benefits of Spin to Win.
Mom's Razor: Mom's Razor deals a fixed 16.5 contact damage, instead of its usual damage-scaled value, while Spin to Win is active.

Tainted Forgotten: Unlike the non-tainted counterpart, Tainted Forgotten's body gains no extra contact damage while Spin to Win is active. Additionally, Tainted Forgotten's contact damage familiars have only 80% of their usual damage.
Void: After absorbing Spin to Win, using Void spawns a temporary, passive Spin to Win familiar for the room. It cannot be activated further for the damage and speed bonuses.

conditionalEffects: While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 speed and increases the contact damage on Isaac's familiars, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, orbital familiars spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.
needsReview: The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.

name: Vasculitis
description: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects of Isaac's tears.
effects: Upon killing an enemy, 1 - 16 blood clot tears are released from them in random directions.
The amount of tears released from an enemy is based on the enemy's health, and is not affected by Isaac's damage, nor the number of tears hit.
These tears are red in coloration, regardless of Isaac's tears, but will inherit the coloration of applied to enemy status effects.
Burst tears will do set damage per floor. The formula for this is: (3.2 + 0.3 x stage).

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t release tears.
Burn: Burning enemies release fire mind tears.
Poison: When a poisoned enemy dies, the released tears are tinted green and will poison other enemies.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t release tears.
Fire Mind: Not recommended. Vasculitis' tears can explode, with great potential to harm Isaac.
Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t release tears.
Frozen enemies can release tears.

name: Giant Cell
description: Causes Isaac to spawn Minisaac familiars when he takes damage, which chase and shoot at nearby enemies.
effects: Whenever Isaac takes damage, he summons a micro-Isaac familiar, known as Minisaac, that chases nearby enemies and attacks on its own.
Minisaacs deal 1.35 base damage that scales with +0.15 per floor: damage = 1.35 + 0.15 * (floor - 1)
Minisaacs shoot 3 tears per second and their tear delay is not affected by Isaac's stats.
Minisaacs persists between rooms and floors.
Each Minisaac is spawned with 15 health points that are constantly drained with a rate of 0.4 per second. The draining stops when they reach 0.8 HP.
They are healed back to full HP whenever Isaac takes damage, even when the familiars cap is reached.
Enemies can damage Minisaacs by shooting projectiles at them or dealing contact damage.
Isaac's bomb explosions will also damage the familiars.
Minisaacs are immune to spikes and lasers.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Increases damage dealt by the familiars by 40%.
Dull Razor: Provides a penalty-free way of spawning Minisaacs and/or healing existing ones.

Glowing Hourglass: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate the Minisaacs. (This is possibly a bug)
Sacrificial Altar: Converts all Minisaacs into 1 Penny each upon use.

interactions.text: Many familiar-modifying items and trinkets do not affect the Minisaacs. These include
Box of Friends
Duct Tape
Extension Cord
Forgotten Lullaby
Friendship Necklace
King Baby

needsReview: Minisaacs shoot 3 tears per second and their tear delay is not affected by Isaac's stats.

name: Tropicamide
description: +2.5 Range, Increases tear size.
effects: +2.5 Range.
+0.22 tear size.

interactions.text: Brimstone / Dr. Fetus / Mom's Knife : No effect on projectile size.
Technology: Laser size is increased.
Lachryphagy: Tears fired will now act as if they have been fed one tear, meaning the tear will explode into 6 parts instead of 5 if undisturbed.

name: Card Reading
description: Spawns two portals at the beginning of each floor that each lead to either the Boss Room, Treasure Room, or Secret Room.
effects: At the beginning of each floor, spawns 2 portals that lead to certain special rooms
A red portal leading to the Boss Room.
A yellow portal leading to the Treasure Room.
A blue portal leading to the Secret Room.
A green portal leading to the Shop.
On floors with no treasure rooms or no secret rooms, only 1 portal will spawn.
The portals will disappear once the starting room is left, whether a portal was taken or not.

interactions.text: Bloody Crown: Makes a second portal spawn in Chapter 4.
Holy Crown/Wicked Crown: Makes a second portal spawn in Chapter 5, if on the respective floor.

name: Quints
description: The first five enemies killed in a room will spawn stationary shooting familiars where they died.
effects: Upon killing enemies, spawns a stationary familiar in their place for the room, up to a maximum of 5. These familiars do not follow Isaac.
The following familiars can spawn
Abel
Boiled Baby
Brother Bobby
Demon Baby
Freezer Baby
Ghost Baby
Guardian Angel
Harlequin Baby
Lil Brimstone
Little Steven
Multidimensional Baby
Robo-Baby
Rotten Baby
Seraphim
Sister Maggy
Rainbow Baby
???'s Soul

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: All shooting familiars spawned are affected, save for Little Steven and Seraphim.
BFFS!: Affects Quints familiars, doubling their damage.
Quints: Lets you spawn an additional 5 Quints familiars per copy.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: The item will be lost, and each spawned familiar counts as one sacrifice. If Quints is sacrificed first (or is the only item available to sacrifice) and at least two familiars are summoned, two Devil Room items will be spawned while only losing one item.
Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t leave familiars behind.

Box of Friends: Existing Quints familiars will not be duplicated, nor more will be created. If Isaac has no other familiars, the generated Demon Baby will hover with the Quints instead of following Isaac.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't leave familiars behind.
King Baby: Familiars do not follow King Baby, nor are the familiars aiming independently at enemies.

name: Tooth and Nail
description: Isaac periodically turns into a spiked statue, briefly becoming invulnerable and dealing contact damage.
effects: Every 6 seconds, Isaac turns to stone and sprouts spikes for 1 second. While Isaac is in this state, he is immune to damage and deals 40 contact damage.

Isaac flashes white three times before turning to stone on the fourth flash. The first three flashes are accompanied by a "ticking" sound, the final one with the spike extension sound of a mimic chest.
Unlike Gnawed Leaf, Isaac can still move and shoot tears.

synergies.text: Contact damage items work great with Tooth and Nail, such as Aries / Mom's Heels / The Virus for extra damage, Serpent's Kiss for Black Heart generation, Midas' Touch for coin generation etc.
Midas' Touch also makes the stone turn a yellowish golden while active. Purely visual, but can help remind the player that they have both items.
Damocles: As Isaac is invincible 1/6th of the time, with some luck, Tooth and Nail may save him from the falling sword.
Kamikaze!: Allows usage without taking damage during invincibility.

The Lost can use this item to prevent additional damage from occurring after losing the Holy Mantle (for example, exiting a Curse Room after being hit), and it does not use up the Holy Mantle's 1-hit protection if it has not been lost.

name: Binge Eater
description: +1 Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 damage and permanently boosts 2 stats.
effects: Grants one Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac.
Item pedestals cycle between the initial item and one of several food items.

Upon picking up an affected food item, in addition to their normal effects, Isaac gains a temporary +3.6 Damage boost (which fades over 30 seconds), a permanent boost to 2 stats depending on the food item consumed, and a permanent -0.03 speed reduction.
Affected food items heal 3 Red Hearts instead of 2.

interactions.text: Crooked Penny / Diplopia: If an item pedestal is copied while the original item is revealed, it will create an identical cycling pedestal of the same two items. If an item pedestal is copied when the food item is revealed, it will create a non-switching pedestal of the food item only.
A Pound of Flesh: Food items in Shops cost 1 Red Heart Container, much like with Devil Deals. If Isaac also has Restock, he is able to gain infinite stats this way.
Death Certificate: Has no effect on the items in the generated areas.
Glitched Crown: The food item is added to the end of the cycle for a total of 6 items per pedestal.
Sacred Orb: The food item is not re-rolled.
Jacob and Esau: Items will swap between the initial item and food item as normal, but only the brother who picked up Binge Eater gets the additional stat bonuses.
Tainted Isaac / Isaac's Birthright: The food item will cycle alongside the original 2 granted by the character, resulting in a total of 3 items per pedestal.

Tainted Lazarus: In a Devil Room, Tainted Lazarus is effectively able to give items to his inactive form for free by picking up a food item. This will remove one heart container, and then instantly restore it. The mirrored Devil items will remain however, meaning he can use Flip and pick them up as his alternate form for no cost.
Tainted Bethany: On pick-up, grants 12 blood charges. Increases blood charges gained from food items from 4 to 6.

conditionalEffects: Upon picking up an affected food item, in addition to their normal effects, Isaac gains a temporary +3.6 Damage boost (which fades over 30 seconds), a permanent boost to 2 stats depending on the food item consumed, and a permanent -0.03 speed reduction.

name: Guppy's Eye
description: Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.
effects: Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.

interactions.text: The contents are immediately updated upon reroll.
Poker Chip: Guppy's Eye will show which chests contain an Attack Fly. This allows Isaac to drop the Trinket, leave the room, and return to reset the chest's contents.
Sack Head: Sack Head rerolls pickups into Grab Bags after they are spawned, making Guppy's Eye less effective on non-Grab Bag contents.
Guppy's Eye: Picking up a second copy of the item gives Isaac a unique costume with both eyes replaced. This is purely cosmetic, and it will otherwise have no effect.

name: Strawman
description: Spawns a controllable Keeper to fight enemies alongside Isaac, functioning similarly to Jacob and Esau. If Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.
effects: Spawns Keeper as an extra character alongside Isaac, who is controlled exactly like Esau.
Keeper will have his base stats, except speed, and use coins as health.
He will not receive any of his starting items, such as Wooden Nickel or Store Key.
When Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.
Grants 1 Bomb upon pickup.

synergies.text: Birthright: If Keeper is the one picking it up, it will grant him a heart container.
Crooked Penny / Diplopia: Picking up multiple copies of the item will spawn additional Keepers that each have their own inventory.
Extension Cord: Beams of electricity flow between Keeper and Isaac.
Greed's Gullet: Keeper gains extra coin hearts at every 25 coin interval.
More Options / There's Options: With careful positioning, both item choice pedestals can be taken.
Sanguine Bond: A very beneficial item for both Isaac and Keeper, as it is fairly easy to snowball into infinitely playing the spikes.
Yum Heart: Because of how Yum Heart works in co-op, when Isaac uses Yum Heart, it will also restore one coin heart for Keeper.
Tainted Isaac : Items left out by Tainted Isaac can be picked up by Keeper.

interactions.text: 1up!: Upon death, Keeper revives at full health in the current room.
4.5 Volt / 9 Volt / The Battery / Battery Pack / Car Battery / Habit / Jumper Cables / Sharp Plug: Useless on Keeper, unless Book of Virtues is held.
Ankh / Judas' Shadow / Lazarus' Rags: Keeper will respawn as the respective character in the current room.
Ankh + Birthright: Strawman ??? will get twice as much HP from health upgrades.
Judas' Shadow + Birthright: Strawman Black Judas can use the The Book of Belial acquired via Birthright as normal and the item recharges as normal. Book of Virtues stacks like usual.
Lazarus' Rags + Birthright: If Birthright was obtained prior to respawn, does nothing. If picked up after, grants its temporary damage.
Keeper: While playing as Keeper, if Strawman respawns via any of the aforementioned items, health no longer converts to flies.
Astral Projection: Keeper gains full benefit of Astral Projection. Isaac gets no speed or fire rate bonuses during its effect, however.
Baby-Bender / BFFS! / Box of Friends: Strawman does not count as a familiar for the purpose of these items.
Big Fan / Guardian Angel: If Keeper is the one who picked it up, it will only buff orbital speed for him.
BFFS! / Hive Mind: If Keeper is the one who picked it up, it will only buff his familiars/flies and spiders and none of Isaac's.
Blood Bombs: Keeper can keep placing bombs for health after Isaac has run out.
Book of Virtues: The book can be picked up by Keeper and used as normal, making it the only active item he can use.
Book of Virtues + Missing No.: The book does not get rerolled.
Dead Cat: Keeper's maximum health is set to 1 coin. Upon death, he revives in the current room with maximum health reset to 1 coin.
Eden's Blessing: If Keeper picks up Eden's Blessing, the extra item will be awarded to Isaac at the start of the next run whether Keeper survives or not.
Esau Jr.: Switching once and back will clear any items Keeper may have had.
False PHD / PHD: Identifies pills, but doesn't convert them.
Genesis: Will not grant item choices for any of Keeper's collected items.
Guppy's Collar: Upon death, Keeper has a chance to revive with 1 coin of filled health in the current room.

Lachryphagy: Isaac's tears can feed Keeper's for great damage. If Isaac, however, has Lachryphagy, Keeper's tears still interact with them, although sometimes it feeds them, other times it absorbs them, without the splitting effect.
The Ladder: A ladder will spawn across gaps for the Keeper, however he cannot use it, only Isaac.
Spirit Shackles: The effect will only happen once, as Keeper cannot recharge them.
Tainted Cain: Items will not turn into pickups if Keeper takes them.
Tainted Lazarus/Dead Tainted Lazarus: Upon flipping, Keeper gets regenerated from scratch, meaning his health gets restored to full and all items he picked up will be permanently removed.
TMTRAINER: All items will become glitched if Keeper holds TMTRAINER. He can be killed to restore item generation to normal.

name: Dad's Note
description: Sends Isaac on an Ascent toward Home.
effects: Initiates the Ascent sequence.
Any trinkets left in Treasure Rooms and Boss Rooms will turn into Cracked Keys.

name: Sausage
description: Adds a Red Heart Container, fully heals Isaac, and gives +0.2 Speed, +0.5 Damage, +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range, +0.2 Shot Speed, and +1.0 Luck. Increases the chance of encountering a Devil Room, Angel Room, and/or Planetarium each by 6.9%.
effects: Fully heals Isaac.
Gives Isaac one Red Heart Container.
+0.2 Speed.
+0.5 Damage.
+0.5 Tears.
+2.5 Range.
+0.16 Shot Speed.
+1.0 Luck.
+6.9% Devil Room / Angel Room chance.
+6.9% Planetarium chance.

interactions.text: Spindown Dice: Changes Sausage into Dad's Note, which, if picked up outside of its special Mausoleum / Gehenna Boss Room, simply fades the music out and does nothing. Additionally, Dad's Note cannot be further rerolled, neither via Spindown Dice or by other means of reroll.
Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

Tainted Lazarus / Dead Tainted Lazarus: Only the increased Devil/Angel Room and Planetarium encounter chance is shared between the two forms, not the stat-ups (referring to the lazarussharedglobal item tag).
Additional copies of this item do not increase Devil Room / Angel Room and Planetarium chance further.

name: Options?
description: If a room gives a reward when cleared, there will be two different rewards to chose from. Taking one causes the other to disappear.
effects: At 0 Luck and with no other modifiers, reduces the chance for a room clear to give no reward from 22% to 16%.
Whenever a room clear reward spawns, a different alternative reward is spawned next to it. Picking up either reward causes the other to disappear.

synergies.text: Broken Padlock: Bombing any chest spawned by Options?, including the ones not requiring keys, allows picking up the contents of the chest without the other reward disappearing, unless the empty chest is touched. This can be easily avoided by simply exiting and reentering the room.

Contract From Below: Spawns a second set of consumables. The "Options?" consumable is not guaranteed to be the same for each copy of the original consumable. Each pair of consumables functions independently for "Options?", meaning Isaac can pick up one of the first two rewards and one of the second two rewards.
Deep Pockets/Old Capacitor: Every extra coin or battery generated will have its own alternative reward.
Guppy's Eye: Takes the guesswork out of choosing between a chest/sack and a pickup by allowing you to see what the chest/sack will give.
Guppy's Tail: Gives a choice between a golden chest and something else in case Isaac is low on keys.

Magneto: Opening a chest does not make the other reward disappear. Picking up the other reward afterwards will only remove the empty chest, and picking up the contents of the chest will not make the other reward disappear, letting Isaac take both rewards. This does not apply to chests with items in them, which disappear or make the other reward disappear as normal. Touching a chest will still make the other reward disappear.

Magneto + Broken Modem: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a TMTRAINER item if the chest contained an item.
Safety Scissors: If a Troll Bomb/Mega Troll Bomb/Golden Troll Bomb is turned into another form of bomb, it can be picked up without causing the other reward to despawn.

interactions.text: Bag of Crafting: Only one of the rewards can be grabbed.
Broken Modem: If the room drops are doubled, only the original set is affected by "Options?"; both consumables of the duplicate set can be collected.

Caution should be approached if you take this item and Magneto when you're in Chest or Dark Room, as there's a chance the chest will "glitch" out via Broken Modem and opening it during the "glitching" will turn the item into a glitched item, as if it was spawned by TMTRAINER.
Bum Friend, Bumbo, Dark Bum, Key Bum, and the familiar gained from the transformation will cause other items to disappear when they take their respective pickups.
D20: Can re-roll both pickups created by Options?, but only one can still be taken.
Glyph of Balance: Only one of the rewards is modified by the Glyph.
Moving Box: One of the pickups will disappear when using Moving Box.
IX - The Hermit?: Only one of the rewards will be "sold".

name: Candy Heart
description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he heals with Red Heart pickups.
effects: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart healed with Red Heart pickups or when gaining an extra filled heart container
+0.02 speed.
+0.05 tears.
+0.10 flat damage.
+0.25 range.
+0.02 shot speed.
+0.10 luck.
Spawns a Red Heart when picked up.

synergies.text: Hypercoagulation:/Tainted Magdalene: Can provide infinite stat boosts, if the dropped hearts are caught in time.
Maggy's Bow: Increases the stat boosts given by Candy Heart, provided extra Red health was restored.

interactions.text: Apple of Sodom: This doesn't give the stat increases when picking up hearts to make spiders.
Candy Heart: This item isn't affected by stacking.

conditionalEffects: +0.02 speed.
+0.05 tears.
+0.25 range.
+0.02 shot speed.
+0.10 luck.

name: A Pound of Flesh
description: Devil deals now cost Penny, Shop items now cost health, and consumables in shops are free but surrounded by spikes.
effects: Devil deals and Black Market items can now be paid with Penny.
Anything that generates Devil Deals (such as Satanic Bible or the special chests in Dark Room) will also create items that cost coins.
Items in Shops now cost health.
Consumables in shops have no cost, but are surrounded with Spikes and can't be pushed out with an explosion.

synergies.text: Binge Eater: All shops become free stat-ups if the food item is chosen.
Restock: The price never increases, staying at one red heart container/three soul hearts for each item, and one full heart of damage for pickups.
However, Restock's coin cost increase mechanic is still present, and if Pound of Flesh is lost, the items will have their equivalent coin cost displayed.
With Binge Eater, this can result in infinite stat gains.
If a Heart is on sale, Isaac can trigger items that activate upon taking damage indefinitely.
If a Lil' Battery is on sale, Isaac can buy items indefinitely with certain active items such as Blank Card with XI - Strength or Book of Revelations with Car Battery.
When transformed into a ghost in Downpour II or as Tainted Jacob, or playing asThe Lost, Isaac can buy items indefinitely.
Maggy's Bow: Buying a Red Heart will out-heal the damage taken from the spikes if Isaac can survive it.
The Wafer / Cancer / Percs!: The spikes only deal half a heart damage, allowing Isaac to gain health from buying hearts.
With Restock, any character except Bethany can buy items indefinitely if a Soul Heart is on sale.

interactions.text: Chaos: Items in Devil Rooms that would otherwise cost two heart containers will only cost one if found in Shops.
Flat File: No effect. Spikes generated surrounding consumables will not be removed.
Holy Mantle / Holy Card / Wooden Cross / Blanket / Dogma: Unless Isaac is The Lost, the spikes around consumables will simply break the shield without letting him take them.
Isaac's Heart: Consumables can no longer be picked up in shops.
Judas' Tongue: Ensures that items in the Member Card secret shop only cost one heart container, but Devil Deal prices are not reduced, and other shop items already only cost one heart container.
Keeper's Box: Items and pickups generated outside Devil Rooms will cost health, but items generated inside Devil Rooms will cost coins.
Keeper's Sack: Because shop items no longer cost coins, stat bonuses are no longer gained from buying shop items, but they are gained from Devil Deals.
The Lost: Only one item can be picked up from each shop; any other items will vanish. Consumables can be taken for free.
However, multiple items can be bought from Devil Deals.
Items will not disappear when taking any consumable.
With Restock, the Lost can buy items indefinitely.
Member Card: Items in the secret shop can cost two heart containers.
Redemption: Doesn't change the conditions to lose or keep the cross even when spending health in shops.
The Stairway: Affects Angel Shops the same way it does regular shops.
Steam Sale: Devil Deals will have their price reduced. Shop items will cost the same amount of health.
Store Credit: Store Credit becomes a useless trinket, as neither Devil Deals nor shop items will become free.

name: Redemption
description: If Isaac enters a Devil Room but leaves without taking/opening anything in it, he gets +1 Damage and a Soul Heart at the start of the next floor.
effects: Upon entering a Devil Room, a white inverted cross will appear above Isaac's head. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the icon still above his head, he will gain a Soul Heart and +1.0 damage.
Taking anything generated by the room (items or consumables) will result in the icon going away, including opening Red Chests / Black Sacks.

interactions.text: Devil's Crown: Devil Treasure Rooms will count as regular Devil Rooms for the purposes of this item.

Found Soul: The soul will receive a cross when a Devil Room is entered, and will not lose it when Isaac takes an item/pickup. When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.
Jacob and Esau: The cross will only disappear if the character holding Redemption takes something. The other character is free to take items and pickups.
Satanic Bible: Taking a Boss item that was replaced with a Devil Deal will remove the cross, however the Boss Room doesn't give the cross.

Tainted Lazarus: Only the character initially entering the Devil Room will receive the cross over his head. The character that leaves the floor with the icon above his head is the one that gains Redemption's benefits.
Using Flip inside the Devil Room will make both forms have the icon over their heads. Even if one form's cross is removed, the other's is unaffected.
Ghostly items that were already bought from taking a deal can safely be taken without deactivating Redemption.

conditionalEffects: Upon entering a Devil Room, a white inverted cross will appear above Isaac's head. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the icon still above his head, he will gain a Soul Heart and +1.0 damage.

name: Spirit Shackles
description: On taking fatal damage, instead of dying, Isaac's ghost is chained to his dead body, and he can continue to fight with 1/2 of a heart, returning to life after 10 seconds. After it activates, it must be recharged by gaining a Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source.
effects: If Isaac were to take fatal damage, rather than dying, he instead transforms into a ghostly form, resembling The Soul, with half a heart. The ghost has flight, spectral tears, and is chained to Isaac's immobile corpse. Isaac's soul returns to his corpse' position after 10 seconds, if he doesn't die while in ghost form.
