Isaac will have invulnerability frames for 1/3rd of a second after reviving.

After activation, Spirit Shackles is disabled until Isaac gains a half or full Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source. HP that is used to charge Spirit Shackles will not be added to Isaac's health.

synergies.text: Found Soul: Spirit Shackles activates for Found Soul, functioning as normal. However, it cannot be recharged, and can only be activated again after Found Soul dies and respawns.
The Lost: Effectively acts as a rechargeable extra life, granting additional defensive measures on top of his inherent Holy Mantle and granting a use to normally useless Soul Hearts.
Magic Skin: When all hearts are converted to Broken Hearts, Isaac will be revived with half a soul heart, allowing many more uses with low health.
Scapular: Can activate at the same time. When this happens, the soul heart granted by Scapular will immediately charge Spirit Shackles.

interactions.text: Ankh / Broken Ankh / Judas' Shadow: Soul hearts given on respawn cannot recharge Spirit Shackles.
Bethany: Soul charges cannot be used to recharge Spirit Shackles. Picking up soul hearts recharges it as normal.
Damocles / Plan C / Suicide King: Ignores Spirit Shackles and fully kills Isaac.

The Forgotten: Spirit Shackles can activate for both characters. They can toggle between The Forgotten and The Soul as normal while it's active, and the form that didn't "die" will have their normal health. Toggling from The Forgotten to The Soul will also create another body of The Forgotten that The Soul will be chained to in addition to the original body.

Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus: The character that has Spirit Shackles must die for it to activate; if the other character dies, it will not activate. Only the character that has Spirit Shackles can recharge it.

In the case of Jacob and Esau, the brother that has Spirit Shackles will be chained to their dead body, while the one that doesn't can move freely. If either brother dies while Spirit Shackles is active, the other dies with them as normal.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: As Hearts cannot spawn or be collected, Spirit Shackles can only be recharged from effects that add Soul Hearts to health directly.

Tainted Forgotten: The ghost will spawn from Tainted Forgotten instead of Tainted Soul; it will be invulnerable, unable to move, and use the bone club instead of Tainted Forgotten. It can also be thrown, but will rapidly return to Tainted Forgotten due to being chained to them. Tainted Soul is unaffected, and can take damage as normal.
Tainted Jacob: will not activate during Lost Form, or when killed by Dark Esau.

name: Cracked Orb
description: Unlocks doors and reveals a random room on the map when Isaac takes damage.
effects: Upon taking damage, activates the following effects
Unlocks all locked doors in the room (doors that need the room to be cleared are not affected).
Opens the Secret Room and the Super Secret Room if adjacent to the room you are in.
Reveals a random unmapped room on the floor.
Destroys all tinted rocks and rocks with Crawl Spaces in the room.

synergies.text: Dog Tooth / Shiny Rock / YO LISTEN!: Makes it extremely easy to destroy tinted rocks and enter Crawl Spaces.
Dull Razor: Allows the player to benefit from the item without taking actual damage.
Book of Secrets / The Mind / Blue Map / Treasure Map / The Compass: Having more rooms already discovered makes Cracked Orb more likely to reveal the ultra secret room.

XIV - Temperance: Allows the player to spawn a source of damage, making it easier to access rooms such as the entrance to Mom's Heart and Mega Satan's door when lacking bombs or being immune to explosive damage.

name: Empty Heart
description: If Isaac has one red heart or fewer at the beginning of a floor, he gains an empty red heart container.
effects: If Isaac has one red heart or less at the beginning of a floor, an empty heart container is added.

synergies.text: Adrenaline: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if conditions are met to grant an empty heart container at the beginning of each floor.
Crow Heart: If no Devil Beggars or Blood Donation Machines can be found, the Crow Heart trinket is a great way to guarantee red hearts are lost so long as you still have non-red health available.
Dark Prince's Crown: The heart containers are empty when granted, which allows the crown's buff to stay active when advancing floors.
Guppy's Paw: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart can be used by Guppy's Paw while staying at or below 1 red heart, granting massively increased survivability.

Lazarus: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart allows Lazarus to effectively negate the downside that removes a single heart container on death, allowing him to purposefully use his mechanic to get a +0.5 damage up per floor. (As long as he still proceeds at one red heart or less)
Potato Peeler: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart can be used by Potato Peeler while staying at or below 1 red heart, granting increased damage and a Cube of Meat per floor.

name: Astral Projection
description: Causes Isaac to turn into a ghost if he gets hit while in an uncleared room, giving him flight and spectral tears and blocking the next hit he takes.
effects: The first time Isaac takes damage while in an uncleared room, time is stopped for 2 seconds and Isaac becomes a ghost and leaves his body behind, which drops to the floor. While in ghost form, Isaac has flight and spectral tears and the next hit he takes is negated.
Isaac's tears and speed are greatly increased while time is stopped, although this is not shown on the HUD.
Isaac's ghost re-enters his body after the room is cleared or if he gets hit again.

synergies.text: Hypercoagulation: Due to the effective speed up, the heart used to activate Astral Projection can easily be collected before it disappears.
IV Bag / Dull Razor / Other sources of self damage: If used in a hostile room, Astral Projection will trigger, effectively granting flight and Holy Mantle for the room.

Old Bandage / Gimpy: When getting hit with only one heart left, Astral Projection allows for picking up the dropped heart in the brief time of invincibility even when the player has no hearts left. Failing to do so or having no hearts dropped results in guaranteed death however, but with luck this loop can be used to potentially save runs.

interactions.text: Holy Mantle: The shield will activate before Astral Projection.
The Lost / Tainted Lost: The Lost will continue to fight after taking damage, however he will instantly die upon taking damage again or once the room is cleared.
If The Lost receives at least half a Soul Heart through any means while the effect is active, he will survive. Black Hearts cannot be used for this.
Plan C / Other insta-kill effects: Will kill Isaac without triggering the ghost effect.
Rock Bottom: Does not preserve the tears and speed bonus Isaac receives after activating Astral Projection.
Spirit Shackles: This item will not activate if Isaac received lethal damage when Astral Projection activated.

name: C Section
description: Replaces tears with fetuses that chase down enemies and deal contact damage. Each shot requires a brief charge up.
effects: Isaac gains a short delay charge attack that fires homing, piercing, spectral fetus tears.
The fetus tears do 75% of Isaac's Damage, 3.75 times per second, until they run out of Range.
The fetuses will automatically fire when Isaac is at full charge, meaning the charge cannot be held.
Charge time is calculated based on Tear Delay.
Fetuses per Second = (30)/(Roundup(Tear Delay * 3) + 1)
Fetuses per second is capped at 15.

synergies.text: Berserk!: Isaac can fire the fetuses on duration. The fetuses hold and attack with bone clubs that are identical to The Forgotten's one.
Brimstone / Azazel: Shoots 4 fetus tears along with the brimstone beam.
Each additional beam created from Monstro's Lung, split tears (such as The Parasite), or multi-shot effects (including Loki's Horns and Eye Sore) spawns four additional fetuses.
Anti-Gravity: The fetuses spawn when the beam is being released. The fetuses do not spawn if Isaac is charging when the beam is being released.
The Ludovico Technique: When combined with Brimstone, overrides C Section: fetuses no longer spawn.
Compound Fracture: Fetuses are skeletons that shoot splitting bone fragments when in contact with an enemy.
Cricket's Body: Fetuses drop four short-ranged tears when they hit the ground.

Dead Eye: Damage boost is granted once a fetus hits an enemy (once per fetus) and is reset when a fetus does not hit anything before going down, using the same rule to determine whether the damage boost is reset or not.
This makes for a great synergy since the fetuses are homing and stay up much longer than regular tears.
Dr. Fetus: The fetuses drop small bombs when they touch an enemy. The bomb's damage follows Dr. Fetus' damage calculation, based on half of the fetuses damage. A fetus can drop only one bomb.

The fetuses' bombs do not benefit from Isaac's bomb effects such as Hot Bombs or Bobby-Bomb. However, they do benefit from Isaac's tear effects and have the appearance of the corresponding bombs. For example, Hot Bombs from Fire Mind, Bobby-Bomb from homing tears. As such, Cricket's Body, The Parasite, and Polyphemus leave a subsequent bomb or bombs, and Mysterious Liquid leaves a creep.
Dr. Fetus + Ipecac: The fetuses explode before dropping any bomb.
Dr. Fetus + Haemolacria: Fetuses will both drop a bomb on touching an enemy and burst into multiple small bombs upon hitting the ground.
Explosivo: Some Fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then explode. However, they do not inflict their contact damage while sticking.
Explosivo + Mom's Knife: The knives from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaging tick. The explosions from a knife deal 60 + half of the fetus' damage which held it.

Explosivo + Berserk! / Spirit Sword / The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: The clubs/swords from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaged enemy from their attack. The explosions from a club/sword deal 60 + the damage its attack dealt.

Explosivo + Technology: The lasers from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaged enemy from their attack. The tears inherit the fetuses' property, including laser attacks, from which can create more tears. The tears from a laser deal 60 + the laser's damage they originated, and their lasers deal the same as the lasers they originated. Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while tears do not spin.
Explosivo + Tech X: The laser rings from fetuses with Explosivo's effect create exploding tears for each damaging tick. The explosions from a ring deal 60 + the ring's damage.
The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: Fetuses are skeletons that attack with bone clubs in addition to contact damage. The fetuses from Tainted Forgotten deal 80% of their normal damage.
With Brimstone: Spawns a brimstone ball along with a fetus. Shots are fired automatically as the charge completes.
With Mom's Knife: Fetuses hold knives instead of bone clubs and no longer perform the swing attacks.
With Monstro's Lung Tears remain unchanged; the Forgotten will fire a burst attack alongside the fetus. No effect on the Soul.
With Technology: Fetuses perform laser attacks and enhanced bone club attacks separately, causing more damage.
Godhead: Fetuses have a glowing aura around them, but the aura cannot damage the enemy in contact with the fetuses.
Haemolacria: Fetuses explode into a burst of tears when they hit the ground.
Ipecac: The fetuses explode on impact, dealing its contact damage, which is often massively increased from the item.
Jacob's Ladder: Fetuses zap nearby enemies.
Luck-based tear effects (e.g. Holy Light / Knockout Drops): If a fetus has the effect, the fetus causes the effect for each damaging tick.
Little Horn: Still only two hands can appear at once.
Ocular Rift: The rifts spawn only once per fetus.

Luck-based tear effects + Angelic Prism: If Isaac's speed is greater than the speed of a fetus, he can manually walk the prism through any fetus with a luck-based tear effect (or any fetus), greatly multiplying its effectiveness.

Luck-based tear effects + Mom's Knife: If a fetus has the effect, the knife also causes the effect for each damaging tick. If not, the knife has chance to cause the effect based on Isaac's Luck for each damaging tick.
Luck-based tear effects + Berserk! / Spirit Sword / Technology / The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: If a fetus has the effect, each attack also causes the effect.
Luck-based tear effects + Tech X: If a fetus has the effect, the laser ring also causes the effect for each damaging tick.

Mom's Knife: Fetuses hold small knives in their front, causing extra damage. The knife deals twice of Isaac's Damage, just as when it is held by Isaac, and their size scales with the fetuses' size. Any additional copy of the item causes Isaac to shoot more fetuses.
Mom's Knife + Proptosis: The knives shrink along with the fetuses, but they retain their tripled damage.
Mom's Knife + Brimstone: Instead of a barrage of knives, fires a normal Brimstone beam alongside knife-carrying fetuses.

Mucormycosis: Some Fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then burst. However, they do not inflict their contact damage while sticking. Unlike normal spores, the fetuses from the burst can home into the enemy they burst from.
Mucormycosis + Mom's Knife: The knives from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaging tick. Their knives deal twice of Isaac's Damage, same as the ones they originated.

Mucormycosis + Berserk! / Spirit Sword / The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: The clubs/swords from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaged enemy from their attack. The fetuses from the burst also hold clubs/swords which are able to create another wave of spores. The damage of attacks are calculated based on half of the spores' flat 3.5 damage.
Berserk! / The Forgotten: Their swings deal 10.5 damage.
Tainted Forgotten: Their swings deal 8.4 damage.
Spirit Sword: Their swing attacks/spin attacks/projectiles deal 8.75/24/11 damage.

Mucormycosis + Technology: The lasers from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaged enemy from their attack. The spores inherit the fetuses' property including laser attacks, which can create another spores. The fetuses from the burst also has laser attacks which are able to create another wave of spores. Their laser attacks deal 3.5 damage, based on the spores' flat 3.5 damage. Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while spores do not spin.

Mucormycosis + Tech X: The laser rings from fetuses with Mucormycosis' effect create spores for each damaging tick. The fetuses from the burst are also surrounded by laser rings which are able to create another wave of spores. Their rings deal 1.75 damage, based on half of the spores' flat 3.5 damage.
My Reflection: Fetuses travel a short distance, then reverse direction and return to Isaac.
The Parasite: Fetuses fire short-ranged tears constantly while in contact with an enemy.
Parasitoid: Parasitoid fetuses spawn spiders/flies and slowing creep with every hit on an enemy.
Polyphemus: Grants +5 flat damage with no fire rate down.
Sinus Infection: Some Fetuses stick to enemies. However, they only do the Sinus Infection damage ticking and often result in dealing much less damage.

Sinus Infection + Mom's Knife: The knives from fetuses with Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaging tick. The boogers from a knife deal half of the fetus' damage which held it per tick.

Sinus Infection + Berserk! / Spirit Sword / The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: The clubs/swords from fetuses with Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaged enemy from their attack. The boogers from a club/sword deal half of the fetus' damage which held it per tick.

Sinus Infection + Technology: The lasers from fetuses with Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaged enemy from their attack. The boogers inherit the fetuses' property including laser attacks, which can create another boogers. The boogers from a laser deal the laser's damage, so does their lasers. Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while boogers do not spin.
Sinus Infection + Tech X: The laser rings from fetuses Sinus Infection's effect create boogers for each damaging tick. The boogers from a ring deal the ring's damage per tick.

Spirit Sword: Fetuses hold small swords and repeat the swing attack and the charged spin attack as they travel. The damage calculation is based on half of the fetus' damage. On base Range, they have just enough time to perform the attacks twice. The sword's size scales with the fetus' size.
Spirit Sword + Berserk! / Mom's Knife / The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: The fetuses hold swords and do not benefit from the others.
Spirit Sword + Proptosis: Although the attacks' damages diminish along with the fetus, the projectile from the sword does not lose its damage over range.
Tainted Azazel: Shoots 2 fetus tears along with his thin brimstone beam.
Tech.5 / Technology 2: Both fire at the same time.
Technology Zero: Fetuses are connected with electricity.
Tech X: Fetuses are surrounded by a laser ring that deals half of their damage. The ring's size scales with the fetus' size.
Tech X + Brimstone: The laser rings do not change into brimstone rings. The Brimstone has no effect unless combined with other additional items.
Tech X + Proptosis: The rings shrink along with the fetuses, but they retain their tripled damage.
Technology: Fetuses rapidly shoot a short-ranged laser based on their damage when facing enemies.
Technology + Cricket's Body: Split tears created from the end of the laser inherit the effects of fetus tears including laser attacks from Technology, but they do not create another split tears.
Technology + Lachryphagy: Fetuses can feed on either other fetuses or Lachryphagy tears which their laser attacks create. Fed fetuses shoot stronger lasers, creating powerful Lachryphagy tears.
Technology + Pop!: Pop! tears created from the end of the laser inherit the effects of fetus tears including laser attacks from Technology, which can create another Pop! tears.
Technology + Proptosis: Although the laser's damage diminishes along with the fetus, it does not lose its damage over range.
Technology + Spirit Sword: Fetuses hold lightsabers and perform laser attacks and enhanced sword attacks separately, causing more damage.

Cursed Eye
Evil Eye
Eye of the Occult (besides stat changes)
The Ludovico Technique

Anti-Gravity: Fetuses will begin stuck in-place as expected, but will ignore this behavior if there are nearby enemies, in which case they will home in and chase them. Range "lifetime" is still ticking during the stuck time unlike normal tears, making them markedly harder to use and shorter lasting.
BFFS!: No effect; fetuses are considered tears, not familiars.
C Section: No additional effect for multiple copies of the item.
Epic Fetus: Overrides C Section making Epic Fetus the only item in the game that can override it.
Eye of Belial: Fetuses' appearances change into Eye of Belial tears when passing through an enemy, but they retain their effects.
Fire Mind: The fetuses can explode and leave fires before they run out of Range, which can result in inflicting less damage.
Flat Stone: Fetuses only bounce after going rather far or damaging enemies for long enough.
Immaculate Heart/Saturnus: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
Knockout Drops: Fetuses affected by it have the appearance of a fist, but they retain their effects.
Lachryphagy: Burst tears appear to be fetuses, but they do not retain homing or piercing effect from C Section.
Lead Pencil: low range burst of 12 non-fetus tears every 15 fetuses fired.
Lost Contact: Fetuses collide with enemy shots, destroying them. The collisions slightly affect the fetuses' movement.
Multidimensional Baby: Fetuses' appearances change into normal tears when passing through Multidimensional Baby, but they retain their effects.
Pop!: Fetuses' movements do not extend their lifespan, it is still limited by Range. Fetuses do not fall after bouncing off of each other 8 times.
Sad Bombs / Tammy's Head: Fires normal tears.

Scissors: C Section tears are fired from the body instead of the head. This makes the head do nothing, but the item still provides a benefit as the body will fire both the C Section tears and the blood fountain from Scissors.
Sharp Key: No effect on thrown keys.
Tear Detonator: Fetuses split into normal tears.

needsReview: Fetuses per Second = (30)/(Roundup(Tear Delay * 3) + 1)

name: Lil Abaddon
description: Spawns a familiar that charges a miniature Maw Of The Void attack while Isaac shoots.
effects: Gives Isaac a familiar that creates a fluctuating black ring after a 1 second charge time that damages enemies that touch it, similarly to Maw Of The Void.
The black ring lasts for 1 second and deals 3.5 damage per tick, up to 15 times per ring, for a total of 52.5 damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: The black ring created gets wider and deals double damage.

Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 10 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
Hemoptysis + BFFS!: The curse causes the ring's damage to be increased to 17 damage per tick.

name: Montezuma's Revenge
description: While firing, Isaac charges up a short-ranged Brimstone-like diarrhea beam that shoots behind him.
effects: Continuously shooting for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a short-ranged brown Brimstone laser and corn shots behind himself when he stops shooting.
The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second), ticks up to 19 times and lasts ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
Corn shots deal 6 damage, and a random amount are created each blast.

synergies.text: Montezuma's Revenge, No. 2, Maw Of The Void and Revelation all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at same time.
Brain Worm: Can cause the poop beam to hook to a target anywhere in the room, potentially hitting a target far outside of its usual range.
Dark Arts: The corn Isaac poops out can be sliced, giving Isaac an insane damage up in seconds.

Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the poop beam deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the poop beam under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

Ipecac: The poop beam gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The beam explodes 10 times, either on the first enemy or obstacle it hits or at the very end otherwise, dealing 10 + twice of the beam's damage.
Jacob's Ladder: The brown laser Isaac fires will produce random arcs of electricity at the end of the laser. The corn Isaac poops out does not interact with the electricity.
Lachryphagy: Spawns a large amount of tears at the end of the poop beam, heavily increasing Isaac's damage output.

My Reflection: Causes the poop beam range behind Isaac to become significantly increased as well as having a short range similar to Azazel's beam in front of him. This greatly eases the use of this item allowing for high DPS.
The Parasite: The poop beam splits into two horizontal beams meaning less risk for Isaac and a bigger area for enemies to be hit.

interactions.text: Censer: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.
Eye of the Occult: No effect.

Eye of the Occult + Brimstone/Technology: The poop beam also automatically fires at the crosshair and becomes a lasso. The loop starts where the beam would normally end and extends out to the cross-hair.
Libra: The poop beam ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

needsReview: The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second), ticks up to 19 times and lasts ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
Corn shots deal 6 damage, and a random amount are created each blast.

name: Lil Portal
description: Spawns a familiar that flies forward, consuming pickups in its path and dealing damage to enemies. Each pickup increases its size and damage and spawns a Blue Fly. Every 4 pickups, opens a portal that leads to an unexplored room. After 1 + (stage number) pickups, opens a portal which leads to a special room with contents that persist between floors.
effects: Summons a portal familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots to deal contact damage to enemies.
The portal will launch itself forward after double-tapping.
The portal will consume all pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into blue flies and causing the familiar to become larger and deal more contact damage.

When the familiar consumes 1 + (stage number) pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to a unique purple Clean Bedroom and will disappear for the rest of the floor, respawning upon entering a new floor.

The room contains a random Chest in the top left corner, a chance for a random battery in the bottom left corner, and a chance of Dice Shard, Soul of Eden, Butter!, or Moving Box, in the bottom right corner. In the center of the room is the portal exit, which will bring Isaac back out through the portal he entered.
This room, and any contents within, will remain constant for the rest of the player's run, accessible by any portal.
Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second.

There are 4 distinct sizes, the amount of consumables required to increase size depending on the stage Isaac is in. It is not possible to reach the maximum size in earlier stages before the familiar summons a portal.

interactions.text: R Key: The special room's contents will be reset after using R Key.

needsReview: Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second.

name: Worm Friend
description: Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab and deal damage to enemies over time.
effects: Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab enemies for 4 seconds. Grabbed enemies take damage over time, are slowed, and are unable to move.
Worm Friend deals 4 damage per tick (8 per second), for a total of 32 damage per grab.
Worm Friend can target and restrain bosses in addition to normal enemies, even including endgame bosses such as Ultra Greed.
needsReview: Worm Friend deals 4 damage per tick (8 per second), for a total of 32 damage per grab.

name: Bone Spurs
description: Enemies spawn floating bones on death, which block shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
effects: Enemies spawn 1-2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.
Bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the moment they were created.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the bones' size and damage.
Spin to Win: Boosts the bones' damage while spinning even though there's no visual tell of the effect.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn't spawn bones.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't spawn bones.

needsReview: Enemies spawn 1-2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.

name: Hungry Soul
description: Enemies have a chance to spawn ghosts on death, which chase and deal contact damage to enemies and explode after a short time.
effects: Grants Isaac a chance to spawn a friendly ghost upon killing an enemy, which rapidly chases down and deals contact damage to enemies.
The chance to spawn a ghost is 33% and is not affected by luck.
Ghosts deal contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage, 4 times per second (2x Isaac's damage per second).
After 7 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 flat damage to nearby enemies up to 3-4 times.
The explosion cannot damage Isaac or the environment.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t spawn ghosts.
BFFS!: No effect.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t spawn ghosts.
Ipecac: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, not the expected +20.
Libra: The ghosts ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
Sacrificial Altar: Ghosts cannot be sacrificed.

needsReview: Ghosts deal contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage, 4 times per second (2x Isaac's damage per second).
After 7 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 flat damage to nearby enemies up to 3-4 times.

name: Jar of Wisps
description: Spawns random wisps that shoot various tears, block shots, and deal contact damage. The number of wisps spawned increases every time the jar is used.
effects: Spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac, fires tears, blocks enemy shots, and deals contact damage to enemies, much like the ones spawned by Book of Virtues.

The jar initially spawns only one / two wisps, but spawns an additional wisp each time the jar is used, up to a maximum of 12 per use. The number of wisps that will be spawned by the jar is indicated by both a counter and the jar visually filling up with wisps.
The wisps spawned by the jar can be ones created by any Book of Virtues synergy, although basic wisps are much more common than special variants.

Isaac can have up to 3 rings of wisps; an inner, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 6 wisps, a center, clockwise-spinning ring of 8 wisps, and an outer, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 12 wisps, for a total of 26.

synergies.text: Car Battery: The number of wisps spawned is doubled.
Car Battery + Book of Virtues: The number of wisps spawned is multiplied by 6.

interactions.text: Void: Will spawn only one wisp per use.

name: Soul Locket
description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he picks up a Soul Heart.
effects: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart gained by picking up Soul Hearts or Black Hearts
+0.04 speed.
+0.1 tears.
+0.2 flat damage.
+0.5 range.
+0.04 shot speed.
+0.20 luck.
Spawns a Soul Heart when picked up.

name: Friend Finder
description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.
effects: On use, spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks, similar to Jacob and Esau.
Friendly monsters can take damage from flames, spikes, and other hazards.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Doubles the amount of random friendly monsters spawned.
Forgotten Lullaby: Doubles the fire rate of spawned monsters, if they fire projectiles.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Monsters spawned by Friend Finder are still affected by Ace Cards.

Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.
Eraser: If Friend Finder attempts to spawn an erased monster it will simply fail and waste the charge, instead of choosing a different monster.
Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.
Saturnus: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.
The Soul: Projectiles shot from charmed monsters will be repelled by the aura.
Tick: Friendly enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or more.

name: Inner Child
description: Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.
effects: Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.
If Isaac doesn't have any Red Heart Containers, he will respawn with a Half Soul Heart instead of a Half Red Heart.
When Isaac respawns as the inner child, he emits a blood explosion that deals 35 flat damage to all nearby enemies.
conditionalEffects: Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.

name: Glitched Crown
description: Item pedestals cycle between 5 random items before being picked up.
effects: New item pedestals cycle very quickly between 5 random items.
The 5 items will cycle in the same order every loop.
Items are rerolled at a rate of once every 0.2 seconds.

synergies.text: Spindown Dice: Rerolling a cycling item will reduce the ID number of the displayed item by 1 and randomize the other 4 options.
This allows Spindown Dice to mimic The D6's rerolling effect on 4/5 of Glitched crown's displayed items.
The D6: All 5 items will be re-rolled.

interactions.text: Binge Eater: Adds a random food item to the cycle, for a total of 6 items on the cycling pedestal. Only the pedestals generated after picking up Binge Eater will be affected.
Damocles: Extra item pedestals do not reroll.
Diplopia: The items on-screen at the moment of activation will be duplicated, but the pedestal will also cycle through four new items.
Genesis: If Glitched Crown is picked up during the item sequence, the effect will start on the second item after grabbing Glitched Crown.
0 - The Fool?: Items spawned using the card such as Boom! will not generate a cycling pedestal.

name: Belly Jelly
description: Causes enemies to bounce off of Isaac, dealing damage to them if they hit an enemy or obstacle. Also gives Isaac the chance to deflect enemy shots.
effects: Enemies that touch Isaac will bounce off him and propel in the opposite direction. If they hit an obstacle or wall while bouncing, they will take damage.
If an enemy bounces into another enemy, the second enemy will also take damage.
When an enemy bounces off of Isaac, there's a 50% chance that Isaac won't receive contact damage.
Additionally grants a 50% chance for projectiles to bounce off of Isaac without taking damage.

synergies.text: Aries: Retains the chance to bounce enemies while preventing damage simultaneously.
Book of Shadows / Unicorn Stump: Can be used as a powerful offensive item since Isaac can still bounce off enemies while invincible.
Cone Head / Hallowed Ground / Host Hat / Infamy / Metal Plate / Star of Bethlehem: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.
Gnawed Leaf: The bouncing effect works while Isaac is invincible.
Serpent's Kiss: Allows Isaac to bounce enemies and poison them at the same time, with a decent chance to get a lot more health back in the form of Black Hearts than originally spent.

interactions.text: Panic Button: The active item will still be activated if Belly Jelly blocks damage.

name: Sacred Orb
description: Prevents items of quality 0-1 from appearing, and items of quality 2 from appearing 33% of the time. Quest items are unaffected.
effects: Prevents low-quality items from appearing, greatly increasing the quality of items received from all item pools.
Items with a quality of 0-1 are automatically rerolled.
Items with a quality of 2 have a 33% chance to be automatically rerolled.
Quest items cannot be rerolled.

interactions.text: Bag of Crafting: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
Binge Eater: The food item is not re-rolled.
Death Certificate: Death Certificate's item generation ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.
Dice Bag: The one-time-use dice given by this trinket are not affected.
Expansion Pack: The random effects generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.
Genesis: If obtained from one of the Genesis room pedestals, no effect on future pedestals spawned in the room. Will function normally upon leaving.
Lemegeton: Generated items are affected by Sacred Orb.
Modeling Clay: Temporary items generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.
Sacred Orb: Additional copies of this item provide no benefit. The chance of quality 2 items being rerolled does not increase.
Spindown Dice: Spindown Dice ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.

name: Sanguine Bond
description: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.
effects: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.
Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.

synergies.text: Goat Head: Allows Isaac to enter and leave the Devil Room at will, making this item substantially more powerful, as red hearts can be collected throughout the floor.
Goat Head + Scapular: The spikes generated by Sanguine Bond can be farmed infinitely.
Quitting and reloading the game will also reset the soul heart regeneration provided by Scapular, thus negating the need for Goat Head.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper / Strawman: The pennies that are spawned when stepping on the spikes can be used to heal Keeper and infinitely farm rewards.
Placenta: With a lot of time, the spikes can be farmed infinitely.
Portable Slot: The pennies that are spawned can be gambled to give hearts, allowing more uses.
The Wafer / Percs: Hearts will last twice as long, allowing more uses. Further uses may be obtained by sacrificing the black hearts given, and any hearts added from devil room items.

interactions.text: Callus: Will not prevent the damage from spikes created by Sanguine Bond.
Flat File: Retracts the spikes. The trinket must be dropped and the Devil Deal re-entered for the spikes to appear again.

needsReview: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.

name: The Swarm
description: Spawns eight orbital flies, which turn into Blue Flies after they block a shot. Each time a room is cleared, spawns another orbital fly.
effects: Gives eight orbital flies when picked up.
Each time a fly blocks a projectile, it will turn into a blue fly.
Each time a room is cleared, spawns an orbital fly.
The maximum number of orbital flies Isaac can have is 16.

name: Heartbreak
description: Grants 3 broken hearts and +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has. Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more until Isaac has nothing but broken hearts.
effects: Grants +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has.
Immediately grants 3 broken hearts.
Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more, replacing other types of hearts if necessary, and activates The Necronomicon's effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.
Once Isaac has no non-broken hearts left, he dies. Extra lives will apply at this point.

synergies.text: A Missing Page / Missing Page 2: Deals an additional +40 damage when Isaac dies. Effects stack together and with multiple copies.
Found Soul: The ghost gains 2 extra hits per floor, and every hit they take will damage all enemies in a room as well.

interactions.text: Damocles: Heartbreak does not protect Isaac from Damocles.
Keeper: Keeper will gain 1 broken heart instead of 3. Taking fatal damage will only grant Keeper 1 broken heart.
Magdalene + Birthright: Can hold up to 17 broken hearts, totaling +4.25 damage instead.
Plan C / Suicide King: Heartbreak does not protect Isaac from these effects.
Tainted Eden / Tainted Isaac: The starting broken hearts are removed when Heartbreak is rerolled/dropped. However, any broken hearts gained from lethal damage will persist.
Tainted Jacob: This effect will save Tainted Jacob while he is in his Lost form, adding two broken hearts to his regular health.
Tainted Keeper: Tainted Keeper will gain 1 broken heart instead of 3. Taking any damage will kill him, as he will then have 2 broken hearts.
Mother's Kiss can mitigate this as it gives Tainted Keeper an extra coin heart.
The Lost / Tainted Lost: The Lost has full benefit of the item. This lets him survive 4 extra hits, each hit adding 1 damage, and the 5th is fatal.
Tainted Lost can't normally obtain it, as it doesn't have the offensive item tag.
The Lost / Tainted Lost + Magic Skin / VI - The Lovers?: No broken hearts are added by the item/card, thus having no effect on Heartbreak.

conditionalEffects: Grants +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has.
needsReview: Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more, replacing other types of hearts if necessary, and activates The Necronomicon's effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.

name: Bloody Gust
description: The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.
effects: When Isaac takes damage, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor.
Speed gained per hit is (0.04x previous hits taken) +0.07.
Fire Rate gained per hit is (0.1x previous hits taken) + 0.25.
Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate.
Fire rate bonuses can exceed the normal maximum fire rate limit.

synergies.text: Blood Rights / Razor Blade / IV Bag: The damage from the item counts for the stats up.

Bloody Lust: Bloody Gust's "rage" effect is shared with Bloody Lust, so if Isaac picks up Bloody Lust after already getting hit with Bloody Gust (or vice versa) the boosts will automatically update to that level.
Dull Razor: Safely provides the stat boosts without needing to take damage.

scaled.source: Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate

conditionalEffects: When Isaac takes damage, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor.
Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate.
needsReview: Speed gained per hit is (0.04x previous hits taken) +0.07.
Fire Rate gained per hit is (0.1x previous hits taken) + 0.25.

name: Salvation
description: Gives Isaac a halo that summons beams of light on enemies inside it. The halo grows larger the more times Isaac has taken damage this floor.
effects: Isaac receives an angelic halo around him.

When an enemy comes in contact with the halo, a beam of light starts to form above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing 3.5 damage and creating 4 more beams that shoot out in all cardinal directions.
The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).
If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 152.5 damage.

Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Damaging enemies with Salvation will not take away Isaac's camouflage.
Dark Arts: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.
Gnawed Leaf: The light beams trigger even when Isaac is a statue.

needsReview: The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).

Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.

name: Vanishing Twin
description: Spawns a familiar that becomes a weaker clone of the floor's boss when entering the Boss Room. Defeating it drops an extra item.
effects: Spawns a flat, rotating fetus familiar that follows Isaac.
After entering a Boss Room, the familiar will move closer to the center of the room, and become a clone of the boss. Isaac must defeat both bosses.
The Vanishing Twin and original boss will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and their movements and attack patterns will be around 20% slower.
Upon death, the clone boss will drop an item pedestal where it died from the boss item pool, even if the fight isn't over yet.
The item cannot appear on top of the trapdoor's tile.
The effect doesn't occur against mini-bosses and end-chapter bosses such as Mom, Mom's Heart, Isaac, Satan, etc.
The Vanishing Twin familiar will return when Isaac reaches the next floor.

synergies.text: Sacrificial Altar: The twin can be sacrificed normally at any time.
If sacrificed after it's transformed into a boss, it will still give an item from the sacrifice, but the boss will not disappear and will also not spawn an additional item.

Satanic Bible: Using it before killing the clone boss will cause it to spawn an item from the Devil Room item pool instead of from the Boss item pool. This item must be purchased just like a normal Devil Deal.
There's Options: Will spawn an additional item choice for the item spawned by Vanishing Twin.
Tick: Further lowers the health of both the original boss and its clone.
Vanishing Twin: Picking up multiple copies of the item will result in multiple clones getting spawned.
Each boss will have its health reduced down further to 75% of the health of its previous clone.
Each of the bosses will spawn a separate item.
Each clone of Great Gideon adds 2 extra waves of enemies.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Will increase the fetus' size, although it has no effect after the transformation happens.
Box of Friends: No effect.

IV - The Emperor?: The twin will clone the additional boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. However, this will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the twin won't be active until the next floor.
Meat Cleaver: No effect on the number of items spawned.
Tainted Keeper: If playing as Tainted Keeper, the item dropped by the clone boss will cost money.

name: Twisted Pair
description: Spawns two familiars that float on either side of Isaac and fire tears that use his tears, range, shot speed, and tear effects, and scale with damage.
effects: Spawns two familiars who float by Isaac's side and fire tears that use Isaac's tears, range, shot speed, tear effects and that each deal 0.375x his damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Twisted Pair's tears deal twice as much damage.
Box of Friends/Crooked Penny/Diplopia: Each additional Twisted Pair will add two more familiars that float farther out from Isaac.
Forgotten Lullaby: Increases the fire rate of Twisted Pair.
Tractor Beam: Twisted Pair's tears follow the beam.
Friendship Necklace: Causes the Twisted Pair to orbit Isaac, allowing for a more precise firing of tears.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: Each familiar will fire a missile from a two additional crosshairs. Not Recommended, as the twisted pair crosshairs are not synced to Isaac's crosshair and move at a much slower rate, making self damage much more likely as the additional crosshairs will struggle to make distance from Isaac. This is likely an oversight.
Eye Drops: The familiars do not have the staggered attack, stat bonuses still apply.
Eye of Greed The two familiars will also fire coin tears which spend Isaac's coins. Their shot counter is independent from Isaac's.
Sacrificial Altar: Only 1 item pedestal is spawned for their sacrifice, unless they were spawned through Cambion Conception, in which case they will count for two.
Terra + Brimstone/Technology: While Terra + laser items like Brimstone or Technology don't open doors normally, Twisted Pair's lasers can open doors. This is likely an oversight.

needsReview: Spawns two familiars who float by Isaac's side and fire tears that use Isaac's tears, range, shot speed, tear effects and that each deal 0.375x his damage.

name: Azazel's Rage
description: Isaac builds rage every time a room is cleared. After four rooms, fires a large Brimstone laser when entering the next room.
effects: Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.
After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large Brimstone laser for ~3.33 seconds.
The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).
needsReview: The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).

name: Echo Chamber
quote: I can see see the future future future
description: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.
effects: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.

synergies.text: ? Card + Ancient Recall / Vurp Pill + R Key: The ? Card effect can be used in conjunction with R Key without consuming it, allowing the player to in theory (with the help of Clicker) obtain completion marks for up to four additional routes and characters in a single run.
Ancient Recall: Can be used to spawn many extra cards.

False PHD: Taking benign pills (e.g. puberty) will give black hearts or damage ups for each of the pills that are activated. Caution should be exercised when using this synergy, since the last three pills taken will be converted to their bad counterparts, and one stat down can ruin the synergy.
PHD, Virgo, or Lucky Foot: The last three activated pills are converted to their good counterparts, including pills taken prior to picking up PHD, Virgo, or Lucky Foot.
R Key: Using the R key does not reset the consumable pool, as such they stay the same in Echo Chamber too.
Jera: Allows for repeat duplication of consumables in the room, up to 16x if used four times.
Suicide King + Dead Cat: Can be used to generate many pickups and items at the cost of three extra lives.
Tarot Cloth: Every activated tarot card will be given a bonus effect.
Vurp Pill: Can be used to spawn infinite pills.

interactions.text: Genesis: The consumable pool is reset when Genesis is used, so if it's re-obtained after using Genesis, the previously stored consumable types won't be activated.
Placebo/Blank Card/Clear Rune: Doesn't cause Echo Chamber to activate, or put the pill/card/rune into the queue.

name: Isaac's Tomb
description: Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.
effects: Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.

Old Chests are similar in appearance to Locked Chests and likewise require a Key to unlock, but have the color of a normal Chest and a worn-down appearance. When opened, they contain one of the following
1-3 Soul Hearts (43% chance)
3 trinkets (42% chance)
An Old Chest item (10% chance)
An Angel Room item (5% chance)

synergies.text: Death Certificate : An Old Chest will appear in the Death Certificate area, unless Death Certificate is used on the floor where Isaac's Tomb was obtained.

interactions.text: Crooked Penny / Diplopia: Additional copies of Isaac's Tomb have no effect. Only one chest is spawned at the start of the floor.
Gilded Key / The Left Hand / Mom's Key / Poker Chip: No effect.

name: Vengeful Spirit
description: After taking damage, spawns an orbital wisp that lasts for the entire floor, up to a maximum of six. They fire tears but do not block shots.
effects: When Isaac takes damage, spawns a red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage to enemies (but does not block projectiles). These red wisps last for the entire floor, and Isaac can have up to 6 red wisps at a time.
Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second.
Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the wisps' size, on-hit and contact damage.
Blood Oath: For each half heart of damage taken at the start of the room, a wisp is spawned.

needsReview: Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second.
Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).

name: Esau Jr.
description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.
effects: When used, swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has three Black Hearts, +2 flat damage, and flight. When used as Esau Jr., swaps back to the original character.

Coins, Bombs, and Keys are shared between the two characters, but everything else (including hearts, items, cards/pills, and trinkets) are not shared and apply only to the character that collects them.
When used for the first time, Esau Jr. gains a random item for each item the original character had. Each new item comes from the same item pool the respective original item was taken from.
Trinkets, Cards, Pills, and/or Active items are not given; only passive items are.
Quest items like The Polaroid are given to both characters, as is the Esau Jr. item.
Pickups that would normally be generated by the new items will not drop when Esau Jr. is first used.
If either character dies, they both die, regardless of whether the other character has any remaining health.

If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a familiar that behaves like Abel but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.

synergies.text: Butter!: Puts Esau Jr. on a pedestal and generates an extra copy for the swapped character to hold, duplicating the item.

interactions.text: Bethany: Esau Jr. will have one heart container, but can still gain heart containers up to the character's normal cap. Soul Hearts will still be used as soul charges instead of health.

Blood Oath / Card Reading / Dream Catcher / Empty Heart / Isaac's Tomb / Luna / Missing No. / Voodoo Head: The character that has the item must be active going to a new floor for it to have its effect.

In the case of Luna, the character that has the item must also be active going into Secret Rooms for them to spawn beams of light. However, either character can then enter the beam of light to gain tears and soul hearts.
Car Battery: No effect.

Chaos / Sacred Orb / TMTRAINER: Will affect the items given to Esau Jr. when used for the first time, but will not affect subsequent uses. Item generation is only affected if the character that has it is currently active.
The Forgotten: Esau Jr. will have one empty bone heart and three black hearts if used as The Forgotten, and one additional empty bone heart if used as The Soul.
Genesis: Using Genesis as Esau Jr. will revert back to the original character.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Esau Jr. will have two coin heart containers, but only one is filled.
Lost Soul: The character that holds Lost Soul must be the one to enter a new floor to get its rewards.
'M: Esau Jr. activates as normal, without being rerolled.
Panic Button: Activates Esau Jr. before the active character takes damage, redirecting the damage to the inactive character. The item's charge is used in the process.
Schoolbag: The extra active item will continue to be held by the character that has Schoolbag. However, it cannot gain charges through any means until the character becomes active again.

Tainted Cain: Each item given to Esau Jr. on the first use is based on the item pool of the last spawned item pedestal before each item is crafted. Esau Jr. starts with a separate bag of crafting that has its own inventory and starts empty. The crafting inventories of both characters are saved. Other abilities are unchanged.
Tainted Eden: Taking damage will visually turn Esau Jr. back into Tainted Eden, but will maintain Esau Jr.'s flight and flat damage bonus.
Tainted Jacob: Tainted Jacob and Esau Jr. both become ghosts if any of them get touched by Dark Esau.
Tainted Magdalene: Esau Jr.'s starting black hearts will quickly drain down to half a heart; he must obtain heart containers while in this form to have any survivability.
Void: Has no effect when absorbed.

needsReview: If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a familiar that behaves like Abel but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.

name: Berserk!
description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.
effects: Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply
+0.4 speed.
+3 flat damage .
Tears are replaced by a jawbone melee weapon that is similar to The Forgotten's bone club.
The jaw bone deals 3x Isaac's damage when swung and 1.5x Isaac's damage per tick when thrown (3x Isaac's damage per second).
The swung jaw bone reflects enemy shots.
Reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

The thrown jaw bone charges very quickly compared to the Forgotten's bone club, but as berserk only lasts five seconds, it uses a noticeable amount of the effect's limited duration to charge and throw the jaw bone.
The swung jaw bone can collect pickups and open chests.
A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as IV Bag or Blood Donation Machine.
While Berserking, Isaac's fire rate is halved then increased by 2. This will be a tears upgrade unless Isaac's tears is 4 or above.
If playing as The Forgotten, the x0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.
Killing an enemy while "Berserking" increases Berserk's current duration by 1 second.
Killing an enemy grants very brief invincibility, preventing damage from exploding enemies.
Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 speed until the effect ends.
Isaac is unable to die while Berserk is active. He can be reduced to 0 hearts, but will not die until the effect ends.
This does not apply to insta-kill effects (such as Damocles and Plan C) - they will kill Isaac even if Berserk is active.
This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.

synergies.text: C Section: Replaces club throw with two swings in quick succession which fire a fetus. All fetuses fired will hold bone clubs, similar to the interaction with The Forgotten.
Scapular: If the fatal damage occurs during Berserk state, Scapular will trigger and grant the Soul Heart.

Suplex!: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a Mama Mega! style explosion, destroying all obstacles in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage.

The Lost / Tainted Lost: This can allow either variant of The Lost to survive being damaged if it happens while Berserk is active. Despite having no visible health bar, their health is normally set to a Half Soul Heart. If they take damage while Berserk is active, they will not die if they are able to pick up a Soul Heart or half soul heart before the effect ends. Black Hearts do not count for this.

The Ludovico Technique: While under the Berserk state, you lose control of the Ludovico Technique tear, which can now be deflected by the jaw bone swing, bouncing off nearby walls and dealing damage to enemies.

interactions.text: 4.5 Volt / 9 Volt / Jumper Cables: No effect.
Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.
Car Battery: Duration is only extended if no enemies are killed during the first half, thus only providing a benefit against bosses that can't spawn enemies.
E. Coli / Flush!: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.
Freeze Effects: Killing enemies by freezing them will not extend the timer, which can make it difficult to maintain the duration.
Frozen enemies do extend the timer.

Libra: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra will instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stats with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit due to the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.
Sharp Plug: Isaac will take damage without gaining any charges.

conditionalEffects: +0.4 speed.
If playing as The Forgotten, the x0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.
Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 speed until the effect ends.
needsReview: A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as IV Bag or Blood Donation Machine.
If playing as The Forgotten, the x0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.

name: Dark Arts
description: Briefly grants +1 speed and makes Isaac invulnerable and intangible. When the effect ends, destroys all projectiles and damages all enemies Isaac passed through.
effects: When used, Isaac gains +1.0 speed and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.
The damage of the blast at the end of Dark Arts is equal to the sum of all damage dealt while dashing between enemies.
Bullets walked through will still count for the final blast damage calculation, even though they can't be damaged.

synergies.text: 9 Volt: Halves the time required to charge Dark Arts.
Backstabber: Tagging an enemy from behind will apply bleeding.
The Battery: Second charge can be used while Dark Arts is active.
Camo Undies: The stealth mode given by Camo Undies won't be removed by activating Dark Arts. However, Dark Arts only gives +0.5 speed while Camo Undies is active.
Car Battery: Dark Arts will last twice as long, totalling at 2 seconds per use.
Euthanasia: Dark Arts can apply the Euthanasia effect.
Pause: Activating Dark Arts will not cancel the effect.
Taurus: Dark Arts' speed increase will contribute towards Taurus' activation.
Black Judas / Tainted Judas: For every enemy/bullet he walks through, he will gain a temporary +1 damage bonus, which wears off at a rate of -0.25 damage every half second.
Wisps: Wisps cannot be destroyed while Dark Arts is in effect.

interactions.text: Aries / E. Coli / Midas' Touch / Mom's Heels / Serpent's Kiss / The Virus: On-touch effects won't activate while Dark Arts is active.
The effects will safely activate if Isaac is touching an enemy when he reappears, as there are a few frames where he is immune to damage but can still collide with enemies.
Blood Oath: Using Dark Arts will block the damage, preventing Blood Oath from activating.
Gnawed Leaf: If Isaac is stationary when Dark Arts ends, he will gain invulnerability without any downtime. Dark Arts can also be used from invulnerability without taking damage.
How to Jump: Can be used while Dark Arts is active.
Kamikaze!: Can be activated without harm while using Dark Arts.
Lil Clot / Sumptorium: Clots gain increased speed and are no longer able to fire, but are still vulnerable to damage while Isaac is using Dark Arts.
Mars: Isaac is able to dash while using Dark Arts.
Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Soul will gain the speed increase, but the invulnerability & attack portion of the activation will only apply to Tainted Forgotten.

conditionalEffects: When used, Isaac gains +1.0 speed and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.

name: Abyss
description: Destroys all item pedestals in the room and gives Isaac a unique locust familiar for each item destroyed. Locusts fly forwards in the direction Isaac shoots and damage enemies hit. Destroying certain items spawns special locusts with unique effects.
effects: On use, destroys all items on item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust familiar for each item destroyed.
These locusts are permanent once created, up to a maximum of 64, after which creating more will replace older locusts.
This limit is shared with Blue Flies and Spiders.
The locusts loosely orbit Isaac similarly to regular Blue Flies, charging in the direction Isaac is firing until hitting an enemy, wall, or certain obstacles like key blocks.
The damage locusts deal is a multiplier of Isaac's damage and dependent on the quality of the item destroyed (2-3 times per hit)
Quality 0: 0.5x damage.
Quality 1: 0.75x damage.
Quality 2: 1x damage.
Quality 3: 1.5x damage.
Quality 4: 2x damage.
The locusts may gain additional effects depending on the item destroyed.

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Increases the locusts' size and damage by 25%.
These two items don't stack.
Extension Cord: Electricity will flow between Isaac and the locusts.
Damage dealt by locusts can spawn blue flies.
Ipecac: Locusts gain a flat +2 damage.
Tainted Eden: Abyss can be rerolled, but the locusts are permanent.

interactions.text: Baby-Bender / Box of Friends: Does not affect locusts.
Car Battery: No effect.

Death Certificate: Only allows the consumption of one item per Death Certificate room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
Genesis: The locusts created by Abyss are removed without creating items to replace them.
Sacrificial Altar: Locusts can be sacrificed for items.

Void: If Void consumes Abyss, the latter will take priority and using Void to consume another item pedestal will generate a locust. Even consuming active items will generate a locust, and Void will not copy that active item's effect. This essentially causes Void to act identically to Abyss, albeit requiring 2 more charges per use. Stats and effects of the active items absorbed prior to consuming Abyss are kept and will trigger everytime Void will be used.

conditionalEffects: Quality 0: 0.5x damage.
Quality 1: 0.75x damage.
Quality 2: 1x damage.
Quality 3: 1.5x damage.
Quality 4: 2x damage.
needsReview: Quality 0: 0.5x damage.
Quality 1: 0.75x damage.
Quality 2: 1x damage.
Quality 3: 1.5x damage.
Quality 4: 2x damage.

name: Supper
description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Gives one full Red Heart container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

synergies.text: Binge Eater: When Isaac picks up Supper it now grants: a permanent +0.5 Tears and +1.0 Luck, a temporary +3.6 Damage (which diminishes to 0 in 30 seconds), heals 1 additional red heart, and takes a permanent -0.03 Speed reduction.

name: Stapler
description: +1 Damage. Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye, like Cain.
effects: +1 Damage
Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye, similar to Cain.

interactions.text: 20/20: Isaac will still fire from both eyes.
Blood Clot/Chemical Peel/The Peeper/Stye: Isaac has a 50% chance of firing tears with respective effect each shot.
Conjoined: The side tears are not affected.
R U a Wizard?: Isaac will only fire from his right eye, diagonally.
Eye Drops: Tears are no longer staggered, but increased fire rate remains.
Technology: Isaac will still fire lasers from his left eye.
Technology 2: Isaac no longer fires tears, he instead fires Technology lasers out of his right eye, alongside the Technology 2 beam.
The Wiz: Isaac will still fire from his left eye.

name: Suplex!
description: Isaac dashes forward and picks up the first enemy hit. After a moment, he jumps and slams them into the ground to deal damage and create a circular rock wave.
effects: Upon use, Isaac dashes forward a short distance. If Isaac runs into an enemy while dashing, he picks them up and a crosshair spawns under him that can be controlled with tear controls. After one second, Isaac leaps up and slams down on the crosshair with the enemy, dealing damage to them and any enemies he lands on depending on his size. On impact, this move creates circular rock waves that damage nearby enemies and destroy obstacles.
The damage the slam deals is 50 +/- 10 for each size up/down Isaac has.
Each spike in the rock wave deals 10 damage, and the range of the rock waves increases/decreases for each size up/down Isaac has.
Isaac is immune to damage for the duration of the effect, which allows him to use it to get into Curse Rooms, open Spiked Chests, and travel over spikes without taking damage.
Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars will still deal damage while Suplex! is active.

synergies.text: Berserk! / Soul of Samson / Tainted Samson: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a Mama Mega! style explosion, destroying all obstacles in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage. The reason this interaction exists is that prior to a patch, doing this would instantly kill any enemy, including end bosses. It was then nerfed to only produce an explosion.
Freeze effects: Isaac can suplex frozen enemies.

Friendly enemies: If Isaac uses Suplex! to dash in a room, he will suplex a friendly enemy upon entering the room. This gives more time to react to danger and allows to deal damage to a group of enemies without risk (since the item gives invincibility during suplexes).

Panic Button: As long as Suplex! is fully charged and Isaac is moving, Panic Button automatically triggers when about to take damage, avoiding the damage and potentially grabbing an enemy in the process. Allows Isaac to grab an enemy by simply walking into them, provided the item is charged.
The Virus: The nature of suplexing helps to inherently poison enemies without consequences most of the time.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

Tainted Forgotten: Suplex can only be used while carrying the body or throwing the body, and can only control where he lands after being thrown. Tainted Soul gains the temporary damage immunity, including while Tainted Forgotten is suplexing a target. Tainted Forgotten cannot dash, requiring walking into enemies after using Suplex to grab them.
Safety Scissors: Suplexed Troll Bombs (and their versions) will explode instead of turning into Bomb pickups.

name: Bag of Crafting
description: Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.
effects: Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage.
The swipe scales in size with Isaac's size.
The swipe will appear further from Isaac the higher his range is.
The swipe can be used to open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests without taking damage.
The swipe can be used to block bullets.
The swipe can be aimed at any direction.
Swiping a pickup on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored.
Double pickups like Double Hearts will add two copies to the bag. Blended Hearts will add one red heart and one soul heart.
Sticky Nickels can't be picked up unless unstuck.
Chests and Grab Bag can't be picked up, but can be opened with a swipe even behind obstacles.
If Isaac has enough money to buy a pickup from a Shop, using Bag of Crafting on that pickup will purchase it and automatically add it to the bag.
Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal.
If a recipe would result in an item that hasn't yet been unlocked, a random item will be crafted instead.
There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome.

If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite.
Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory.
Crafting an activated item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups like collecting it would.
hides the crafting preview.
As The Lost, Birthright prevents items with the nolostbr item tag from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting.
As Tainted Lost, items without the offensive item tag will not appear.
As Keeper, items with the nokeeper item tag will not appear.
In Greed Mode or Greedier Mode, items with the nogreed item tag will not appear.
In Daily Challenges, items with the nodaily item tag will not appear.
In Challenge, items with the nochallenge item tag will not appear.
If NO! is held, active items will be skipped.
If Sacred Orb is held, items with Quality 0 or 1 will be skipped. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.

synergies.text: Abyss / Void: Can be used in conjunction with Bag of Crafting to gain a large amount of locusts/stat boosts.

Serpent's Kiss: Due to the high amount of Black Hearts generated by the item, they can be utilized to either craft a high amount of Devil Room items, or a ludicrous amount of Brimstone, due to its recipe always consisting of eight Black Hearts.

Pay to Win / XX - Judgement?: Can be a powerful combination for when Isaac is not Tainted Cain as he can craft multiple item pedestals in the Treasure Room which can be rerolled repeatedly using the generated Shop Restock Machine.

interactions.text: Butter!: Bag of Crafting is dropped before pickups can be collected or items crafted.
Car Battery: No effect.
The Ludovico Technique: Swiping the bag at the Ludovico tear will bat it in the direction of the knockback.

Sacred Orb: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
Tainted Eden: If the Tainted Eden loses Bag of Crafting from a reroll while it contains pickups, then rerolls back into it at a later point, it will still contain the pickups.
Wild Card: Holding up Bag of Crafting counts as an active item use for Wild Card, and can be replicated.
? Card: Does NOT give a free duplicate of whatever the full bag would create.

name: Flip
description: Item pedestals have a second un-interactable "ghostly" item behind them. Activating will flip the real and ghostly items around. If playing as Tainted Lazarus, also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.
effects: While holding Flip, when Isaac enters a new room containing an item (Treasure Room, Shop, etc.), the item pedestal will have a second "ghostly" item behind it.
The real item can be interacted with normally, while the ghostly item cannot.
The ghostly item will vanish if there is no real item on the pedestal and Isaac leaves the room.
Upon use, flips all real / ghostly items around on pedestals, allowing Isaac to collect the ghostly items. Does not affect pedestals that do not contain a ghostly item.
As long as Isaac does not exit the room, empty pedestals can be flipped, meaning both the original item and the flipped ghostly item can be collected.
If playing as Tainted Lazarus, activating it also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.
Tainted Lazarus' Flip also only requires 4 charges.

synergies.text: Eternal D6: When Eternal D6 makes an item disappear, the ghostly item behind it will not be gone and can be taken after using Flip.
Upon using Flip, the new item will be free to take, even if the original item had to be purchased with money or health.

interactions.text: Tainted Isaac / Glitched Crown: The cycling effect only gets applied to the primary item; the ghostly item does not cycle. Using Flip on a cycling item pedestal will cause the currently visible item to switch places with the ghostly one, after which neither item will cycle.
The D6 / Perthro / Dice Shard, etc.: Only rerolls visible item. Ghostly items remain unchanged.
Car Battery: No effect.
Damocles: Additional pedestals will not have ghostly items.
Void: Ghostly items no longer appear when absorbed by Void, rendering Flip useless.

name: Lemegeton
description: Spawns a destructible orbital familiar representing a random passive item, which blocks shots and deals contact damage. While the wisp is alive, Isaac gains that item's effects.
effects: Upon use, Lemegeton will grant a random passive item as an orbital familiar. The item summoned has a 25% chance to be from the current room's Item Pool, or from a random item pool otherwise. The item must have the 'summonable' item tag in order to be generated.
These familiars can block up to 4 shots and/or get hit by 2 explosions before being destroyed. When the familiar is destroyed, the item it granted is lost.
If Isaac is shielded or invulnerable, his familiars are also immune to damage.
Familiars also deal contact damage to enemies equal to 2x Isaac's damage per tick (4x Isaac's damage per second). They take contact damage.
Isaac can have up to 26 familiars: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.
Using Lemegeton while Isaac already has 26 causes the oldest one to be replaced.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the damage of Wisps.
Also applies to Tainted Bethany's Lemegeton, despite not being visually shown.
Rock Bottom: Stat increases remain even after its wisp has been destroyed.
Satanic Bible: Using Lemegeton in a Boss Room after activating the Satanic Bible on that floor will pull from the Devil Room item pool, even if the boss wouldn't normally drop an item after defeat.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Does not double the wisps spawned by Lemegeton.
