Car Battery: Two wisps are created on use, only the name of the second item is displayed. If a Car Battery wisp is created, another wisp is summoned immediately.
Chaos: Item wisps will be selected from random pools, regardless of the room Isaac is in.
Magic Skin: Can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run.
Sacred Orb: Generated wisps are affected by Sacred Orb.
Sacrificial Altar: Every wisp will be converted to a Half Soul Heart. Familiars created by Lemegeton are sacrificed normally.

needsReview: Familiars also deal contact damage to enemies equal to 2x Isaac's damage per tick (4x Isaac's damage per second). They take contact damage.

name: Sumptorium
description: Removes half a heart and creates a Clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tear effects. As Tainted Eve, passively converts health into Clots while firing. Activating returns all Clots to health.
effects: When used by any character other than Tainted Eve, removes half a heart of health upon use and creates a Clot familiar.
Blood clot familiars mimic Isaac's movement (including flight), firing, and tear effects.
Blood clot familiars will mimic all tear-altering effects, such as Spirit Sword.
Holding down the swap button allows Isaac to move independently from the blood clots.

The familiars have health and will be destroyed if they take enough damage. They start with a set amount of HP when spawned, and the health of Red Heart and Rotten Heart Clots will slowly decay down to 1 HP over time, while the health of the other clot types decay down to 5 HP.
Their health decays at a rate of 1 HP per 2.5 seconds.
They are immune to hazards such as spikes, Fire Places, and lasers.
Enemies deal 1 point of contact and projectile damage to them when hit.
Isaac's Bombs and Troll Bombs deal 2 points of damage.
Draining health does not count as taking damage, so creating familiars will not trigger damage-activated effects.
Each type of heart generates a different type of blood clot
Passively, holding down the fire button will create blood clot familiars every two seconds and drain half a heart.

Upon activation, Sumptorium destroys any remaining blood clots and heals Tainted Eve for the same type of hearts that were used to generate them. The blood clots deal 3x Tainted Eve's damage to enemies they pass through as they return.
Should Tainted Eve have more blood clots than room in her health bar when doing this, all excess blood clots will drop next to her.
The charge time is only 1 second rather than 10 seconds.

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: Gives the clots homing shots.
BFFS!: Doubles the clots' size and damage.
Forgotten Lullaby: Increases the clots' fire rate.

Glowing Hourglass: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate the clots. (This is possibly a bug)
Sacrificial Altar: Turns each clot into a penny.
Spin to Win: Makes the clots deal 6 contact damage.
The Ludovico Technique: Spawns a controllable Ludo tear for each clot.
The Ludovico Technique + A Lump of Coal: Each Ludo tear's damage is based off of the distance from its corresponding clot.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Cannot be used to duplicate clots.
Car Battery: Summons 2 clots instead of one for double the health cost. Not Recommended forTainted Keeper as it can instantly kill him.
The Forgotten: In order to stop clots from moving while playing as The Forgotten, it is needed to hold down Left CTRL/RT while switching to The Soul, and vice-versa.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Coin hearts count as Red hearts.
Lazarus / Revival Items: Clots will be retained after losing the extra life.
The Lost / Tainted Lost: Sumptorium spawns a blue clot and kills The Lost and Tainted Lost immediately upon use. However, they can still get golden clots without dying if they pick up a golden heart.
My Reflection: Clots' tears will be redirected to Isaac instead of returning back to them.
Strawman: Clots will follow Strawman instead of Isaac if they were spawned in a previous room.
Tainted Eden: Clots made by Sumptorium are retained after taking damage.
Tainted Forgotten: Clots made by Sumptorium have a club too, but they are commanded by Tainted Soul, making it the only way to attack while moving freely.
Tractor Beam: Clots' tears will be fired from Isaac instead, and will stay within the tractor beam.

needsReview: Isaac's Bombs and Troll Bombs deal 2 points of damage.

name: Recall
description: Retrieves the Forgotten's body from any distance. Only available as the Birthright effect for Tainted Forgotten.
effects: Retrieves the Tainted Forgotten's body automatically, even from a distance.
Tainted Soul is invincible while Tainted Forgotten is returning to him (except to Devil Beggars and similar forms of self-damage).
Tainted Forgotten will deal ~4-6 times Isaac's damage to enemies that collide with it while it's returning to the Soul.

name: Hold
description: Exclusive to Tainted ???. Allows him to save one poop bomb for later, allowing him to gather more over time.
effects: Removes Tainted ???'s leftmost poop, storing it inside of Hold and cycling to the next poop.
Using Hold again while a poop is inside it will remove the poop and use it as expected.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

name: Keeper's Sack
description: Gives range, speed, or damage when buying things from a shop. Spawns three coins and a Key on pickup.
effects: Spawns 3 random coins and a Key on the floor when picked up.
Every 3 coins spent on items and pickups grants in a cycle: +0.5 damage, then +0.25 range, then +0.03 speed.

interactions.text: Bag of Crafting: Purchasing a pickup by swinging the Bag of Crafting at it will still give the stat upgrades from Keeper's Sack.
Diplopia/Crooked Penny: Extra copies of Keeper's Sack do not grant any more stats from purchasing items.
Steam Sale: As items/pickups cost less money, Isaac will gain fewer stats for making the same purchases.
Store Credit: Anything bought will not give stats.
Tainted Keeper: Every Devil Room, Treasure Room, Angel Room etc. will give stat ups, as long as the items are bought.

scaled.source: Every 3 coins spent grants in a cycle: +0.5 damage, then +0.25 range, then +0.03 speed (averaged per step)

conditionalEffects: Every 3 coins spent on items and pickups grants in a cycle: +0.5 damage, then +0.25 range, then +0.03 speed.

name: Keeper's Kin
description: Rocks and other Obstacles spawn blue spiders over time while in a room with enemies, and spawn two blue spiders when destroyed.
effects: If Isaac is in a room with enemies, rocks and rock-like obstacles will occasionally spawn blue spiders.
Causes all rocks to spawn 0-2 blue spiders when destroyed.

synergies.text: Compost : Will double the current amount of blue spiders.
D12: Due to the high tendency of replacing rocks with TNT, it allows for easy destruction of nearby rocks, resulting in lots of blue spiders.
Leo / Mega Mush / Notched Axe / / Sulfuric Acid / Terra / Thunder Thighs: As Isaac can break all reachable rocks, he can amass a lot of blue spiders.
Mega Mush : When Isaac destroys blocks it will produce blue spiders.

name: Keeper's Box
description: Spawns a random Shop item or pickup which can be bought for its normal price.
effects: Upon use, spawns a random pickup or item, which must be bought for its normal Shop price.
Items generated will always be shop items and pickups will only be those that can appear for sale in shops.
The only exception to this is Black Sacks, which can replace Grab Bags despite not being able to do so in shops.
There is an an equal ~11.1% chance to spawn a card, pill, bomb, key, battery, item, soul heart, red heart, or sack.

synergies.text: Coupon / Mr. ME! / Crooked Penny + Schoolbag: Spawned pickups/items can be made free.
D20 + Schoolbag: Rerolled pickups have a chance to reroll into an item from the current room's item pool.
Keeper's Sack: Stat upgrades from the spawned pickups/items can be gained even when shops become unavailable (Floors after the Mom fight excluding ???).

Restock: Buying spawned pickup or item in Shop will always restock into the same thing as what's being sold in the upper left of the shop and their prices will never increase. This still works even if the top left slot was already bought before having Restock. This does not work outside of the shop. It also works in Greed and Greedier modes, respawning them as Keys (since the leftmost pickup is always a key).
Steam Sale: Spawned pickups/items will be on sale.

interactions.text: Adoption Papers: Does not affect Keeper's Box items, meaning both familiars and shop items can be purchased in tandem over the course of a run.
Chaos / Sacred Orb / TMTRAINER: Affects items spawned by the box.
Glitched Crown / Tainted Isaac: The alternate item(s) will be from the pool of the room it is used in.
Store Credit: Cannot be used on consumables or items spawned by Keeper's Box outside of the Shop.
Shop Restock Machine: Using a Restock Machine in a Shop will remove every spawned pickup/item. Using the machine outside of the shop will only reroll items.

name: Everything Jar
description: Spawns certain pickups based on how many charges it has. If fully charged, instead has one of many unique effects.
effects: Everything Jar can be activated while not fully charged.
If the item is not fully charged, it spawns a pickup based on how many charges it had
1: A Poop.
2: A Penny.
3: A Bomb.
4: A Key.
5: A full Red Heart.
6: A pill.
7: A card, rune, or soul stone.
8: A Soul Heart.
9: A Gold Heart.
10: A Golden Key.
11: A Golden Bomb.
If the item is fully charged, it instead has one of the following effects
Spawns a random amount of various different pickups, including coins, hearts, bombs, keys, cards, pills, and trinkets.
Spawns a Fly.
Spawns an assortment of friendly dips, blue spiders, and blue flies.
Spawns random enemies in front of every door and closes the doors.
Enemies also spawn in front of adjacent Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms if there are any.
Does nothing.
Spawns an item pedestal that cycles between 9 different items 30 times per second. The item selection is from the current room's item pool.
Spawns many colored beams of light around the room that deal damage to enemies. These beams of light varyingly scale with Isaac's damage.
Fills the room with Poop, similarly to A Card Against Humanity
Spawns 6 Troll Bombs around the room, similarly to Anarchist Cookbook.
Flips all sprites to the side, gives Isaac random tear effects for the rest of the room, and permanently increases and decreases one of Isaac's stats, similarly to Dataminer.
This also rerolls any item in the room into a glitched TMTRAINER item.
Spawns many Shopkeepers around the room. These have a chance to be special/error shopkeepers.

Spawns a Giga Bomb pickup that gives Isaac a bomb and converts his next bomb into a giga-bomb that deals 300 blast damage, spawns many rock projectiles that deal 15 damage, and creates 13 holes in a diamond shape around the blast zone that deal 99 damage to enemies that were in their areas. These holes cannot spawn if they would close Isaac's path around the room.
This bomb has a chance to be lit when it spawns.

synergies.text: Hallowed Ground: Using the first charge will always spawn a white poop.
Bag of Crafting: Allows Isaac to consistently produce high quality pickups or specific types of pickups for use in known recipes.
Mama Mega! + Schoolbag: Consistent spawning of golden bombs allows for Mama Mega to be reused repeatedly.

interactions.text: 9 Volt: Fully recharges Everything Jar upon pickup. It also slowly recharges Everything Jar's first charge while Isaac is in an uncleared room.
Car Battery: Instead of doubling its effect, Everything Jar will spawn a poop alongside its normal drop.
Glitched Crown / Soul of Isaac / Tainted Isaac: The rapidly cycling item pedestal does not gain more items in its selection or slow down.
Void: Consuming the Everything Jar will cause Void to spawn a poop when used, regardless of charge level.

name: TMTRAINER
quote: ZZaZZ ZZdZZiZZmZZhZZ ZZvZZ ZZoZZ ZZ ZZsZZlZZhZZsZZoZZaZZiZZ
description: Causes all future items to be "glitched", granting them completely random effects.
effects: When picked up, all future items become "Glitched", causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items as well as effects that are not normally controlled by the player, such as enemy spawning and other behind-the-scenes effects.
Quest items do not become glitched. This includes: The Polaroid, The Negative, Key Piece 1, Key Piece 2, Knife Piece 1, Knife Piece 2, Dad's Note.
Additionally, the currently playing music will fade out. The silence will remain until another music track plays.
Any enemies in the room will also become simultaneously frozen and set on fire.
"Glitched" items can be passive or active and are completely randomly generated with practically infinite possibilities. There is a 75% chance that the item will be passive.
Random effects combine effects that exist on other items, and assign them to a random event (e.g. on enemy death, on room clear, on damage taken etc.).
These effects may also be derived from installed modded items.
Glitched items sold for money cost a random amount of pennies up to 99 pennies.

interactions.text: 'M: Rerolls glitched actives into other glitched actives.
Bag of Crafting: Recipes are not glitched.
Binge Eater: Functions as intended, cycling pedestals between a glitched item and an HP up item.
Death Certificate: TMTRAINER will not apply to Death Certificate's items.
Diplopia: Glitched items are copied normally. Pedestals spawned before acquiring TMTRAINER will duplicate into a glitched item.
Dream Catcher: Cannot identify glitched items.

Genesis: Removes TMTRAINER's effect and allows items to spawn normally again, including items which appear in the special Bedroom created by Genesis. This also applies to glitched items which invoke Genesis' effect.
Lemegeton: Spawns wisps of glitched items. All wisps look like The Sad Onion, but this is purely aesthetic. The wisps do not have any items' effects.
Magic Skin: All summoned items will be glitched. Magic Skin cannot replace future glitched items after being left behind.
Missing No.: Can reroll TMTRAINER, but not any previously acquired glitched items.
Modeling Clay: Cannot transform into glitched items. Will visually vanish from sight, but is still held and can be dropped as normal.
Spindown Dice: Glitch items will disappear if rerolled.
Tainted Cain: Can craft TMTRAINER but it will have no effect other than giving shop items random prices which are most often overpriced.

name: Anima Sola
description: Chains down the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, preventing them from moving or attacking.
effects: Upon use, chains down the nearest enemy, completely preventing them from acting for 5 seconds.
This effect works on enemies that are invulnerable.
If used again, it releases the enemy early.
If multiple enemies are chained down at once, the enemy released early will be the one closest to Isaac even if Dark Esau is chained down too.
While playing as Tainted Jacob
Anima Sola will always target Dark Esau if he is present.

While Dark Esau is chained down, using Anima Sola again will release him and cause him to charge directly at Tainted Jacob, damaging and burning enemies in its path. This will not use up additional item charges.
Dark Esau deals no contact damage to Jacob while chained down.
If used in a room with no enemies, Anima Sola will immediately summon Dark Esau.
If Birthright is obtained, the recharge time is lowered to 10 seconds and the chain duration is increased to 6.67 seconds.

synergies.text: 9 Volt: Halves recharge time, allowing for chaining enemies much more frequently.

Car Battery: Two enemies will be chained simultaneously. If only one valid enemy is present, it will be chained for twice the duration. Using Anima Sola again will unchain the enemy closest to Isaac first.

name: Spindown Dice
description: Reduces the internal ID number of all items in the room by one, turning them into the item with that number.
effects: Rerolls all pedestal items in a room by decreasing their internal ID number by one until a valid item is rolled. This effect occurs per item and is independent of any other items in the room.
Unlockable items will be skipped if they are not unlocked.

synergies.text: Glitched Crown / Isaac with Birthright / Tainted Isaac: Rerolling a cycling item will reduce the ID number of the displayed item by 1 and randomize all other options. This may allow Isaac to acquire items with large ID numbers by jumping to a higher ID.

interactions.text: Car Battery: All future rerolls turn into the item that is 2 less than the previous ID.
The Sad Onion: Disappears upon being rerolled, as its internal ID number is 1.
TMTRAINER / : Glitch items will disappear if rerolled.

name: Hypercoagulation
description: After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, launches Red Hearts from Isaac that despawn after 1.5 seconds.
effects: After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, he drops a Red Heart that despawns after 1.5 seconds.
The heart dropped depends on the source: half-hearts of damage taken drop Half Red Hearts, and full hearts of damage taken drop full hearts.
The hearts will get launched out of Isaac with momentum, making them difficult to pick up.
If Isaac is firing tears as he gets hit, the heart will get launched in that direction.

synergies.text: Ace Cards / Diplopia / D1 / Jera: Converted/duplicated hearts will not disappear.
Blood Rights / Razor Blade: Damage taken to use the item also spawns hearts, reducing the cost of using them. The first usage of these items each room will spawn a full red heart.
Cancer / Percs! pill / The Wafer: Damage sources that spawn full red hearts will still spawn a full red heart despite the cost being reduced to half a heart.
Dull Razor: Can be used to spawn full red hearts for Isaac to pick up.
Humbleing Bundle: Red Heart spawns can be converted to Double Hearts.

interactions.text: Cambion Conception: By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the half-red hearts, Isaac can easily generate powerful familiars for free.
Candy Heart / Immaculate Conception: The hearts will count toward gaining stat boosts/familiars.
Compost: The temporary heart will be converted into a Blue Fly/Spider.
D20 / GB Bug: Rerolled hearts will still disappear.
Daemon's Tail: Hearts spawned do not turn into keys but simply do not spawn 80% of the time, and the 20% that do spawn will always be Black Hearts.
Glass Cannon: Spawns two more full red hearts when Glass Cannon breaks, regardless of how much health was lost to it.
Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Spawns blue flies upon getting hit, essentially granting them the same effect as Infestation.
IX - The Hermit?: The heart will not be converted to coins.
IV Bag: Doesn't spawn hearts.
Maggy's Bow: Doubles the healing received from the hearts spawned.
Magneto / Super Magnet: Will immediately start pulling the dropped hearts to Isaac, breaking their momentum and making collection much easier.

needsReview: After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, he drops a Red Heart that despawns after 1.5 seconds.

name: IBS
description: Causes Isaac to throw poop, create buffing creep, or drop bombs while fighting enemies.

name: Hemoptysis
description: Double-tapping a fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. Affected enemies are cursed and take more damage from Brimstone-like attacks.
effects: Double-tapping the fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. The sneeze deals damage equal to 1.5x Isaac's damage, knocking enemies and projectiles back. Knocked back enemies take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) additional damage if they hit a wall or obstacle, and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.
The sneeze has a cooldown of 1 second.
The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage to enemies if it would have caused Isaac half a heart of damage, and 7 damage if it would have caused Isaac a full heart damage.

The sneeze applies a curse to enemies. Enemies under the curse will take more damage from Brimstone-like laser attacks and violently explode on death, damaging and spreading the curse to nearby enemies. Any enemies spawned by those under the curse will also be cursed.
The following attacks will deal increased damage (2x damage +3 flat damage)
Brimstone attacks from Azazel/Tainted Azazel
Athame
Brimstone
Brimstone Bombs
Head of Krampus
Lil Abaddon
Lil Brimstone
Maw Of The Void
Montezuma's Revenge's brimstone (not tears)
Mega Blast
Shoop da Whoop!
Trisagion
Urn of Souls' brimstone (while holding Birthright with Judas or Black Judas)
The curse lasts for 5 seconds.

synergies.text: Fire Mind: The sneeze will still set enemies on fire, but not cause explosions, similar to its interaction with Brimstone.
Loki's Horns: Chance to sneeze in all cardinal directions.
Monstro's Lung: Multiple sneezes are applied around the character.
The Wiz: Shoots two sneezes diagonally instead of one straight forward.
Ipecac: The sneeze causes an explosion. The explosion deals additional damage equal to 3x Isaac's damage +10 and will not hurt Isaac.

name: Ghost Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Bombs become spectral and spawn ghosts that deal contact damage to enemies and explode after 10 seconds.
effects: Gives Isaac 5 Bombs.
Isaac's bombs create ghosts when they explode, which rapidly chase and deal contact damage to enemies.
The ghost deals contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage per tick (2x Isaac's damage per second).
After 10 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies up to 3 times and destroying nearby projectiles. Isaac does not take damage from the explosion.
If there are no enemies in the room, the ghost follows Isaac. However, it cannot follow Isaac between rooms.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus: Has a chance to shoot a Ghost Bomb that also has spectral properties and can travel through objects.
Scatter Bombs: Split bombs create ghosts that instantly launch themselves at enemies and explode, similar to Purgatory. They each deal 2x Isaac's damage, up to 4 times.
Mr. Mega: Ghosts appear larger and do extra damage only upon exploding.

interactions.text: Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: No effect.
Ipecac: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, not the expected +20.
Libra: The ghosts ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

name: Gello
description: Spawns a demon familiar for the current room attached to Isaac that moves and fires in the direction Isaac shoots, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.
effects: Spawns a demon familiar attached to Isaac by a cord for the current room, floating in the direction Isaac shoots. It automatically fires tears (whenever Isaac is shooting) in the direction of the closest enemy to it, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.
The item is initially held over Isaac's head until he fires, which launches the familiar in the direction he shoots, dealing 3x Isaac's damage to all enemies it passes through.
If Isaac has any tear modifier that requires him to charge his shots (i.e. Brimstone), Gello will automatically release its shot every time it is fully charged.
Gello's tears deal 0.75x Isaac's damage.

synergies.text: Tainted Azazel: Each time Gello starts charging an attack, he will "sneeze" just like Tainted Azazel does, cursing enemies in front of him. This allows Tainted Azazel to keep enemies cursed without needing to come up to a dangerously close distance to them.
Tainted Lazarus: The familiar persists when switching states.
Uranus: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide if Isaac is moving, similarly to when kicked by Isaac.
Lilith / Tainted Lilith: Gello's tears deal 1.0x of Isaac's damage instead.

name: Decap Attack
description: Throws Isaac's head, which is still able to fire tears at the spot it lands. Reactivating the item or stepping on the head reattaches it.
effects: Throws Isaac's head while allowing to shoot from the spot it lands, blocking enemy shots as well as dealing contact damage to nearby enemies. Meanwhile, Isaac's body can no longer shoot tears.
The head does 24 damage on impact and 4 damage per tick (12 damage per second) on contact when it's on the ground.
The head can return by picking it up with the body, or by using the item again without requiring charges. Both the throwing and retaking of the head can deal damage to enemies passing through.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.

The Forgotten: The head changes in sync when switching between The Forgotten and The Soul. The Forgotten's bone attack still belongs to the body, while The Soul's tear attack belongs to the head as expected.
Tainted Forgotten: Throws the head of Tainted Forgotten, but the bone attack still remains on his body. The head can only be recalled by reactivating the item or having the body touch the head.
Transcendence/The Pinking Shears: Isaac is invisible apart from his shadow while both items are active.
Mom's Knife: The knife still follows and shoots from the body, the head doesn't shoot tears.

name: G FUEL!
description: Grants various effects based on the amount of G FUEL! obtained. Only appears on certain Daily Challenges or with an easter egg seed.
effects: A can of G FUEL! is available at the start of every floor. Floors affected by will give two cans.
Some of G FUEL!'s effects depend on how many copies of the item Isaac has
Replaces Isaac's tears with various "guns".
The first can simply increases damage, tears, and shot speed without replacing tears.
The second can replaces Isaac's tears with bullets.
The third can changes the firing pattern into two accurate, rapid-fire streams of bullets. Changes Isaac's stats similarly to Soy Milk.
The fourth can changes the attack into a buckshot shotgun, shooting a large spread of pellets which bounce on impact with obstacles.
The fifth can changes the attack into a slug shotgun, shooting a single high damage projectile that bounces on impact with obstacles.
The sixth can changes the attack into a minigun, rapidly shooting bullets with low accuracy. This also pushes Isaac back depending on the firing speed.
The seventh can changes the attack into a rocket launcher, shooting explosive rockets that detonate on impact.
The eighth can onwards gives Isaac a random weapon from the ones listed above.
The ninth can onwards adds random tear effects to bullets.
Starting with the second copy, speeds up the game every time it's picked up.
Starting with the fourth copy, non-boss enemies have a chance to multiply, with further copies increasing the number of enemies.
Each copy increases the amount of screen shake caused by gunfire and enemy explosions.
Grants +0.2 Speed. Ignores the speed cap. Collecting other speed up items will also break the cap.
Unlike other items that change speed, G FUEL causes one of Jacob and Esau characters to move faster than the other.
All explosion sprites are replaced with stock explosion footage. Certain bosses have special explosion animations.
All enemies explode on death. These explosions do not deal damage and do not destroy objects.
All consumable spawn animations will be accompanied by explosion sprites as well.
Enemies grant far more score on death than usual, and the amount is displayed when they die.
All water and blood in rooms is replaced with a light blue liquid (presumably G Fuel).
Pressing the "drop" button plays an airhorn sound effect.
Most "special floor tiles" are replaced with special G Fuel floor tiles.
Replaces Isaac's nightmares during floor transition with G Fuel-themed versions.
conditionalEffects: The first can simply increases damage, tears, and shot speed without replacing tears.
